chapters.title: Chapter 301: The Smoother Things Go, the More Vigilant One Must Be
paragraphs: Seeing the introduction on the light screen,
even Yang Fan couldn’t help but gasp at this moment.
Although the other talents were powerful, the one that truly kept his eyes fixed on it was the Growth of All Things at the very top.
Just by looking at those few simple lines of introduction, his heart began to beat violently.
“Yang Da.”
“Can this Growth of All Things stack with Hundred-fold Evolution?”
Yang Fan asked immediately.
Yang Da did not answer immediately, but instead placed his finger on his temple.
A massive stream of data flashed rapidly deep within his pupils, as if he were remotely connecting with other Intelligent Life within the Divine Kingdom.
A moment later, Yang Da raised his head abruptly, his face revealing irrepressible ecstasy.
“Master! The results are out!”
“I just ordered Yang Yi to mobilize all computing power to continuously monitor the resource output of a Spiritual Vein.”
“After comparative calculations, the resource output efficiency per unit of time has indeed increased tenfold!”
“This means that Growth of All Things and Hundred-fold Evolution can definitely stack!”
Speaking of this, even Yang Da’s voice was somewhat excited.
“As expected of an S-rank Talent!”
“Growth of All Things is essentially similar to the S-rank Talent, Tenfold Time Sequence.”

“The latter absorbs the vitality of the Divine Kingdom to increase the Cultivate speed of believers, while the former is purely a resource-type talent that only affects the output gains of the Divine Kingdom!”
“The two do not conflict with each other!”
“One month in the outside world is still three thousand years of Evolution in the Divine Kingdom.”
“But the cumulative output of various resources is equivalent to thirty thousand years!”
Boom!
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt his mind roar.
The next moment, he suddenly spread his arms, and the emotions he had suppressed for so long erupted completely.
“Hahahaha!”
The laughter echoed throughout the entire Divine Kingdom hall.
At this moment, he felt as if he had already seen the future.
He saw countless gods bowing at his feet, saw billions of believers crossing the Void Realm, and saw Divine Kingdom warships blotting out the sky.
“Ten years of the cultivation path to grasp the universe, ten thousand years of time held in my palm. Today I borrow the power of my talent, one day all gods shall call me master!”
The voice echoed, lingering for a long time.
At this moment, Yang Fan felt a nearly invincible confidence for the first time.
Under normal circumstances, the further the Divine Kingdom develops into its Late Stage, the slower its speed becomes.
Looking at the entire Human Race, those low-tier gods have easily survived for tens of thousands of years.
And as for High-Order Gods like Gu Xuanting, how long have they actually lived?
I’m afraid even he himself might not remember clearly.
But now, the appearance of Origin Evolution seems to completely shatter this perception.
Looking back, it seems Yang Fan actually moved the slowest during the Divine Being stage.
As his strength continuously improved, the path under his feet not only didn’t become rugged, but instead became smoother and wider.
SSS-rank Talent!
As expected of an existence that has no records in the entire Human Race database!
This is the feeling of truly having a cheat code!
After a long while, Yang Fan finally calmed down and slowly walked toward the throne.
The moment he sat down, the arrogance and excitement on his face gradually disappeared.
Replacing them was his usual calmness and depth.
“Yang Da, from now on, do not continue to purchase large quantities of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and enlightenment ancient tree in the form of reinvestment.”
“From now on, the total number purchased each month must not exceed ten thousand.”
Hearing this, Yang Da was visibly stunned.
“Master, why is that?”
According to his calculations, after possessing Growth of All Things, the growth rate of the Divine Kingdom’s wealth would only become more exaggerated.
He could completely continue to invest the profits to achieve snowball-style growth.
Before long, all Spiritual Veins within the Divine Kingdom could be replaced with Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.
“Divine Kingdom investment is to obtain Divinity Points.”
“Obtaining Divinity Points is to make the believers stronger.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
“But do you think that with the current thousandfold profit output, the believers in my Divine Kingdom can really consume such vast resources?”
Yang Da was slightly taken aback upon hearing this.
“The smoother things go, the more vigilant one must be.”
“Our cash flow is already too massive.”
“If we continue to reinvest according to the old method, every Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest that appears at auctions will be bought up by us.”
“Sooner or later, it will attract the attention of those with ulterior motives.”
“Moreover, we still don’t know what the origin of the Dark Web is.”
“For the unknown, one must maintain reverence.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze became increasingly deep.
“Our most important task right now is not making money.”
“But strengthening the Divine Kingdom and strengthening the believers.”
“Store grain broadly, build high walls, and postpone proclaiming oneself king.”
As the calm words fell, the entire Divine Kingdom hall fell into silence.
The data stream in Yang Da’s eyes flickered continuously.
A moment later, he bowed respectfully, “Master is wise.”
After explaining the overall follow-up plan for the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom and returned to the real world.
As expected, just as Gu Xuanting said, the news of his Breakthrough to godhood spread throughout Taichu City without any delay.
All kinds of messages appeared one after another.
There were congratulations from Geniuses of the same cohort, as well as congratulatory messages from some senior students.
There were even quite a few forces sending gifts through the Virtual World.
Divine Kingdom buildings, Divinity Points, rare Materials... everything one could ask for.
There were also several large companies that sent collaboration invitations directly, with extremely generous terms.
Yang Fan just took a brief look.
Following Gu Xuanting’s reminder, he accepted all those free gifts without exception.
As for invitations for cooperation, meetings, and the like, he ignored them all.
He was a member of the Gu Family now; maintaining boundaries was far more important than short-term benefits.
Besides that, he also received several dinner invitations.

Sima Bang and Ye Jianfeng jointly sent a message, inviting him to a small gathering at Yuexiang Pavilion. Their tone was very polite, and they even specifically stated that if he was busy, it would be fine to reschedule for another day.
On the other side was a message from Wen Yushui.
This name, which hadn’t been contacted for a long time, appeared again in the communication list.
The other party’s words were brief, but clearly expressed a desire to meet.
Yang Fan glanced at it, didn’t reply, and skipped it directly.
The last one was from Lu Wan.
The woman from the Lu family who introduced the rules to him in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone back then.
The content of the message was very simple: [A private room has been prepared on the top floor of the Lu Family Restaurant.]
Yang Fan frowned slightly, feeling troubled.
Lu Wan’s status was similar to Gu Le’s.
He couldn’t easily refuse and offend the Lu family, nor was it appropriate to get too close and cause unnecessary misunderstandings.
After thinking for a moment, Yang Fan forwarded this message to Gu Le.
Not long after, Gu Le said “Got it” with satisfaction, then stood up and walked into the room, closing the door.
The moment the door closed, the entire room was completely isolated.
The soundproofing here was extremely strong, even utilizing high-tier isolation Materials produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.
Even perception at the god level could not peek in at all.
Yang Fan did not know what happened inside.

Shortly after, Gu Le walked out of the room again, her cheeks slightly flushed, her breathing slightly rapid, and her expression somewhat complex, as if she had just experienced quite a “confrontation”.

chapters.title: Chapter 302: A Waste?
paragraphs: Yang Fan glanced at it and didn’t ask any further.
As long as the trouble was resolved, it was fine.
In the following days, Yang Fan remained as usual, quietly waiting in Taichu City for the official transfer orders from the Primordial Academy.
A month quickly passed.
By now, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already sunk deep into his divine kingdom.
Under the hundredfold Time Evolution, this single month was a full three thousand years for the divine kingdom.
The changes in the divine kingdom were an earth-shaking expansion and restructuring.
The two most prominent changes were the Immortal Court and the Zombie Kingdom.
As the territory of the divine kingdom continued to expand, the S-Rank Building “Immortal Court” also expanded to a new scale.
The believers of the Cultivation system still occupied the core area, and the density of Spiritual Qi far exceeded the past.

They did not need Yang Da to purchase a large number of residential buildings from the Divine Shop; the Immortal Court itself was enough to support the Cultivation and Breeding of all Cultivation believers.
Here, Cultivating and Breeding had almost become their only daily routine.
On the other side, the Eternal Corpse Mine had also undergone astonishing changes.
With the expansion of the divine kingdom, its living space had long since become like an independent zombie ecological continent.
Yang Da purchased a large number of Spirit Plants similar to “Corpse Flowers” from the Divine Shop and spread them across the entire area, forming a stable cycle of Death Qi.
At the same time, a large number of foreign race corpses were continuously thrown into the Life Essence Conversion Pool.
In just over ten years of divine kingdom time, this area had gradually restored to its former appearance.
Meanwhile, the scale of the cloning nutrient pods was also expanded to an astonishing hundred-billion level.
A large number of clones were continuously released into the Eternal Corpse Mine, being transformed into ordinary zombies at the initial stage.
Afterwards, they continuously evolved and made Breakthroughs, promoting to Zombie Generals and becoming Yang Fan’s new believers.
Yang Da purchased nine elf holy trees through the Gu Family’s channels, and now the number of Adult Elves had also skyrocketed.
Fortunately, with the existence of the World Tree, the living environment of the Elf Race was now very abundant.
The development of the Mechanical Civilization and the Martial Arts system was relatively slow.

In terms of the Martial Arts system, Yang Da continuously expanded the Martial Arts arenas and supporting cities, while also adjusting the allocation of Resources, relocating some core areas to city-states with higher Spiritual Qi, and providing more generous Resources and benefits.
Only in a more stable and prosperous new environment would believers be more willing to breed and expand their population size.
As for the Mechanical Civilization, it was completely constrained by time and learning progress.

Even with the Legacy system of the “Goddess of Wisdom,” those Intelligent Life still needed to gradually modify their own structures through the Mechanical Heart, absorbing knowledge through continuous trial and error.
Three thousand years was still too short for the Mechanical Civilization.
Fortunately, the initial believers of the current Mechanical Civilization no longer relied on other believers to breed.
Similar to the Zombie System, the earliest believers all came from the lives in the cloning nutrient pods.
Afterwards, through self-iteration and mechanization modifications, they formed Intelligent Life.
On the vast land of the divine kingdom, the former wilderness had long been completely transformed.
Cities began to expand outward, and the prototypes of towns were constantly taking shape.
However, more areas were still undeveloped, covered by dense Spirit Plants and naturally evolved vegetation.
The entire land of the divine kingdom was like a giant world that was waking up.
Order was being established, civilization was diversifying, and the combat power of the believers was growing crazily.
Yang Fan was extremely satisfied with all these changes.
In just one month of real-world time, he could clearly feel that his own strength was at least more than twice as strong as before.
The overall combat power of his believers was skyrocketing at an almost exponential rate.
With a thought from Yang Fan, the information of the divine kingdom appeared before his eyes.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 10 billion square kilometers
Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Authority: Time Evolution (100x); Second Divine Authority: Origin Evolution]
[S-rank Talent: Growth of All Things] [A-rank Talent: Battle Body] [A-rank Talent: Spiritual Body] [A-rank Talent: Divine Craftsman] [B-rank Talent: Breeding]

Believers: Core Formation (55 million), Foundation Establishment (660 million), Martial King (13 million), Martial Master (440 million)... Third-class Intelligent Life (11 million), Second-class Intelligent Life (14.5 billion), Zombie King (5.8 billion)...
Professions: Alchemist (3.8 billion), Blacksmith (15.6 billion), Talisman Master (440 million), Formation Master (670 million)...
Vassals: Elven Warriors (9.8 billion)
Techniques: Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array (B-rank, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-rank, Major Achievement), Zombie Tide Dance (C-rank, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 102 trillion (...)

Buildings: Fountain of Life x3 million, War God Codex (S-rank), Heavenly Court (S-rank), Goddess of Wisdom (S-rank), Eternal Corpse Mine (S-rank), World Tree (S-rank), Great Void Warship x30 (S-rank), Mechanical War Puppet x40 (S-rank), God-Slaying Tower x20 (S-rank), Immortal Army Soul Stele x20 (S-rank), flesh disaster hive x10 (S-rank), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x94,452 (S-rank), enlightenment ancient tree x90,220 (S-rank)... Spiritual Vein x40 million (A-rank), Alchemy Tower x500,000 (B-rank), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x100,000 (B-rank), Special Life Building: elf holy tree (million-year, nurturing Elven Warriors) x10...
Wonders: Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x200,000 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x100,000

Assets: Spirit Plant Star x10, Third-class Smart Weapon x110 million, Second-class Smart Weapon x10 billion, Mechanical Heart x1.3 million, Otherworldly Collector x5 billion, cloning nutrient pod x100 billion, ordinary zombie (x1.8 trillion)...”
With the S-rank Talent: Growth of All Things, the investment return of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom had already exceeded others by a thousandfold.
Now, every month, relying solely on the two industries of the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the enlightenment ancient tree, he could earn Divinity Points in the hundreds of trillions.
If not for the fact that these two Resources were already rigid demands for the believers of the Cultivation system,
and that there were a large number of companies and gods in the Virtual World’s Divine Shop making long-term purchases,
Yang Fan’s output alone would probably have been enough to impact market prices in a short period of time.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan spoke slowly, “Yang Da.”
As his voice fell, Yang Da’s figure quickly appeared in the hall of the divine kingdom, “Master.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“From today on, continue to acquire Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees through the Dark Web.”
“If you come across auctions for war-type S-Rank Buildings, increase the bid by ten percent based on the estimated transaction price to acquire them.”
“In addition, from now on, the scale of Resources sold externally by the divine kingdom each month should be controlled within one hundred trillion Divinity Points.”
“Any excess will no longer be sold and will instead be entirely consumed internally within the divine kingdom.”
“Earth Heart Milk and enlightenment tea will be prioritized for the Cultivation of the Cultivation believers and distributed as rewards.”
Hearing this, Yang Da was clearly stunned for a moment, and then couldn’t help but speak.
“Master, currently the highest Realm in the Cultivation system is only the Core Formation Realm.”
“For them, the specifications of Earth Heart Milk and enlightenment tea are simply too high.”
“Isn’t it a bit of a waste?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan shook his head gently, “A waste?”
A hint of a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
“Do you think that at my current level, I still need to consider cost-effectiveness?”

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Leaving Taichu City, Heading to the Frontline
paragraphs: Yang Fan slowly stood up from his divine throne, his gaze looking beyond his Divine Kingdom.
“Before my Breakthrough to become a deity, even with a hundredfold time dilation, the resources produced by my Divine Kingdom remained limited.”
“Placed within the entire Human Federation, I’m afraid it wouldn’t even cause a ripple.”
“But now, it’s different.”
As he said this, Yang Fan’s eyes gradually became profound.
“According to our current growth rate, the future production of Earth Heart Milk and Enlightenment Tea can still increase by a hundredfold, a thousandfold, or even more.”
“Although my identity is protected by the federal supreme intelligent life, there is a limit to any secrecy.”
“Once it continuously affects the market and abnormal fluctuations appear, someone will always notice the problem.”
Yang Da fell silent, evidently having understood Yang Fan’s concerns.
Yang Fan continued:
“Now, for me, Divinity Points are just a number.”
“What I lack is not wealth, but strength.”
“It is the power sufficient to protect everything.”
“Rather than letting resources pile up in the warehouse, it is better to convert them into the strength of my believers.”
“Only a powerful Divine Kingdom is worthy of possessing its current wealth.”
“As for Divinity Points, as long as there are enough, that is fine.”
The calm words echoed in the great hall.
Data constantly flashed in Yang Da’s eyes.
A moment later, he slowly bowed in salute.
“Master is far-sighted; this subordinate understands.”
“From now on, all resource allocation plans will prioritize the development and safety of the Divine Kingdom as the highest priority.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
Now, he no longer needed to worry about ordinary resources.
When wealth reaches a certain level.
Hiding oneself and strengthening oneself is the most important thing.
Consciousness returned to reality.
As soon as Yang Fan opened his eyes, he found Gu Le resting her chin on her hands, staring at him intently.
“What’s wrong? Is there something on my face?”
Yang Fan touched his face.
“No.”
Gu Le shook her head, her eyes full of smiles.
“But since you are about to go to the frontline, I’m afraid I won’t see you for a long time, so I want to look at you a few more times.”
Yang Fan laughed upon hearing this.
“Isn’t there the Virtual World? We can meet anytime.”
“That’s not the same.”
Gu Le rolled her eyes.
“I’ll graduate in a little over a year, and then I’ll have to serve on the frontline too.”
“You must protect me, husband.”
“No problem.”
Yang Fan patted his chest.
“Maybe by then, your husband will already be invincible.”
“Just keep bragging!”
Gu Le looked speechless.
Then, seemingly thinking of something, she earnestly cautioned:
“The Primordial Academy’s transfer order has come down, and someone will be here shortly to escort you to the frontline.”
“Once you get there, you can’t be as reckless as you were at school.”
“I don’t want to take ‘Chengye’ and engage in another marriage of convenience.”
Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
“Rest assured, your husband is the most timid person.”
“Is that so?”
Gu Le looked him up and down.
“I can’t tell at all.”
Just as the two were talking.
Knock, knock, knock—
The door was suddenly knocked.
Yang Fan got up and opened the door; outside stood two familiar figures.
It was precisely the two guardians that Primordial Academy had arranged for him, Tang Yue and Ye Wen.
“Young Lord.”
Both bowed in salute at the same time.
“We two are responsible for escorting you on this trip to the frontline.”
Both were Tier 3 Gods, but in the face of the current Yang Fan, their attitudes were exceptionally respectful.
Especially Tang Yue, who had served as his guardian since Yang Fan left Yang County.
It was just that over these years, Yang Fan was simply too worry-free.
Besides Cultivating, he stayed in Taichu City and basically never left the academy’s sphere of influence.
She collected the federation subsidy every month but had almost never done anything.
However, she had seen the entire trajectory of Yang Fan’s growth with her own eyes.
From the initial Human Race Prodigy, to the later Peerless Prodigy who shook Primordial Academy, and now to breaking through to become a deity in his third year.
Such a growth speed, looking at the entire history of Primordial Academy, would not exceed the count of two hands.
Thinking of this, Tang Yue couldn’t help but sigh in her heart, “I really misjudged him...”
Although she knew Yang Fan had good talent back then, she had never imagined that he would progress so quickly.
After some simple pleasantries, Yang Fan turned to look at Gu Le, “I’m leaving.”
Gu Le waved her hand; there wasn’t much sadness on her face.
In fact, for deities with long lifespans.
A mere year or two is no different from ten days or half a month in the eyes of ordinary people.
Not to mention that the two could meet anytime through the Virtual World; there was no such thing as a life-and-death separation.
As for their relationship as husband and wife...
Before Yang Fan left, the marital duties that needed to be paid had already been paid.
In the next year or so, the two could completely continue to Cultivate their relationship in the Virtual World.
Given the current level of realism in the Virtual World, some functions were even more convenient than in reality.
One could only say that technology changes life.
Following Tang Yue and Ye Wen, he left his residence and arrived at the spaceship docking area.
A huge silver warship sat quietly in the port, emitting a cold and heavy metallic luster.
After boarding the spaceship, Tang Yue spoke proactively:
“Young Lord, heading to the frontline requires crossing multiple space wormholes consecutively, which will take about two months.”
“The time is quite ample; if you have a need, Young Lord, we can take the route via Xiling Planet.”
When Yang Fan first went to Xiling Planet, it was precisely Tang Yue and Ye Wen who accompanied him the whole way.
That was why the other party asked this question.
Furthermore, according to federation law, during the ten-year mandatory service period, he could not leave the frontline area without authorization.
If he didn’t take the opportunity to go back on the way now, he wouldn’t be able to see his family in the real world for a long time to come.
“Let’s go there,” Yang Fan said calmly.
Although the Virtual World existed, since it was on the way, it was better to go back and take a look.
Ever since he possessed the Dark Web channel and was able to purchase large quantities of S-grade resource buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.
Yang Fan had notified Ma Yu that from then on, all tax revenue from Xiling Planet should be used for local construction, with no need to transport resources to him anymore.
Now that so much time had passed, he was actually quite curious whether Xiling Planet had restored its former vitality.
The spaceship started and sailed into the vast starry sky.
From Primordial Academy to Xiling Planet, it takes about one month.
Along this journey, because Yang Fan had already Breakthrough to become a deity.
Tang Yue and Ye Wen’s attitudes toward him had also obviously changed.
The topics discussed by both sides became more and more in-depth.
Private transactions between deities, the unwritten rules existing on the frontline, choices for Divine Kingdom investments, financial layouts of large groups in the real world...
Although Yang Fan’s status was now far higher than the two, along the way, he always communicated with a normal mindset, without the slightest arrogance.
Tang Yue and Ye Wen were also happy to share their experiences.
After a month, Yang Fan’s horizons were invisibly broadened a lot.
After all, both had lived in Taichu City for a long time, and since becoming deities, they had already lived for tens of thousands of years.
Regardless of experience or knowledge, they were far from what those Loose Cultivator deities outside could compare to.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Home, After All, Is Still That Home
paragraphs: After several space wormhole jumps, the spaceship finally arrived above Xiling Planet.
Since Ma Yu had received the news in advance, almost the entire upper echelon of Xiling Planet was currently gathered outside the main hall.
On the massive docking plaza, gods waited quietly.
Among them were not only the gods of the Luo Family but also the gods who had been forced to leave due to the Rao Family’s insane taxation.
Now that Xiling Planet had regained its vitality, these people had returned one after another.
And standing at the very front was none other than Ma Yu.
Boom—accompanied by a low rumble, the spaceship slowly descended.
The hatch opened, and Yang Fan stepped out slowly, accompanied by two Tier 3 Gods, Tang Yue and Ye Wen.
The moment he appeared, the entire plaza fell into a brief silence.
Everyone’s gaze fell upon Yang Fan.
The next moment, countless Divine Thoughts swept over him simultaneously.
Immediately after, everyone’s pupils contracted sharply.
“A... a God?”
“Isn’t Master only a junior in university?”
“How is that possible! Did we sense it wrong?”
“Could this young man not be one?”
Many gods who had newly joined Xiling Planet were filled with shock. They subconsciously looked at Ma Yu, seemingly wanting to get an answer from him.
The gods of the Luo Family were even more shocked; they had followed him all the way from Yang County and knew better than anyone how long it had taken for Yang Fan to grow.
A God in his twenties! Their Luo Family... what kind of powerful figure had they latched onto!
Just as the scene was becoming restless, Ma Yu suddenly took a step forward. “Everyone, silence!”
The pressure of a Fifth-Order God spread, and the plaza immediately quieted down again.
Afterwards, Ma Yu quickly walked up to Yang Fan and bowed respectfully. “Greetings, El...”
Halfway through, Ma Yu paused slightly, then immediately changed his words without hesitation. “Greetings, Master!”
What did being a Fifth-Order God matter? The talent Yang Fan was displaying now had already far exceeded Ma Yu’s understanding.
With such Aptitude, he would almost certainly step into the ranks of High-Order Gods in the future.
Furthermore, the Gu Family stood behind him. For a person of such status, acknowledging him as master in advance was by no means a disgrace, but an Opportunity.
“I told you, there’s no need to make such a big fuss.” Yang Fan shook his head slightly.
“I am heading to the front lines tomorrow; take me to the villa first.”
“Yes.” Ma Yu bowed quickly, his face full of smiles.
“Master Yang, the Mistress, and the young master are already waiting for you.”
After speaking, he took the lead to guide the way. Yang Fan followed and left.
The many gods kneeling on the plaza also slowly turned their bodies as Yang Fan moved.
From beginning to end, no one dared to look up, including Luo Hai and Luo Chengfeng.
It was just that the two of them had their heads buried too low, and Yang Fan didn’t notice them at all.
Now, the gap in their status was simply too great. It was so great that even those who were nominally his elders dared not rashly step forward to strike up a conversation in public.
In this world, strength is certainly important, but status is the symbol of power. Strength is the guarantee, while status determines where you stand.
The former is the sword that guards oneself, while the latter is the authority that commands the rules.
Many direct-line Geniuses from the Five Great Families, even if they were only a Divine Being, would be respectfully called “Young Master” by those high-and-mighty gods upon seeing them.
Because what they revered was never the present, but the power represented behind them, as well as a more certain future.
Soon, the group arrived at the villa area. Just as they entered the hall, a milky, childish voice drifted over. “Ya ya!”
A small child was seen standing unsteadily while holding onto the sofa, surrounded by three or four robot nannies; it was none other than Yang Fan’s son, Yang Chengrou.
In the hall, Yang Fan’s parents, as well as Luo Rou and Luo Bing, were all there.
Seeing Yang Fan return, Luo Rou and Luo Bing greeted him almost simultaneously. They hugged his arms from the left and right. “Husband, why did you return so suddenly?”
Luo Bing’s eyes were full of love. “It’s fortunate you notified us in advance, otherwise I wouldn’t have had time to ask for leave and rush back.”
The current Luo Bing was no longer the cold, icy beauty from Yang County of the past.
Over these years, she had been studying at Tianshui University in the Luo Tian Star Domain and had gradually come to see a wider world.
And she herself had become a celebrity at school. Of course, this wasn’t because her Aptitude was particularly stunning, but because her identity as Yang Fan’s wife had become known.

Now, for Luo Bing, university life was more like just going through the motions. Any bit of resources that flowed from Yang Fan’s hands was enough to cause earth-shaking changes in her Divine Kingdom.
As for things like ranking rewards or federal scholarships, she had long lost interest in them. The more she saw, the more she could understand the true operating rules of this world.

Her past pride and coldness had long been thrown to the back of her mind. As long as she could stay by Yang Fan’s side and receive his recognition, her starting point already surpassed ninety-nine percent of the people in the world.
Yang Fan smiled and reached out to rub the heads of the two women. Then he squatted down and picked up Yang Chengrou, who was beside the sofa.
Over these years, he had been staying in Taichu City and had somewhat neglected this little guy.
Suddenly being picked up by a stranger, Yang Chengrou was visibly stunned for a moment. Then he shrank his neck, his big eyes filled with a bit of confusion and a little fear.
“Quick, call Daddy.” Luo Rou encouraged him from the side. “Ya... ya...” “Ya ya!”
Yang Chengrou tried for a long time, but ultimately only made indistinct sounds, which immediately caused everyone to burst into laughter.
Just then, Sun Rong poked her head out from the kitchen. “Don’t just stand there! Come help cook! Knowing that Fan was coming back, Ma Yu specially ordered a batch of high-quality Dragon meat!”
“It’s just that this stuff is too hard to handle; no matter how it’s stewed, it won’t get tender!” “Mom.” Luo Rou hurriedly walked over.
“This kind of high-tier ingredient needs to be processed with a special cooking building. I’ll put it into my Divine Kingdom first and materialize it later; you should rest for now.”
“So that’s how it is.” Sun Rong suddenly realized, then couldn’t help but mutter. “No wonder when I had Yang Tiexin taste the food, he kept saying it wasn’t good.”

Yang Tiexin, who was on the side, heard this and his face immediately darkened. He was, after all, a major shareholder in a Xiling Planet listed company. As a result, he hadn’t done any real work all morning and had just been dragged around to taste food. Even now, his jaw was still sore.

Watching his parents full of energy, a gentle smile couldn’t help but appear on Yang Fan’s face. His Divine Kingdom was developing, and his strength was growing. But no matter how far he traveled, home, after all, was still that home.

The villa prepared by Ma Yu was very large. The family sat around the dining table, and Yang Fan also managed to relax for a rare moment, chatting with his family about many things, including the news that he was about to go to the front lines to serve.
Hearing this, whether it was Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong, or Luo Rou and Luo Bing, looks of worry appeared on their faces. After all, the two words “front lines” in themselves represented danger.

However, regarding this, Yang Fan appeared very relaxed. “Don’t worry, I have already achieved a Breakthrough to become a God. And the Gu Family has already made arrangements on their end. Going there this time is more for experience and gilding; there won’t be any danger.”

chapters.title: Chapter 305: How Delicious It Will Be!
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, everyone finally let out a sigh of relief.
After all, that was one of the Five Great Families of the Human Federation.
Who didn’t know about the Gu Family?
Upon hearing the name “Gu Family,” neither Luo Rou nor Luo Bing showed the slightest dissatisfaction.
They were not fools; Yang Fan’s achievements today, aside from his own talent, were inseparable from the help of the Gu Family.
Even they themselves had received quite a bit of care from Gu Le.
Now, both of their divine kingdoms had developed to the Peak of the Divine Being stage, and they were not far from a Breakthrough to demigod status.
In the future, they might even have the chance to step into the god level.
Their horizons were naturally much broader than when they were in Yang County.
Therefore, they had never thought about engaging in harem infighting.
Over the years, Luo Rou had never even used Yang Chengrou’s name to make any demands of Yang Fan.
Because she understood one principle: what Yang Fan was willing to give was what she and her child deserved.
If he wasn’t willing to give it, saying anything more would be meaningless.
Instead, it would only exhaust the affection between them.
Compared to the proud daughter of heaven from the Gu Family, their status was, after all, far inferior.
All they could rely on was the affection accumulated from when they started from nothing.
They even understood why Yang Fan spent more time by Gu Le’s side.
Because only the Gu Family could truly help Yang Fan go further.
If they were in Yang Fan’s position, they would likely make the same choice.
This world has never operated based on romance alone.
To love others, one must first learn to love oneself.
Only by living well oneself can one be qualified to take care of those around them.
If Yang Fan possessed peerless talent but spent his days circling around Divine Beings like them, failing to strive for progress,
they would actually find it uncomfortable.
Having affection and loyalty is enough.
As for the future,
as Yang Fan grew stronger, his business expanded, and his status rose,
those of them who had accompanied him on his journey would naturally receive their own rewards.
That evening, Sun Rong took the initiative to carry Yang Chengrou to the room next door to look after him.
Meanwhile, the three of them returned to the bedroom.
The body of a god has boundless strength; the night of spring was at its Peak.
Deep affection carries a thousand meanings; by dawn, the moon had already faded.
Early the next morning, Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes, feeling refreshed.
However, for a god, this bit of exertion was nothing at all.
Luo Rou and the other were fast asleep, curled up in the blankets like little birds.
A smile appeared on Yang Fan’s face; he did not intend to wake them.
The words of farewell had already been spoken last night.
Sometimes, not disturbing someone is also a form of tenderness.
After gently closing the bedroom door, Yang Fan walked out of the villa.
Outside the villa, Ma Yu was already waiting quietly.
Upon seeing Yang Fan appear, he immediately bowed respectfully, “Master.”
“There is no need for that.”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“From now on, just call me Boss, like before.”
After all, Ma Yu was a Fifth-Order God, and now he was responsible for all the affairs, big and small, on Xiling Planet; he could be considered Yang Fan’s most capable lieutenant in the real world.
Yang Fan was still somewhat unaccustomed to having such a Mid-tier God calling him “Master” all day long.
“Yes, Boss.”
Ma Yu immediately changed his address, then said with a serious expression:
“Rest assured, Boss, I will definitely manage the industries on Xiling Planet well for you.”
“The advantage of Xiling Planet being located at a transportation hub has already begun to manifest.”
“I have utilized all my connections, and many companies have already decided to establish branches and logistics transfer stations here.”
“The future tax revenue and value-added businesses will definitely satisfy you, Boss.”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan only smiled.
“You can handle these matters as you see fit.”
“Use a portion of the tax revenue for the construction of Xiling Planet.”
“Leave a portion for my family and those folks from Yang County.”
“As for the rest, if you have needs yourself, you can allocate and use it as you see fit.”
Ma Yu was stunned, clearly not expecting Yang Fan to delegate power to this extent.
In the past, Yang Fan would have been eager to pour every bit of tax revenue from Xiling Planet into the construction of his divine kingdom.
But now, he seemed not to care about these earnings at all.
Nowadays, the daily earnings generated by Yang Fan’s divine kingdom were over a quadrillion Divinity Points.
By comparison, the meager tax revenue from Xiling Planet could hardly catch his eye.
But Ma Yu was thinking something completely different at this moment.
His heart was even surging with shock.
This was a living planet!
According to his plan, once it was fully developed in the future, generating over 300 billion Divinity Points in tax revenue every month was almost a certainty.
Such immense wealth would make even a Fifth-Order God like him tempted.
Yet Yang Fan had actually handed over the right to control it to him directly.
What kind of trust was this?
For a moment, Ma Yu even suspected whether Yang Fan was testing him.
After all, he was currently the actual administrator of Xiling Planet.
If he truly wanted to embezzle, many things could indeed be hidden.
However, he truly had no such intentions.
For Ma Yu, what he truly valued was never the tax revenue of Xiling Planet, but Yang Fan himself.
Someone who could create the listed company Elephant Loan would never be so short-sighted.
“Rest assured, Boss.”
Ma Yu promised solemnly.
“I will personally audit all accounts; I will never misuse a single cent of tax revenue.”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression was a bit strange; he always felt that Ma Yu seemed to have misunderstood something.
In fact, even if Ma Yu were to take all these earnings, he wouldn’t really care.
As long as the other party could hold down the fort on Xiling Planet and protect his family well, that was enough.
Afterward, Ma Yu enthusiastically reported on the recent development situation.
“Currently, the local tax rate on Xiling Planet has been lowered by another 50%, and the comprehensive tax rate is now far lower than that of surrounding living planets.”
“Most of the gods and demigods who left previously have returned, and recently, a large number of talents have applied for immigration.”
“In addition, the application for nine-year compulsory education has been submitted to the Federation for review.”
“The qualifications for running divine kingdom high schools and vocational colleges are also being applied for simultaneously.”
“A local stock exchange has been established, which will be able to help local enterprises finance and expand in the future.”
“Relying on the advantage of being a transportation hub, I plan to focus on developing tourism, the logistics industry, and cross-Star Domain trade...”
Speaking of this, Ma Yu’s eyes grew brighter and brighter, as if he could already see that prosperous commercial planet of the future.
However, at this moment, Yang Fan hurriedly raised his hand to interrupt.
“Stop.”
“I naturally believe in your ability.”
“The original inhabitants of Xiling Planet haven’t had it easy all these years; under your leadership, I imagine their lives will get better and better.”
“I have to set off for the front lines today; let’s talk about these matters later.”
Upon hearing this, Ma Yu nodded, still feeling unsatisfied.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan looked up at the spaceship in the distance, his eyes filled with a hint of anticipation.
He no longer had much interest in these commercial plans.
Compared to tax revenue and making money, he wanted to go to the front lines more.
Just how delicious would a god’s Divine Kingdom Core be!

chapters.title: Chapter 306: White Zombie
paragraphs: Yang Fan boarded the spaceship.
Accompanied by the roar of the engines, the spaceship slowly departed Xiling Planet, heading towards the direction of The Frontline of the Human Race.
Merely traveling consumed another full month.
For a Divine Being, a month is no longer short.
But for gods whose lifespans are nearly infinite,
let alone one or two months, even several years are merely the snap of a finger.
However, while two months passed in the Real World, six thousand years had already passed in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
The span of six thousand years caused earth-shaking changes to the entire divine kingdom once again.
A large amount of newly added barren land was continuously developed.
Now, more than half of the area of the divine kingdom expanded due to the Breakthrough to a god has been fully utilized.
City of Technology structures rose from the ground one after another, and densely packed roads extended in all directions.
The population continuously spread outward from the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Looking out, prosperity and vitality were everywhere throughout the divine kingdom.
Following Yang Fan’s orders, Yang Da still strictly controlled the sales scale of Resources.
The total value of Earth Heart Milk and enlightenment tea sold every month was maintained at around one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Continuing to purchase Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest, enlightenment ancient tree, and various types of warfare buildings from the Dark Web remained the divine kingdom’s largest expense.
However, even so, the total monthly expenditures amounted to no more than twenty to thirty trillion Divinity Points.
As for the Medicinal Pill, Spirit Stone, and various high-quality foods consumed by believers to Cultivate,
although the total amount had multiplied several times compared to before, for the current Yang Fan, that minor expense could not even be considered a fraction of his revenue.
Even though he had actively suppressed the scale of his income, the liquid funds on the divine kingdom’s ledger still reached as high as two hundred and forty trillion Divinity Points.
A large number of A-rank Spiritual Vein were spread throughout the divine kingdom, and the Spirit Stone required by Cultivation system believers had long been supplied in unlimited quantities.
As for the incomparably precious Earth Heart Milk, it was distributed by Yang Da as a reward to those outstanding believers who were in the Breakthrough stage.
Not only the Cultivation and Martial Arts systems were like this, but the Elf Race could also obtain corresponding rewards.
The Cultivation speed of the believers throughout the divine kingdom had long reached an extremely exaggerated degree.
However, speaking of the greatest harvest over these six thousand years, it had to belong to those zombie believers in the Eternal Corpse Mine.
After the development of long years, the first batch of truly meaningful zombie believers was finally born.
[ White Zombie: 14 million ]

To develop the Zombie System, Yang Da specially purchased a large number of Cultivation Technique suitable for zombie Cultivation from the Divine Shop, gradually transforming the original Zombie System into a Zombie System.
It was just that within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom, there were no high-grade corpse-path Resources similar to Earth Heart Milk.
Therefore, these zombies could only rely on time to continuously accumulate and slowly undergo Evolution.
But the Zombie System had an advantage unmatched by other civilizations, and that was the number of believers.
Their environmental requirements were extremely low, and their survival density was shockingly high.
Land of the same area could often accommodate several times or even tens of times the population of ordinary believers.
Therefore, the total number of believers in the Zombie System now even exceeded the total number of believers in all other systems combined.
When the sample size became large enough,
no matter how low the probability, miracles would eventually be born.
And these White Zombie were the results born under Time Evolution.
Their strength was already comparable to the Core Formation Realm in the Cultivation system.
What truly shocked Yang Fan was still the battlefield capabilities displayed by the White Zombie.
During the Zombie King period, their methods of spreading viruses were still very primitive.
Most of them could only rely on blood pollution, wound infection, and flesh-to-flesh contact.
But when they evolved into White Zombie, everything underwent a qualitative change.
They were already able to use Cultivation Technique to integrate various corpse poisons, viruses, and even the power of curses into the air, forming a large-scale diffusion.
The infection efficiency surged by a hundredfold or a thousandfold.
Even a single White Zombie was enough to pollute an entire battlefield.
And this kind of system was extremely rare looking across the entire Human Federation.
The reason was also very simple.
First, this route required a massive amount of ordinary believers to undergo transformation; a slight mishap could trigger a loss of control.
And even destroy the entire divine kingdom in reverse.
Second, the Cultivation cycle was too long. If there was no Heaven-Defying talent like a hundredfold Time Evolution,
relying solely on the Zombie System to step by step grow into a god had a despairingly high difficulty.
Even more difficult than Mechanical Civilization.
After all, as long as one was willing to invest Resources into the Mechanical Path, the speed of development could continuously increase.
As for the Zombie System, it required time sedimentation while being filled with various unstable factors; the risks far outweighed the benefits.
Precisely because of this, this route had always belonged to an unpopular system within the Human Federation.
But for Yang Fan, who possessed Time Evolution, it could be called a perfect match.
At this moment, Yang Fan stood in front of the spaceship’s porthole, looking at the approaching The Frontline Star Domain, his eyes filled with anticipation.
He was even somewhat eager to participate in a real Divine Kingdom War.
His current self was long incomparable to when he had just broken through to a god.
The combat power of the divine kingdom had undergone even earth-shaking changes.
Yang Fan even vaguely had a feeling that even Tang Yue and Ye Wen, these two Tier 3 God, might not necessarily steadily defeat him.
Fourteen million White Zombie simultaneously thrown into the enemy’s divine kingdom would crazily spread corpse poison.
The consumption of detoxification potions alone would become an extremely terrifying number.
Not to mention that there were still a large number of warfare-type S-Rank Building in his current divine kingdom.
If they really fought, it would probably be hard to say who would win and who would lose.
Just as Yang Fan was daydreaming about life on The Frontline, Yang Yi’s voice suddenly resounded in his mind.
“Master, Qin Xue sent a message inviting you to meet in the Virtual World.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, and then seemed to think of something.
“The divine kingdom has changed too much recently; I almost forgot about this matter.”
“It seems I still owe a loan of thirty trillion Divinity Points.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan could not help but chuckle softly.
Then he looked at Tang Yue and Ye Wen not far away.
“I am going to handle some personal business.”
The two nodded to acknowledge, and Yang Fan turned around and returned to his room.
Putting on the virtual helmet,
his consciousness quickly entered the Virtual World.
Inside the familiar reception room, Qin Xue had already been waiting for a long time.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, a proper smile immediately appeared on her face.
“Little Brother Yang Fan, calculating by the distance, you should be arriving at The Frontline soon, right?”
“Ever since you broke through to a god, Elder Sister hasn’t had the time to formally congratulate you yet.”
Facing the other party’s polite words, Yang Fan similarly smiled politely.
“Thank you, Elder Sister Qin Xue.”
“However, congratulations can wait; I have already prepared the funds.”
“Shall I transfer it directly into Elder Sister Qin Xue’s divine kingdom, or to the company account?”
Hearing this, a trace of surprise clearly flashed in Qin Xue’s eyes, but she still quickly said:
“The company has a dedicated corporate account.”
The interest of six trillion Divinity Points was not a small amount, and now Yang Fan was even a premium client in her hands.
When the agreed deadline arrived, it naturally wouldn’t look good for her to directly let Intelligent Life urge collection.
Meeting in person could also be considered a kind of respect for the client.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Arrival
paragraphs: Yang Fan nodded, then immediately contacted Yang Da.
He transferred all thirty-six trillion Divinity Points into the designated account.
Qin Xue did not check the account balance in front of him, but instead offered a professional smile.
“Little Brother Yang Fan, now that you have achieved a Breakthrough to the God realm, your credit rating has increased significantly.”
“After consulting with the shareholders, we are willing to increase your maximum loan limit to one hundred trillion Divinity Points.”
“If you have any needs, you can apply at any time.”
At this point, Qin Xue appeared very confident.
The God stage is precisely when one needs funds the most.
The area of the God-Kingdom expands explosively, the number of believers skyrockets, and massive amounts of funds are needed for various resources, buildings, legions, and industries.
Many of their company’s major clients began their cooperation during the Demigod stage.
They borrowed all the way to the God stage, and eventually even signed long-term agreements for thousands or tens of thousands of years.
Although the loan interest rates are not high, once the scale of funds reaches a certain level, it is impossible to pursue exorbitant profits.
An annual return of around twenty percent is already enough to satisfy the shareholders.
However, Yang Fan gently shook his head.
“Sister Qin Xue, my father-in-law has given me quite a bit of resource support, so I am not currently lacking Divinity Points.”
“Furthermore, I have already transferred all thirty-six trillion Divinity Points into the account, so I will pass on the loan.”
Upon hearing this, Qin Xue was instantly stunned.
“Paid it all back?”
She had invited Yang Fan to meet not only to collect interest but also to take the opportunity to lend Yang Fan another seventy trillion Divinity Points.
As it turned out, Yang Fan had unexpectedly settled both the principal and interest in one lump sum.
Such a high-quality client, and they had only cooperated for one year?
Thinking of this, the smile on Qin Xue’s face almost faltered, and the corner of her mouth twitched slightly.
After a long silence, she could only sigh with envy:
“Third Elder only has one daughter, little sister Gu Le.”
“Little brother is truly blessed.”
Yang Fan only smiled upon hearing this and did not explain.
In fact, the reason he brought up Gu Xuanting was just to find a reasonable excuse for himself.
Nowadays, his monthly income is over one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
In the foreseeable future, he basically will not have any financing needs.
The one hundred trillion limit Qin Xue proposed might be an astronomical figure for other Gods.
But for him now, it is not much different from a small loan.
Rather than dragging it out, it is less troublesome to settle it in one go.
As for verifying it with Gu Xuanting?
It is unlikely that anyone would do something so foolish for the sake of a loan business.
Moreover, given Qin Xue’s current level, she probably cannot reach a figure like Gu Xuanting of the Gu Family.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly stood up.
“If there is nothing else, I will take my leave.”
“If I have any financing needs in the future, I will definitely contact Sister Qin Xue first.”
Hearing this, although Qin Xue felt quite regretful in her heart, she still maintained her professional smile.
“Then this big sister will wait for little brother to bring business.”
“If you are not satisfied with the interest rate, we can actually negotiate further.”
Yang Fan nodded with a smile, then waved goodbye and withdrew his consciousness from the Virtual World.
Meanwhile, Qin Xue sat alone in the reception room, looking at the 36 trillion that had arrived, speechless for a long time.
In the end, she could only sigh helplessly.
“High-quality clients are never short of funds; business is hard to do! I still need to slightly lower the market threshold.”
Several hours later, the spaceship finally arrived at the outer peripheral area of the Human Race front line.
Just at this moment, Yang Fan suddenly felt the ship’s hull vibrate slightly.
Hum—
The surrounding space seemed to ripple in layers.
“Young Lord, do not worry; this is spatial turbulence, and it will pass in a moment.”
Tang Yue reminded him.
“Spatial turbulence?”
A trace of doubt appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Tang Yue nodded.
“Unlike the Human Race hinterland where we usually live, the front line area has a large number of Gods fighting in the real world all year round.”
“The power of Gods is already enough to shake space.”

“If it is just small-scale combat, the world itself will slowly repair the spatial cracks, but once it exceeds a certain critical point, such as the outbreak of a large-scale Divine Kingdom War, or High-Order Gods continuing to attack, it will cause irreversible damage to real space.”
“Over time, this kind of spatial turbulence area has formed.”
Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully.
Tang Yue continued to explain:
“Of course, this is only one of the reasons.”
“Nowadays, the Divine Shops of various races can achieve cross-reality transactions, essentially relying on spatial nodes for transmission.”
“And the front line is one of the areas with the densest flow of goods.”
“Massive amounts of resources are transported through spatial channels every day.”
“Over the years, this also increases the burden on space.”
“Therefore, the spatial environment at the front line is much more fragile than inside the Federation, and it will be more difficult to purchase ordinary supplies.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan subconsciously opened his smart watch.
The next moment, his expression changed slightly.
He saw that the Divine Shop, which he could enter at any time on ordinary days, had turned gray at this moment.
Apparently, it could no longer be used normally.
“The Divine Shop is closed?”
Yang Fan asked, frowning.
“Then how are Medicinal Pills, weapons, food, and various basic war supplies procured at the front line?”

In the past, whether it was for Divine Kingdom War or the development of believers, Yang Fan would buy whatever he lacked directly from the Divine Shop, and he had long been accustomed to this convenience.
Moreover, God-Kingdom talents are strange and varied; some believers are good at Alchemy, some are good at forging, and some God-Kingdoms have amazing food production.
If all God-Kingdoms were really left to be completely self-sufficient and entered a state of closed warfare, the disadvantages would be far too great.
Yang Fan suddenly remembered those Demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone at Primordial Academy.
The reason they were defeated by him.
Besides the reason of strength, their biggest flaw was being completely isolated from the outside world.
Once targeted, they had no effective means at all.
Tang Yue smiled upon hearing this:
“As long as there is a market, there will naturally be people doing business.”
“Of course, you can buy supplies from the outside world, but the price will be much higher.”
“Spatial turbulence will increase the cargo loss rate, and merchants need to bear higher insurance costs and transportation risks.”
“Some high-value-added goods will even be transported directly via spaceships.”
“Of course, ordinary supplies have cheaper circulation channels at the front line; the Young Lord will understand in the future.”
Yang Fan nodded, becoming increasingly curious about the operating system of the front line.
Just at this time, the spaceship slowly decelerated.
Accompanied by a slight vibration, the cabin door slowly opened.
Yang Fan looked up and was slightly stunned.
Because two acquaintances were standing outside.
One of them was wearing black battle armor with a handsome face; it was none other than Gu Le’s cousin—Gu Jiuheng.
The other person was wearing a loose robe with a lazy look on his face; it was none other than Sima Bang’s own brother—Sima Tianci.
Yang Fan also did not expect that these two would come together to pick him up.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: The Gap Is Larger Than Between Humans and Dogs
paragraphs: “Cousin, Brother Tianci.”
“Long time no see.”
Yang Fan walked up with a smile to greet them.
Sima Tianci laughed out loud and walked straight up to him.
Bang!
He slapped Yang Fan heavily on the shoulder.
However, Yang Fan’s body didn’t move an inch, and he didn’t even sway a step.
A look of surprise flashed in Sima Tianci’s eyes.
“Good lad, you’ve even broken my record for the time it takes to achieve a Breakthrough.”
“How long has it been? Your strength is actually this high.”
“You’ve got some skills; I underestimated you before.”
Sima Tianci couldn’t help but tease.
After finishing his visit home, he had returned to the front lines.
It was Sima Bang who told him the news of Yang Fan’s Breakthrough.
Although he had always thought highly of Yang Fan, the speed of Yang Fan’s growth still exceeded his expectations.
While the Hundredfold Time Sequence Talent was Heaven-Defying, its consumption of resources was equally terrifying.
Sima Tianci was even curious at this moment about just how many resources Gu Xuanting had poured into Yang Fan to make his growth speed so fast.
“Alright, let’s get going.”
Gu Jiuheng walked up.
Then he glanced at Sima Tianci beside him.
“Yang Fan, don’t learn from this guy in the future, lying around sleeping in the rear every day.”
Before Yang Fan could speak.
Sima Tianci rolled his eyes and said with a straight face:
“These days are auspicious for rest.”
Gu Jiuheng’s mouth twitched.
“Auspicious my foot. I think every one of the three hundred and sixty-five days a year is suitable for rest for you.”
“You clearly awakened the ‘Dao Child’ Talent.”
“Yet you slack off every day.”
“Aunt Xuanqing has already sent me multiple messages, asking me to urge you more.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but find it funny.
Which normal god isn’t desperately developing their divine kingdom, wishing they could split one day into two?
But Sima Tianci was different; he came from two major families, the Sima Family and the Gu Family, his father was the current head of the Sima Family, and he possessed an SS-Rank Talent.
Yet he lived his life exactly like a retired official.
“Just brush off my mom; that’ll be fine.”
Sima Tianci waved his hand indifferently, then threw an arm around Yang Fan’s shoulder.
“Let’s go, let’s go, let’s go eat first and welcome Brother Yang.”
Yang Fan laughed at this, then turned back to look at Tang Yue and Ye Wen, nodding gently to signal them.
“Thank you both for your hard work on the way here.”
“Young Lord, you are too kind.”
Tang Yue and Ye Wen quickly bowed, their expressions extremely respectful.
Although they were Tier 3 Gods, compared to the status of the three people in front of them, the gap was simply too large.
They had no qualifications to participate in this kind of private gathering.
After bowing, the two of them returned directly to the spaceship.
They soon disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Yang Fan followed behind Gu Jiuheng and Sima Tianci, walking forward.
Along the way, demigods and gods kept coming towards them.
When they saw Gu Jiuheng and Sima Tianci, they all stopped and bowed respectfully.
Some even had a look of fawning and flattery on their faces.
The two seemed long used to this and didn’t even pause their steps.
Yang Fan followed behind while observing the surrounding environment.
This place was somewhat similar to the trading district in Taichu City.
The streets were wide, and various shops were open on both sides.
Medicinal Pill shops, Materials shops, war equipment shops, follower cultivation centers...
Almost all resources needed by gods could be found here.
A large number of robots were coming and going, transporting goods.
Some were pushing metal cargo boxes, while others were driving hover transport vehicles.
The entire street area seemed extremely busy.
What surprised Yang Fan the most was that among the crowds coming and going, there wasn’t a single Divine Being to be seen.
Looking around, the lowest level was a demigod, and most were true gods.
“This is the front line, so naturally there aren’t as many rules as in Taichu City.”
Gu Jiuheng said casually.
“Yang Fan, this area counts as a general resource trading district.”
“Medicinal Pills, Spirit Stones, and various war supplies can basically be bought here.”
“Because of spatial turbulence, the Divine Shop cannot directly teleport supplies into your hands.”
“So most purchased resources are sealed in cards and delivered by robots.”
“In the future, if you have needs, just buy a few robots; there’s no need to come here personally for these trivial matters.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Thank you, Brother Jiuheng.”
Gu Jiuheng waved his hand, “Small matter.”
“Additionally, special resources and even some S-Rank Buildings can be bought here.”
“However, you can’t buy those things with Divinity Points; they require military merit to exchange.”
“Essentially, you are doing business with the Han Family military government.”
“You will naturally come into contact with it in the future.”
Yang Fan silently committed this information to memory.
Soon, the three arrived in front of an antique-style restaurant.
The restaurant was dozens of stories high, with a constant flow of customers at the entrance.
The minimum requirement to enter here was to be a god.
Just as the three approached, an old man immediately came out to greet them with a face full of smiles, his waist almost bent at a ninety-degree angle.
“Young Master Gu! Young Master Sima!”
“How do you two have the time to honor us with your presence today?”
Speaking of which, the old man’s gaze fell on Yang Fan, and a look of confusion appeared on his face.
“May I ask who this is?”
Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly; the aura of the old man in front of him was profound, even a notch stronger than Gu Jiuheng.
He was definitely a Mid-tier God.
He didn’t expect that such a figure would personally greet guests at the door and hold such a low posture.
Gu Jiuheng introduced him:
“Boss Li, this is Yang Fan, he is also my brother-in-law.”
“He’s new to the front lines, please help look after him in the future.”
Hearing the word “brother-in-law,” the other party’s pupils shrank, and the smile on his face instantly became even brighter.
“So it is the honored son-in-law of the Gu Family!”
“What virtue or ability do I have to be able to see Young Master Yang?”
“I am Li Fengzhu, I have been running this restaurant on the front lines for tens of thousands of years.”
“In the future, if Young Master Yang has any needs, just give the order.”
After speaking, Li Fengzhu bowed respectfully.
Yang Fan nodded in response, though he was surprised inside, he didn’t reveal too much.
Then, personally led by Li Fengzhu, the three arrived at the top floor of the restaurant.
Soon, plates of delicacies and spirit wine were brought up.
After all the waiters left, the whole room returned to silence.
Just then, Sima Tianci suddenly laughed.
“Brother Yang, you haven’t adapted to your own status yet.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “What do you mean?”
Sima Tianci picked up a piece of spirit meat and put it into his mouth.
“That Shopkeeper Li just now, do you think it’s a bit strange for a Fifth-Order God to be greeting guests at the door?”
Yang Fan did not deny it; it was indeed so.
A Fifth-Order God is a dominant existence on many planets in the outside world.
Yet just now, he was bowing and scraping to them, which looked somewhat incongruous no matter how you looked at it.
Seeing Yang Fan’s expression, Sima Tianci laughed immediately.
“Actually, there’s nothing strange about it.”
“Between gods and gods, the gap is larger than between humans and dogs.”
“Li Fengzhu being able to open such a large restaurant on the front lines shows he has some ability.”
“But that’s all; in all likelihood, the burden of his divine kingdom is too heavy, and he can only take risks on the front lines to earn Divinity Points to support his followers.”
Sima Tianci picked up his wine glass and took a sip.
“But you are different: a god in your twenties, the son-in-law of the Gu Family.”
“Let alone a Fifth-Order God like him.”
“Even if a High-Order God came, they would still have to be polite.”
“After all, we are destined to become High-Order Gods in the future.”
At this point, Sima Tianci’s expression was no longer lazy; instead, it held deep confidence, even pride.
“Status isn’t given by others; it’s earned by oneself.”
“Everyone climbs desperately, not so that after succeeding, they still stand in the same position as everyone else.”
“When you are strong enough, others respecting you, fawning over you, and doing things for you is not because they are lowly, but because this is the reward you deserve.”
“Those in high positions enjoy resources; those in low positions chase opportunities.”
“All order in this world, in the end, is built upon value.”
“So don’t feel unaccustomed to it; we stand much higher than these ordinary gods.”

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Production Base
paragraphs: Yang Fan upon hearing this, immediately understood the other person’s intention behind the hint.
Over these past few years, he had grown too fast, and many times his mindset still lingered in the past.
In the eyes of others, his status and position were long incomparable to ordinary gods.
“Thank you, Brother Sima.”
Yang Fan nodded, then picked up his wine glass and took a sip.
Gu Jiuheng then took over the conversation.
“Yang Fan, the Third Elder has already greeted me in advance.”
“Your main purpose for coming to The Frontline is still to gain credentials.”

“You broke through to a god too recently, and your Divine Kingdom needs time to develop. Before your strength reaches a Bottleneck, there is no need to rush to fight for the Alien Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Next, you can just develop your Divine Kingdom with peace of mind. If you lack any Resources, just tell me directly.”
“As for military merits, the Gu Family has its own commission channels on The Frontline.”
“When the military merit shares turned in by other gods are distributed, naturally there will be a share for you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately stood up to thank him, “Thank you, Brother Jiuheng.”
However, as soon as his voice fell, Sima Tianci beside him couldn’t help but wail.
“Why?!”
“Why is Brother Yang’s treatment for gaining credentials so good?”
“I want to gain credentials like this too!”
Gu Jiuheng rolled his eyes instantly.
“You?”
“Yang Fan has the Hundredfold Time Sequence Talent.”
“As long as the Resources are sufficient, the growth speed of believers far exceeds that of ordinary gods.”

“According to the Third Elder’s plan, it is to let him gain credentials to accumulate qualifications first, and then go into business or politics to acquire massive wealth to feed back into his Divine Kingdom.”
“You, with a ‘Dao’ Child Talent—”
“Instead of properly utilizing the Divine Kingdom War to put pressure on your believers and make them Cultivate properly, you think about lying flat every day?”
Sima Tianci looked wronged, “How can Cultivating be as comfortable as sleeping?”
Gu Jiuheng rubbed the space between his eyebrows, clearly too lazy to argue with this guy anymore.
Looking out through the car window, Yang Fan saw a densely packed cluster of high-rise buildings in the distance, overlapping layer upon layer as if there was no end.
A large number of robots shuttled back and forth among them, carrying, delivering, and recording in an orderly manner.
His gaze slightly condensed.
With his current Mental Energy strength, he almost instantly “saw” through the essence of that area.
Inside those high-rise buildings, densely packed, were entirely Divine Beings.
Like groups that had been cut apart and uniformly placed.
“Brother Jiuheng, what is over there?” Yang Fan asked.
Gu Jiuheng glanced in the direction of his gaze and said casually,
“That is the basic Resources production base of The Frontline.”
“Production base?” Yang Fan frowned slightly, his expression somewhat peculiar.
Gu Jiuheng nodded.
“Spatial turbulence is severe on The Frontline, and many basic supplies cannot be stably purchased through the Divine Shop at all.”
“And using spaceships for transport is too costly.”
“Therefore, the most stable way is local production.”
He paused, seemingly organizing his wording.
“The route these people take has a unified name in the Federation...”
Saying this, he couldn’t remember it for a moment.
“The logistics route.”
Sima Tianci added lazily, picking up a piece of spiritual meat and putting it into his mouth.
“To put it bluntly, they are people from Divine Kingdoms originating from small places, with limited Resources, ordinary talents, and who couldn’t even pass the university entrance exams.”
Gu Jiuheng nodded and supplemented:
“Right, it is what the outside world often calls logistics Divine Kingdoms.”
“Moving into The Frontline, their Divine Kingdoms are responsible for basic Resources production to supply battlefield consumption, which has the lowest cost.”
Yang Fan was slightly startled, and memories from Yang County No. 1 Middle School couldn’t help but surface in his mind.
At that time, most of his classmates seemed to have taken this “logistics route”.
Only after arriving in Taichu City had he almost never heard anyone mention this word again.
“These people don’t need to be managed.”
Gu Jiuheng continued,
“Managed uniformly by machine soldiers, their scope of activity is strictly restricted, and they basically won’t leave the production area.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan frowned slightly, “So many Divine Beings were forced to be arranged here?”
His Mental Energy slowly spread out.
That cluster of buildings was so colossal it was almost exaggerated.
Even with his current perception, he couldn’t reach the boundaries.
And the crowds within were layered, partitioned, and precisely cut, resembling some kind of production unit scheduled by the System.
Even daily living quarters and meals were uniformly distributed by robots.
Everything was ordered to the point of near indifference.
Hearing these words, Gu Jiuheng smiled.
“Forced? It’s not to that extent.”
“If they were truly forced, it wouldn’t be manageable at all.”
“The number of Divine Kingdoms taking the logistics route across the entire Federation is simply too large.”
“Those who can come to The Frontline are instead people with connections, backgrounds, or special talents.”
“The vast majority of Divine Beings can only stay in their original domiciles.”
“Those who can make it here are already a screened round of ‘high-quality logistics’.”
Yang Fan frowned, “Then why would anyone still be willing to come?”
Gu Jiuheng’s tone was calm.
“Because the returns here are higher.”
“Earn a massive amount of Resources on The Frontline, and only after returning is there a possibility to Breakthrough to a Demigod.”
“To put it bluntly, this is an exchange.”
“Trading short-term restrictions for future upward mobility.”
He paused.
“Only the strong are qualified to talk about freedom.”
“Temporarily losing freedom is to exchange for greater freedom in the future.”
“In essence, it is still a business.”
“As for the risks...”
Gu Jiuheng raised his head and glanced outside the window.
“The Frontline is not a safe zone.”
“Even if it’s just a small-scale conflict, or some Alien God losing control.”
“These logistics areas are often the first places to be affected.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, his gaze deepening by a fraction.
If it weren’t for the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent,
His current situation might also be the same as his father’s, in Mingyue Community of Yang County.
Squeezing believers on one side, while running around for taxes and Resources.
Even the word “The Frontline” would only exist in textbooks.
“Brother Yang.”
Sima Tianci suddenly spoke, his tone casual.
“Divine Beings’ Divine Kingdoms are too restricted; in essence, they are stable production tools.”
“Upon arriving at The Frontline, you still need to find more Demigod Subordinate Gods for long-term cooperation.”
“Proxy wars are safer.”
He paused, his tone lightening a bit.
“If you encounter danger, you must know when to let go.”
As he spoke, he casually poured a glass of wine for Yang Fan.
At this moment, the three of them sat at the same table, and the atmosphere was no longer as rigidly hierarchical as when they first met.
More of it was a conversation among peers.
Gu Jiuheng beside them nodded.
“Although the Third Elder does not hope for you to participate too much in the Divine Kingdom War on The Frontline, it is still necessary to understand some situations.”
“Proxy wars essentially use Subordinate Gods’ believers to play games against the opponent’s demigods.”
“The probability of the Main God’s Divine Kingdom coordinates being exposed is not high.”
“Even if exposed, one can prepare for battle in the Divine Kingdom in advance or call for reinforcements.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “Thank you, Brother Jiuheng.”
The three dined and chatted leisurely.
Inside the restaurant, Spiritual Qi was dense, and spiritual food and fine wine intertwined with a faint luster.
During the conversation, Yang Fan also gradually caught a true glimpse of the layout and rules of The Frontline from the two of them.
On the surface, the entire Human Race frontline was uniformly governed by the Han Family Military Government, responsible for frontline scheduling and the operation of the military merit System.
However, in reality, the Five Great Families had all made deep deployments here, each forming a massive interest network.

Including but not limited to, the Resources supply System, legion establishment and outsourcing, military merit distribution channels, Subordinate God trading markets, logistics Divine Kingdom contracting, and so on.
