chapters.title: Chapter 310: Military Merit System
paragraphs: The logistics production base seen by Yang Fan was merely the tip of the iceberg.

In the more core areas of The Frontline, there were also distributed battlefield advancement zones, demigod garrison belts, deity residential zones, and the military merit settlement and exchange System built by the Han Family in the Virtual World.
The entire System was like a huge net, binding together war, Resources, and personal divine kingdom development.
According to Sima Tianci, many demigods would proactively sign short-term Subordinate God Contracts with High-Order Gods to accelerate the growth of their divine kingdoms.
At the cost of bearing the risks of war, they exchanged it for resource preference and development channels.
In a sense, this was also one of the most common “growth paths” on The Frontline.
After a hearty meal and drinks.
Gu Jiuheng led Yang Fan away from the restaurant to a pre-arranged residential area.
Appearing before Yang Fan’s eyes was a standalone villa.
The villa was situated in a patch of green space shrouded by a barrier.
The architectural style leaned towards simplicity and sternness, but the details were extremely luxurious.
A large number of Spirit Plants and ornamental plants were planted in the courtyard, exuding a faint glow.
There were even specialized robotic gardeners regularly pruning, watering, and adjusting the Spiritual Qi circulation, keeping the entire courtyard in its optimal state at all times.
The room zoning was clear, with a Cultivate room, meditation room, and rest area all readily available.
The spatial layout even bore traces of slight spatial folding technology.
“This is one of the Advanced residences of the Gu Family’s Ninth Legion.”
Gu Jiuheng said casually.
“You stay here first.”
“After a little over a year, younger sister Gu Le should also come over, and by then you two can live together.”
His tone was casual, carrying a hint of banter.
Looking at the villa before him, Yang Fan was also somewhat shocked in his heart.
Along the way, he had already seen quite a few deities, among which there was no shortage of Tier 4 and Tier 5 existences.
However, most of those people merely resided in ordinary small detached Western-style houses.
As for the villa Gu Jiuheng arranged for him, regardless of its specifications or location, it was clearly more than one tier higher.
This was The Frontline after all, where land and residential Resources were extremely tight.
Its housing prices probably could only be compared with core areas like Taichu City.
Yang Fan sighed inwardly, “As expected of the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Families.”
At this time, Gu Jiuheng put away his smile, and his tone became a bit more serious.
“Brother-in-law, contact me anytime you have issues.”
“The Frontline is not like Taichu City; there aren’t that many rules here.”
“As long as you don’t betray the Human Race or touch the bottom line, you can do whatever you want.”
He paused, his gaze darkening slightly.
“However, there is one point you must remember.”
“You cannot let your Real World Physical Body personally enter dangerous areas like The Frontline.”
“Once your Physical Body is destroyed, you will lose all connection channels with the outside world in a short period of time.”
“By then, even the Gu Family won’t be able to save you.”
Yang Fan’s expression turned serious, “Understood, many thanks, Brother Jiuheng.”
After watching Gu Jiuheng leave, Yang Fan did not stay long.
He casually chose a room and sat cross-legged.
The next moment, his consciousness sank into his divine kingdom.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 10 billion square kilometers
Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Authority: Time Evolution (one hundred times); Second Divine Authority: Origin Evolution]
[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things]...
Believers: Core Formation (350 million)... Martial King (290 million)... Third-Class Intelligent Life (480 million)... White Zombie (120 million)...
Occupations: Alchemist (4.4 billion) Blacksmith (10.2 billion) Talisman Master (1.8 billion) Formation Master (1.2 billion)...
Dependents: Elven Warriors (15.4 billion)
Techniques: Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array (B-rank, Major Achievement) Zombie Tide Dance (C-rank, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 232 trillion

Buildings: Fountain of Life X4 million, War God Codex (S-rank), Heavenly Court (S-rank), Goddess of Wisdom (S-rank), Eternal Corpse Mine (S-rank), World Tree (S-rank), Great Void Warship X40 (S-rank), Mechanical War Puppet X60 (S-rank), God-Slaying Tower X30 (S-rank), Immortal Army Soul Stele X30 (S-rank), flesh disaster hive X20 (S-rank), ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary X5 (S-rank), Nine Nether River X5 (S-rank), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest X105,000 (S-rank), enlightenment ancient tree X106,000 (S-rank), divine weapon world-forging platform (S-rank)...
Wonders: Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena X500,000 (Already deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele X500,000
Assets: Spirit Plant Star X10, Third-Class Smart Weapon X1.6 billion...”
The divine kingdom was still in a high-speed Evolution stage, with high-order believers constantly emerging.
According to the current trend, perhaps it wouldn’t be long before Nascent Soul level believers would be born.
Yang Fan’s Divine Thought stirred slightly, “Yang Da.”
As the voice fell, Yang Da’s figure instantly emerged, respectfully standing in the Void Realm.
“Master.”
“The first matter.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
“Materialize one hundred alloy robots into the Real World, and you will take unified charge of them.”
“Go to The Frontline trading area and bulk purchase basic supplies as war reserves.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da said.
Yang Fan continued:
“The second matter, through the Gu Family’s channels, acquire a batch of Spirit Plant Stars and ore vein stars.”
“Now that the divine kingdom’s Alchemy and Blacksmith Systems are developing rapidly, have them start working ahead of time.”
“Medicinal Pills and weapons should all be reserved in advance.”
“Before troops and horses move, food and fodder go first.”
“We cannot wait until after the war starts to restock.”
Yang Da bowed slightly, “Your subordinate understands. How should the quantity of resource stars be planned?”
Yang Fan waved his hand casually.
“According to the current believer production capacity, max it out directly.”
“In the future, the procurement authority for resource stars will be handed over to you; just make your own judgment.”
For the current Yang Fan, a resource star worth one hundred billion Divinity Points no longer required meticulous calculation.

There were too many things to worry about in the development of the divine kingdom. As a deity, he only needed to grasp the direction, and the remaining details would naturally be coordinated by Yang Da.
“Your subordinate understands.”
Yang Da responded once more.
“The third matter.”
Seeing Yang Fan take out a pitch-black token.
“Utilize the Ninth Legion identity to log into the Han Family military merit System and help me retrieve the S-Rank Building exchange list.”
“Yes.”
The instant the token was taken by Yang Da.
The Void Realm shook gently.
The next moment, a light-blue light screen slowly unfolded from above the divine kingdom.
The light screen shimmered with a faint glow, layers of data streams flowing like a river of stars.
[Detecting identity information...]
[Gu Family member: Yang Fan]
[Human Federation rating: Peerless Prodigy]
[Basic information loading complete]
The light screen paused for a split second, then refreshed again:
[Name: Yang Fan]
[Identity: Belonging to the Ninth Legion]
[Current military merit: 0]
[First login detected, the intelligent System will provide you with a brief description]
[The Frontline military merit System is jointly supervised by the Five Great Families]
[The Han Family holds a 60% stake, and the remaining four major families each hold 10%]
[Military merit acquisition channels are as follows:]
[1. Kill Alien Demigods / deities]
[2. Obtain and hand over Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates]
[3. Hand over high-value Alien Divine Kingdom buildings]
[Whether to open the exchange list]
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “Open.”

Countless pieces of information were instantly parsed, reorganized, and categorized.
A massive exchange list unfolded across the Void Realm.
Densely packed S-Rank Buildings came into view.
[Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest]: 30,000 military merits
[enlightenment ancient tree]: 20,000 military merits
[War God Codex]: 50,000,000 military merits
[Myriad Phenomena Weapon Refining Furnace]: 20,000,000 military merits
[Great Void Warship]: 500,000 military merits
[Goddess of Wisdom]: 60,000,000 military merits
Rows of exchange information constantly refreshed.
There were even many names that Yang Fan had never even heard of.
Under Yang Da’s organization,
Yang Fan quickly discovered that all the S-Rank Buildings in his divine kingdom had inventory, except for the Eternal Corpse Mine.
There were even a large number of completely unknown high-tier buildings.
The data was so massive that Yang Fan even needed to enlist the help of Intelligent Life to process it.
The moment he saw the exchange list, a trace of barely concealable heat flashed deep within Yang Fan’s eyes.
Compared to the auction-style random acquisition method of the Dark Web, the military merit exchange System was undoubtedly more stable and systematic.
As long as one had enough military merits, they could almost directly “call out” any high-tier building they needed.
The Dark Web, on the other hand, was more like gambling on luck.

Apart from resource-type buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest, those high-tier S-Rank Buildings that could truly affect the structure of a divine kingdom often had to be fought for purely by luck.
“An S-Rank Building of the level of the War God Codex has quite a high military merit requirement.”
Yang Fan softly spoke, “Yang Da, is there a way to quickly acquire military merits?”
“Reporting to Master.”
Yang Da immediately responded.
“Killing an Alien Demigod can be exchanged for 100,000 military merits. Killing a First-Order Alien God can be exchanged for 10,000,000 military merits.”
“As for wanting to obtain military merits in large quantities, the most primary method is turning in Alien Divine Kingdom buildings.”
“Especially buildings above S-Rank, whose value is extremely high.”
“The military merit rewards for some special buildings are even no weaker than killing an Alien God.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slightly frowned, “Turning in buildings...”
His gaze flickered.
“What are the Five Great Families doing with so many high-tier alien buildings?”
“Even if loaded into the Human Race’s divine kingdom System, most might not necessarily be useful.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan suddenly recalled the Eternal Corpse Mine he had once obtained.
Back then, the federal supreme intelligent life had also suggested handing it over.
If not for the fact that his divine kingdom happened to have the Zombie System, that building itself would have had almost zero utilization value.
He pondered for a moment, and ultimately shook his head.
Since he couldn’t figure it out, he simply stopped thinking about it.
His consciousness returned to reality.
Yang Fan did not rest, instead directly standing up and leaving the villa.
After a Breakthrough into a god, he would no longer feel fatigued.
At this moment, he was full of curiosity about everything at The Frontline, naturally wanting to look around.
Very quickly, he arrived once again at the trading area he had passed by earlier.
Without Gu Jiuheng and Sima Tianci by his side, he casually walked into a shop.
Inside the shop, a god immediately hurried over, his face full of smiles and a posture so humble it was almost ingratiating.
“Welcome, honored guest. What do you need?”
“Medicinal Pills, weapons, spirit food, Materials—our shop has everything you could need.”
Yang Fan glanced at the other party, somewhat surprised.
The Aura emanating from the other party was that of a Tier 3 God; if placed in Yang County, it would be enough to become a Family head-level figure.
Yet here, why was their status so low?
“I’m just looking around.” Yang Fan spoke indifferently.
That god hurriedly nodded and did not ask any more questions.
Yang Fan’s gaze casually swept across the shelves, where various basic supplies dazzled the eye.
“High-quality spirit rice, starting from 1,000 tons, priced at 2.2 Divinity Points.”
“Blood-Explosion Pill (B-Rank), starting from 10,000 pieces, priced at 1 Divinity Point.”
“Blood Wolf Clan corpse (battlefield Resources), starting from 100 tons, priced at 3 Divinity Points.”
The prices were dense and clear.
Yang Fan quickly calculated in his heart.
He discovered that the basic price levels here were indeed slightly higher than the outside world, roughly between 1.5 and 1.6 times.
However, to him, these prices did not hold much significance.
Without lingering further, Yang Fan directly turned and left.
These basic supplies would be purchased in batches by robots controlled by Yang Da.
He did not need to waste time here, nor was there any necessity to compare prices one by one.
With his current scale of returns, resource flows of this level would no longer affect his decision-making.
Just as he continued moving forward, Yang Da’s voice sounded in his mind.
“Master, the purchase of the resource stars has been completed.”
“A total of forty Spirit Plant Stars and fifty ore vein stars.”
“The total expenditure for the purchase is approximately 10 trillion Divinity Points.”
Yang Fan’s steps did not stop as he responded with a Divine Thought.
“Understood. Afterwards, arrange for believers to be stationed and synchronously build the defense System; you can handle it yourself.”
“Yes, Master.”
Afterwards, Yang Fan headed toward the demigod garrison zone.
He had no intention of following Gu Xuanting’s arrangements to stay safely in the rear for ten years.
For the Alien Divine Kingdom Core, Yang Fan could no longer wait.
However, he was not a reckless person.
He remembered Gu Jiuheng’s words very clearly: his main body could not step onto The Frontline battlefield.
On this point, he would not violate it.
That being the case, there was only one safest method—proxy warfare.
The demigod garrison zone was much livelier than the residential area of the gods.
There were no grand buildings here, only rows of high-density prefabricated houses squeezed tightly together.
It looked like a compressed city.
Moreover, almost none of the demigods here rested inside their rooms.
Many people sat cross-legged directly at their doorways.
As if waiting for “business” to knock on their door.
“Respected God!”
A demigod hurried forward, his expression respectful yet unable to hide his eagerness.
“My divine kingdom talent is D-Rank’Sinew and Bone’, and my believers have extremely powerful Physical Bodies!”
“Their frontal combat capability is quite good!”
“For just 10,000 Divinity Points, I can sign a short-term Subordinate God Contract with you to help you win a Divine Kingdom War!”
The First-Order God opposite him slightly frowned.
“10,000? That’s too high.”
“Your talent is not worth this price.”
The demigod immediately said, “9,000!”
The god still shook his head, “Still too high.”
“8,000!” The demigod reported it almost gritting his teeth.
The god pondered for a moment.
“Alright.”
“What about subsequent warfare Resources?”
The demigod immediately responded.
“A resource quota of 6,000 Divinity Points.”
“No restrictions on food, weapons, or defense buildings.”
“Settled according to The Frontline guidance prices.”
Only then did the god nod, “Alright, let’s sign the contract.”
As the words fell, an expression of wild joy instantly appeared on the demigod’s face.
His talent was too poor, and he hadn’t signed a contract with a god for a long time. If this continued, where would he get the Resources to develop his divine kingdom?
8,000 Divinity Points amounted to 800 billion Faith Points. To him, this was already quite a lot.
Doing divine kingdom investments step-by-step in the outside world, who knew how many years it would take to earn such income.
Huge profits naturally came with huge risks; after all, Divine Kingdom Wars with alien races were all matters of risking one’s life.
Within the garrison, such transactions could be seen everywhere.
Gods were selecting demigods.
Demigods were promoting themselves.
Bargaining had almost become a daily routine.
Yang Fan swept his gaze around, his eyes moving slightly.
The order here was completely different from what he had imagined.
Gods did not have absolute suppression power, and demigods were not pure slaves.
It was more like a cooperative relationship constrained by rules.
You put up Resources, and I risk my life for you.
Simple, direct, even somewhat cold, but exceptionally clear.
Even if the god felt their heart ache upon hearing the quote, no one dared to truly use force to suppress the price.
It was as if an invisible layer of rules was restricting the boundaries of both parties.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Fellow Townsman Meeting Fellow Townsman
paragraphs: “This Lord!”
A voice interrupted his thoughts.
A demigod had already arrived in front of Yang Fan.
“I possess the C-rank Divine Kingdom talent ‘Breeding’, which is suitable for protracted battles!”
“I only need basic food supplies!”
“My believers reproduce at an extremely fast rate, which can continuously replenish troops!”
“It only costs 2,000 Divinity Points!”
Yang Fan glanced at him, then shook his head and left directly.
That demigod was slightly stunned, then showed a look of disappointment and slowly sat back down in his original place.
Through the communication with Tang Yue on the spaceship, Yang Fan had long understood the rules of the proxy war.
The essence was very simple.
Demigods fought on the The Frontline, while gods provided resources such as weapons, Medicinal Pills, and war buildings in the rear to influence the direction of the battle.
The winner could seize the opposing demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core.
And through the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card, attempt to lock onto the Divine Kingdom coordinates of the Alien God.
As long as the deduction was successful, whether or not to choose to invade was entirely decided by the winner of the proxy war.
One could make sufficient preparations before launching a surprise attack.
One could also choose to sell the Divine Kingdom coordinates or directly submit them to the military exploits System, which could similarly exchange for huge rewards.

As for the direction of the war between demigods, while the resource support of the gods was certainly important, ultimately, what had the greatest impact was still the strength of the demigods’ believers themselves.
As for the C-rank “Breeding” talent, it fundamentally did not belong to combat-type talents at all.
Since Yang Fan wanted to select a Subordinate God, naturally he had to choose a strong one.
Yang Fan continued walking forward.
The number of demigods stationed on the The Frontline was extremely large.
But most of them were uniformly C-rank or even D-rank talents.
Occasionally, a B-rank would appear, but almost all of them were non-combat-type talents.
Either biased towards resource production or biased towards development.
Demigods with genuine combat talents were few and far between.
Yang Fan walked all the way, yet still hadn’t found a satisfactory candidate.
He looked up at the demigods sitting at the entrance waiting to be chosen, his gaze pausing slightly as a hint of complex emotions inevitably arose in his heart.
If these people were placed in a place like Yang County, they would already be considered existences with good talent, and could even be called “Geniuses”.
Yet here, they were merely commodities waiting for a high price.
Having painstakingly managed their Divine Kingdoms all their lives, there was a high probability they still couldn’t cross that step to step into the divine level.
Therefore, they came to the The Frontline.
Trading their lives for a possibility.
“This Lord, I am a C-rank talent ‘Mad Blood’. My believers have decent combat power, but the price is a bit more expensive, requiring 20,000 Divinity Points...”
A familiar voice suddenly came from behind.
Yang Fan’s footsteps paused slightly as he slowly turned around.
The moment he saw the other person’s face, he froze completely.
That face caused him to be somewhat dazed.
He had actually encountered a “fellow townsman” from Yang County on the The Frontline.
Within this boundless territory of the Human Race, spanning countless Star Domains and planes, they were still able to meet on the The Frontline.
Such a probability was almost low enough to be negligible.
Yet it happened precisely.
At this moment, the other party also finally saw Yang Fan’s face.
The next instant, their pupils shrank violently.
“Yang Fan!!!”
“Why are you here?!”
There was shock in the voice, as well as disbelief.
This person was none other than Li Tianheng.
Back at Yang County No. 1 Middle School, he was a Genius second only to Luo Bing.
No one expected that in a mere three years, he had actually stepped into the demigod level as well, even faster than Luo Bing.
“Take my punch!”
Li Tianheng suddenly let out a low shout.
The blood Qi all over his body suddenly erupted, surging like a raging fire.
All his power instantly converged onto his right fist, punching out fiercely!
The speed was extremely fast, and the power was extremely fierce.
Quite a few demigods nearby subconsciously glanced over.
“???” Yang Fan looked dumbfoundedly at Li Tianheng, who was attacking him.
He didn’t even have any intention of defending, letting this punch land directly on his chest.
It wasn’t that he couldn’t dodge, but that there was simply no need.
A demigod’s full-strength strike.
For him now, it couldn’t even achieve a “defense break”.
As the punch landed, Li Tianheng’s body violently shook.
The force of the rebound instantly exploded.
He retreated several steps in a row, his right hand trembling uncontrollably.
His left hand tightly grabbed his already deformed finger bones, his face turning pale.
His eye sockets were even somewhat red, but he stubbornly gritted his teeth without uttering a sound.
The surrounding air instantly fell silent.
Quite a few people had already noticed the commotion over here.
This was the rear garrison of the military district, a place for transactions between gods and demigods.
Who dared to directly take action here?
Have they grown tired of living?
“How is this possible? You’ve actually made a Breakthrough to a god!”
Li Tianheng stared fixedly at Yang Fan, his eyes filled with shock and a questioning of life, even mixed with a hint of indescribable... breakdown.
Yang Fan fell into silence, his expression a bit subtle.
Just a moment ago, this person still looked like he was conducting a transaction, but the moment he recognized him, he immediately flipped out and attacked without any hesitation.
Now it was great; only after finishing the fight did he start doubting reality.
Were gods and demigods really that hard to tell apart?
After so many years, why was this guy’s thought process still so novel?
Right at this moment, a dense burst of footsteps suddenly sounded from afar.
A team of enforcement robots quickly ran over, their metal joints emitting neat and cold echoes.
The red light in the eyes of the leading robot swept across, immediately locking onto the scene.
“Demigod-level power fluctuations detected. Confirmed occurrence of illegal action.”
“According to federal law, your actions are suspected of criminal violations, carrying a maximum sentence of three years in prison.”
“You have the right to remain silent, and you are entitled to legal counsel.”
The cold Mechanical voice echoed in the air.
Li Tianheng gave a start, instantly sobering up entirely.
“Wait! It’s a misunderstanding! He’s my high school classmate, we were just messing around, we didn’t fight!”
He spoke extremely fast while nonchalantly hiding his already fractured right hand behind his back.
The robot turned its head, its gaze falling upon Yang Fan.
“Is this situation true?”
It bowed slightly, its tone still Mechanical, yet obviously with a trace of added courtesy.
Yang Fan glanced at Li Tianheng and spoke indifferently:
“True.”
He and Li Tianheng didn’t have any animosity; to be precise, back then the other party had even used the entire power of his Divine Kingdom to help him out.
Moreover, apart from being a bit reckless and having a screw loose in the brain, Yang Fan didn’t have any ill feelings toward him either, so naturally he wouldn’t want to send him to prison.
At this moment, Li Tianheng also visibly let out a huge sigh of relief, as if he had just been pulled back from the edge of a cliff.
“Even if it’s sparring, actions must not be taken within this area.”
“Considering it’s your first offense, this is only a warning. Do not let it happen again.”
The robot coldly finished announcing the handling result, then turned and led the team away.
Until the other party completely disappeared from view did Li Tianheng raise a hand to wipe the cold sweat from his forehead, letting out a long breath.
He still had a huge loan on his back.
If he were really locked up for three years, with compound interest, he might never crawl out in this lifetime.
“Yang... greetings... Lord God.”

The robot coldly finished announcing the handling result, then turned and led the team away.
Until the other party completely disappeared from view did Li Tianheng raise a hand to wipe the cold sweat from his forehead, letting out a long breath.
He still had a huge loan on his back.
If he were really locked up for three years, with compound interest, he might never crawl out in this lifetime.
“Yang... greetings...
Lord God.”

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Young Master Yang?
paragraphs: Only Li Tianheng knew how many times he had rehearsed meeting Yang Fan in his mind.
Ever since his Breakthrough to demigod, he had constantly fantasized about how to “get back at him” the next time he saw Yang Fan, even modifying his lines through several versions.
Yet the moment he actually saw the person, his brain completely short-circuited.
Whatever plans, whatever revenge, whatever vindication—all of it was overridden by impulse.
He just attacked directly!
Only after coming to his senses did he belatedly feel afraid.
A demigod attacking a god...
Just now, even if the other party had casually slapped him to death, no one would have said a single extra word.
“Meeting an old friend in a distant place, I actually prefer your enthusiasm from just now.”
Yang Fan smiled, his tone casual.
“Just call me by my name, don’t be so constrained.”
Hearing this, Li Tianheng’s expression flushed slightly.
He took a deep breath, as if making a firm decision, his voice sounding somewhat tight.
“Classmate Yang Fan, I wonder if I might have the honor of treating you to a meal?”
“Of course you can.”
Yang Fan glanced at him with a calm tone, “Didn’t you still want to sign a Subordinate God Contract with me just now? I think we can discuss it.”
As soon as these words came out, Li Tianheng’s facial muscles twitched violently, but he ultimately didn’t dare to retort.
He turned and left, his pace noticeably faster than usual.
“So what if you’ve broken through to a god? You think I don’t have anyone covering me? Just you wait!”
Walking in front, the more Li Tianheng thought about it, the angrier he became, and he already began plotting petty schemes in his heart.
Along the way, he occasionally turned back to glance at Yang Fan.
He found that Yang Fan was just following calmly, truly looking as if he were attending an ordinary dinner party.
At this moment, Li Tianheng’s slight thought of ‘venting his anger’ grew a bit more steady in his heart.
Soon, the two arrived at The Frontline trading area.
A brightly lit restaurant stood in the center of the block.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept over it, his brows twitching imperceptibly, his expression slightly unnatural.
“Classmate Yang Da, please.” Li Tianheng grinned with a hint of unfathomable smugness.
Yang Fan glanced at him, roughly guessing that the other party was plotting something.
“Ahem, do you know the owner of this restaurant?” Yang Fan asked casually.
“Of course I know them!”
Li Tianheng lifted his chin, his tone instantly turning proud, “The master of this restaurant is precisely my Family Old Ancestor—Li Fengzhu.”
He paused, his eyes carrying a hint of confidence and swagger.

“My Old Ancestor is a Fifth-Order God. Yang Fan, I might as well tell you, once we go in later, you’d better fine yourself three cups of wine, and the matter of you tricking me during the First High exam back then will be considered written off, otherwise...”
“Otherwise?” Yang Fan’s tone remained calm.
Standing at the restaurant entrance as if he had finally gotten back at him, Li Tianheng patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, his tone also hardening.
“Don’t think you’re amazing just because you’ve broken through to a god.”
“I admit my talent is inferior to yours, I concede.”
“But out there in the world, background is what ultimately matters.”
“Just admitting a mistake, it shouldn’t be that hard for you!”
He spoke these words with complete self-assurance.
After all, the scene just now had completely calmed him down.
Given Yang Fan’s strength, he wasn’t someone he could provoke head-on.
But he still couldn’t swallow that breath from back then.
According to his thoughts, with his own Family elder stepping forward to slightly suppress Yang Fan’s arrogance, it would be best to let Yang Fan suffer a small ‘loss’.
It wouldn’t amount to a blood feud, but it had to vent his anger.
“There’s no need to go that far.” Yang Fan replied indifferently.
Hearing these three words, Li Tianheng instead let out a sigh of relief, and his expression looked much better.
In his view, this already counted as “backing down”.
“Keep your head down after going in.”
Li Tianheng lowered his voice, “The restaurant opened by my Family Old Ancestor is not an ordinary place; those entertained here are all powerful gods with backgrounds on The Frontline.”
“Later we’ll go to the basement floor, there’s a small private room there, I’ll take you to broaden your horizons.”
As he spoke, he had already reached out and pushed open the side door of the restaurant.
He glanced at the lobby through the crack of the door.
After confirming no one inside was paying attention, Li Tianheng immediately pulled Yang Fan, quickly entered the door, and headed straight for the basement.
His movements were crisp, even carrying a hint of cautious eagerness, as if afraid someone might see them.
But the moment he stepped in—
A terrifying coercive pressure suddenly descended!
Li Tianheng’s body suddenly stiffened, and his entire person was instantly frozen in place.
“Humph.”
A low voice rang out, carrying unquestionable majesty.
“Kid, did I not make myself clear enough?”
“Back then when this old man passed by Tiannan Star, I indeed left behind a Bloodline, but I also left behind sufficient Resources.”
“This place is not somewhere you can come to casually.”
“Since you have already broken through to a demigod, you should go where demigods belong and rely on your own strength.”
“This basement of mine is not your safe haven.”
“If you really die here, no one will collect your corpse.”
The moment the voice fell, a hand had already pressed onto Li Tianheng’s shoulder.
The terrifying force pressed down directly.
“Crack—”
Li Tianheng’s legs went soft, and his entire body collapsed onto the ground on the spot, his face turning ashen.
“Old... Old Ancestor, I know I was wrong, I’ll leave right away!”
Gods had long since broken through the shackles of flesh and blood.
As long as the divine kingdom is undestroyed, a god does not die.
To them, time had long lost its meaning.
Some gods, having nothing better to do, would even travel between various galaxies, discuss the Dao, or simply pass the long years.
For such existences, so-called Bloodline and blood ties were extremely faint in their concepts.
Descendants occasionally left behind on a whim would continuously multiply over the long course of time, forming various Family branches.
And the Yang County Li Family was precisely a Bloodline casually left behind by Li Fengzhu tens of thousands of years ago.
In his eyes, this was merely a piece of “past Karma”, hardly counting as any sort of attachment.
The stronger one’s strength, the less they cared about blood relations.
If Li Tianheng lacked discretion, insisted on clinging to him, and even affected the operation of his restaurant...
He wouldn’t mind making him disappear completely from then on.
The coercive pressure continued to increase, and Li Tianheng’s face grew increasingly pale.
He could clearly feel that his bones and Soul were being squeezed bit by bit.
He was only a demigod.
Once his Physical Body in reality collapsed, that would be death in the true sense, with no room for maneuver.
The boundary of death was infinitely approached at this moment.
Cold sweat continuously slid down his forehead.
The exact moment his consciousness was about to shatter, that terrifying force pressing down on his body suddenly vanished.
As if it had never existed.
A hand steadily gripped Li Fengzhu’s wrist.
The hand pressing on Li Tianheng’s shoulder moved away from him.
The movement was very light, yet it carried an irresistible power.
The air instantly returned to normal.
Li Tianheng looked as if he had been fished out of deep water.
He staggered two steps and sat flat on the ground, panting heavily, his face pale.
At that instant just now, he truly thought he was dead for sure.
“Yang... Young Master Yang?”

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Reason
paragraphs: Li Fengzhu was slightly stunned, then immediately withdrew his right hand.
The trace of oppression on his face instantly vanished, replaced by an almost natural apology.
“I was just disciplining an ignorant junior just now and lost my composure for a moment. I am truly sorry.”
His tone was very calm, but upon closer inspection, his right wrist was slightly red and even faintly swollen.
“Store Manager Li, he is my friend.”
Yang Fan’s tone remained calm and without fluctuations.
The moment those words fell, the atmosphere changed instantly.
Li Fengzhu’s gaze narrowed slightly.
The next instant, he stepped forward directly and helped Li Tianheng up from the ground.
His movements even carried a bit of naturalness.
Afterwards, Li Fengzhu reached out and patted Li Tianheng on the head.
“This child has my blood flowing in his veins.”
“It’s just that his talent is a bit lacking, and he isn’t steady enough in his actions.”
“If there is any offense, I apologize to Young Master Yang on his behalf.”
As he spoke, he casually straightened Li Tianheng’s collar.
Then he turned around and bowed slightly toward Yang Fan.
His posture was extremely low, even carrying a hint of deliberate ingratiation.
At this moment, Li Tianheng was completely dumbfounded, his mind a blank.
What happened?
Why couldn’t he understand what was going on?
Yang Fan didn’t say anything more, merely waving his hand casually. “Arrange a private room.”
“You got it, Young Master Yang, this way please.”
Li Fengzhu immediately turned sideways and made a gesture of invitation.
“The room on the top floor with the best view has already been prepared for you.”
Yang Fan glanced at Li Tianheng, who was still standing in place.
He directly reached out, grabbed him, and led him upstairs together.
Watching Yang Fan’s figure disappear into the stairwell,
the smile on Li Fengzhu’s face slowly faded.
He subconsciously raised his hand and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
His fingertips paused slightly; the wrist that had just been grabbed by Yang Fan was already slightly swollen and numb.
His gaze sank slightly, and the shock in his heart grew even greater.
“As expected of a Prodigy from the Five Great Families, truly extraordinary.”
“Having just achieved a Breakthrough to a deity, he actually possesses this kind of strength...”
He gently let out a breath.
“Li Tianheng...”
“How could this trash of a junior get involved with such a person?”
Thoughts flashed rapidly through his mind, and without lingering, he went personally to arrange the dishes.
Inside the private room, the view was extremely high.
The entire The Frontline core area was in full view, with lights like an ocean and strict order.
The table was already laden with delicacies.
Every single dish contained Spiritual Qi; the aroma was not strong, but extremely pure, faintly making one’s Qi and blood stir slightly.
Li Tianheng sat by the window.
At this moment, he appeared exceptionally restrained.
Looking at the ridiculously massive The Frontline core area outside the window, he was momentarily at a loss.
At this moment, Li Fengzhu personally walked in carrying a pot of fine wine.
He did not sit down, but simply poured three cups first.
The wine liquid was clear, but faintly carried divine fluctuations.
“Young Master Yang.”
“Please forgive any disrespect shown just now.”
Having said that, he raised his cup and drank three cups in a row.
His movements were crisp and clean, without any hesitation.
Yang Fan glanced at the table, his tone calm.
“Store Manager Li, it’s just a minor matter, no need to mind it.”
“Brother Li and I still have things to discuss.”
Li Fengzhu immediately nodded. “Understood.”
Without any unnecessary lingering, he turned and left.
When he reached the door, he paused for a moment.
He turned his head to look at Li Tianheng, a trace of an “elder-style” gentle smile appearing on his face.
“Tianheng, ah, in the past Old Ancestor paid too little attention to you.”
“Your talent is actually not bad.”
“In the future, don’t be so rash when doing things.”
“Being able to forge a connection with Young Master Yang is a blessing you cultivated over eight lifetimes; you must cherish it.”
After giving these admonitions, he didn’t linger any longer, gently closing the door as he left.
Li Tianheng looked up at Yang Fan, opened his mouth, but for a moment didn’t know what to say.
Inside the entire private room, the atmosphere inexplicably grew quiet.
“You... Who exactly are you now?” Li Tianheng’s voice trembled slightly.
“Of course I am still Yang Fan,” Yang Fan said indifferently. “However, I’ve gained an identity.”
“What identity?” Li Tianheng subconsciously pressed.
In his eyes, Li Fengzhu was already the kind of existence that was high and out of reach.

A Fifth-Order God, and able to open such a large-scale restaurant in the core location of the The Frontline trading area, he inherently represented the top tier of resources, connections, and strength.
Yet a person like this had an attitude toward Yang Fan just now that was almost... cautious, even ingratiating.
This contrast directly shattered Li Tianheng’s original perception.
No matter how hard he thought, he couldn’t figure it out.
Why had that guy who was in the same class as him back then reached a level in just a few short years where even his own Old Ancestor had to bow his head?
“Son-in-law of the Gu Family.” Yang Fan said casually.
“Damn!”
Li Tianheng abruptly stood up, choking the words back down to the tip of his tongue, and then sat down dejectedly.
“Did you fucking marry into another family as a matrilocal son-in-law again?” He muttered softly, “With such good talent, why do you always live off women... and change to a different one each time.”
The voice was very soft, but it still didn’t escape Yang Fan’s ears.
Yang Fan raised his eyes to look at him and rolled his eyes directly.
“I am a deity now, stop gossiping over there, I can hear you.”
“Cough...”
Li Tianheng’s expression stiffened, and he quickly stood up to pour wine for Yang Fan.
“Brother Yang, I just envy you for having such good opportunities.”
“A person like me doesn’t even have the ability to live off women.”
He paused, his expression becoming a bit more serious.
“Brother Yang, thank you for saving my life just now.”
“As for that matter back then, I figured it out long ago; you didn’t actually do anything wrong.”
“It’s just that I couldn’t swallow that breath in my own heart, which is why I acted against you on a momentary impulse.”
“I’ll punish myself with three cups first.”
After speaking, he drank it down in one gulp.
The moment the first cup of wine went down—
Boom!
A violent surge of power suddenly exploded from within his body.
His face instantly turned flushed, his Qi and blood churned, and his skin even faintly revealed crack-like red light.
His entire person looked as if he was about to be blown apart.
“Cough... cough cough!”
He abruptly braced himself against the table, his breathing even becoming rapid.
“This wine... what is this stuff?!”
“Just this single cup, if it were sprinkled into my Divine Kingdom, I’m afraid the entire environment of the Divine Kingdom would be elevated by a notch!”
Yang Fan glanced at him, his tone calm.
“Celestial Brew.”
“Your believers are too weak to bear it, you can’t drink too much.”
“How many Divinity Points is this pot of wine?” Li Tianheng asked, panting.
“Twenty,” Yang Fan said.
“Damn?!”
Li Tianheng’s eyes went straight.
“Are you robbing people! This could even buy a mouthful of the Fountain of Life!”
As he spoke, he subconsciously moved the wine pot closer to his side with an extremely natural movement.
As if he was afraid someone would snatch it away.
Looking at his appearance, Yang Fan couldn’t help smiling softly and shaking his head.
“How did you end up running to the The Frontline?”
Hearing this question, Li Tianheng fell silent for a moment, then slowly began to speak.
“After the College Entrance Examination, my grades were average and I could only go to an ordinary university. At that time, I was somewhat unreconciled.”
“Teacher Cao Wang told me that the growth speed on the The Frontline is much faster than in university.”
“Back then, I was young and hot-headed, and wanted to catch up to your footsteps, hoping to get back at you after becoming a deity.”
“So I followed along and came.”
Speaking up to this point, he looked up at Yang Fan, a trace of unspeakable complexity filling his eyes.
There was emotion, and also relief.
Hearing the name “Cao Wang”, Yang Fan’s expression shifted slightly.
Yang County No. 1 Middle School, head teacher of Class 1.
“What happened to him later?” Yang Fan asked.
Li Tianheng fell silent for a split second.
“He died.”
“Not long after coming to the The Frontline, he encountered a small-scale military conflict.”
“His Physical Body was shattered by alien races.”
“Afterwards... he never appeared again.”

“Cough... cough cough!”
He abruptly braced himself against the table, his breathing even becoming rapid.
“This wine... what is this stuff?!”
“Just this single cup, if it were sprinkled into my Divine Kingdom, I’m afraid the entire environment of the Divine Kingdom would be elevated by a notch!”
Yang Fan glanced at him, his tone calm.
“Celestial Brew.”
“Your believers are too weak to bear it, you can’t drink too much.”
“How many Divinity Points is this pot of wine?” Li Tianheng asked, panting.
“Twenty,” Yang Fan said.
“Damn?!”
Li Tianheng’s eyes went straight.
“Are you robbing people!
This could even buy a mouthful of the Fountain of Life!”
As he spoke, he subconsciously moved the wine pot closer to his side with an extremely natural movement.
As if he was afraid someone would snatch it away.
Looking at his appearance, Yang Fan couldn’t help smiling softly and shaking his head.
“How did you end up running to the The Frontline?”
Hearing this question, Li Tianheng fell silent for a moment, then slowly began to speak.
“After the College Entrance Examination, my grades were average and I could only go to an ordinary university.
At that time, I was somewhat unreconciled.”
“Teacher Cao Wang told me that the growth speed on the The Frontline is much faster than in university.”
“Back then, I was young and hot-headed, and wanted to catch up to your footsteps, hoping to get back at you after becoming a deity.”
“So I followed along and came.”
Speaking up to this point, he looked up at Yang Fan, a trace of unspeakable complexity filling his eyes.
There was emotion, and also relief.
Hearing the name “Cao Wang”, Yang Fan’s expression shifted slightly.
Yang County No.
1 Middle School, head teacher of Class 1.
“What happened to him later?” Yang Fan asked.
Li Tianheng fell silent for a split second.
“He died.”
“Not long after coming to the The Frontline, he encountered a small-scale military conflict.”
“His Physical Body was shattered by alien races.”
“Afterwards... he never appeared again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Leveraging Power
paragraphs: Li Tianheng sighed, and the private room fell briefly silent.
The destruction of a deity’s Physical Body inherently represents being weaker in strength than the enemy.
So much time has passed, the possibility of survival is extremely low.
This is the cruelty of the The Frontline; even deities can die at any moment.
Li Tianheng continued speaking:
“After Teacher Cao passed away, I was assigned to the production base.”
“Later, the Li Family Restaurant was recruiting helpers, and the Old Ancestor discovered that I had a Bloodline aura, so he brought me in.”
“At that time, I was only a Divine Being, not even qualified to be a waiter in the restaurant.”
“It was only under the Old Ancestor’s resource supply that I managed to Breakthrough to a demigod.”
Saying this, a trace of awkwardness appeared on his face.
“However, later the Old Ancestor found me clumsy and unable to speak well, so he kicked me out and told me to make a living on my own.”
“Believers need to eat and Cultivate, but I didn’t have many resource buildings in my Divine Kingdom, so I could only figure out ways to make money myself.”
He spread his hands.
“You’ve seen everything that happened afterward.”
Li Tianheng’s tone at this moment was very calm.
The grudges between people are often not complicated in essence.
When strengths are similar, there will be defiance, competition, and the desire to prove oneself.
But when the gap widens to an untouchable level, those emotions will instead lose their fulcrum.
Whether it’s anger or unwillingness, they will slowly lose meaning.
Replaced by a more realistic judgment——
Can I still catch up?
Can I borrow a bit of light?
Even, as long as the other party was willing to look at him, those so-called past prides were no longer important.
Li Tianheng at this moment was just like this.
When he looked up at Yang Fan again, those past unwillingness and competitions had quietly dissipated.
What remained was only a realistic understanding after years of struggling on the The Frontline.
And a trace of a thought that even he was unwilling to admit——
Perhaps, he could use Yang Fan’s momentum to live a little more easily in this place where people are eaten without even spitting out their bones.
Yang Fan looked at Li Tianheng and asked casually,
“Do you want to sign a Subordinate God Contract with me?”
Li Tianheng was stunned for a moment, a trace of embarrassment appearing on his face, and he scratched his head and said:
“Um... I owe external debts of 100,000 Divinity Points. I wonder how the reward for a Divine Kingdom War is?”
As soon as his voice fell, Yang Fan had already reached out and pressed his finger between his eyebrows.
A wisp of Divine Thought fell, and the next instant, 100,000 Divinity Points were directly transferred into Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom.
Li Tianheng’s pupils shrank violently, and he looked at Yang Fan in disbelief.
The contract hasn’t even been signed yet, and the other party wired the money over first?
At this moment, the little bit of displeasure and estrangement originally remaining in his heart was instantly washed away completely.
100,000 Divinity Points, converted into Faith Points, was a full 100 trillion.
Placed in a small place like Yang County, all the liquid funds of the Li Family added together were probably around this much.
What did those old grievances from back then count for?
It was just being scammed once when he was young, making him hold out a bit longer in front of the demonic monkey’s pursuers.
It was just losing a few million low-tier believers.
Could this count as any big deal?
Li Tianheng stood up abruptly, his expression solemn.
“Brother Yang, from now on this life of mine is yours! Wherever you point, I will fight!”
Ever since Li Tianheng broke through to a demigod, his Divine Kingdom area skyrocketed.
In order to enhance believers’ combat power and expand the Divine Kingdom’s industries, he impulsively took out loans.
The monthly interest rate of the loan was as high as 10%, which had pressed him so much that he could barely breathe recently.
Now that these 100,000 Divinity Points had arrived, his only thought was to immediately pay off all his debts.
Those financial companies were more ruthless than the other, eating people without spitting out bones.
From now on, he would never do any leverage to invest in the Divine Kingdom again.
Looking at Li Tianheng’s posture of “recognizing a master on the spot”, Yang Fan was still a bit unaccustomed to it for a moment.
He shook his head and said faintly:
“Treat this sum of money as compensation for what happened back then, not the employment fee for the Subordinate God Contract.”
“If you are willing to be my agent, for every Divine Kingdom War, I can give you an extra 100,000 Divinity Points as a subsidy.”
100,000 Divinity Points, for the current Yang Fan, was merely a drop in the bucket.
Since they were old acquaintances and he happened to have the ability, he didn’t mind lending a hand to pull the other person along.
Hearing this, Li Tianheng’s eyes lit up, and then he blurted out:
“Brother Yang... no, Adoptive Father! From now on, whatever you say goes, I will definitely follow your lead and be utterly loyal!”
This scene made Yang Fan pause slightly.
Back at Yang County No. 1 Middle School, that high-spirited Genius had now turned into such a posture.
Making it hard for one to tell for a moment whether reality was too heavy or human hearts were too light.
He couldn’t help thinking of his close friend Zhang Pang.
Back then when he was recruited as a son-in-law by the Luo Family, the other party was also in this exact appearance.
The times were changing, and people were changing too.
But the underlying color of the human heart never truly changed——seeking advantage and avoiding harm, dwelling where the strong reside.
At this moment, Li Tianheng rubbed his hands, his expression somewhat restrained, yet carrying a bit of carefulness:
“Um Brother Yang, although my believers are not weak, you cannot completely ignore the Divine Kingdom War.”
“Without deities supporting war supplies in the rear, no matter how strong I am, I won’t be able to hold out against the opposite side.”
Yang Fan glanced at him and said in a calm tone:
“What are you thinking? You’re my high school classmate, not a tool person.”
“We are friends, how could I harm you.”
Li Tianheng was startled, then smiled bitterly: “Isn’t this once bitten by a snake, twice shy.”
As soon as the words left his mouth, he realized something was wrong, quickly covered his mouth, and his face flushed red.
Yang Fan couldn’t help laughing out loud: “You really aren’t suited to working in the restaurant. Manager Li letting you leave was right.”
The guests coming and going at the Li Family Restaurant were either people with deep backgrounds or powerfully strong deities.
With his straightforward personality, if he wasn’t careful, he wouldn’t even know how he died after offending someone.
Yang Fan stood up, “Follow me.”
Li Tianheng was stunned for half a second, then quickly stored the unfinished food on the table into his Divine Kingdom, and hurriedly followed.
Inside the first-floor lobby of the restaurant, Li Fengzhu took the initiative to speak:
“Young Master Yang, there has been much offense today. This meal will be my treat, please feel free to come often in the future.”
As his words fell, his posture was put extremely low, even carrying a trace of ingratiating meaning.
Yang Fan, however, merely waved his hand gently.
“No need. Manager Li doesn’t have an easy time doing business, and you are also my friend’s Old Ancestor, how could I take advantage of you like this.”
Saying that, his fingertips moved slightly, and a wisp of divinity fluctuation fell, directly transferring the Divinity Points over.
The action was crisp and neat, without a trace of hesitation.
“Right, Manager Li.”
Yang Fan suddenly raised his eyes, his tone calm, but carrying a faint, undeniable sense of oppression.
“Li Tianheng will be my Subordinate God from now on.”
“Next time he comes to the restaurant to consume, directly arrange a top-floor private booth for him, and just charge the expenses to my account.”
Li Fengzhu’s heart gave a start, and he nodded hastily.
“Understood, Young Master Yang can rest assured!”
“For Tianheng to be able to become your Subordinate God is his Opportunity.”
“From now on in my restaurant, he is likewise the most noble guest!”

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Li Tianheng Who Had an Epiphany
paragraphs: “That’s good.”
Yang Fan responded indifferently.
Saying no more, he turned around, took Li Tianheng away from the restaurant, and walked toward the villa area.
The figures of the two gradually disappeared at the end of the street.
Only then did Li Fengzhu slowly straighten his body, his brows tightly locked, and a trace of complexity flashed in the depths of his eyes.
“Li Tianheng... Didn’t he grow up in a nameless county on Tiannan Star?”
“How did he get involved with the Gu Family’s son-in-law?”
He muttered softly, his tone holding both confusion and a hint of remorse.
Had he known earlier, he shouldn’t have been so cold to this kid back then.
It’s just a pity that wanting to remedy it now was already a step too late.
He gently exhaled a breath, “I can only... slowly ease the relationship in the future.”
Although Li Fengzhu was a Fifth-Order God, in the eyes of ordinary gods and demigods, he was already a high-and-mighty existence.
But in reality, he had no background.
Being able to snap up such a sizable restaurant in the The Frontline trading area relied on thousands of years of bit-by-bit accumulation and careful management.
On the surface, he was glorious and decent, a “decent figure” among Mid-tier Gods.
But only he himself knew that in front of truly major families, this bit of strength and resources of his was simply not worth mentioning.
A single sentence from the other party would be enough to instantly collapse his thousands of years of accumulation.
The so-called status was merely established on the safety of “no one taking a serious look at him.”
A god with a major background like Yang Fan must definitely not be offended.
After leaving the restaurant, Yang Fan casually reminded him.
“It’s better to have less contact with this Old Ancestor of your Li Family in the future.”
“If I hadn’t been here just now, you probably would have already died.”
His tone was calm, as if he were stating a most ordinary fact.
Hearing this, Li Tianheng was silent for a moment, then nodded.
“I know.”
He paused, then gave a bitter smile.
“However, I don’t hate the Old Ancestor.”
“If it weren’t for him, I might still be trapped in the production base right now, unable to even see the outside world.”
“Being able to achieve a Breakthrough to a demigod also entirely depended on the Old Ancestor.”
His tone was very calm, without resentment, nor did he have the qualification to resent.
“The Old Ancestor left Tiannan Star for too long; the Family’s ancient books didn’t even record it.”
“He was willing to bring me out, and I am already very satisfied.”
“Today’s matter was my fault.”
Li Tianheng smiled self-deprecatingly.
“I originally just wanted to borrow some momentum to act cool in front of you, not expecting to almost lose my life.”
After finishing, he instead felt much more relaxed.
It was as if he had completely let go of some tense thing.
Yang Fan glanced at him, nodded slightly, and said nothing more.
Yang Fan did not originate from a major Family.
His only true relatives in the past were Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong.
The two had mediocre talent and ordinary strength, but from childhood to adulthood, they tried their best to give him a safe and worry-free growth environment.
Precisely because of this, Yang Fan was not indifferent to things like “Family affection”.
Therefore, he disliked Li Fengzhu’s approach of “being able to dispose of Family members at will”.
But he also understood that the rules of this world were not determined by emotions.
Therefore, he would not casually interfere in other people’s Karma.
Not long after, Yang Fan brought Li Tianheng to his Gu Family villa on the The Frontline.
The villa covered an extremely vast area, with patches of green plants inside, full of vitality.
Various service robots operated orderly within it, pruning flowers and trees, tidying the environment, and allocating resources; everything was in good order.
It was like a private world “exquisitely managed”.
Standing at the entrance, Li Tianheng was completely stunned.
Even in the most prosperous area of Yang County, he had never seen such an exaggerated living environment.
You must know this was the The Frontline; wasn’t it supposed to conserve resources and serve everything for the war?
Demigods suffered at the front?
Gods enjoyed blessings in the back?
Everything before his eyes completely subverted his cognition.
For a split second, he even suspected whether he had walked into the wrong world.
His worldview was quietly reshaped at this moment.
“Yang... Brother Yang.”
Li Tianheng’s throat moved slightly, and his voice was a bit tight.
“Sister-in-law’s identity... Could she be from the Gu Family’s direct lineage?”
He was no longer that county youth from back then.
During this period on the The Frontline, he already had a basic understanding of the power structure of the Human Federation.
He knew very well what the two words Gu Family represented.
Upon hearing that Yang Fan married into the Gu Family as a matrilocal husband, although his heart was shocked, it was not unacceptable.
After all, in his memory, before the College Entrance Examination, Yang Fan had already been specially recruited by the Primordial Academy.
Studying deeply in a top-tier academy naturally highered the probability of meeting those children of major families.
But to be able to live in such a large villa on the The Frontline!
The identity of this “sister-in-law” was probably much higher than he had imagined.
“She is direct lineage, and moreover a Prodigy among the direct lineage.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm as he casually added.
“Right, we already have a child named Gu Chengye.”
“A year later he might also follow his mother to the The Frontline; remember to prepare red envelopes by then.”
He spoke relaxed, even carrying a bit of a joking meaning.
But falling into Li Tianheng’s ears, it felt like a heavy hammer.
——Boom!
His entire person instantly froze.
His Dao Heart almost shattered on the spot.
In these years, he ran around on the The Frontline, and the Divine Kingdom War was fraught with danger at every step; a slight carelessness would mean total annihilation.
In order to become stronger, he was even driven to doubt life at one point, and a dignified demigod almost got forced to sell himself.
But what about now?
He struggled desperately on the line of life and death.
Yet Yang Fan had settled down and started a Family in the Primordial Academy, and even had a child.
Both are humans, how could the gap become so huge?
“Brother Yang...”
Li Tianheng’s voice trembled, and his eye sockets turned red.
“I... I don’t want to work hard anymore either.”
He fiercely rushed forward and grabbed Yang Fan’s thigh.
“Do you have any resource channels? No need for direct lineage! I’m not worthy!”
“Collateral lineage is fine too! Even a slightly connected relationship is okay!”
“I want to live off a woman too!!”
His emotional breakdown was righteous and confident.
At this moment, he seemed to have completely had an Epiphany.
Those years of so-called striving, struggling, and bitter cultivation were all illusions.
“If suffering were useful, then the richest beings in this world should be those Divine Beings who treat believers as mine slaves!”
He raised his head, his eyes even carrying a kind of “Epiphany-like clarity”.
“Living off a woman is the true Dao!”
“With a different starting point, the destination is a natural chasm!”
“What’s the use of hard work? Can ten years of bitter cultivation compare to someone else’s three generations of accumulation?”
Yang Fan was rendered somewhat speechless by this act of his, casually lifted him off his leg, and wore a look of disgust.
“Stop acting crazy.”
“Seeing that I succeeded, you think you’ve found a shortcut?”
“Those Prodigy women of major families are not as simple as you think.”
He paused, his tone calming down.
“Instead of having time to dream, you might as well make yourself stronger first.”
Changing the subject.
“Alright, let’s talk about business.”
“Sign the Subordinate God Contract and report your Divine Kingdom’s current combat power to me.”
“I’ll give you the coordinates of the Alien Divine Kingdom in a moment.”
“After taking it down, you can go pioneer the basic resources that I don’t use yourself.”

But to be able to live in such a large villa on the The Frontline!
The identity of this “sister-in-law” was probably much higher than he had imagined.
“She is direct lineage, and moreover a Prodigy among the direct lineage.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm as he casually added.
“Right, we already have a child named Gu Chengye.”
“A year later he might also follow his mother to the The Frontline; remember to prepare red envelopes by then.”
He spoke relaxed, even carrying a bit of a joking meaning.
But falling into Li Tianheng’s ears, it felt like a heavy hammer.
——Boom!
His entire person instantly froze.
His Dao Heart almost shattered on the spot.
In these years, he ran around on the The Frontline, and the Divine Kingdom War was fraught with danger at every step; a slight carelessness would mean total annihilation.
In order to become stronger, he was even driven to doubt life at one point, and a dignified demigod almost got forced to sell himself.
But what about now?
He struggled desperately on the line of life and death.
Yet Yang Fan had settled down and started a Family in the Primordial Academy, and even had a child.
Both are humans, how could the gap become so huge?
“Brother Yang...”
Li Tianheng’s voice trembled, and his eye sockets turned red.
I don’t want to work hard anymore either.”
He fiercely rushed forward and grabbed Yang Fan’s thigh.
“Do you have any resource channels?
No need for direct lineage!
I’m not worthy!”
“Collateral lineage is fine too!
Even a slightly connected relationship is okay!”
“I want to live off a woman too!!”
His emotional breakdown was righteous and confident.
At this moment, he seemed to have completely had an Epiphany.
Those years of so-called striving, struggling, and bitter cultivation were all illusions.
“If suffering were useful, then the richest beings in this world should be those Divine Beings who treat believers as mine slaves!”
He raised his head, his eyes even carrying a kind of “Epiphany-like clarity”.
“Living off a woman is the true Dao!”
“With a different starting point, the destination is a natural chasm!”
“What’s the use of hard work?
Can ten years of bitter cultivation compare to someone else’s three generations of accumulation?”
Yang Fan was rendered somewhat speechless by this act of his, casually lifted him off his leg, and wore a look of disgust.
“Stop acting crazy.”
“Seeing that I succeeded, you think you’ve found a shortcut?”
“Those Prodigy women of major families are not as simple as you think.”
He paused, his tone calming down.
“Instead of having time to dream, you might as well make yourself stronger first.”
Changing the subject.
“Alright, let’s talk about business.”
“Sign the Subordinate God Contract and report your Divine Kingdom’s current combat power to me.”
“I’ll give you the coordinates of the Alien Divine Kingdom in a moment.”
“After taking it down, you can go pioneer the basic resources that I don’t use yourself.”

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Signing the Contract
paragraphs: Hearing that it was serious business, the breakdown on Li Tianheng’s face instantly vanished.
The entire person switched back from “fantasy disillusionment mode” to “combat state”.
“Don’t worry, Brother Yang!”
“Mission guaranteed to be completed!”
Afterward, Li Tianheng took out a faintly glowing contract scroll from his embrace and handed it to Yang Fan with both hands.
This was a Subordinate God Contract custom-made by the Human Federation for the The Frontline.
Unlike conventional divine kingdom contracts, the restrictions of the divine kingdom’s rules were weaker, but the constraints of federal law were stronger.
In essence, it was a short-term cooperation contract characterized by “high freedom but strict supervision”.
Both parties could dissolve it at any time, and permanent binding did not exist.
Therefore, it was also known as—a short-term Subordinate God Contract.
As for the clauses on the contract regarding resource distribution, post-war profit-sharing, and others, Li Tianheng filled them all in as “zero” without any hesitation.
To him, Yang Fan’s initial investment of one hundred thousand Divinity Points was already full of sincerity.
Even if Yang Fan didn’t make a move at all this time, he was willing to bear all the costs.
Yang Fan and he simultaneously pressed their hands onto the contract.
The next instant.
The contract suddenly ignited a pale golden brilliance, spreading out like water ripples, transforming into two streaks of light that plunged into the centers of their brows respectively.
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly.
He could clearly perceive that an indistinct passage had appeared between his divine kingdom and Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom.
The passage existed, but it was extremely unstable, as if it could snap at any moment.
If high-tier believers were to be teleported, it was highly likely to directly tear apart the passage structure.
Yang Fan understood in his heart that this was the natural restriction of the divine kingdom’s rules.
Even after signing a Subordinate God Contract, it was still very difficult for a deity’s believers to enter a demigod’s divine kingdom.
“Brother Yang.”
Li Tianheng took a deep breath, and his speech speed noticeably accelerated after getting into state.
“My current divine kingdom has a total population of about three billion.”
“Among them, about 1.3 billion are elderly and women and children, and about 1.5 billion are battle-ready believer soldiers.”
“The divine kingdom has a reserve of two million doses of Blood-Coagulating Powder.”
“Ten million sets of C-grade weapons, two hundred million sets of D-grade weapons, and one billion sets of E-grade weapons.”
He paused for a moment and continued:
“That set of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array rewarded by the school has already reached Major Achievement.”
“In addition, I also bought two E-grade Formations from the Divine Shop—the Locking Heaven Array and the Extinguishing God Array, both of which have currently reached Minor Achievement.”
Speaking of this, his eyes lit up slightly.
“Right, previously when the school organized the Divine Kingdom Defense War, your divine kingdom gave me quite a bit of inspiration.”
“I later bought five thousand Thousand Poison Swamps myself.”
“On the side of the City of Technology, two City-Annihilating Cannons are also equipped.”
“If we lure the enemy into my divine kingdom to fight, it should be able to cause quite a bit of depletion.”
As he spoke, the more Li Tianheng talked, the more excited he became, and his expression grew increasingly proud.
Although he had lived extremely hard lives at the The Frontline these years, the development of his divine kingdom had truly been piled up solidly.
In his view, although his journey all the way here was a bit disheveled.
But placed among all the classmates of Yang County No. 1 Middle School’s current cohort.
Aside from the “monster” Yang Fan, he had already steadily suppressed everyone, and even Luo Bing was not his match.
Thinking of this, his confidence grew a bit more.
However, as Yang Fan listened to his recounting, his expression gradually turned somewhat peculiar.
“Cough.”
He paused, and still couldn’t help speaking up.
“Didn’t you develop through loans? How come... the divine kingdom feels so weak?”
The moment the word “weak” fell, Li Tianheng froze entirely.
“No way? Brother Yang?”
His eyes widened.
“My divine kingdom’s combat power is still weak?”
“I’m not bragging, but with just this configuration of mine, among those demigods just now, it can already be considered part of the strongest batch.”
The more he spoke, the more anxious he became, even carrying a hint of grievance.
“Over a billion battle-ready population!”
“Just the food expenses for the divine kingdom every day are an astronomical figure.”
“If it weren’t for fighting the Divine Kingdom War, I would have already issued a Divine Decree to restrict believers from reproducing.”
He sighed, his tone even revealing a trace of helplessness over “excessive financial pressure”.
“If they keep reproducing, I really can’t afford to raise them.”
Yang Fan continued to ask, “What is the specific strength of these battle-ready believers?”
Mentioning this question, Li Tianheng’s expression immediately regained its confidence.
“Because of the sequelae of my “Mad Blood” talent, I previously took out a loan to buy a large amount of Fountain of Life.”
“The overall environment of the divine kingdom has improved greatly, and the growth rate of the believers has also been pulled up a lot.”
His tone paused, and he raised his hand to gesture.
“Among the current battle-ready believers, there are about 500 million Tier 5 Beings.”
“The rest are basically Tier 4 beings.”
Speaking of this, he was obviously somewhat smug.
But soon, he added another sentence, as if emphasizing the “gold content”.
“There are also believers at the Qi Refining level, which once reached twenty at their Peak.”
“Of course, later their lifespan reached its limit and without a new Breakthrough, there are now fourteen left.”
He shrugged.
“You know too, Brother Yang, breaking through from Tier 5 to Qi Refining is inherently a major hurdle, and sometimes it depends on luck; this kind of fluctuation is very normal.”
He spoke as if it were a matter of course, even carrying a bit of “industry common sense” flavor.
Yet as Yang Fan listened, he fell silent for a fraction of a second.
A moment later, he couldn’t help muttering inwardly: “After leaving the Primordial Academy, are the demigods outside... all this ‘weak’?”
Judging by his current Mental Energy perception.
Being at the same demigod tier, the power fluctuation on Li Tianheng’s body was not even one-thousandth of Ye Jianfeng and the others’ power.
The gap was so large that it was somewhat outrageous.
“Find any room to stay in.”
Yang Fan pulled back his thoughts and spoke indifferently.
“I’ll go buy divine kingdom coordinates first.”
“During the Divine Kingdom War, just listen to my arrangements.”
“Many thanks, Brother Yang!”
Li Tianheng stood at attention almost immediately.
“No, many thanks, Adoptive Father!”
“I’ll just stay in the corner!”
After saying that, he walked straight towards the nanny room at the very edge of the villa.
“If you need anything, just call me.”
“Pouring tea and serving water, cooking and sweeping, I actually know how to do all of it.”
Looking at his back, Yang Fan helplessly shook his head.
There were many rooms, and he didn’t care where the other party wanted to stay.
However, Li Tianheng’s subconscious “self-demotion” was also understandable.
After all, the gap in status and strength between the two sides was indeed no longer on the same level.
Returning to his room, Yang Fan put on the virtual helmet and entered the The Frontline military merit exchange interface.
Regarding the military merit System, he had already understood it very clearly through Yang Da.
Besides being able to exchange for high-tier war buildings, divine kingdom coordinates could also be purchased here.
The next instant, the divine kingdom coordinate exchange interface slowly unfolded.
Different from ordinary resource exchanges, this page was obviously more “grim”, and the interface presented a structure similar to a star map.
Countless light spots floated in the Void Realm, and every single light point represented a purchasable divine kingdom coordinate.
As for the color of the light spots, it represented the danger Rank and reward rating.
[Divine Kingdom Coordinate · Purchase Interface]
Demigod-grade Divine Kingdom Coordinates:
[Coordinates: ]
Race: Ashen Bone Clan (Humanoid Bone-based Civilization)
Strength Rating: Grade B Lower-Middle
Divine Kingdom Scale: About 25.6 billion units of living beings
[Divine Kingdom Defense System]
White Bone City Wall (Grade B Defense Building): Can absorb 30% of physical impact
Bone Spirit Corridor (Grade C Defense Building): Can continuously summon skeletal guards
Blood Sacrifice Altar (Temporary Enhancement): Can increase overall combat power by 20% in a short time
(Can be expanded)
[Potential Supporting Deities Behind the Scenes]
Main God: Lord of Ashen Skeletons (First-Order God)
Support Tendency: Medium-Low, mainly focusing on basic supplies.
Probability of successful deduction after a successful invasion: Low
[Risk Assessment]: Medium
[Coordinate Price]: 100,000 Divinity Points
[Coordinates: ]
Race: Molten Zerg (Zerg Civilization)
Strength Rating: Grade B+
