chapters.title: Chapter 318: Having Too Much Money to Burn?
paragraphs: As expected of the Divine Kingdom coordinates from the The Frontline military, the introduction was much more detailed than the demigod coordinates Yang Fan purchased from the Divine Shop, and the price was even cheaper.
Yang Fan could understand that these Alien Demigods on the The Frontline possessed stronger strength and had gods supporting them from behind, so naturally the price was cheaper.
He continued tapping the page and discovered that the coordinates of gods could also be purchased.
[Divine God Coordinates (Requires Military Merit for Exchange)]
[First-Order God Coordinates]
Exchange Conditions: 1 Million Military Merits
Remarks: [Purchasing with one million military merits grants entry qualifications to the divine war, conducted under the framework of the “Federal War Agreement”.
The target is the currently designated conquest object of the The Frontline Third Legion.
Once the purchase is completed, it will automatically connect to the Third Legion’s war sequence dispatch System.
Its Divine Kingdom combat power will be uniformly integrated into the battlefield command System, accepting task assignments and scheduling.
The Divine Kingdom Battlefield is monitored in real-time by Intelligent Life throughout the entire process.
After the war ends, unified settlement and military merit distribution will be conducted based on each party’s war contribution.]
Seeing this remark, Yang Fan’s brow inevitably furrowed.
“Yang Da, why are there so many restrictions on a god’s Divine Kingdom coordinates?” Yang Fan asked.
Not only did he need to coordinate and fight with other Human Race gods, but he also had to accept unified deployment.
This kind of restriction made it completely unacceptable to him.
“Reporting to Master, the situation of the The Frontline Divine Kingdom War is extremely complex.”
“A single move can affect the entire situation.”
“Even for a First-Order God, once their Divine Kingdom faces the risk of annihilation, they will proactively hand over their coordinates to exchange for support from their peers.”
“In addition, the Divine Kingdom coordinates of gods are extremely scarce, and obtaining them is extremely difficult.”
“The military’s unified control is, on one hand, to monopolize strategic resources, and on the other hand, to prevent Human Race gods from being defeated one by one.”
Yang Da paused and continued.
“Unlike Divine Kingdom Wars between demigods, the Divine Kingdom of a First-Order God is extremely massive, with an average area often reaching the scale of tens of billions of square kilometers.
The rules inside the Divine Kingdom are complete and the System is complex.
Wanting to push through to the Divine Kingdom Core requires spending an extremely long time.
There are numerous battlefield variables, and without unified coordination, it is very easy to fall into crisis.”
After hearing this, Yang Fan’s brow furrowed even tighter instead.
Relying on Origin Evolution, the Divine Kingdom Core of a demigod could bring talents to Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, but it could not expand the area of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan only now discovered that the wars between gods were not that simple.
If he continued to choose to be a lone wolf, it might lead to a one-versus-many situation.
“Master need not worry.”
Yang Da continued to speak.
“This subordinate suggests that you can recruit a large number of Subordinate Gods, and acquire the Divine Kingdom Core of Alien Demigods through proxy wars.”
“Afterwards, use the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card to inversely anchor the coordinates of the Alien Gods.”
“The deeper the entanglement between the Subordinate God and the target god, the higher the success rate of the deduction.”
He paused and added.
“As for frontal wars between gods, although external intervention exists, they usually do not fully enter the field.”
“In most cases, they will only provide war resources, military equipment support, or temporary war buildings.”
“The believers of other gods usually do not directly participate in the war.”
“Judging by Master’s Divine Kingdom foundation, this layer of risk is completely controllable.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan also nodded.
Then he directly confirmed the transaction on the coordinate purchase interface.
One hundred thousand Divinity Points were deducted.
A set of Beast-Race Demigods Divine Kingdom coordinates was transmitted to Yang Fan.
The reason for choosing this target was not only because of strategic matching, but also because the god supporting this target had a relatively high level of support intensity.
The success probability of deducing the god’s coordinates was at “above average.”
But it also meant that such demigods tended to be extremely powerful.
Li Tianheng’s pressure would become much greater.
Yang Fan immediately sent the complete information to Li Tianheng.
A few minutes later, the door was knocked on.
Li Tianheng stood outside the door, his expression obviously a bit stiff.
The look in his eyes when he looked at Yang Fan even carried a trace of a complex “sense of tragic heroism.”
“Brother Yang... You aren’t still holding a grudge against me for what happened before, right?”
“You’d rather spend one hundred thousand Divinity Points just to send me to my death!”
His voice was even trembling slightly.
In proxy wars, although the cost of demigod coordinates was borne by the god, in order to ensure fairness of The Frontline information,
when the god handed the coordinates over to the Subordinate God, detailed intelligence on the Alien God would also be transmitted synchronously.
The moment Li Tianheng saw this information on the Beast-Race Demigods, his expression changed completely.
There was completely no chance of winning.
The believers under the opponent’s command numbered as many as 20 billion, and the entities in the Qi Refining Realm even broke through the tens of thousands.
What was even more terrifying was that the support intensity of the god behind them was extremely strong, and resources were almost endless.
Demigod coordinates of this level already belonged to absolute The Frontline high-risk targets.
Even if normal gods purchased them, they would weigh their options repeatedly.

It was not just the price of 100,000 Divinity Points; once their own Subordinate God was defeated, there was also a huge probability that the opponent would inversely deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates.
He didn’t understand why Yang Fan would make such a choice.
“With me here, what are you afraid of?” Yang Fan said confidently.
“Enter the Divine Kingdom with your consciousness; I will help you simply construct a defense System first.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm, as if he were just speaking of a trivial matter.
Bitterness surged in Li Tianheng’s heart.
He felt that this time he had completely boarded a pirate ship and had no way out at all.
He could only bite the bullet and sink his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom.

Under the Subordinate God Contract, although the spatial passage could not carry a god’s believers to fight across boundaries, a god’s consciousness could ignore barriers and directly enter the Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom.
The next instant, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already appeared above Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom.
Looking out, the aura of life in the Divine Kingdom Core area was still relatively rich, but the periphery was already in complete ruin.
The earth was pitted and covered with dense cracks, as if it had been torn apart countless times.
Large areas of forests were burned and collapsed, leaving only charred remains.
Large amounts of unidentified venom accumulated in low-lying areas, emitting a pungent aura.
The entire peripheral area was almost completely destroyed by the war.
With just a single glance, Yang Fan had already judged the situation.
Before meeting him, Li Tianheng had obviously already experienced multiple Divine Kingdom Wars.
“Brother Yang, the situation is just like this.”
Li Tianheng walked to Yang Fan’s side, his expression exhausted to the extreme.
“These are all my military forces.”
“If you really want my life, then I accept it.”
He no longer held any hope.
In his view, this war was already a dead end.
Yet what he couldn’t understand was why Yang Fan, having clearly mastered all his intelligence, still spent a huge price to purchase this high-risk coordinate.
Li Tianheng couldn’t figure it out, even if Yang Fan was dissatisfied with him.
Wouldn’t it have been fine for him to just watch the show when Li Fengzhu made a move against him?
Was it necessary to transfer 100,000 Divinity Points to him and spend another 100,000 to purchase coordinates?
Was he having too much money to burn?
Yang Fan did not answer; he only raised his right hand and gently snapped his fingers.
The next instant, space suddenly tore apart.
Countless streams of light poured down from the Void Realm.
One war defense building after another descended upon Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom like shooting stars.

“This subordinate suggests that you can recruit a large number of Subordinate Gods, and acquire the Divine Kingdom Core of Alien Demigods through proxy wars.”
“Afterwards, use the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card to inversely anchor the coordinates of the Alien Gods.”
“The deeper the entanglement between the Subordinate God and the target god, the higher the success rate of the deduction.”
He paused and added.
“As for frontal wars between gods, although external intervention exists, they usually do not fully enter the field.”
“In most cases, they will only provide war resources, military equipment support, or temporary war buildings.”
“The believers of other gods usually do not directly participate in the war.”
“Judging by Master’s Divine Kingdom foundation, this layer of risk is completely controllable.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan also nodded.
Then he directly confirmed the transaction on the coordinate purchase interface.
One hundred thousand Divinity Points were deducted.
A set of Beast-Race Demigods Divine Kingdom coordinates was transmitted to Yang Fan.
The reason for choosing this target was not only because of strategic matching, but also because the god supporting this target had a relatively high level of support intensity.
The success probability of deducing the god’s coordinates was at “above average.”
But it also meant that such demigods tended to be extremely powerful.
Li Tianheng’s pressure would become much greater.
Yang Fan immediately sent the complete information to Li Tianheng.
A few minutes later, the door was knocked on.
Li Tianheng stood outside the door, his expression obviously a bit stiff.
The look in his eyes when he looked at Yang Fan even carried a trace of a complex “sense of tragic heroism.”
“Brother Yang...
You aren’t still holding a grudge against me for what happened before, right?”
“You’d rather spend one hundred thousand Divinity Points just to send me to my death!”
His voice was even trembling slightly.
In proxy wars, although the cost of demigod coordinates was borne by the god, in order to ensure fairness of The Frontline information,
when the god handed the coordinates over to the Subordinate God, detailed intelligence on the Alien God would also be transmitted synchronously.
The moment Li Tianheng saw this information on the Beast-Race Demigods, his expression changed completely.
There was completely no chance of winning.
The believers under the opponent’s command numbered as many as 20 billion, and the entities in the Qi Refining Realm even broke through the tens of thousands.
What was even more terrifying was that the support intensity of the god behind them was extremely strong, and resources were almost endless.
Demigod coordinates of this level already belonged to absolute The Frontline high-risk targets.
Even if normal gods purchased them, they would weigh their options repeatedly.

It was not just the price of 100,000 Divinity Points; once their own Subordinate God was defeated, there was also a huge probability that the opponent would inversely deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates.
He didn’t understand why Yang Fan would make such a choice.
“With me here, what are you afraid of?” Yang Fan said confidently.
“Enter the Divine Kingdom with your consciousness; I will help you simply construct a defense System first.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm, as if he were just speaking of a trivial matter.
Bitterness surged in Li Tianheng’s heart.
He felt that this time he had completely boarded a pirate ship and had no way out at all.
He could only bite the bullet and sink his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom.

Under the Subordinate God Contract, although the spatial passage could not carry a god’s believers to fight across boundaries, a god’s consciousness could ignore barriers and directly enter the Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom.
The next instant, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already appeared above Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom.
Looking out, the aura of life in the Divine Kingdom Core area was still relatively rich, but the periphery was already in complete ruin.
The earth was pitted and covered with dense cracks, as if it had been torn apart countless times.
Large areas of forests were burned and collapsed, leaving only charred remains.
Large amounts of unidentified venom accumulated in low-lying areas, emitting a pungent aura.
The entire peripheral area was almost completely destroyed by the war.
With just a single glance, Yang Fan had already judged the situation.
Before meeting him, Li Tianheng had obviously already experienced multiple Divine Kingdom Wars.
“Brother Yang, the situation is just like this.”
Li Tianheng walked to Yang Fan’s side, his expression exhausted to the extreme.
“These are all my military forces.”
“If you really want my life, then I accept it.”
He no longer held any hope.
In his view, this war was already a dead end.
Yet what he couldn’t understand was why Yang Fan, having clearly mastered all his intelligence, still spent a huge price to purchase this high-risk coordinate.
Li Tianheng couldn’t figure it out, even if Yang Fan was dissatisfied with him.
Wouldn’t it have been fine for him to just watch the show when Li Fengzhu made a move against him?
Was it necessary to transfer 100,000 Divinity Points to him and spend another 100,000 to purchase coordinates?
Was he having too much money to burn?
Yang Fan did not answer; he only raised his right hand and gently snapped his fingers.
The next instant, space suddenly tore apart.
Countless streams of light poured down from the Void Realm.
One war defense building after another descended upon Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom like shooting stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Poison?
paragraphs: One thousand Fortress Cannons suddenly landed, directly covering the middle area of the divine kingdom. Each battery on the City of Technology was spaced ten meters apart, with their muzzles uniformly facing the outer perimeter.
One hundred thousand Thousand Poison Swamps rapidly deployed, expanding wildly along the outer perimeter and directly transforming the ruined land into a highly toxic forbidden zone.
High above in the sky, a fleet of one thousand f3500 fighter jets roared and circled, their engine roars tearing through the firmament like a steel storm patrolling the skies.

On the ground, one million Mechanical soldiers arrayed themselves neatly, while a thousand Super Alloy Robot Warriors marched in unison, advancing like a cold, rigid tide toward the core defense line.
In just a few breaths, the entire divine kingdom was completely reconstructed.
The dilapidated, desolate, and incomplete world was forcibly rewritten into a fortress of war.
A firepower system, an aerial system, and ground legions—it had everything.
The outer perimeter of the divine kingdom instantly transformed into a combat zone.
Li Tianheng froze in place, his gaze completely vacant.
After a moment, he suddenly snapped back to reality.
“Bro... Brother Yang, are all these defensive structures lent to me?”
His voice even carried a hint of trembling.
“With these, if you let me fight a defensive battle, I have absolute confidence.”
Ever since stepping foot onto The Frontline and becoming a demigod, he had never felt such a strong sense of security.
Especially those densely packed Fortress Cannons.
Li Tianheng declared that any demigod who dared to attack his divine kingdom was simply courting death!
“They aren’t lent to you.”
Yang Fan said calmly.
“They are a gift to you.”
For the current Yang Fan, these defensive structures were already obsolete items.
You must know that his divine kingdom contained a massive amount of s-class war structures.
These ordinary defensive structures were already of no use to keep, yet a pity to discard.
Take the f3500 fighter jets, for example. Now, under Yang Da’s arrangement, they had already become cargo planes used to transport goods for believers!

Originally, Yang Fan had planned to wait until his family members achieved a Breakthrough to demigodhood before giving these defensive structures to them in batches, but for now, he could give a small portion to Li Tianheng.
At the very least, it would prevent him from losing his nerve before the battle even began.
Hearing that Yang Fan was directly giving such a massive scale of defensive structures to him, Li Tianheng froze instantly, his mouth wide open.
“Adoptive Father! How does this adopted son of yours deserve such care from you?!”
“It was my fault back then for being ignorant and raising my hands against you in front of other classmates.”
“Why don’t you hit me back? Just hold back a little, as long as you don’t beat me to death!”
As he spoke, he lunged straight forward, snot and tears streaming down as he wailed in such a tragic manner, even carrying a hint of exaggerated comicality.
“Enough, stop acting the fool.”
Yang Fan rolled his eyes.
“These structures are of no use to me anymore. I am going to stay on The Frontline for ten years and am prepared to cooperate with you long-term.”
Ever since seeing Li Tianheng on The Frontline, Yang Fan could no longer quite figure him out.
To say he was reckless, he was still the same old self, his very first reaction upon meeting was to directly throw hands.
Yet once he recognized reality, he became extremely pragmatic, opening and closing his mouth with either “Bro” or “Adoptive Father”.
Hearing this, Li Tianheng did not hesitate at all. “Forget ten years, a permanent Subordinate God Contract is no problem at all!”
Yang Fan’s lavishness had completely shattered his understanding.
Situated within the divine kingdom, he could clearly perceive every single change.
The aura emitted by those Super Alloy Robot Warriors was not the least bit weaker than believers in the Qi Refining Realm.
Furthermore, the f3500 fighter jets circling in the sky brought an even heavier sense of oppression.
Just this single wave of reinforcement was probably enough in value to buy his entire divine kingdom.
Over the years on The Frontline, Li Tianheng had also signed contracts with quite a few gods.
But those gods were stingier than the last, and the Divinity Points they supported him with even had to be precise down to a single digit.
In comparison, Yang Fan’s generosity was simply outrageous.
Generous to the point of feeling unreal.
At this moment, Li Tianheng even developed an illusion—
He had finally found his organization.
After a brief shock, Li Tianheng seemed to think of something, and his expression turned somewhat hesitant again.
“Brother Yang, with these defensive measures, I am confident I can guard the divine kingdom.”
“However, aside from the robots, the rest of the forces can only be used for defense.”
“The gap in overall combat power between both sides still exists, and I don’t have the confidence to take down the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.”
Yang Fan did not reply, simply raising his right hand.
An iron box forged from a special metal slowly materialized mid-air.
“Inside this is something to defeat the enemy.”
“Next, you just need to command the Super Alloy Robot Warriors to penetrate deep into the enemy’s divine kingdom—the deeper, the better—and then open it.”
Li Tianheng furrowed his brows slightly.

He could sense that although this iron box was right inside his own divine kingdom, it seemed to be isolated by some kind of force, making it completely impossible to pry into even a fraction of its contents.
“What is this?”
Yang Fan said indifferently.
“Do as I say.”
Pausing for a moment, he added another sentence.
“Also, don’t open it inside your own divine kingdom, otherwise it will waste quite a lot of Resources.”
As his voice fell, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already withdrawn from the divine kingdom.
Li Tianheng stood in place, his throat swallowing slightly, his eyes filled with irrepressible curiosity.
Yet he still forcibly suppressed the impulse and acted according to Yang Fan’s instructions.
A Super Alloy Robot Warrior holding the iron box, accompanied by a Tier 5 Being believer by its side, passed through the coordinate channel together and entered the Orc race’s divine kingdom.
Almost the moment they entered, the Alien God had already captured the abnormal fluctuations.
The orc demigod’s gaze subsequently cast toward this area.
Under Li Tianheng’s remote control, the Super Alloy Robot Warrior did not pause, taking the believer and flying straight toward the direction of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.
At this moment, Li Tianheng was also observing all the movements of the enemy’s divine kingdom through the believer’s perspective.
He couldn’t help taking a deep breath, his eyes full of confusion.
“What on earth is Brother Yang giving me...”
“Could it be a super nuclear bomb produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom?”
“A trump card of this caliber probably has extremely high value and must be put to good use.”
Inside the opponent’s divine kingdom, a massive number of orc believers began frantically surrounding and slaughtering the Super Alloy Robot Warrior.
Although the Super Alloy Robot Warrior possessed combat power comparable to the Qi Refining Realm, it was ultimately just a Mechanical body.
Facing the encirclement of tens of thousands of orcs—even though most of them were merely ranked beings—it gradually began to find itself overmatched, and its advance speed was forcibly suppressed.
It could no longer push deeper by even half a step.
Seeing this scene, Li Tianheng hesitated no longer and directly gave the order.
“Open the metal box!”
The next instant, the metal box was opened.
Quietly resting inside the box was a palm-sized, emerald-green Medicinal Pill.
The moment it was opened, an extremely dense miasma suddenly drifted out.
The instant the Medicinal Pill came into contact with the air, it began to melt rapidly, and the green mist swept across in all directions like an out-of-control gale.
The surrounding orc believers instinctively inhaled a few breaths, yet they did not detect any abnormalities, and a hint of puzzlement even surfaced on their faces.
After a brief pause, the offensive unfolded once more.
Yet that Super Alloy Robot Warrior took swift action at this moment, frantically evacuating with Li Tianheng’s Tier 5 Being believer.
It charged all the way out of the battle circle, settled that believer upon a secluded hill, and then turned around alone to lure away the pursuing orcs.
Once it entered the opponent’s divine kingdom, this Super Alloy Robot Warrior comparable to the Qi Refining Realm was destined to be unable to escape.
Meanwhile, Li Tianheng still needed to continue observing the battlefield changes through the believer’s perspective.
“What is this thing? How come there is no reaction at all?”
“Poison? The reaction is this slow? That shouldn’t be right...”

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Will Always Remember You
paragraphs: Li Tianheng frowned, his face full of doubt.
Since it was something entrusted by Yang Fan, it could by no means be just an ordinary method.
But if it were truly going to have an effect on a demigod-level battlefield, the toxicity must be extremely terrifying.
Yet it had been spreading for so long now, and there was still no obvious change.
Just as he was puzzled, that fifth-order believer in the Divine Kingdom suddenly showed an abnormality.
Clearly there were no enemies around, but the faith connection between him and Li Tianheng was rapidly weakening.
It was as if it were being stripped away bit by bit by some kind of force.
“What’s the situation?”
Li Tianheng’s expression suddenly changed.
He immediately issued a Divine Decree, having the believers climb to high places to observe the external situation.
That fifth-order believer quickly climbed up the hill.
The next moment, within his field of vision, the scene below suddenly underwent a change.
Tens of thousands of orc believers were already obviously not right at this moment.
Some weaker orcs began to twitch frantically, their skin rapidly cracking, their teeth growing continuously, and saliva dripping endlessly down the corners of their mouths.
Their eyes gradually lost reason, replaced by a tyrannical madness.
The next instant, they actually began indiscriminately attacking their own kind!
The entire battlefield instantly fell into chaos.
Seeing this scene through the believer’s perspective, Li Tianheng felt a sudden chill run through his body, his spine growing cold.
“Fuck... zombie virus?!!”
His expression instantly became extremely unnatural.
This scene instantly reminded him of the scene they had seen when participating in the Divine Kingdom Defense War back at Yang County No. 1 Middle School upon entering Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
That familiar loss of control and madness were almost identical.
“You’ve fucking broken through to become a god, and you’re still playing this trick?”
“No... why can this thing still be packed into a box? And it can even spread through the air?”
Li Tianheng was completely dumbfounded.
He was completely unable to understand everything happening before his eyes.
Moreover, from the believer’s perspective, that Super Alloy Robot Warrior was ultimately completely dismantled and submerged in the orc frenzy.
That fifth-order believer could no longer hold on either, rapidly losing reason under the spread of the pollution, and ultimately similarly mutating into a Human Race zombie.
The next moment, the The Frontline vision was completely cut off.
Li Tianheng stood frozen in place, his heart aching with a pang of distress.
That was a robot warrior comparable to the Qi Refining Realm, and just like that, it was gone.
“Brother Yang... you are truly so wasteful.”
“How could you let such an expensive robot do such dangerous work? This is clearly the job of my believers.”
He couldn’t help but complain.
“As expected, it’s still better to cling to a rich woman.”
“If you don’t run a household, you truly don’t know how expensive firewood, rice, oil, and salt are.”
Li Tianheng quickly sent the video recorded just now through the believer’s perspective to Yang Fan.

At the same time, he attached a sentence: ‘Brother Yang, your little brother here is terrified of being poor. Next time for such dangerous work, just let my believers go. Letting such a precious robot march to its death is simply too wasteful!’
On the other side.
Watching the large number of beast-race believers slaughtering each other on the screen, Yang Fan slightly raised the corners of his mouth, revealing a trace of a satisfied smile.
Standing to the side, Yang Da also had an excited expression and respectfully bowed.
“Brilliant move, Master!”
“By relying on corpse pills to wage a war of attrition, we can completely and continuously erode the Divine Kingdom of the Alien Demigods at an extremely low cost.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.

These emerald-green Medicinal Pills were precisely corpse pills condensed by believers who had reached the White Zombie level, using the secret arts of Corpse Cultivators to nurture them within their bodies for a hundred years.
Every single corpse pill required a White Zombie believer to spend long years to form.
Not only that, after the corpse pill left an environment filled with corpse aura, the corpse poison inside would continuously leak away.
Only in a place dense with corpse aura like the Eternal Corpse Mine could the corpse pills be preserved for a relatively long time.
Precisely because of this, corpse pills could hardly be stored in large quantities.
Such war materials could not even be searched and purchased in the Divine Shop.
The reason was also very simple.

For ordinary Corpse Cultivator Divine Kingdoms, the cost of cultivating corpse pills was too high, and once truly thrown into a Divine Kingdom War, the opponent could completely purchase a large amount of corpse-poison-antidote potions in advance to cope with it, making the input and return completely disproportionate.
But all of this was simply not a problem for Yang Fan.
Within his Divine Kingdom nowadays, the believers who had broken through to the White Zombie level had long since exceeded one hundred million.
Other Corpse Cultivator Divine Kingdoms needed three months or even longer to nurture a batch of corpse pills.
Whereas Yang Fan only needed one day.
What was truly expensive, on the contrary, was the container used to store the corpse pills.
That was the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box developed by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.

Originally specialized for preserving top-grade Spirit Medicine, Divine Pills, and various high-tier Heaven And Earth Treasures, it was able to almost completely isolate the loss of Spiritual Qi and medicinal properties.
Every single Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box was priced as high as one million Faith Points.
Now, however, it was being used by Yang Fan to hold corpse pills.
However, for the current Yang Fan, this little cost was long since not worth mentioning.
When resources were scarce, the consumption of every single Faith Point needed to be repeatedly weighed for gains and losses.
But when the accumulation of the Divine Kingdom reached a certain degree, resources that once needed careful budgeting merely became an ordinary consumption in war.
The development of a Divine Kingdom civilization was never about a certain treasure becoming cheap.
Rather, it was that after one became powerful enough, things once regarded as precious treasures would eventually turn into chips that could be discarded at will.
“Since it has an effect, then continue giving corpse pills to Li Tianheng, letting him use them to pollute the opponent’s Divine Kingdom environment,” Yang Fan ordered.
“Understood, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully acknowledged the order and immediately began to make arrangements.
Inside the Eternal Corpse Mine.
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, corpse pills were continuously nurtured and produced one after another.
Robot Soldiers constantly entered and exited the mine, methodically taking out the corpse pills and placing them into one Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box after another.
Sealing, inspection, transportation...
The entire process did not have the slightest pause, resembling a mature assembly line.
A large number of robots holding Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes constantly passed through the space channels, continuously delivering them to Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Li Tianheng was personally stationed at the The Frontline, commanding the entire Divine Kingdom War.
On the periphery of the Divine Kingdom, a large number of Robot Soldiers stood in strict battle array.
The orc army continuously forced their way into the Divine Kingdom through space channels.
Yet what welcomed them was the overwhelming firepower coverage of f3500 fighter jets in the sky, as well as the deadly bombardment formed by Fortress Cannons.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
The roaring of artillery fire was incessant.
No matter how many orc troops came, just that many died.
They were completely unable to cross even half a step beyond the outer defense line.
Whenever the orc army temporarily retreated, Li Tianheng would immediately seize the opportunity to dispatch believers to enter the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.
Majestic Divine Might descended, and Li Tianheng’s voice simultaneously sounded in the minds of all the believers.
“Warriors of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Today, it is your turn to sacrifice yourselves for the Divine Kingdom.”
“You shall be divided into teams of ten thousand, each carrying one Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box, and enter the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.”
“Gas masks and biochemical armor must be worn throughout the entire process, and must not be removed in advance.”
“After releasing the poisonous pill, you must return to the periphery of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom and hand the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box over to the Mechanical warriors.”
“Once the mission is completed, you will have fulfilled your final duty as citizens of the Divine Kingdom.”
“The Divine Kingdom will always remember you.”
“Everything for the Divine Kingdom!”
Countless tiered believers had fanatical gazes as they shouted angrily and in unison.
“Everything for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Everything for the Gods!”

Moreover, from the believer’s perspective, that Super Alloy Robot Warrior was ultimately completely dismantled and submerged in the orc frenzy.
That fifth-order believer could no longer hold on either, rapidly losing reason under the spread of the pollution, and ultimately similarly mutating into a Human Race zombie.
The next moment, the The Frontline vision was completely cut off.
Li Tianheng stood frozen in place, his heart aching with a pang of distress.
That was a robot warrior comparable to the Qi Refining Realm, and just like that, it was gone.
“Brother Yang... you are truly so wasteful.”
“How could you let such an expensive robot do such dangerous work?
This is clearly the job of my believers.”
He couldn’t help but complain.
“As expected, it’s still better to cling to a rich woman.”
“If you don’t run a household, you truly don’t know how expensive firewood, rice, oil, and salt are.”
Li Tianheng quickly sent the video recorded just now through the believer’s perspective to Yang Fan.
At the same time, he attached a sentence: ‘Brother Yang, your little brother here is terrified of being poor.
Next time for such dangerous work, just let my believers go.
Letting such a precious robot march to its death is simply too wasteful!’
On the other side.
Watching the large number of beast-race believers slaughtering each other on the screen, Yang Fan slightly raised the corners of his mouth, revealing a trace of a satisfied smile.
Standing to the side, Yang Da also had an excited expression and respectfully bowed.
“Brilliant move, Master!”
“By relying on corpse pills to wage a war of attrition, we can completely and continuously erode the Divine Kingdom of the Alien Demigods at an extremely low cost.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.

These emerald-green Medicinal Pills were precisely corpse pills condensed by believers who had reached the White Zombie level, using the secret arts of Corpse Cultivators to nurture them within their bodies for a hundred years.
Every single corpse pill required a White Zombie believer to spend long years to form.
Not only that, after the corpse pill left an environment filled with corpse aura, the corpse poison inside would continuously leak away.
Only in a place dense with corpse aura like the Eternal Corpse Mine could the corpse pills be preserved for a relatively long time.
Precisely because of this, corpse pills could hardly be stored in large quantities.
Such war materials could not even be searched and purchased in the Divine Shop.
The reason was also very simple.

For ordinary Corpse Cultivator Divine Kingdoms, the cost of cultivating corpse pills was too high, and once truly thrown into a Divine Kingdom War, the opponent could completely purchase a large amount of corpse-poison-antidote potions in advance to cope with it, making the input and return completely disproportionate.
But all of this was simply not a problem for Yang Fan.
Within his Divine Kingdom nowadays, the believers who had broken through to the White Zombie level had long since exceeded one hundred million.
Other Corpse Cultivator Divine Kingdoms needed three months or even longer to nurture a batch of corpse pills.
Whereas Yang Fan only needed one day.
What was truly expensive, on the contrary, was the container used to store the corpse pills.
That was the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box developed by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.

Originally specialized for preserving top-grade Spirit Medicine, Divine Pills, and various high-tier Heaven And Earth Treasures, it was able to almost completely isolate the loss of Spiritual Qi and medicinal properties.
Every single Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box was priced as high as one million Faith Points.
Now, however, it was being used by Yang Fan to hold corpse pills.
However, for the current Yang Fan, this little cost was long since not worth mentioning.
When resources were scarce, the consumption of every single Faith Point needed to be repeatedly weighed for gains and losses.
But when the accumulation of the Divine Kingdom reached a certain degree, resources that once needed careful budgeting merely became an ordinary consumption in war.
The development of a Divine Kingdom civilization was never about a certain treasure becoming cheap.
Rather, it was that after one became powerful enough, things once regarded as precious treasures would eventually turn into chips that could be discarded at will.
“Since it has an effect, then continue giving corpse pills to Li Tianheng, letting him use them to pollute the opponent’s Divine Kingdom environment,” Yang Fan ordered.
“Understood, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully acknowledged the order and immediately began to make arrangements.
Inside the Eternal Corpse Mine.
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, corpse pills were continuously nurtured and produced one after another.
Robot Soldiers constantly entered and exited the mine, methodically taking out the corpse pills and placing them into one Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box after another.
Sealing, inspection, transportation...
The entire process did not have the slightest pause, resembling a mature assembly line.
A large number of robots holding Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes constantly passed through the space channels, continuously delivering them to Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Li Tianheng was personally stationed at the The Frontline, commanding the entire Divine Kingdom War.
On the periphery of the Divine Kingdom, a large number of Robot Soldiers stood in strict battle array.
The orc army continuously forced their way into the Divine Kingdom through space channels.
Yet what welcomed them was the overwhelming firepower coverage of f3500 fighter jets in the sky, as well as the deadly bombardment formed by Fortress Cannons.
“Boom!
Boom!
Boom!”
The roaring of artillery fire was incessant.
No matter how many orc troops came, just that many died.
They were completely unable to cross even half a step beyond the outer defense line.
Whenever the orc army temporarily retreated, Li Tianheng would immediately seize the opportunity to dispatch believers to enter the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.
Majestic Divine Might descended, and Li Tianheng’s voice simultaneously sounded in the minds of all the believers.
“Warriors of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Today, it is your turn to sacrifice yourselves for the Divine Kingdom.”
“You shall be divided into teams of ten thousand, each carrying one Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box, and enter the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.”
“Gas masks and biochemical armor must be worn throughout the entire process, and must not be removed in advance.”
“After releasing the poisonous pill, you must return to the periphery of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom and hand the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box over to the Mechanical warriors.”
“Once the mission is completed, you will have fulfilled your final duty as citizens of the Divine Kingdom.”
“The Divine Kingdom will always remember you.”
“Everything for the Divine Kingdom!”
Countless tiered believers had fanatical gazes as they shouted angrily and in unison.
“Everything for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Everything for the Gods!”

chapters.title: Chapter 321: Poison Him to Death Directly
paragraphs: Soon, squads of ten thousand men neatly assembled.
Carrying the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box, they continuously charged toward the Beast-Race Divine Kingdom under the cover of the Robot Soldiers.
Although Li Tianheng failed to find any data on the corpse pill, he had already checked the information regarding the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box through the Virtual World.
When he saw that a single Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box was priced as high as one million Faith Points, the corners of his eyes twitched violently.
Thinking that he had actually let his believers rush into the enemy’s divine kingdom holding such a treasure without recovering it, he wished he could slap himself twice hard.
What a prodigal waste!
Even while wearing gas masks and biochemical battle armor, these believers could only delay the speed of corpse toxin erosion.
From the moment they stepped into the enemy’s divine kingdom, there was no possibility of them returning alive.
Therefore, these people were all suicide squads with the lowest Aptitude carefully selected by Li Tianheng.
Their final mission was to deliver the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box to the outer periphery of the opponent’s divine kingdom and hand it over to the robots.
As for afterwards...
They would remain in the enemy’s divine kingdom forever.
Watching the suicide squads depart, Li Tianheng felt no pity in his eyes, but only sighed,
“Brother Yang, you are truly rich.”
“Are those wealthy women all so rich? To actually make you waste things like this.”
“How come a good man like me who is thrifty and manages the household well can never run into a wealthy woman?”
After finishing, his eyes were full of envy, and even mixed with a bit of heartache.
After all, that was a Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box worth one million Faith Points each.
Failing to recover even a single one was like cutting flesh from his body.
At this moment, that Beast-Race Demigod was sitting upright in the Divine Kingdom Core.
His expression was gloomy to the extreme.
The outer periphery of his divine kingdom had already been completely eroded by a bizarre green corpse qi.
Looking out, the original defense zone was constantly showing signs of Beast-Race believers mutating and losing control.
As a demigod who had fought on The Frontline for years, he naturally would not make low-level mistakes at the command level.
The moment the first batch of believers mutated, he had already issued an order for cleanup.
High-tier believers quickly took action, slaughtering all contaminated Beast-Race believers and burning them on the spot, completely cutting off the source of diffusion.
At the same time, a large number of elite troops were transferred to garrison the outer defense line.
As long as Human Race believers were found to appear, they would be immediately surrounded and killed, leaving no room for infiltration.
However, very soon, he sensed something was wrong.
Those weird metal boxes, as if endless, continuously appeared everywhere on the battlefield.
One, ten, a hundred, a thousand, or even tens of thousands...
Often before the believers of both sides truly made contact, the opponent had already opened the box and released that bizarre green miasma.
To prevent his own believers from suffering continuous losses in the poisonous fog, he had to repeatedly contract his defense lines and continuously retreat.
In the cognition of the Beast-Race Demigod,
items capable of causing such large-scale destruction to the divine kingdom environment must be extremely costly.
The opponent’s way of fighting was essentially a gamble consuming astronomical Resources.
As long as he guarded the divine kingdom and did not let Human Race believers truly penetrate deep into the core, this “smashing money tactic” was simply impossible to achieve decisive results.
Divine Kingdom War was essentially a war of interests, and no one would fight a war destined to run at a loss.
However, as time passed, he soon realized the situation was far from being that simple.
The speed at which the corpse qi diffused far exceeded expectations.
Even with his continuous cleanup, the outer periphery of the divine kingdom still began to be penetrated by the green corpse qi, slowly diffusing toward the core area.
Even if the divine kingdom’s self-cleaning mechanism operated at full power, it was already difficult to fully suppress it.
Driven by necessity, he could only purchase antidote potions on a large scale from the Divine Shop.
Relying on these potions, he forcibly carved out a safe passage and took the opportunity to mobilize elite troops to inversely invade Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom.
At this moment, this Beast-Race Demigod’s eyes were already splitting with anger.
“My God, the opponent’s divine kingdom defense system is extremely strong. With current troop strength, it is simply impossible to achieve an effective Breakthrough.”
“Once we continue a forced attack, it will only increase losses in vain.”
A Beast-Race high-tier believer knelt on one knee and reported in a deep voice.
The Beast-Race Demigod took a deep breath, killing intent surging in his eyes.
“Stop the reverse invasion.”
“Adjust the defense line, and move all inner watchtowers forward to the engagement area.”
“As long as Human Race believers are found, kill them immediately, and absolutely do not allow them to continue advancing.”
“Understood, My God!”
The believer quickly retreated to execute the order.
When the hall returned to silence, the Beast-Race Demigod slammed his fist heavily onto the armrest of the throne.
“We are the agents of the gods; the gods eat meat, and at most we drink soup.”
“Yet look at you, directly fighting a war of attrition with me?”
“This Human Race... is simply a lunatic!”
He panted heavily, forcibly suppressing his anger.
Then his consciousness left the divine kingdom, and he began to urgently head to the Divine Shop to purchase antidote potions.
Now the battlefield situation was completely out of control.
The defense system deployed within Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom was too dense, and a forced siege was simply unrealistic.
The only thing that could be done right now was to steadfastly guard his own divine kingdom while continuously investing Resources to combat the spread of the corpse toxin.
This Divine Kingdom War was no longer a pure slaughter of believers.
Instead, it had completely evolved into a war of resource attrition—
One side frantically poisoned.
The other side desperately detoxified.
While continuously placing orders for purchases, the Beast-Race Demigod could not help cursing in a low voice.
“Stupid Human Race, this is my divine kingdom after all.”
“You want to drag me down with this method? It’s simply wishful thinking.”
“The Resources you invested are dozens of times mine? In the end, the one who loses will only be you!”
That being said, his heart was bleeding.
The consumption of each batch of antidote potions was solid Divinity Points.
If these Resources were used to cultivate believers, they could have greatly enhanced the overall combat power.
Yet now they could only be continuously consumed in this bizarre war.
Thinking of this, the chill in his eyes grew even worse.
“A Human Race that harms others without benefiting oneself...”
“I have remembered your divine kingdom coordinates.”
“One day, I will definitely make you pay the price.”
Li Tianheng’s consciousness quickly returned from the Divine Kingdom Battlefield to reality.
As soon as he returned, he couldn’t wait to run and look for Yang Fan, with undisguised excitement in his expression.
“Brother Yang, when are we going to launch a full-scale attack on the opponent’s divine kingdom?”

Now the outer periphery of the Beast-Race divine kingdom had been severely eroded by the corpse toxin, and a large number of Beast-Race believers showed abnormal states such as coughing, weakness, and mania.
The overall combat power had dropped significantly by a large margin.
In Li Tianheng’s view, this was precisely the best time to press the attack while winning.
If a large army pressed down upon the border right now, cooperating with the Robot Soldiers army given to him by Yang Fan, the odds of winning were definitely not low.
Yang Fan only spoke indifferently,
“Attack? Haven’t we always been attacking?”
Li Tianheng was stunned.
“Brother Yang, you mean... release poison first to weaken the opponent, and then concentrate forces to strike?”
“We are still in the preparation stage?”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“Keep releasing poison.”
“Poisoning him to death directly, wouldn’t that suffice?”

chapters.title: Chapter 322: It Is Not That I Do Not Want To, But That I Truly Cannot
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s tone was as calm as if he were discussing the most ordinary matter.
Li Tianheng’s mouth twitched violently, and he felt completely dazed.
He stared at Yang Fan for a long time, unable to help swallowing a mouthful of saliva.
“Brother Yang... Are you kidding me?”
To directly use poison to drag a demigod’s Divine Kingdom to death?
Just how many resources would that consume?
Even if they actually won in the end, could they even recover a fraction of the cost?
In his view, this style of fighting was simply outrageous to the extreme.
The world of the rich was completely incomprehensible.
He even faintly had the illusion that city folk knew how to play too well, and he wanted to return to the countryside.
“Since the effect is quite good, increase the supply of the corpse pill tenfold starting now.”
Yang Fan continued.
“The believers no longer need to participate in deep combat; leave everything to the Robot Soldiers.”
“You only need to send the corpse pill into the outer perimeter of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom and deploy it.”
“The corpse poison will continue to spread through the air, so there is no need to push forward any further.”
After listening, Li Tianheng fell completely silent.
This was no longer a war; it was a pure “resource poisoning war”.
For a moment, he didn’t even know how to evaluate it.
Hesitating for a moment, he still couldn’t help speaking up.
“Um... Brother Yang, there is something I don’t know whether I should say or not.”
Yang Fan glanced at him. “Speak.”
Li Tianheng’s expression was serious, even carrying a hint of admonition.
“Brother, I actually envy you quite a bit for marrying a good wife.”
“But as for living off a woman, it is best not to do it with such righteous confidence.”
“Whatever can be saved should still be saved.”
His tone was extremely earnest, faintly carrying a worry for Yang Fan’s future.
In his view, the Divinity Points Yang Fan was currently investing relied almost entirely on the support of the Gu Family.
If he squandered them like this, problems would arise sooner or later.
After all, he had seen too many gods.

Even his Old Ancestor, Li Fengzhu, clearly already a Fifth-Order God, still had to run a tavern as a manager on the The Frontline to subsidize resources in order to maintain the operation of his divine kingdom.
Even for god-level existences, every single Divinity Point had to be meticulously calculated.
Resources were never enough.
The more they earned, the more they felt it wasn’t enough.
Looking at Li Tianheng’s restrained yet sincere expression, Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
“Do as I say, stop talking nonsense.”
“Fine, you’re the boss, your word is final!”
Li Tianheng sighed deeply with grief, but still obediently agreed.
At the same time, Yang Fan once again descended a Divine Decree.
Inside the Eternal Corpse Mine, more White Zombie-grade believers began to condense corpse pills with all their might.
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, one day in reality allowed the mine to stably produce over a million corpse pills.
And this was still far from the limit.
The number of White Zombie believers under Yang Fan’s command had long broken through the hundred millions.
If they all stopped to Cultivate and poured their full effort into condensing corpse pills, producing hundreds of millions a day would not be a difficult task.
However, to deal with a mere Beast-Race Demigods, this level was still far from necessary.
At this moment, the beast-race divine kingdom had completely transformed into another appearance.
The outer perimeter of the divine kingdom was long completely shrouded in dense corpse poison, and everywhere the eye could see was grayish-green mist.
The originally vibrant vegetation, trees, and flowers all withered and rotted, and the ground presented large patches of lifeless gray-white decay.
A large number of beast-race believers had long undergone mutations, their eyes turbid and movements stiff, wandering slowly through the divine kingdom as if they had lost consciousness.
On the outer The Frontline of the divine kingdom, batches of Robot Soldiers were continuously entering.
Each and every one of them carried a dozen or so Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes in their hands.
Upon reaching the designated area, they neatly opened them.
Inside each spirit sealing box, seven or eight emerald-green corpse pills were packed.
The corpse pills were directly dumped onto the ground, and immediately the robots quickly retracted the containers and returned to Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom.
The entire process was as efficient and ruthless as an assembly line operation.
At this moment, Li Tianheng’s consciousness was suspended above the outer perimeter of his own divine kingdom, his expression exceptionally solemn.
I don’t know since when, but he had already purchased tens of thousands of sets of testing equipment at his own expense.
All Robot Soldiers returning from the enemy divine kingdom had to undergo a strict inspection process.
First was high-pressure rinsing to remove surface contamination residue.
Then entering the full-body disinfection cabin for chemical spray sterilization.
Finally, undergoing multiple energy scans, and only after confirming no residual corpse poison whatsoever were they allowed to enter the next transportation link.
Even though it was impossible for these robots themselves to be infected, he still insisted on enforcing the full-process anti-poison standards.
He was even more serious than in any previous frontal war against an Alien Demigod.
Li Tianheng issued a Divine Decree.
“All Mechanical units pay attention.”
“After this Divine Kingdom War ends, within one year, all Robot Soldiers must undergo quarantine observation in the outer area.”
“It is strictly forbidden to enter the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Each Mechanical unit must enhance its anti-poison awareness and strengthen self-management capabilities.”
“Anti-poison is no small matter; hidden dangers must be eliminated from the source.”
“Starting from myself, starting from now, starting from every single robot.”
“Whoever brings illness back to the city will bear the consequences!”
As soon as this Divine Decree came out, the entire outer perimeter of the divine kingdom fell into a brief silence.
But very quickly, those Robot Soldiers equipped with basic intelligent Systems responded in unison.
“Obey!”
The voices were neat and uniform, echoing within the divine kingdom like the oath of a Mechanical legion.
At this moment.
The beast-race Divine Kingdom Core.
Two tall beast-race phantom figures stood quietly in the Void Realm.
One of them was precisely that Beast-Race Demigods.
At this moment, he was kneeling on both knees, his expression extremely wretched.
“Lord Abdol, I beg you, lend me another fifty thousand Divinity Points!”
“Those corpse poisons are about to spread to the Divine Kingdom Core!”
The beast-race god named Abdol lowered his head to take a look at his Subordinate God’s current divine kingdom environment, and his expression also grew increasingly solemn.
After a long while, he let out a soft sigh.
“The cost is too high.”
“To completely curb these corpse poisons, it will require investing at least five million Divinity Points.”
Speaking up to here, he fell silent for a moment.
In the end, he still shook his head.
“You haven’t lost unjustly.”
“In this Divine Kingdom War, the resources invested by the opponent have already exceeded tens of millions of Divinity Points.”
“Your divine kingdom... is already done for.”
Hearing this, that Beast-Race Demigods’s face instantly turned pale as paper.
“My Lord!”
“Over the years, I have always been loyal and devoted to you, and even obtained the divine kingdom coordinates of several Alien Gods for you.”
“You cannot stand by and watch me die!”
Abdol closed his eyes and slowly shook his head.
“It is not that I do not want to, but that I truly cannot.”
“I have lived for over ten thousand years, yet I have never seen such a crazy way of waging war.”
“Moreover, my current divine kingdom cannot produce this much circulating capital either.”
“The Divinity Points I lent you these past few days do not need to be repaid.”
“As for the rest... May fortune favor you.”
As his voice fell, Abdol’s phantom figure slowly dissipated.
“No—”
The Beast-Race Demigods let out a heartbreaking roar of fury.
The voice was filled with despair and unwillingness.

In his view, the Divinity Points Yang Fan was currently investing relied almost entirely on the support of the Gu Family.
If he squandered them like this, problems would arise sooner or later.
After all, he had seen too many gods.

Even his Old Ancestor, Li Fengzhu, clearly already a Fifth-Order God, still had to run a tavern as a manager on the The Frontline to subsidize resources in order to maintain the operation of his divine kingdom.
Even for god-level existences, every single Divinity Point had to be meticulously calculated.
Resources were never enough.
The more they earned, the more they felt it wasn’t enough.
Looking at Li Tianheng’s restrained yet sincere expression, Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
“Do as I say, stop talking nonsense.”
“Fine, you’re the boss, your word is final!”
Li Tianheng sighed deeply with grief, but still obediently agreed.
At the same time, Yang Fan once again descended a Divine Decree.
Inside the Eternal Corpse Mine, more White Zombie-grade believers began to condense corpse pills with all their might.
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, one day in reality allowed the mine to stably produce over a million corpse pills.
And this was still far from the limit.
The number of White Zombie believers under Yang Fan’s command had long broken through the hundred millions.
If they all stopped to Cultivate and poured their full effort into condensing corpse pills, producing hundreds of millions a day would not be a difficult task.
However, to deal with a mere Beast-Race Demigods, this level was still far from necessary.
At this moment, the beast-race divine kingdom had completely transformed into another appearance.
The outer perimeter of the divine kingdom was long completely shrouded in dense corpse poison, and everywhere the eye could see was grayish-green mist.
The originally vibrant vegetation, trees, and flowers all withered and rotted, and the ground presented large patches of lifeless gray-white decay.
A large number of beast-race believers had long undergone mutations, their eyes turbid and movements stiff, wandering slowly through the divine kingdom as if they had lost consciousness.
On the outer The Frontline of the divine kingdom, batches of Robot Soldiers were continuously entering.
Each and every one of them carried a dozen or so Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes in their hands.
Upon reaching the designated area, they neatly opened them.
Inside each spirit sealing box, seven or eight emerald-green corpse pills were packed.
The corpse pills were directly dumped onto the ground, and immediately the robots quickly retracted the containers and returned to Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom.
The entire process was as efficient and ruthless as an assembly line operation.
At this moment, Li Tianheng’s consciousness was suspended above the outer perimeter of his own divine kingdom, his expression exceptionally solemn.
I don’t know since when, but he had already purchased tens of thousands of sets of testing equipment at his own expense.
All Robot Soldiers returning from the enemy divine kingdom had to undergo a strict inspection process.
First was high-pressure rinsing to remove surface contamination residue.
Then entering the full-body disinfection cabin for chemical spray sterilization.
Finally, undergoing multiple energy scans, and only after confirming no residual corpse poison whatsoever were they allowed to enter the next transportation link.
Even though it was impossible for these robots themselves to be infected, he still insisted on enforcing the full-process anti-poison standards.
He was even more serious than in any previous frontal war against an Alien Demigod.
Li Tianheng issued a Divine Decree.
“All Mechanical units pay attention.”
“After this Divine Kingdom War ends, within one year, all Robot Soldiers must undergo quarantine observation in the outer area.”
“It is strictly forbidden to enter the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Each Mechanical unit must enhance its anti-poison awareness and strengthen self-management capabilities.”
“Anti-poison is no small matter; hidden dangers must be eliminated from the source.”
“Starting from myself, starting from now, starting from every single robot.”
“Whoever brings illness back to the city will bear the consequences!”
As soon as this Divine Decree came out, the entire outer perimeter of the divine kingdom fell into a brief silence.
But very quickly, those Robot Soldiers equipped with basic intelligent Systems responded in unison.
“Obey!”
The voices were neat and uniform, echoing within the divine kingdom like the oath of a Mechanical legion.
At this moment.
The beast-race Divine Kingdom Core.
Two tall beast-race phantom figures stood quietly in the Void Realm.
One of them was precisely that Beast-Race Demigods.
At this moment, he was kneeling on both knees, his expression extremely wretched.
“Lord Abdol, I beg you, lend me another fifty thousand Divinity Points!”
“Those corpse poisons are about to spread to the Divine Kingdom Core!”
The beast-race god named Abdol lowered his head to take a look at his Subordinate God’s current divine kingdom environment, and his expression also grew increasingly solemn.
After a long while, he let out a soft sigh.
“The cost is too high.”
“To completely curb these corpse poisons, it will require investing at least five million Divinity Points.”
Speaking up to here, he fell silent for a moment.
In the end, he still shook his head.
“You haven’t lost unjustly.”
“In this Divine Kingdom War, the resources invested by the opponent have already exceeded tens of millions of Divinity Points.”
“Your divine kingdom... is already done for.”
Hearing this, that Beast-Race Demigods’s face instantly turned pale as paper.
“My Lord!”
“Over the years, I have always been loyal and devoted to you, and even obtained the divine kingdom coordinates of several Alien Gods for you.”
“You cannot stand by and watch me die!”
Abdol closed his eyes and slowly shook his head.
“It is not that I do not want to, but that I truly cannot.”
“I have lived for over ten thousand years, yet I have never seen such a crazy way of waging war.”
“Moreover, my current divine kingdom cannot produce this much circulating capital either.”
“The Divinity Points I lent you these past few days do not need to be repaid.”
“As for the rest...
May fortune favor you.”
As his voice fell, Abdol’s phantom figure slowly dissipated.
“No—”
The Beast-Race Demigods let out a heartbreaking roar of fury.
The voice was filled with despair and unwillingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 323: It Really Is Like A Game
paragraphs: Meanwhile.
Batch after batch of Robot Soldiers continuously shuttled through the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom.
They mechanically opened the tianshu spirit sealing boxes and dumped corpse pills onto the ground one by one.
The thick corpse aura continued to spread.
Like a tide, it slowly eroded toward the Divine Kingdom Core.
The entire Divine Kingdom had completely turned into a forbidden zone of death.
Even those Beast-Race believers in the Qi Refining Realm were now listless and dispirited.
Some coughed violently, while others had scarlet eyes.
Quite a few Beast-Race believers seemed to have lost their sanity, frantically scratching their own necks and faces.
Streaks of bloody wounds constantly emerged, and blood flowed down between their fingers, yet they remained completely oblivious.
The real world.
Another day passed.
Early in the morning, Li Tianheng knocked on Yang Fan’s door with an excited face.
“Brother Yang!”
“We won!”
“The last believer of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom has also turned into a zombie, and that Beast-Race Demigods has fallen!”
At this moment, Li Tianheng stood outside the door, his expression both excited and filled with deep emotion.
From the start of the war until now, it had been less than ten days.
This was the easiest Divine Kingdom War he had ever experienced.
Except for sacrificing tens of thousands of suicide squad believers at the very beginning, his subordinates’ believers had hardly participated in any direct combat.
Even the subsequent work such as transportation, epidemic prevention, and testing was all completed by Robot Soldiers.
Rather than calling it a Divine Kingdom War,
it was more like crushing the opponent to death with sheer resources.
Hearing this, Yang Fan just nodded calmly.
“Very good.”
“Except for the Divine Kingdom Core, all the remaining assets of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom belong to you.”
“Decide how to handle them yourself.”
Hearing this, Li Tianheng immediately swallowed hard.
“Brother Yang, I... I will arrange for believers to take over immediately.”
After saying that, he hurried back to his room, his consciousness entering the Divine Kingdom once again.
Then, he led the robot army into the Beast-Race Divine Kingdom at the first moment.
When truly stepping into it, even Li Tianheng couldn’t help taking a sharp gasp of cold air.
Looking as far as the eye could see.
The tens of millions of square kilometers of the Divine Kingdom had long been completely enveloped by the bluish-green corpse aura.
The entire heaven and earth were covered with a pale green layer.
It made one’s scalp tingle just looking at it.
Li Tianheng couldn’t help shivering.
Afterwards, he immediately mobilized all Super Alloy Robot Warrior and ordinary Robot Soldiers to start comprehensively taking over this Divine Kingdom.
“Take away all buildings that still have value!”
“Those Spirit Plants, spiritual grains, and the Beast-Race members that have already turned into corpses, don’t worry about them.”
“Move fast!”
Following the issuance of the command, a large number of Robot Soldiers quickly took action.
Under this set of tactics by Yang Fan, this Beast-Race Divine Kingdom had almost been completely destroyed.
Large areas of Spirit Plants had long withered and rotted.
The captive Spirit Beasts either died or completely turned into corpses.
Looking across the entire Divine Kingdom, the only things of real value left were the buildings that had been completely preserved.
Although they were all in the Beast-Race style, the The Frontline had many trading channels, and these buildings could still sell for quite a few Divinity Points.
Subsequently, a large number of bizarre Beast-Race buildings were moved back to Li Tianheng’s Divine Kingdom one by one.
And the first thing Li Tianheng did was to comprehensively disinfect these buildings.
High-pressure washing, chemical spraying, energy sterilization...
After a whole set of procedures, no building could escape.
Whether preparing to sell them or keeping them for personal use, the hygiene work had to be done properly.
Li Tianheng definitely didn’t want his Divine Kingdom to be tainted by that eerie corpse poison.
“Wasteful, this is simply too wasteful!”
“There are so many spiritual fields in the core area, and they were all ruined by the zombie virus!”
“What a pity, Brother Yang really doesn’t know how to live economically.”
“Why hasn’t a rich woman taken a fancy to me yet?”
While supervising the Robot Soldiers in moving and disinfecting, Li Tianheng couldn’t help shaking his head and sighing.
Since only buildings needed to be recovered, the remaining areas had no reclamation value at all.
Therefore, in just a few hours, the entire battlefield was cleared.
Finally, the Divine Kingdom Core, which was as tall as a Half-man, was personally delivered to Yang Fan by Li Tianheng.
“Brother Yang.”
“I have already had Intelligent Life calculate it. If all these buildings are sold, they should still be worth about fifty or sixty thousand Divinity Points.”
“How about I help you process them?”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“No need, they are all yours.”
“This... isn’t very good, right?”
Li Tianheng instantly blushed a little.
In his view, during this Divine Kingdom War, he had done almost nothing.
Yang Fan merely used his Divine Kingdom to bypass the rule restrictions of the Divine Kingdom.
From beginning to end, the one who truly exerted effort was Yang Fan.
Whether it was corpse pills, robots, or those expensive tianshu spirit sealing boxes, they were all provided by Yang Fan.
He had only stood by the side and acted as a useless commander.
Now accepting these spoils of war, he really felt a bit embarrassed.
Yang Fan, however, didn’t care at all.
“Keep them.”
“These few Divinity Points are of no use to me anymore.”
“Deal with them as soon as possible.”
“Once I figure it out through research, we will immediately start the next Divine Kingdom War.”
After saying that, Yang Fan closed his eyes again.
The Divine Kingdom Core of that Beast-Race Demigods was accordingly put away into his own Divine Kingdom.
Yang Da had been waiting aside for a long time.
At this moment, he held a light blue card with both hands.
It was the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card just purchased.
“Master, everything is ready.”
Yang Fan nodded, a trace of curiosity also appearing in his eyes.
The Divine Kingdom Deduction Card was not a product created by gods.
But a special resource naturally evolved from various Secret Realms.
Since its production yield was not low, it could be easily bought whether in the Divine Shop or major shops on the The Frontline.
A Divine Kingdom Deduction Card sold for only a few million Faith Points.
However, what truly determined the success rate of the deduction was not the Deduction Card.
The closer the connection between the two parties and the more information mastered, the higher the possibility of a successful deduction.
Of course, luck was also indispensable.
“Divine Kingdom Deduction Card...”
“Hehe, this world really is like a game.”
Yang Fan chuckled softly.
Yang Da immediately gently placed the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card on top of the Divine Kingdom Core.
The next moment.
The entire card instantly turned into a light blue radiance, completely enveloping the entire Divine Kingdom Core.
Wisps of mysterious energy, hard to perceive with the naked eye, slowly rose.
As if piercing through the endless Void Realm, searching for some illusory connection in the dark.
A moment later.
Ripples suddenly appeared above the Divine Kingdom Core.
An illusory light and shadow slowly condensed.
Following that, a faint and elusive spatial coordinate began to appear bit by bit.
However, just as the coordinates were about to take shape,
the light and shadow trembled violently.
In the end, only two fuzzy letters emerged.
The next instant, that mysterious force seemed to be completely exhausted.
Bang——
The entire mass of light blue radiance collapsed with a boom.
The coordinates that had just condensed also turned into countless spots of light, completely disappearing into the Void Realm.
The deduction failed.
