chapters.title: Chapter 324: Exchanging Military Merits
paragraphs: Seeing this, Yang Fan did not reveal too much disappointment on his face.
After all, apart from the Divine Kingdom Core of an Alien Demigod, he knew almost nothing about the god behind it.
Failure in deduction was only to be expected.
This is also why god coordinates are so precious.
Between different races, wanting to obtain the specific information of the other party’s god is inherently an extremely difficult matter.
Apart from relying on Divine Kingdom Deduction Cards to try one’s luck, there are almost no other methods.
There are even quite a few gods who, through proxy wars, successively conquered hundreds of Alien Demigods, yet still failed to successfully deduce the divine kingdom coordinates of an Alien God.
“Yang Da, based on this Divine Kingdom Core, can we determine the other party’s divine kingdom talent?”
Yang Fan asked.
“Reporting to Master, it cannot be done.”
Yang Da shook his head slightly.
“However, considering the existence of the Origin Evolution Talent, I suggest that in the future, even if Master obtains a demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core, do not easily let it go.”
“Being able to Breakthrough to a demigod, their divine kingdom must possess a divine kingdom talent, and with high probability, it is above D-grade.”
“Even if it is an Alien God, after Master absorbs it, you can at least obtain an F-grade talent.”
“No matter how small a mosquito’s legs are, they are still meat.”
After listening to Yang Da’s analysis, Yang Fan nodded approvingly.
Afterwards, he gently placed his right hand upon that Divine Kingdom Core.
The next instant.
The half-person-high Divine Kingdom Core quickly transformed into specks of light, entirely absorbed by Yang Fan.
After losing the Divine Kingdom Core, that beast-race divine kingdom instantly began to collapse and disintegrate.
At the same time, a small piece of divine kingdom land was pulled by an invisible force, slowly merging into Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Above that patch of land, thick corpse Qi and zombie virus still permeated.
However, Yang Fan did not have the slightest worry.
He did not even have the thought of deploying detoxifying potions.

Nowadays, apart from the Eternal Corpse Mine, because his divine kingdom had deployed a large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests, the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi had long been rich to the extreme.
This bit of corpse Qi and virus, facing the divine kingdom’s massive self-purification ability, would soon be completely purified.
Yang Fan’s thoughts moved slightly.
A piece of divine kingdom information slowly emerged before his eyes.
[A-grade talent Battle Body, F-grade talent Powerful] (Can be fused)
Just as Yang Da expected, after absorbing the Divine Kingdom Core of this Alien Demigod, he only obtained an F-grade divine kingdom talent.
Regarding this, Yang Fan was not surprised.
These demigods acting as proxies on the The Frontline would not have overly outstanding talents to begin with.
This is similar to the situation within the Human Race.

Those existences who possessed A-grade or even stronger divine kingdom talents during the divine kingdom Awakening, even without a background, had long been recruited and nurtured in advance by various Family.
Those who truly appear on the The Frontline are often demigods without backgrounds and with relatively ordinary talents.
They can only choose to bear unimaginable war risks, plotting for themselves a chance to Breakthrough to a god in the future.
“Those with outstanding talents are, after all, only a minority.”
“C-grade, D-grade, or even F-grade talents are the norm.”
Yang Fan muttered softly.

Ever since being specially recruited by the Primordial Academy to enter Taichu City for cultivation three years ago, he had witnessed too many so-called Genius, and had come into contact with too many figures truly standing at the upper echelons.
Now coming to the The Frontline, he instead faintly felt somewhat unaccustomed to this disparity in levels.
Certain perceptions are unconsciously shaped by the environment.
When what you come into contact with for a long time are figures standing on the clouds, the world you see naturally becomes even more out of reach.
And after staying in such an environment for a long time, one’s perception of this world will naturally produce deviations.
The so-called “Why don’t they eat meat porridge” is essentially like this.
“I still need to find a way to obtain the coordinates of the Alien God.”
“The value of hundreds or thousands of demigods might not compare to a single Divine Kingdom Core of an Alien God.”
Yang Fan’s gaze sank slightly, beginning to rethink the methods of obtaining benefits on the The Frontline.
Soon, he withdrew his thoughts.
“Yang Da, upload this beast-race demigod’s coordinates to the military merit System and exchange them for military merits.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully complied.
The audit speed of the The Frontline military merit System was extremely fast.
Before long, the military merits had already arrived in the account.
An information panel emerged before Yang Fan’s eyes.
[Name: Yang Fan]
[Identity: Belonging to the Ninth Legion]
[Current Military Merits: 100,000]
The kill reward for an Alien Demigod was merely one hundred thousand military merits.
Yet core buildings like the War God Codex that could drive the evolution of the entire divine kingdom civilization required fifty million military merits to exchange.
In other words, it required a full five hundred Alien Demigods.
Yang Fan’s brows furrowed slightly, a trace of thought flashing in his eyes.
Through the experiment of the first proxy war, he had already determined that he completely had the ability to batch-clear Alien Demigods, thereby rapidly obtaining military merits.
But problems followed closely behind.
This kind of efficiency was too conspicuous.
Once he appeared too prominent, it was very likely to attract the attention of the Human Race’s upper echelon.
Even within the proxy war System, gods were extremely cautious when selecting proxies.
If the proxy was too weak, after defeat, being reversely deduced by alien races could even lead to the exposure of one’s own divine kingdom coordinates.
Most gods on the The Frontline generally would not launch more than ten proxy wars each year.
On one hand, for safety considerations, suitable proxies were already scarce.
On the other hand, it was a matter of cost.

For a proxy like Li Tianheng who possessed the Mad Blood talent, the base risk fee for just a single war was as high as twenty thousand Divinity Points, plus subsequent resource investments, the overall consumption of a war was often around fifty thousand Divinity Points.
When gods act, they likewise must consider costs.
If one was lucky and could deduce the coordinates of an Alien God, it would naturally be a massive profit.
But most of the time, it was merely barely maintaining balance, or even suffering a small loss.
Although Yang Fan did not need to consider cost issues, he had to control his “sense of presence”.
Otherwise, once he killed a large number of Alien Demigods within a year and batched-exchanged military merits, it would inevitably attract the attention of the Human Race’s upper echelon.
Within the palace, Yang Fan quietly sat upon the throne, his fingers rhythmically tapping on the armrest.
After a moment, he spoke.
“Yang Da.”
“Subordinate is here,” Yang Da said respectfully.
“Purchase five more divine kingdom coordinates of Alien Demigods, all choosing life-attribute divine kingdoms.”
“Hand them over to Li Tianheng, and continue to use the previous set of tactics.”
“In addition, allocate another batch of robots and defense buildings to him.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully complied.
Yang Fan’s consciousness quickly returned to reality.
Not long after, a knock on the door sounded.
“Come in.”
After receiving permission, Li Tianheng pushed open the door and entered.
His expression was obviously somewhat nervous.
“Um... Brother Yang, I just received the notification from your Intelligent Life.”
“You bought five more divine kingdom coordinates all at once?”
Yang Fan nodded.
“That’s right.”
“I will continue to strengthen your divine kingdom’s defense while allocating more robots.”
“The war strategy remains unchanged.”
Li Tianheng was stunned for a moment, “Then... which one should I attack first?”

Those existences who possessed A-grade or even stronger divine kingdom talents during the divine kingdom Awakening, even without a background, had long been recruited and nurtured in advance by various Family.
Those who truly appear on the The Frontline are often demigods without backgrounds and with relatively ordinary talents.
They can only choose to bear unimaginable war risks, plotting for themselves a chance to Breakthrough to a god in the future.
“Those with outstanding talents are, after all, only a minority.”
“C-grade, D-grade, or even F-grade talents are the norm.”
Yang Fan muttered softly.

Ever since being specially recruited by the Primordial Academy to enter Taichu City for cultivation three years ago, he had witnessed too many so-called Genius, and had come into contact with too many figures truly standing at the upper echelons.
Now coming to the The Frontline, he instead faintly felt somewhat unaccustomed to this disparity in levels.
Certain perceptions are unconsciously shaped by the environment.
When what you come into contact with for a long time are figures standing on the clouds, the world you see naturally becomes even more out of reach.
And after staying in such an environment for a long time, one’s perception of this world will naturally produce deviations.
The so-called “Why don’t they eat meat porridge” is essentially like this.
“I still need to find a way to obtain the coordinates of the Alien God.”
“The value of hundreds or thousands of demigods might not compare to a single Divine Kingdom Core of an Alien God.”
Yang Fan’s gaze sank slightly, beginning to rethink the methods of obtaining benefits on the The Frontline.
Soon, he withdrew his thoughts.
“Yang Da, upload this beast-race demigod’s coordinates to the military merit System and exchange them for military merits.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully complied.
The audit speed of the The Frontline military merit System was extremely fast.
Before long, the military merits had already arrived in the account.
An information panel emerged before Yang Fan’s eyes.
[Name: Yang Fan]
[Identity: Belonging to the Ninth Legion]
[Current Military Merits: 100,000]
The kill reward for an Alien Demigod was merely one hundred thousand military merits.
Yet core buildings like the War God Codex that could drive the evolution of the entire divine kingdom civilization required fifty million military merits to exchange.
In other words, it required a full five hundred Alien Demigods.
Yang Fan’s brows furrowed slightly, a trace of thought flashing in his eyes.
Through the experiment of the first proxy war, he had already determined that he completely had the ability to batch-clear Alien Demigods, thereby rapidly obtaining military merits.
But problems followed closely behind.
This kind of efficiency was too conspicuous.
Once he appeared too prominent, it was very likely to attract the attention of the Human Race’s upper echelon.
Even within the proxy war System, gods were extremely cautious when selecting proxies.
If the proxy was too weak, after defeat, being reversely deduced by alien races could even lead to the exposure of one’s own divine kingdom coordinates.
Most gods on the The Frontline generally would not launch more than ten proxy wars each year.
On one hand, for safety considerations, suitable proxies were already scarce.
On the other hand, it was a matter of cost.

For a proxy like Li Tianheng who possessed the Mad Blood talent, the base risk fee for just a single war was as high as twenty thousand Divinity Points, plus subsequent resource investments, the overall consumption of a war was often around fifty thousand Divinity Points.
When gods act, they likewise must consider costs.
If one was lucky and could deduce the coordinates of an Alien God, it would naturally be a massive profit.
But most of the time, it was merely barely maintaining balance, or even suffering a small loss.
Although Yang Fan did not need to consider cost issues, he had to control his “sense of presence”.
Otherwise, once he killed a large number of Alien Demigods within a year and batched-exchanged military merits, it would inevitably attract the attention of the Human Race’s upper echelon.
Within the palace, Yang Fan quietly sat upon the throne, his fingers rhythmically tapping on the armrest.
After a moment, he spoke.
“Yang Da.”
“Subordinate is here,” Yang Da said respectfully.
“Purchase five more divine kingdom coordinates of Alien Demigods, all choosing life-attribute divine kingdoms.”
“Hand them over to Li Tianheng, and continue to use the previous set of tactics.”
“In addition, allocate another batch of robots and defense buildings to him.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully complied.
Yang Fan’s consciousness quickly returned to reality.
Not long after, a knock on the door sounded.
“Come in.”
After receiving permission, Li Tianheng pushed open the door and entered.
His expression was obviously somewhat nervous.
Brother Yang, I just received the notification from your Intelligent Life.”
“You bought five more divine kingdom coordinates all at once?”
Yang Fan nodded.
“That’s right.”
“I will continue to strengthen your divine kingdom’s defense while allocating more robots.”
“The war strategy remains unchanged.”
Li Tianheng was stunned for a moment, “Then... which one should I attack first?”

chapters.title: Chapter 325: What Nonsense Are You Spouting
paragraphs: Yang Fan said calmly, “Multi-line combat, don’t waste time.”
“Multi-line combat?”
Li Tianheng didn’t react for a moment.
Having spent so many years on the The Frontline, he had only ever seen situations where a Divine Kingdom’s coordinates were exposed and then besieged.
He had never seen anyone proactively initiating a multi-line Divine Kingdom War.
He hesitated for a moment, but still couldn’t help asking the worry in his heart: “Brother Yang... Are you sure you have this much poison?”
The previous Divine Kingdom War had been participated in by him in its entirety.
That battle could be said to be the most relaxed and safest war he had ever experienced.
There were no large-scale frontal conflicts, no tragic consumption.
Even strictly speaking, there was no combat in the true sense at all.
But the more relaxed it was, the more unreal it felt to him.
However, there was no such thing as a free lunch in this world, nor was Yang Fan’s tactic all that brilliant; to put it bluntly, it was smashing it with money!
In Li Tianheng’s view, this method of warfare was simply a war method that maximized losses.
Using the zombie virus to contaminate the opponent’s entire Divine Kingdom was simply outrageous.
Afterwards, Li Tianheng compared the prices of various poisons in the Virtual World.
He estimated that the resources Yang Fan invested in this war probably exceeded ten million Divinity Points.
This Divine Kingdom War was fought completely without any reason!
This was just like taking 100 million to buy the life of a beggar!
At this moment, Li Tianheng looked up at Yang Fan, and his gaze actually held a hint of affection reserved for an ‘intellectually disabled’ person.
Yang Fan frowned.
“What kind of expression is that?”
Li Tianheng snapped back to his senses instantly and quickly put on a smile.
“No, no, Brother Yang, whatever you say goes!”
Yang Fan didn’t pay any more attention to him and directly said,
“Go purchase an Advanced Intelligent Life of the warfare type.”
“From now on, leave Divine Kingdom Wars to it to handle.”
“As long as there are no major changes, you don’t need to participate personally anymore.”
“I have more important things for you to do.”
Li Tianheng immediately straightened his chest, “Brother Yang, just give your orders!”
After the previous war, not only did he not suffer losses, but he also gained huge harvests.
After cashing out the buildings of the Beast race’s Divine Kingdom and paying off his loans, he still had quite a bit of surplus in his hands.
Even if Yang Fan hadn’t said anything, he was already prepared to purchase Intelligent Life to assist with Divine Kingdom management.
Yang Fan looked at him and slowly spoke, “Help me recruit a batch of Subordinate Gods.”
“What?!”
Li Tianheng’s expression changed.
The next second, he directly dropped to his knees with a “thud” and hugged Yang Fan’s lower leg.
“Brother Yang!”
“Did I do something wrong somewhere?”
“Don’t abandon me!”
“We are fellow townsmen after all, and I’ve already prepared to be your dog for a lifetime; you can’t abandon me after using me so quickly!”
Yang Fan’s face darkened, and he raised his foot to push him away, his tone carrying disgust.
“Stay away from me.”
“I said to help me recruit Subordinate Gods, not to terminate the contract with you.”
Li Tianheng scratched his head, his face full of confusion.
“Brother Yang, I didn’t quite figure this out.”
“For a proxy war, isn’t one proxy enough?”
“Am I not still alive? What are you recruiting other Subordinate Gods for?”
He truly could not understand Yang Fan’s thoughts.
Yang Fan glanced at him indifferently.
“Just do as I arrange.”
“In addition, discuss the price with them in advance.”
“Have you negotiate on my behalf; the price can be about ten percent higher than the market price.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s expression gradually turned serious.
“However, there is one very important point.”
Li Tianheng immediately straightened his body, pricked up his ears, looking like he was listening attentively.
“The higher their Divine Kingdom talent, the better.”
“It’s best if it’s a B-grade Divine Kingdom talent.”
Hearing this, Li Tianheng immediately shook his head.
“Brother Yang, you might not know about this.”
“Those demigods on the The Frontline with B-grade Divine Kingdom talents mostly have resource-type or support-type talents.”
“What you should really recruit are proxies like me who possess warfare-type Divine Kingdom talents.”
After saying that, his eyes shone as he looked at Yang Fan.
That expression seemed to be saying: ‘How is it? Did I remind you in time? Hurry up and praise me!’
Yang Fan was silent for two seconds.
He suddenly felt that dealing with Intelligent Life was much more relaxing.
He issued orders, and they executed them.
Simple, efficient, never asking too many questions.
But people in reality were much more complicated.
Especially a person like Li Tianheng.
Blunt and silly, yet harboring not the slightest bit of malice toward himself.
It made people feel a bit embarrassed to even get angry.
Yang Fan rubbed the space between his eyebrows, his tone becoming a bit more serious.
“From now on, whatever I say, you do.”
“If you raise this many opinions again, we will terminate the contract.”
As soon as these words came out, Li Tianheng gave a violent shudder and quickly stood straight.
“Yes! Brother Yang!”
“Guaranteed to complete the mission!”
Only then did Yang Fan nod.
“I have already transferred five million Divinity Points to your Divine Kingdom.”
“You negotiate a fixed price with them on my behalf.”
“Make it clear in advance: apart from the fees paid at the very beginning, I will not provide any further resource support afterward.”
“All resources required for the war must be purchased by themselves.”
Hearing this, Li Tianheng instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
“Rest assured, Brother Yang.”
“Those demigods actually like this kind of trading method the most.”
“Some deities agree to everything nicely at the beginning, but when the war is halfway through, they temporarily lower prices and cut resources; their table manners are extremely ugly.”
Speaking to the end, Li Tianheng seemed to recall some unpleasant experience, couldn’t help curling his lips, his tone full of disgust.
After Li Tianheng left, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom once again.
“Master.”
Yang Da stepped forward and respectfully bowed.

“The coordinates of the five Alien Demigod Divine Kingdoms purchased this time come from the Beast race, Tree Spirit race, Troll race, Lizardman race, and Pig-man race respectively, all belonging to life-type Divine Kingdoms.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Such minor matters do not need to be reported to me in the future.”
“Later, use a robot to go out and continue helping me purchase a large quantity of Super Alloy Robot Warriors through the The Frontline trading channels.”
“Yes.”
Just as Yang Da agreed, he immediately revealed a trace of doubt.
“Master, why is this?”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth raised slightly.
“Limited by the rules of the Divine Kingdom, my believers cannot enter demigod Divine Kingdoms on a large scale, even if the other party is my Subordinate God.”
“However, these robots do not fall into this category.”
Hearing this, Yang Da’s eyes suddenly lit up.
“Brilliant, Master!”
“Absorbing the Divine Kingdom Core of an Alien Demigod ultimately incurs too much loss.”
“If one wants to quickly strengthen their Divine Kingdom talent, the cost-effectiveness of a Human Race Divine Kingdom Core is clearly higher.”
As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, in Yang Da’s cognition, only two things were most important.
Serving the deity Yang Fan, and making the Divine Kingdom continuously grow stronger.
As for race, morality, values...
These concepts had never existed within his core logic.
“Nowadays, the Divine Kingdom’s monthly income has already exceeded one hundred trillion Divinity Points.”
“The cost of these Super Alloy Robot Warriors can be completely ignored.”
“By then, Master only needs to sign Subordinate God Contracts in large quantities, and then use the robots to invade your own Subordinate Gods...”
Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Yang Fan.
“What nonsense are you talking about.”

chapters.title: Chapter 326: The Demeanor of a Big Shot
paragraphs: Yang Fan glanced at Yang Da, then explained,
“The Subordinate God Contract restricts Subordinate Gods, and naturally it restricts me, their Main God as well.”
“Furthermore, the Subordinate God Contracts signed on the The Frontline are all regulated by federal law.”
“If I really did something like invading my own Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom, as long as they reported it before dying, even the Gu Family wouldn’t be able to protect me.”
Yang Da was momentarily stunned.
“It was this subordinate’s oversight.”
“Then why is Master buying so many robot warriors?”
Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
“War always comes with risks.”
“The Subordinate God Contracts I signed with these Subordinate Gods are flat-rate contracts, and I don’t need to provide any subsequent support.”
“If they win, I will only take the Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core, and all other ordinary resources will belong to them.”
“This allows them to profit while also helping me build up my reputation.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan changed the subject.
“But if they lose...”
“I will use the spatial passage to snatch back that Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom Core.”
“In this way, I can ensure that my Divine Kingdom coordinates are not exposed while also reaping a Divine Kingdom talent.”
“Alien Demigods have no channels to report me.”
“Even if the matter is exposed, so what?”
“Neither law nor morality can allow anyone to accuse me.”
Yang Fan gently tapped the armrest of his throne, his tone still calm.
“When all is said and done, the only thing I paid was Divinity Points.”
“And coincidentally, that is also the thing I lack the least right now.”
“Killing the chicken to get the eggs and draining the pond to catch fish are not only riskier, but also not worth it.”
“Slow is fast.”
“At least from a practical perspective...”
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“I am much more conscientious than other gods.”
“Master is wise!”
“In this way, we can profit on both ends.”
“Those Subordinate Gods who survive will not only gain generous returns, but they will also feel grateful because of Master’s lavish spending and spontaneously publicize for Master.”
“By then, there will surely be more and more demigods on the The Frontline actively seeking to sign Subordinate God Contracts with Master.”
Yang Da said with a face full of admiration.
Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction and said earnestly,
“Yang Da, although Intelligent Life forms like you are reliable in your work and have astonishing computing power—”
“—humans are complex.”
“In many cases, when looking at interests, we cannot just look at the present.”
“Your master is currently a Prodigy heavily nurtured by the Gu Family and an upper-class figure of the Human Federation.”
“As a big shot, when doing things, you must have the demeanor of a big shot. Some things can be thought in your heart, but they cannot be said out loud.”
“As the highest Intelligent Life form of my Divine Kingdom, pay more attention to your discretion when speaking in the future.”
“Don’t make me correct you every time, understand?”
Finishing his words, Yang Fan calmly tidied his collar, straightened his back, and sat upright on the throne again, looking like a total gentleman.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded seriously.
But deep down, he couldn’t help but sigh.
Humans... were indeed still too complex.
Clearly, Master was worried about causing trouble and wasn’t short on Divinity Points, which was why he chose this method.
Yet after such a speech, he forcefully packaged himself into a benevolent Main God.
Thinking of this, Yang Da silently rolled his eyes in his heart.
However, he quickly adjusted his core logic.
After spending so much time together, he had already learned to tuck his tail between his legs and act like a well-behaved Intelligent Life form in front of Master.
To prevent his palace from being sealed again,
for such minor matters in the future, he should still learn from Ling Xuzi.
Whatever Master says is always right.
That afternoon.
Li Tianheng hurried back to the villa.
At this moment, he was holding three Subordinate God Contracts in his hands.
“Brother Yang, the matter has been settled.”
“However, since you didn’t show up in person, coupled with the fact that the price offered was about ten percent higher than the market price, quite a few demigods harbored suspicions.”
“In the end, only a few people who had a good relationship with me chose to believe me.”
As he spoke, Li Tianheng handed over the three contracts.
“These are the contents of the contracts.”
“In addition, they have another request: they hope to use Human Federation Intelligent Life to screen Alien Demigods of comparable strength as proxy war targets for them.”
Yang Fan took the contracts and glanced at them briefly.
After confirming that the contents had no issues, he moved his mind and directly completed the signing.
Hum—
The three contracts simultaneously bloomed with faint golden light.
The next moment, the contracts turned into countless golden specks of light.
Half of them sank into the center of Yang Fan’s brows, while the other half penetrated the Void Realm and flew away from the villa.
At the same time,
Yang Fan could clearly feel that three more one-way spatial passages had appeared within his Divine Kingdom.
As for who the three newly contracted Subordinate Gods were and what they looked like...
He had no interest in understanding at all.
Seeing Yang Fan sign the contracts so decisively, Li Tianheng quickly added,
“Um... Brother Yang.”
“I have already signed an automatic payment agreement through Human Federation Intelligent Life.”
“Sixty thousand Divinity Points per person.”
“I... was slow to speak.”
In Li Tianheng’s view, this price was already on the high side.
If Yang Fan didn’t agree, he could completely refuse to sign.
Yang Fan merely waved his hand.
“It’s fine.”
“You continue to help me recruit Subordinate Gods.”
“The price can be a bit higher, but don’t make it too outrageous.”
“Understand?”
“Understood!” Li Tianheng nodded repeatedly.
Yang Fan was not short on Divinity Points.
If he had spent twice the market price to recruit Subordinate Gods this time, what Li Tianheng brought back today probably wouldn’t be three contracts, but over a hundred.
Money had never been a problem.
But Yang Fan also did not want to disrupt the market price of Subordinate God Contracts on the entire The Frontline because of himself.
He didn’t care how those demigods viewed him, but he had to consider the attitudes of other gods.
Having just arrived at the The Frontline and being a person of the Gu Family, it was fine to act a bit wealthy and bold.
But in doing things, after all, one couldn’t go too far out of bounds.
“I understand.”
“I am still renting a house outside.”
“I’ll head over to continue recruiting people in a moment.”
“I guarantee to recruit more Subordinate Gods for Big Brother!”
Li Tianheng patted his chest to guarantee.
Although until now, he still couldn’t figure out why Yang Fan wanted to sign so many Subordinate Gods.
But Yang Fan transferred five million Divinity Points to him all at once.
He could more or less guess that Yang Fan most likely wanted to use proxy wars to deduce the coordinates of more Alien Gods.
Although he still felt that doing this was somewhat a waste of resources.
But after experiencing the previous verbal education, he had completely learned to behave.
Follow Yang Fan, do more work, talk less.
Otherwise, if his contract was really terminated, he probably wouldn’t even have a place to cry.
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
After Li Tianheng left, he returned to the room and sat cross-legged.
Since new Subordinate Gods had been signed, naturally corresponding monitoring had to be established.
Although all fees were paid when the contracts were signed and no further resources needed to be provided afterward,
he had to grasp the battlefield situation.
Once a Subordinate God was defeated, he had to intervene at the first instance to snatch back the Divine Kingdom Core.
Although the probability of his Divine Kingdom coordinates being deduced was extremely low,
Yang Fan would never allow any risk of his Divine Kingdom coordinates being exposed.
As for the candidate responsible for monitoring the Subordinate God battlefield, he had already thought of one long ago.
It was none other than Ling Xuzi.

“As the highest Intelligent Life form of my Divine Kingdom, pay more attention to your discretion when speaking in the future.”
“Don’t make me correct you every time, understand?”
Finishing his words, Yang Fan calmly tidied his collar, straightened his back, and sat upright on the throne again, looking like a total gentleman.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded seriously.
But deep down, he couldn’t help but sigh.
Humans... were indeed still too complex.
Clearly, Master was worried about causing trouble and wasn’t short on Divinity Points, which was why he chose this method.
Yet after such a speech, he forcefully packaged himself into a benevolent Main God.
Thinking of this, Yang Da silently rolled his eyes in his heart.
However, he quickly adjusted his core logic.
After spending so much time together, he had already learned to tuck his tail between his legs and act like a well-behaved Intelligent Life form in front of Master.
To prevent his palace from being sealed again,
for such minor matters in the future, he should still learn from Ling Xuzi.
Whatever Master says is always right.
That afternoon.
Li Tianheng hurried back to the villa.
At this moment, he was holding three Subordinate God Contracts in his hands.
“Brother Yang, the matter has been settled.”
“However, since you didn’t show up in person, coupled with the fact that the price offered was about ten percent higher than the market price, quite a few demigods harbored suspicions.”
“In the end, only a few people who had a good relationship with me chose to believe me.”
As he spoke, Li Tianheng handed over the three contracts.
“These are the contents of the contracts.”
“In addition, they have another request: they hope to use Human Federation Intelligent Life to screen Alien Demigods of comparable strength as proxy war targets for them.”
Yang Fan took the contracts and glanced at them briefly.
After confirming that the contents had no issues, he moved his mind and directly completed the signing.
Hum—
The three contracts simultaneously bloomed with faint golden light.
The next moment, the contracts turned into countless golden specks of light.
Half of them sank into the center of Yang Fan’s brows, while the other half penetrated the Void Realm and flew away from the villa.
At the same time,
Yang Fan could clearly feel that three more one-way spatial passages had appeared within his Divine Kingdom.
As for who the three newly contracted Subordinate Gods were and what they looked like...
He had no interest in understanding at all.
Seeing Yang Fan sign the contracts so decisively, Li Tianheng quickly added,
Brother Yang.”
“I have already signed an automatic payment agreement through Human Federation Intelligent Life.”
“Sixty thousand Divinity Points per person.”
“I... was slow to speak.”
In Li Tianheng’s view, this price was already on the high side.
If Yang Fan didn’t agree, he could completely refuse to sign.
Yang Fan merely waved his hand.
“It’s fine.”
“You continue to help me recruit Subordinate Gods.”
“The price can be a bit higher, but don’t make it too outrageous.”
“Understand?”
“Understood!” Li Tianheng nodded repeatedly.
Yang Fan was not short on Divinity Points.
If he had spent twice the market price to recruit Subordinate Gods this time, what Li Tianheng brought back today probably wouldn’t be three contracts, but over a hundred.
Money had never been a problem.
But Yang Fan also did not want to disrupt the market price of Subordinate God Contracts on the entire The Frontline because of himself.
He didn’t care how those demigods viewed him, but he had to consider the attitudes of other gods.
Having just arrived at the The Frontline and being a person of the Gu Family, it was fine to act a bit wealthy and bold.
But in doing things, after all, one couldn’t go too far out of bounds.
“I understand.”
“I am still renting a house outside.”
“I’ll head over to continue recruiting people in a moment.”
“I guarantee to recruit more Subordinate Gods for Big Brother!”
Li Tianheng patted his chest to guarantee.
Although until now, he still couldn’t figure out why Yang Fan wanted to sign so many Subordinate Gods.
But Yang Fan transferred five million Divinity Points to him all at once.
He could more or less guess that Yang Fan most likely wanted to use proxy wars to deduce the coordinates of more Alien Gods.
Although he still felt that doing this was somewhat a waste of resources.
But after experiencing the previous verbal education, he had completely learned to behave.
Follow Yang Fan, do more work, talk less.
Otherwise, if his contract was really terminated, he probably wouldn’t even have a place to cry.
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
After Li Tianheng left, he returned to the room and sat cross-legged.
Since new Subordinate Gods had been signed, naturally corresponding monitoring had to be established.
Although all fees were paid when the contracts were signed and no further resources needed to be provided afterward,
he had to grasp the battlefield situation.
Once a Subordinate God was defeated, he had to intervene at the first instance to snatch back the Divine Kingdom Core.
Although the probability of his Divine Kingdom coordinates being deduced was extremely low,
Yang Fan would never allow any risk of his Divine Kingdom coordinates being exposed.
As for the candidate responsible for monitoring the Subordinate God battlefield, he had already thought of one long ago.
It was none other than Ling Xuzi.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Steady Means Safe
paragraphs: “Rest assured, Master.”
Ling Xuzi knelt on the ground and said with confidence.
“If we are merely observing the trend of the battle, there is no need to infiltrate the Divine Kingdom Core; staying on the outer periphery of the other party’s divine kingdom will suffice.”
“It is an effortless task for the ranked believers of our Void Spirit Race to accomplish such a mission.”
“Besides, this subordinate is currently only a demigod. As long as we have the coordinates, infiltrating the other party’s divine kingdom is not a difficult task.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly and then passed the Subordinate God coordinates to Ling Xuzi.
After the Subordinate God Contract is signed, a one-way channel will be formed between the divine kingdoms.
The main god can clearly grasp the divine kingdom coordinates of the Subordinate God, but the Subordinate God cannot reversely perceive the coordinate position of the main god.
This is also one of the core safety mechanisms of the Subordinate God Contract.
Yang Fan was also very confident in Ling Xuzi’s abilities.
Back when the Void Spirit Race believers infiltrated his divine kingdom, he only vaguely sensed the abnormality, yet was always unable to accurately locate them.
Until later, when he spent a huge sum of money to purchase a large number of detection devices, he managed to barely clear out those lurkers.
In comparison, the abilities of these demigods on the The Frontline were simply incomparable to the Yang Fan of back then.
With the concealment ability of Ling Xuzi’s believers nowadays, even if they infiltrated the core area of the other party’s divine kingdom, they might not necessarily be detected.
After making proper arrangements, Yang Fan withdrew from his divine kingdom consciousness and returned to reality.
The specific affairs within the divine kingdom were all handed over to Yang Da to handle.
He only needed to steer the direction.
Meanwhile, Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom had long undergone earth-shaking changes.
Due to simultaneously opening five Alien Divine Kingdom Battlefields, under Yang Da’s assistance, his overall defense system was comprehensively upgraded.
In the outer periphery of the divine kingdom, a large number of Robot Soldiers were stationed and patrolling year-round.
Even four new City of Technology were built, located respectively in the east, west, south, and north directions of the divine kingdom.
On top of the city bodies, rows upon rows of Fortress Cannon were densely erected, emitting a chilling cold light and full of deterrent force.
Once any spatial fluctuation appeared, it would be locked onto in the first instance.
In the Divine Kingdom Core area, Li Tianheng’s believers lived a completely different life.
Resources were abundant, and food was stable.
Aside from daily Cultivate, it was conducting believer Breeding and population expansion.
Meanwhile, after paying off his loans, Li Tianheng was finally willing to invest resources.
He purchased an ordinary high-tier Intelligent Life to be used for the overall management of the divine kingdom.
He additionally purchased a combat-type high-tier Intelligent Life, which was deployed in the outer periphery, specialized in charge of defense and war dispatch.
As for the Divine Kingdom Battlefield The Frontline, countless Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box were continuously sent into his divine kingdom through spatial channels.
Then, robots carried the sealing boxes to enter the Alien Divine Kingdoms for “deployment”.
The poison of the corpse pill continued to spread, endlessly corroding the enemy’s divine kingdom.
If any enemy legion attempted to counterattack Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom, what greeted them would be a dense salvo of City-Annihilating Cannon.
At this moment, Li Tianheng was not in the nanny room of Yang Fan’s villa.
Instead, he had returned to his own rented apartment.
He sat at the table with his legs crossed, his face glowing and full of spirit.
Beside the table was an LCD display panel he had specially purchased.
The screen was scrolling and playing the recruitment information he had posted.
“Recruiting Subordinate God with high pay, generous benefits, and full settlement of Divinity Points on the spot.”
“Are you still suffering from the trouble of gods temporarily lowering prices and withholding resources in the Late Stage?”
“Are you still lost in a plight where no one appreciates you and the path ahead is hopeless?”
“Do you yearn for a stable, powerful main god who never defaults on resources?”
“Join us and change your destiny!”
After this advertisement was posted, it indeed attracted quite a few people to come and consult.
But most of them were demigods with D-grade divine kingdom talents.
According to Yang Fan’s requirements, these people were basically screened out and rejected.
Over the course of a week, he ultimately finalized only four Subordinate God Contracts, just waiting for Yang Fan to confirm and sign them.
Li Tianheng had never felt that life could be so relaxed and fulfilling.
Merely being responsible for recycling the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box, he had already earned a fortune.
Nowadays, the divine kingdom’s resources were very abundant, and he had already begun using Breeding Card to expand his believer population.
“Brother Yang...”
“Thank you for this thigh.”
“I will definitely work hard and never drop the ball.”
Every morning when he woke up, he would silently recite this in his heart.
During this period of time, Yang Da was also continuously purchasing various supplies.
Among them, the largest item was alien corpses.
On the The Frontline, if one were to say what thing was the “cheapest”, I’m afraid it was only these corpses.
After all, Divine Kingdom War broke out here all year round.
Whether gods or demigods, high-intensity wars were conducted almost every year.
Especially for wars at the deity level, the real world often lasted for several years, easily involving the slaughter of hundreds of billions of believers.
Corpses piled up like mountains on the battlefield; while fighting, they also recycled them, including both aliens and the Human Race.
And there were already quite a few structures in the world that required flesh and blood essence, so these corpses naturally possessed value.
Supply and demand determine price. Under the condition that corpse supply on the The Frontline was extremely abundant, their price was naturally suppressed to the lowest.

As for Yang Fan, because he needed to continuously manufacture corpse pills, the corpse Qi consumption of the Eternal Corpse Mine was extremely huge, and thus he had to continuously purchase corpses and then feed them into the Life Essence Conversion Pool for replenishment.
However, this little consumption of Divinity Points was likewise nothing to the current Yang Fan.
Another five days passed.
On this day, the Dark Web auction opened as scheduled.
Yang Da participated in the bidding just like usual.

Due to Yang Fan’s restrictions, the procurement volume of resource-type structures such as the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the enlightenment ancient tree significantly declined, and the scale of related transactions shrank accordingly.

But for s-class war structures like the Great Void Warship, Yang Da would make a move every single time he participated in the auction, and his bid was always only about 10% higher than the suggested transaction price.
This was also Yang Fan’s requirement, not to save Divinity Points, but in order not to disrupt the market price system.
If he directly swept the goods at twice the price, it would very likely lead to the war structures in this Dark Web auction being swept clean by him.
It was extremely likely to attract the attention of other gods, which did not conform to Yang Fan’s survival Law.
Anyway, the Dark Web would open an auction once a month, and the development of the divine kingdom also required time, so he was not in a hurry.
Slow is fast, steady is safe.
What surprised Yang Fan even more was that although he was located on the The Frontline with constant spatial turbulence, the Dark Web’s transaction channels seemed to be completely unaffected.
After the payment was completed, those s-class war structures would be directly delivered into his divine kingdom through spatial channels.
This also made Yang Fan increasingly curious about the Dark Web.
Even when purchasing structures above A-grade through formal channels, various chambers of commerce would find ways to cross the The Frontline for delivery.
But the transactions of the Dark Web were “instantly effective”.
It was as if no matter where one was located, the settlement could be completed instantly.
It was as natural as when he was still in Taichu City and casually clicked open the Divine Shop.
This ability to cross the The Frontline and spatial blockades clearly had already exceeded the scope of ordinary transaction systems.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Ten Million!
paragraphs: A few days later, Li Tianheng returned to the villa again.
This time, he brought seven Subordinate God Contracts.
In addition, the five Divine Kingdom Wars under his command had all ended.
Relying on continuous contamination from a large number of corpse pills, he directly wore the five Alien Demigods to death inside their Divine Kingdoms.
“Brother Yang, these are their Divine Kingdom Cores. Please keep them safe!”
Li Tianheng’s face was piled with smiles as he hurriedly handed over the pieces of Divine Kingdom Cores.

These Divine Kingdom Cores varied in size, with the largest being no more than the height of a Half-man. From their appearance, it could be seen that the strength of these Alien Demigods was not considered strong.
Yang Fan nodded slightly and waved his hand casually, storing them all into his Divine Kingdom.
“Um... Brother Yang, over at the demigod residential area, there are still quite a few demigods with D-Rank Divine Kingdom talent who want to sign contracts with you.”
“However, most of those with better talents and stronger strength are still taking a wait-and-see attitude.”
“So currently there are only these seven, six of whom have C-Rank talent, and one has a B-Rank resource-type talent.”
Li Tianheng felt a bit awkward.
“Would you consider showing up in person? After all, I am only a demigod, and it is indeed hard to make them completely convinced.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan merely waved his hand. “It’s fine, just keep up your pace.”
According to Ling Xuzi’s report, those three Subordinate Gods were still carrying out Divine Kingdom Wars in full swing.
Moreover, their strength was quite good, and they were all fighting in the Divine Kingdoms of the alien races.
Compared to Li Tianheng, their wars were much more complex.
Commanding believers, allocating resources, and procuring supplies—every step affected the overall situation.
A true Divine Kingdom War between demigods often lasted for several months in the real world from start to finish.
Yang Fan was not in a hurry.
Only when these Subordinate Gods ended their wars and survived would it be the best “advertisement”.
By then, naturally more people would actively come to sign contracts.
As for demigods with D-Rank talent, it wasn’t that he looked down on them, but rather that he temporarily didn’t want to make himself seem too abrupt.
Other gods also needed to recruit Subordinate Gods; he couldn’t eat all the “meat” by himself while leaving others unable to even drink the soup.
Since higher treatment was offered, naturally higher-quality targets had to be screened.
Moreover, if the Subordinate Gods failed in future wars and Yang Fan stepped in afterward, the harvest would be even greater.
The Origin Evolution bringing dozens of F-Rank talents might not even compare to the value of a single D-Rank talent.
Li Tianheng nodded and took his leave.
However, just as he walked out of the villa, he accidentally bumped into a figure.
The other party did not move at all, but he felt as if he had crashed into a towering giant mountain.
An invisible Qi instantly suppressed downward, causing him to instinctively step back.
A dignified demigod actually failed to stand steady and sat directly on the ground.
Li Tianheng’s expression changed drastically as he hurriedly looked up.
The next instant, his entire body stiffened, and he hurriedly lowered his head.
“Gr-Greetings, Lord God!”
“Who are you? A mere demigod, why do you appear here?”
A low voice fell.
Terrifying coercion enveloped him.
At this moment, Li Tianheng only felt that his Physical Body, along with his Divine Kingdom, seemed to be targeted by some terrifying behemoth, with the chill piercing straight into his Soul.
At the same time, countless believers in his Divine Kingdom also sensed it simultaneously.
One by one, their faces turned pale as they successively knelt and prostrated on the ground, showing looks of panic.
Right at this moment, Yang Fan walked out of the villa.
“Cousin, how do you have time to come over?”
As he spoke, that terrifying aura pressing down on Li Tianheng instantly dissipated.
Li Tianheng panted heavily, covered in cold sweat, his entire body almost lying flat on the ground.
And the person who came was none other than Gu Jiuheng.
He originally came to check on Yang Fan’s recent situation and incidentally deliver this month’s military merit dividend, but he didn’t expect to run into a demigod right at the entrance.
This was one of the most core and safest areas of the The Frontline.
Ordinary gods wouldn’t dare to enter easily, let alone a demigod.
Gu Jiuheng glanced at Li Tianheng with slightly furrowed brows.
He had no impression of this person at all, and at a glance, he was just an ordinary person without a background.
“I’m here to deliver this month’s military merit dividend, and incidentally check on how my brother-in-law has been doing recently,” he said indifferently.
“Not bad, he is my Subordinate God who came over to deliver things,” Yang Fan explained casually.
Gu Jiuheng nodded, didn’t look at Li Tianheng any further, and entered the villa together with Yang Fan.
Until long after the two had left, Li Tianheng slowly climbed up from the ground and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
“My rental apartment is still safer...”
“In this kind of place... there are too many gods, and it’s too abrupt for me to appear here.”
He swallowed his saliva, looked toward the direction of the villa, and couldn’t help muttering:
“Brother Yang, oh Brother Yang, the soft rice you eat... is truly outrageous.”
Inside the villa, the atmosphere was quite relaxed.
Gu Jiuheng asked casually, “You brat, your actions are quite fast. You recruited a Subordinate God so quickly?”
Yang Fan smiled, “A high school classmate. I didn’t expect to run into him on the The Frontline.”

Gu Jiuheng was stunned for a moment, then laughed awkwardly, “So it was one of our own people. I thought it was some reckless demigod wandering around this area. If I had known earlier that he was your classmate, I wouldn’t have hit him so heavily just now.”
He paused and added another sentence, his tone becoming slightly more serious.
“However, in the future, let him come to this kind of place less often.”
“The concept of class is very heavy on the The Frontline. Although demigods are not uniformly controlled like Divine Beings, running around randomly is still dangerous.”
“For instance, in this place, if some god casually obliterates him on a whim, the law enforcement robots won’t be able to do anything.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Thank you for the reminder, Cousin.”
As if suddenly remembering something, Gu Jiuheng raised his chin.
“Take out the Ninth Legion identity token.”
Yang Fan complied, took out the token, and handed it over.
After taking it, Gu Jiuheng also took out a purple-gold token from his sleeve and gently pressed it against Yang Fan’s token.
The two tokens trembled slightly, and then a fine ripple emerged, confirming completion.
Gu Jiuheng withdrew his hand, his tone casual yet carrying a trace of a matter-of-fact meaning.
“You are the Third Elder’s son-in-law. Although you currently have no achievements, you still have a dividend quota of ten million military merits every month.”
He paused.
“This month’s has already been transferred for you. Starting next month, the military merit System will automatically settle it into your account.”
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed.
“Ten million?!”
Gu Jiuheng glanced at him and smiled, “Does it feel like a lot?”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then nodded earnestly.
It wasn’t a lot.
It was a bit ridiculously much.
In the exchange System of the military merit System, he knew very well what this ten million meant.
A top-tier S-Rank Building like the “War God Codex” was only fifty million military merits.

As for some resource-type S-Rank Buildings, such as the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest, the enlightenment ancient tree, and the like, they could be exchanged for just tens of thousands of military merits.
That was to say, without doing anything, living in the The Frontline villa arranged by the Gu Family, he could effortlessly get a top-tier S-Rank Building for free in five months.

Terrifying coercion enveloped him.
At this moment, Li Tianheng only felt that his Physical Body, along with his Divine Kingdom, seemed to be targeted by some terrifying behemoth, with the chill piercing straight into his Soul.
At the same time, countless believers in his Divine Kingdom also sensed it simultaneously.
One by one, their faces turned pale as they successively knelt and prostrated on the ground, showing looks of panic.
Right at this moment, Yang Fan walked out of the villa.
“Cousin, how do you have time to come over?”
As he spoke, that terrifying aura pressing down on Li Tianheng instantly dissipated.
Li Tianheng panted heavily, covered in cold sweat, his entire body almost lying flat on the ground.
And the person who came was none other than Gu Jiuheng.
He originally came to check on Yang Fan’s recent situation and incidentally deliver this month’s military merit dividend, but he didn’t expect to run into a demigod right at the entrance.
This was one of the most core and safest areas of the The Frontline.
Ordinary gods wouldn’t dare to enter easily, let alone a demigod.
Gu Jiuheng glanced at Li Tianheng with slightly furrowed brows.
He had no impression of this person at all, and at a glance, he was just an ordinary person without a background.
“I’m here to deliver this month’s military merit dividend, and incidentally check on how my brother-in-law has been doing recently,” he said indifferently.
“Not bad, he is my Subordinate God who came over to deliver things,” Yang Fan explained casually.
Gu Jiuheng nodded, didn’t look at Li Tianheng any further, and entered the villa together with Yang Fan.
Until long after the two had left, Li Tianheng slowly climbed up from the ground and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
“My rental apartment is still safer...”
“In this kind of place... there are too many gods, and it’s too abrupt for me to appear here.”
He swallowed his saliva, looked toward the direction of the villa, and couldn’t help muttering:
“Brother Yang, oh Brother Yang, the soft rice you eat... is truly outrageous.”
Inside the villa, the atmosphere was quite relaxed.
Gu Jiuheng asked casually, “You brat, your actions are quite fast.
You recruited a Subordinate God so quickly?”
Yang Fan smiled, “A high school classmate.
I didn’t expect to run into him on the The Frontline.”
Gu Jiuheng was stunned for a moment, then laughed awkwardly, “So it was one of our own people.
I thought it was some reckless demigod wandering around this area.
If I had known earlier that he was your classmate, I wouldn’t have hit him so heavily just now.”
He paused and added another sentence, his tone becoming slightly more serious.
“However, in the future, let him come to this kind of place less often.”
“The concept of class is very heavy on the The Frontline.
Although demigods are not uniformly controlled like Divine Beings, running around randomly is still dangerous.”
“For instance, in this place, if some god casually obliterates him on a whim, the law enforcement robots won’t be able to do anything.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Thank you for the reminder, Cousin.”
As if suddenly remembering something, Gu Jiuheng raised his chin.
“Take out the Ninth Legion identity token.”
Yang Fan complied, took out the token, and handed it over.
After taking it, Gu Jiuheng also took out a purple-gold token from his sleeve and gently pressed it against Yang Fan’s token.
The two tokens trembled slightly, and then a fine ripple emerged, confirming completion.
Gu Jiuheng withdrew his hand, his tone casual yet carrying a trace of a matter-of-fact meaning.
“You are the Third Elder’s son-in-law.
Although you currently have no achievements, you still have a dividend quota of ten million military merits every month.”
He paused.
“This month’s has already been transferred for you.
Starting next month, the military merit System will automatically settle it into your account.”
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed.
“Ten million?!”
Gu Jiuheng glanced at him and smiled, “Does it feel like a lot?”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then nodded earnestly.
It wasn’t a lot.
It was a bit ridiculously much.
In the exchange System of the military merit System, he knew very well what this ten million meant.
A top-tier S-Rank Building like the “War God Codex” was only fifty million military merits.

As for some resource-type S-Rank Buildings, such as the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest, the enlightenment ancient tree, and the like, they could be exchanged for just tens of thousands of military merits.
That was to say, without doing anything, living in the The Frontline villa arranged by the Gu Family, he could effortlessly get a top-tier S-Rank Building for free in five months.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Why Is He Putting On An Act?
paragraphs: Gu Jiuheng looked at Yang Fan’s shocked expression and continued to smile, saying,

“It really is quite a lot. For many Tier 3 Gods, even if they spend years participating in the Divine Kingdom War on the The Frontline and hunting Alien Gods, their military merits accumulated over decades might not even catch up to yours in a single month.”
His tone was very calm, as if he were stating a fact.
Yang Fan did not interrupt, just listening quietly.
Gu Jiuheng glanced at him and continued,
“Brother-in-law, you need to understand one thing: your identity is different from those ordinary gods.”
“You are a member of the Gu Family, your wife is Gu Le, and your father-in-law is the Third Elder of the Gu Family.”
“This world is inherently unfair.”
“The gods of the Five Great Families stand at a higher starting point from the very beginning.”
“And these military merits come from the dividends of flow the Ninth Legion.”
Yang Fan raised his eyebrows slightly, “Dividends?”
“That’s right.” Gu Jiuheng nodded.
“The Ninth Legion is controlled by the Gu Family. I am a brigade commander, considered middle management.”
“In this position, it is normally occupied by a Mid-tier God. I was able to sit here largely because my surname is Gu.”
His tone was very calm, without showing off or concealing anything.
“The Legion Commander also has the surname Gu and is an Eighth-tier God.”
“However, within the Ninth Legion, the members of the Gu Family are only a minority. Most of them are gods from all over the Human Race who joined the legion.”
“They are responsible for fighting, while we are responsible for dispatching, intelligence, resources, and logistical support.”
“By relying on the system to operate and cooperating with each other, we can win one Divine Kingdom War after another efficiently and at a low cost.”
“That being the case, a portion of the military merits they obtain will naturally flow back into the internal system.”
He paused here for a moment.
“To put it bluntly, it’s a cut.”
Yang Fan looked thoughtful, “Similar to federal taxation?”
Gu Jiuheng chuckled softly, “You can understand it roughly like that, but the targets are different.”
“Federal taxation targets Divine Beings and demigods.”
“While in the military merit system, they are basically gods.”
“After all, those high-tier resources and buildings simply cannot be bought in outside markets.”
Yang Fan cupped his fists, “Thank you, Cousin, for clearing up my confusion.”
“You’re welcome.” Gu Jiuheng waved his hand, his expression becoming a bit more serious than before.

“The reason I told you so much is to remind you of one thing—the fastest way to obtain military merits is not by relying on Subordinate Gods to fight proxy wars, but through the Divine Kingdom War between gods.”
He paused, his tone dropping slightly.
“The Third Elder hopes that you play it safe for the next ten years and treat the The Frontline as a gilded resume, which is certainly not wrong.”
“But my personal advice is that you had better not really treat yourself as someone who has come here to retire.”
“Whether it’s military merits or Divinity Points, for a divine kingdom, you can never have too many.”
Gu Jiuheng raised his eyes to look at Yang Fan.
“With your talent, coupled with the resource support from the Third Elder, in at most a hundred years of real time, the area of your divine kingdom will be utilized to its limit.”
“By then, ordinary A-Rank resource buildings will cover every inch of land, and the real problem will emerge—there won’t be enough space.”
His tone paused slightly.
“You will have to start setting up S-Rank Buildings.”
“And when you reach that stage, you will discover a very realistic fact—the development of a divine kingdom has no upper limit, but resources have a Bottleneck.”
“The more you earn, the more you will feel it’s not enough.”
He smiled with the certainty of someone who had been through it.
“That’s why I said you must seize all time and every opportunity to earn more resources.”
Saying this, Gu Jiuheng even took a step closer, patted Yang Fan on the shoulder, and his tone carried an obvious meaning of cultivation.
“Ten million military merit points per month; this is the Gu Family’s investment in a Peerless Prodigy.”
“The period is ten years. Once the time is up, this portion of the subsidy will be canceled.”
“So these ten years are the golden time for your development, and you must utilize them to the absolute limit.”
“Don’t hoard military merits; smash them all into S-Rank Buildings as much as possible.”
His gaze narrowed.
“Your talent is SS-Rank Hundredfold Time Sequence, and the growth speed of your believers is extremely fast, but the consumption of Spiritual Qi in the divine kingdom is equally terrifying.”
“I suggest you prioritize purchasing a large number of resource buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest to guarantee the supply of Spiritual Qi.”
“Only in this way can your talent truly be transformed into growth in combat power.”
“As for the Divine Kingdom War, you can come to work under me in the Ninth Legion. I will arrange the safest and most lucrative theater missions for you.”
“More tempering is more effective than closed-door development.”
“Thank you, Cousin, I will consider it seriously.” Yang Fan nodded.
After saying this, Gu Jiuheng said no more and turned to walk out the door.
Yang Fan stood up to see him off.
When he reached the door, Gu Jiuheng put his hands behind his back and looked up at the firmament, as if he suddenly had a bit more emotion.
“Brother-in-law, to be honest, I actually quite envy you.”
“Although I am also a member of the Gu Family, back when I entered the The Frontline, I only had the identity of a Human Race Prodigy.”
“So my military merit subsidy is only two million a month.”
He shook his head gently.
“The longer you stay on the The Frontline, the more you will understand a truth—resources are never enough.”
“The stronger a person is, the more they lack resources.”
He suddenly turned his head to look at Yang Fan.
“Do you know how many S-Rank Buildings there are in my divine kingdom right now?”
Yang Fan shook his head and did not answer.
The corners of Gu Jiuheng’s mouth lifted slightly, carrying a trace of unconcealable confidence.
“S-Rank resource buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest—”
“I have already set up one thousand three hundred and fourteen of them.”
The air fell silent for a moment, and Yang Fan’s expression had a bit of’surprise’.
Looking at Yang Fan’s expression, he seemed very satisfied with this “reasonable surprise”.
Then he chuckled softly.
“Alright, I won’t say much more to you.”
“Once you’ve figured it out, come report to me.”
“Remember, ten years from now, all the Family will give you is connections; there will no longer be any resource inclination.”
He waved his hand and turned to leave.
His footsteps paused for a moment at the end of the corridor, as if on a sudden whim, and he chanted softly:
“The divine path is endless, stepping through wind and frost; military merits like fire illuminate the vast expanse;
Do not lean on Family shade to block the sun, rely on one’s own strength to stand in the firmament;
Wait until wings are formed to soar across the nine domains, spreading divine wings to break the heavenly light.”
He let out a loud laugh before leaving contentedly.
Looking at Gu Jiuheng’s receding back, Yang Fan’s expression finally couldn’t hold anymore.
He subconsciously glanced at his own divine kingdom panel.
[Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest X 112,000 (S-Rank) enlightenment ancient tree X 113,000 (S-Rank)]
After two seconds of silence, he let out a soft breath.
“I always thought this cousin of the Gu Family was so amazing?”
“Turns out he’s just a puny weakling!”
“Why is he putting on an act!”
He shook his head and turned back to the villa.
On the other side, Gu Jiuheng had already walked to another block.
As soon as he left Yang Fan’s line of sight, his whole body visibly relaxed, his steps even became much lighter, and the corners of his mouth couldn’t be pressed down.
He hummed a little tune, his expression quite joyful.
“So comfortable.”
“That girl Gu Le messages every day to brag about how amazing her husband is, my ears are almost growing calluses.”
He looked up at the sky, the smile deepening.
“Although my talent is a tier lower, I’ve managed to get by on the The Frontline for thirty or forty years after all.”
“I wonder if I shocked my brother-in-law just now?”
He couldn’t help laughing out low.
“Hahaha, putting on an act in front of a Peerless Prodigy who hasn’t fully grown up yet.”
“It feels so damn good.”
Thinking about the conversation just now, he became even more proud.
“1,314 S-Rank Buildings...”
“My brother-in-law, I hope he wasn’t scared.”
“These are all the foundations I worked so hard to accumulate.”
“Don’t let him suffer internal friction over this, hahahaha.”

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Bullying the Weak, Hunting Demigods
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s mind stirred slightly.
The next moment, his consciousness descended into the Divine Kingdom.

The Divine Kingdom was boundless and vast. Mechanical Civilization, Immortal Alliance, Wanxiang Martial Court, Elf Kingdom, and Zombie Kingdom each performed their respective duties, and the entire Divine Kingdom operated in an orderly manner.
“Yang Da, how is the situation?”
Yang Fan asked.
Yang Da immediately bowed respectfully.
“Reporting to Master, the Divine Kingdom coordinates of the Alien God still have not been deduced.”

Ever since Yang Fan took the five demigod Divine Kingdom Cores into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da had used the Divine Kingdom Deduction Card at the very first moment to attempt to reverse-deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates of the god behind those Subordinate Gods.
However, wanting to reverse-deduce a god’s Divine Kingdom location through Subordinate Gods was inherently a matter of extremely low probability.
Yang Fan had already mentally prepared himself for this.
His expression remained calm, and he was not disappointed because of this.
He slowly raised his right hand.
Hum——
The five Divine Kingdom Cores slowly rose into the air, rapidly decomposing under the encapsulation of Divine Power, turning into wisps of pure Origin power that merged into the Divine Kingdom.
The edges of the Divine Kingdom trembled slightly, expanding outward by a small section.
At the same time, strands of Divine Kingdom rules also emerged.
Yang Fan once again acquired five Divine Kingdom Talents.
“[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things, D-rank Talent Planting, F-rank Talent Resources × 3] (Can be fused).”
“[A-rank Talent Battle Body, F-rank Talent Might, F-rank Talent Stiff Bone] (Can be fused).”
A total of three F-rank resource-type talents, one D-rank resource-type talent, and one F-rank combat-type talent were obtained.
However, for Yang Fan today, these gains could only be considered better than nothing.

Whether Human Race or alien races, demigods who chose to come to the The Frontline to acquire resources through proxy wars were mostly ordinary demigods without backgrounds who dared to fight and forge ahead.
Therefore, the Divine Kingdom Talents they possessed were mostly very ordinary.
Yang Fan attempted to mobilize Origin Evolution to fuse these talents.
But when the talent Origins merged into it, it was like a drop of water falling into a vast ocean.
It only stirred up a trace of an insignificant ripple.
It was fundamentally unable to cause an obvious qualitative change in his Divine Kingdom Talents.
“If I could devour all those Alien Demigods kept in captivity by Primordial Academy, that would be great.” Yang Fan couldn’t help exclaiming.
Those Alien Demigods not only possessed powerful Divine Kingdom Talents themselves.
Within their Divine Kingdoms, they stored an even greater number of Human Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores.
To other demigods,
the greatest function of a Divine Kingdom Core was merely to expand the area of the Divine Kingdom.
But in Yang Fan’s eyes, that meant Divine Kingdom Talents that could be continuously fused and transformed.
“Proxy wars...”
Yang Fan murmured softly, his eyes lowering slightly, as if pondering something.
At this moment, Yang Da suddenly spoke.
“Master, should we continue to purchase Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates through the military merit System and hand them over to Li Tianheng?”
Yang Fan shook his head gently.
“Just purchase five every month through the military merit System.”
“If the quantity is too large, it will inevitably arouse suspicion from others.”
Speaking of this, the corners of his mouth curved up slightly.
“Besides, the military merit System is not the only place where Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates can be purchased.”
“Go, have Yang Yi log in to the Virtual World Divine Shop.”
“Make batch purchases from major companies selling Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“Remember, do not buy too much from the same company.”
“Try to disperse the transactions to different companies at different times.”
“Now that I control more and more funds, the more this is the case, the more cautious I must be.”
“Once the action is too large, it is very easy to expose anomalies.”
“Yes, Master!” Yang Da immediately replied.
Yang Fan continued:
“Limited by the Divine Kingdom rules, I cannot directly invade demigod Divine Kingdoms; these matters can only be left to Subordinate Gods to handle.”
“As for the purchased Divine Kingdom coordinates, select life-attribute demigods entirely, and at the minimum, they must be at the dangerous level.”
“The stronger the strength, the higher the probability of possessing powerful Divine Kingdom Talents.”
Speaking to the end, a flash of undisguised greed crossed the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
Nowadays, demigod Divine Kingdom Cores had a very limited improvement on his Divine Kingdom area.
If it were during the demigod period, a single demigod Divine Kingdom Core would be enough to expand his Divine Kingdom by millions of square kilometers.
But now, that same Divine Kingdom Core expanding by ten to twenty thousand square kilometers was already considered pretty good.
Yang Fan didn’t care about this at all.
One is not enough, then a hundred.
A hundred are not enough, then a thousand.
Furthermore, the Divine Kingdom area was only secondary.
What he truly cared about were those Divine Kingdom Talents that could constantly fuse and grow.
In this world, the number of demigods far exceeded true gods.
If he could deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates of a god, Yang Fan would naturally make complete preparations and personally launch a Divine Kingdom War.
After all, a god’s Divine Kingdom Core was far more valuable to him now than countless ordinary demigods.
But if there was temporarily no such opportunity, Yang Fan was not anxious either.
This feeling of bullying the weak, hunting demigods, continuously devouring their Divine Kingdom Cores, and slowly strengthening oneself... also seemed quite good.
“Subordinate will arrange it right away.”
Data streams flashed continuously in Yang Da’s eyes, and excitement was hard to conceal in his tone.
In his opinion, his master acted extremely cautiously.
Whether it was the development of the Divine Kingdom or the layout of the war, every step had been repeatedly scrutinized, preferring to be a bit slower rather than taking risks easily.
Yet it was precisely such a master who could always come up with plans sufficient to break conventional thinking.
For instance, currently hunting demigods in large numbers and absorbing Divine Kingdom Cores through proxy wars.
If other gods heard this, they would probably only think Yang Fan had gone mad.
After all, launching a proxy war required investing a massive amount of Divinity Points, resources, and time.
Moreover, an ordinary demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core offered extremely limited improvements to a god.
The input and harvest were simply not proportional.
If one did not consider the scenario of deducing a god’s coordinates, even in the vast majority of cases, it was a losing business.
But to Yang Fan, these simply did not count as problems.
Because right now, what he lacked the least were Divinity Points.
After explaining everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Divine Kingdom and returned to the real world.
Demigod residential area.
Li Tianheng was leisurely lying on a reclining chair, crossing his legs, looking like a landlord and a wealthy tycoon.
“Brother Li, can’t this fee... be increased a bit more?”
A middle-aged man rubbed his hands, his face full of nervousness and a flattering smile.
“Brother Zhang, this is already the highest market price.”
Li Tianheng shook his head.
“Although you possess a B-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, a spiritual farmer ultimately leans towards Planting development, and has limited help for warfare.”
“Even if the price is higher, I have no way to explain it to my god.”
Hearing this, the man’s expression struggled for a moment.
Then he looked around, and after confirming that there was no one nearby, he immediately leaned close to Li Tianheng’s ear and lowered his voice to say:
“Brother Li, add another twenty thousand Divinity Points.”
“Since that Lord God let you be in full charge, he must trust you very much.”
“Once the contract is signed, I will privately return ten thousand Divinity Points to you.”
