Whether Human Race or alien races, demigods who chose to come to the The Frontline to acquire resources through proxy wars were mostly ordinary demigods without backgrounds who dared to fight and forge ahead.
Therefore, the Divine Kingdom Talents they possessed were mostly very ordinary.
Yang Fan attempted to mobilize Origin Evolution to fuse these talents.
But when the talent Origins merged into it, it was like a drop of water falling into a vast ocean.
It only stirred up a trace of an insignificant ripple.
It was fundamentally unable to cause an obvious qualitative change in his Divine Kingdom Talents.
“If I could devour all those Alien Demigods kept in captivity by Primordial Academy, that would be great.” Yang Fan couldn’t help exclaiming.
Those Alien Demigods not only possessed powerful Divine Kingdom Talents themselves.
Within their Divine Kingdoms, they stored an even greater number of Human Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores.
To other demigods,
the greatest function of a Divine Kingdom Core was merely to expand the area of the Divine Kingdom.
But in Yang Fan’s eyes, that meant Divine Kingdom Talents that could be continuously fused and transformed.
“Proxy wars...”
Yang Fan murmured softly, his eyes lowering slightly, as if pondering something.
At this moment, Yang Da suddenly spoke.
“Master, should we continue to purchase Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates through the military merit System and hand them over to Li Tianheng?”
Yang Fan shook his head gently.
“Just purchase five every month through the military merit System.”
“If the quantity is too large, it will inevitably arouse suspicion from others.”
Speaking of this, the corners of his mouth curved up slightly.
“Besides, the military merit System is not the only place where Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates can be purchased.”
“Go, have Yang Yi log in to the Virtual World Divine Shop.”
“Make batch purchases from major companies selling Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“Remember, do not buy too much from the same company.”
“Try to disperse the transactions to different companies at different times.”
“Now that I control more and more funds, the more this is the case, the more cautious I must be.”
“Once the action is too large, it is very easy to expose anomalies.”
“Yes, Master!” Yang Da immediately replied.
Yang Fan continued:
“Limited by the Divine Kingdom rules, I cannot directly invade demigod Divine Kingdoms; these matters can only be left to Subordinate Gods to handle.”
“As for the purchased Divine Kingdom coordinates, select life-attribute demigods entirely, and at the minimum, they must be at the dangerous level.”
“The stronger the strength, the higher the probability of possessing powerful Divine Kingdom Talents.”
Speaking to the end, a flash of undisguised greed crossed the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
Nowadays, demigod Divine Kingdom Cores had a very limited improvement on his Divine Kingdom area.
If it were during the demigod period, a single demigod Divine Kingdom Core would be enough to expand his Divine Kingdom by millions of square kilometers.
But now, that same Divine Kingdom Core expanding by ten to twenty thousand square kilometers was already considered pretty good.
Yang Fan didn’t care about this at all.
One is not enough, then a hundred.
A hundred are not enough, then a thousand.
Furthermore, the Divine Kingdom area was only secondary.
What he truly cared about were those Divine Kingdom Talents that could constantly fuse and grow.
In this world, the number of demigods far exceeded true gods.
If he could deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates of a god, Yang Fan would naturally make complete preparations and personally launch a Divine Kingdom War.
After all, a god’s Divine Kingdom Core was far more valuable to him now than countless ordinary demigods.
But if there was temporarily no such opportunity, Yang Fan was not anxious either.
This feeling of bullying the weak, hunting demigods, continuously devouring their Divine Kingdom Cores, and slowly strengthening oneself... also seemed quite good.
“Subordinate will arrange it right away.”
Data streams flashed continuously in Yang Da’s eyes, and excitement was hard to conceal in his tone.
In his opinion, his master acted extremely cautiously.
Whether it was the development of the Divine Kingdom or the layout of the war, every step had been repeatedly scrutinized, preferring to be a bit slower rather than taking risks easily.
Yet it was precisely such a master who could always come up with plans sufficient to break conventional thinking.
For instance, currently hunting demigods in large numbers and absorbing Divine Kingdom Cores through proxy wars.
If other gods heard this, they would probably only think Yang Fan had gone mad.
After all, launching a proxy war required investing a massive amount of Divinity Points, resources, and time.
Moreover, an ordinary demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core offered extremely limited improvements to a god.
The input and harvest were simply not proportional.
If one did not consider the scenario of deducing a god’s coordinates, even in the vast majority of cases, it was a losing business.
But to Yang Fan, these simply did not count as problems.
Because right now, what he lacked the least were Divinity Points.
After explaining everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Divine Kingdom and returned to the real world.
Demigod residential area.
Li Tianheng was leisurely lying on a reclining chair, crossing his legs, looking like a landlord and a wealthy tycoon.
“Brother Li, can’t this fee... be increased a bit more?”
A middle-aged man rubbed his hands, his face full of nervousness and a flattering smile.
“Brother Zhang, this is already the highest market price.”
Li Tianheng shook his head.
“Although you possess a B-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, a spiritual farmer ultimately leans towards Planting development, and has limited help for warfare.”
“Even if the price is higher, I have no way to explain it to my god.”
Hearing this, the man’s expression struggled for a moment.
Then he looked around, and after confirming that there was no one nearby, he immediately leaned close to Li Tianheng’s ear and lowered his voice to say:
“Brother Li, add another twenty thousand Divinity Points.”
“Since that Lord God let you be in full charge, he must trust you very much.”
“Once the contract is signed, I will privately return ten thousand Divinity Points to you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Establishing His Own Company
paragraphs: As the words fell.
Bang!
Li Tianheng abruptly stood up and shoved the other person away.
“Get lost!”
“Are you fucking signing or not?”
“The person behind me is my own brother!”
“When I, Li Tianheng, hang out in the streets, what I value most is ‘loyalty’!”
“Go find someone else for shitty things like taking kickbacks!”
“If you’re not signing, get the hell out of here!”
The more Li Tianheng talked, the angrier he got, almost kicking out.
What a joke!
He followed Yang Fan to fight the Divine Kingdom War, and apart from helping recover the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box, he practically didn’t have to do anything.
Every single war gave a reward of one hundred thousand Divinity Points alone.
After the war ended, all those buildings inside the other party’s divine kingdom were given to him entirely.
Under such circumstances, he would still team up with outsiders to scam Yang Fan out of his Divinity Points?
If he really did such a thing.
Li Tianheng felt that every time he woke up in the middle of the night afterwards, he would have to slap himself hard twice, “I’m fucking not a human!”
“Brother Li, don’t rush, I’ll sign, I’ll sign!”
Startled, the man didn’t dare to bargain any further and quickly picked up the contract to sign his name.
In fact, he also knew that his divine kingdom talent was not popular on The Frontline.
In this area right now, the price given by Li Tianheng was already the highest.
Not only that, all the Divinity Points were paid in a lump sum, so there was no need to worry about reneging on the debt afterwards.
He had just wanted to test the waters earlier.
In case he could really earn an extra ten thousand Divinity Points, the believers within his divine kingdom wouldn’t have to worry about Resources for the next few years.
Doing business, after all, always required a bit of bargaining.
Who would have thought... he actually ran into such an unyielding and reckless fellow.
Thinking of this, a sense of admiration instead arose in the man’s heart.
“That Divine Lord’s vision is truly sharp.”
“Choosing such a stubborn Subordinate God to handle things really gives people peace of mind.”
Li Tianheng put away the contract and said indifferently:
“Within ten days, I will uniformly submit the contracts.”
“At that time, The Frontline Intelligent Life will uniformly match you with an Alien Demigod.”
“That way, you won’t have to worry about encountering opponents whose strength far exceeds your own.”
“Fair enough.”
Hearing this, the man nodded repeatedly.
“Not worried, not worried.”
“It doesn’t matter even if the Divine Lord personally chooses.”
“Senior certainly wouldn’t let us die in vain.”
This was an unstated rule tacitly agreed upon by all demigods on The Frontline.
Once the Subordinate God Contract was signed, a trace of connection would be established between the two divine kingdoms.
If the Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom Core was seized by the alien race, the Alien God might trace this connection to deduce the coordinates of the divine kingdom behind it.
Therefore, no god would intentionally harm their own Subordinate God.
Doing so was not only meaningless, but would instead bring huge hidden dangers to themselves.
“Alright, go home and wait for the news.”
Li Tianheng waved his hand with a look of disgust.
Watching the retreating figure of the other person leave, he couldn’t help but curl his lips.
I don’t know since when.
Whenever someone smiled all over their face and called him “Brother Li” left and right, he would subconsciously be on guard.
Right at this moment, a message suddenly came from Yang Da’s side.
The next second, a series of divine kingdom coordinates popped up directly.
Dense and numerous, easily over a hundred of them.
Seeing this scene, Li Tianheng was stunned on the spot.
“What the fuck?!”
“Brother Yang, what is this... situation with you?”
“How come these Alien Demigod coordinates were all bought from the Virtual World Divine Shop?”
His eyes widened in shock.
“Brother Yang, do... do you have so much money that you have nowhere to spend it?!”
You must know that divine kingdom coordinates were inherently a form of “information warfare”.
Military channels were not only more accurate, but also much cheaper.
As for the coordinate trading companies in the Virtual World Divine Shop, it was completely a different concept.
That was expensive, ridiculously expensive.
Starting at least from one million Divinity Points at every turn.
In his cognition.
The act of buying coordinates in such a place was basically equivalent to “exclusively for suckers”.
Only a fool with so many Resources that they had nowhere to spend them would do this.
Not daring to delay, Li Tianheng immediately sent a Feixun message to Yang Fan.
Then he directly put on the virtual helmet and entered the Virtual World.
After experiencing the sense of oppression from Gu Jiuheng just now.
He inexplicably gained a hint of awe towards Yang Fan’s residence in the Real World.
Unless absolutely necessary, he didn’t even dare to go over in person.
In the Virtual World, light and shadow intertwined.
As soon as Li Tianheng logged online, he already appeared in front of Yang Fan.
He hurriedly spoke: “Brother Yang, what are these coordinates you bought?”
“Stop talking nonsense.” Yang Fan spoke indifferently, his tone calm, yet carrying an unquestionable sense of oppression.
“Alrighty!”
Li Tianheng instantly stood as straight as a ruler, like a military posture straightened by a conditioned reflex.
“Then... what should this younger brother of yours do next?”
Yang Fan raised his eyes and glanced at him.
“I will continue to provide you with the corpse pill.”
“Follow the poisoning tactic and invade these demigods’ divine kingdoms as soon as possible.”
“I only want the Divine Kingdom Core and S-Rank Buildings.”
“Do you understand?”
As the voice fell, Li Tianheng nodded frantically without the slightest hesitation.
“Understood! Completely understood!”
Yang Fan’s gaze sank slightly, and he continued:
“Where I live in reality, there are too many gods around.”
“For your safety.”
“From now on, all Resource handovers will be completed through robots.”
“Do not show your face directly.”
Li Tianheng’s expression turned joyful: “Alrighty!”
As soon as Li Tianheng left, Yang Fan opened Feixun and clicked on the coordinates sent by Ma Yu.
The next instant.
His consciousness descended upon Xiling Planet once again.
Inside the conference hall, space trembled slightly.
Yang Fan’s figure slowly condensed.
There was only Ma Yu in the entire conference hall.
At this moment, he was standing respectfully with his head slightly lowered, “Boss.”
Yang Fan nodded gently, then spoke:
“I remember you said before.”
“Elephant Loan once invested in students from the Primordial Academy?”
Ma Yu was slightly startled, then immediately replied:
“Yes.”
“However, Elephant Loan has a limited scale.”
“Among Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy, the highest we contacted were Grade-B Geniuses.”
“After graduating, the other party is still engaged in debt collection work at Elephant Loan.”
Yang Fan didn’t speak immediately, but continued to ask:
“Are there still students to invest in at Primordial Academy now?”
Ma Yu shook his head.
“There are no more.”
“Recently, Elephant Loan’s core business has fully shifted to Xiling Planet.”
“The lending business has basically contracted, and currently industrial development is the main focus.”
“Coupled with the addition of the Luo Family, Xiling Planet’s talent reserve is already sufficient.”
“So there is temporarily no plan to continue investing in students.”
He paused, and tentatively asked:
“Boss, do you want to establish your own company in the Real World and lay out industries?”
At this moment, Ma Yu’s eyes carried a hint of excitement.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up as well.
Nowadays, his Divinity Points were abundant to the point of being exaggerated.
His monthly divine kingdom revenue had already exceeded the level of trillions.
His divine kingdom possessed a powerful wealth-generating capability.
Yet his industries in the Real World only possessed one Xiling Planet.
Much like a giant consortium hidden in the deep sea, possessing terrifying wealth, yet lacking a corresponding Real World identity and power structure to match it.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Am I Too Poor?
paragraphs: You must know that gods never pursued wealth just for the sake of it.
Divinity Points were merely tools.
Their true pursuit was the continuous evolution of their Divine Kingdoms and the ascension at the level of rules.
However, in the real world, power, status, and influence were equally “anchors” and another extension of a god’s identity.
As for him right now, the only presentable real-world identity he had was one—the son-in-law of the Gu Family.
Just like that, how could Yang Fan be content?
Yang Fan slowly took a breath.
“I do have thoughts in this direction.”
“However, it’s not mature yet.”
Ma Yu’s eyes instantly lit up.
“Boss, I’m good at starting companies.”
“With your identity as the son-in-law of the Gu Family, as long as the company goes public, it will inevitably attract a massive amount of capital.”
“By then, regardless of financing capability or development speed, it will be far beyond what Elephant Loan can compare to today. It can at least improve tenfold or a hundredfold!”
“Going public?”
Yang Fan looked thoughtful.
“That’s right.”
Ma Yu nodded without hesitation.
“If Boss thinks starting from scratch is too troublesome, you can also directly go public through a backdoor listing.”
“This subordinate is willing to unconditionally transfer all equity of Elephant Loan to Boss.”
When saying these words, Ma Yu’s expression was earnest, without the slightest hesitation.
However, Yang Fan gently shook his head.
The biggest advantage of going public was nothing more than using the capital market to leverage more resources at an extremely low cost and continuously expand the scale of the enterprise.
For ordinary gods, this was the fastest way to accumulate wealth.
But for the current Yang Fan...
Wealth was conversely the least attractive thing.
The Divine Kingdom’s thousand-fold investment returns operated continuously, and the Divinity Points created every month were an extremely exaggerated figure.
His purpose in founding a company was never to make money.
Rather, it was to establish his own real-world forces.
Allowing the company to become the tentacles of his real world, bringing him greater influence, power, and right to speak.
Yang Fan looked toward Ma Yu, “Are you really willing to hand Elephant Loan to me?”
“This subordinate is willing.”
Ma Yu did not have any hesitation, nodding heavily.
“Boss.”
“In the eyes of ordinary people, I am a Fifth-Order God and a major shareholder of a listed company, already considered standing at the upper layer of the pyramid.”
“Yet only after truly stepping into this circle did I realize.”
“More than eighty percent of the resources and power in the Human Federation are firmly grasped in the hands of the Five Great Families.”
“These past years, I relied on Divine Kingdom investments to accumulate capital bit by bit.”
“Constantly seeking partners, calculating risks, pulling people to invest, and raising funds everywhere.”

“In order to keep Elephant Loan alive, I even personally visited countless forces, lowered my posture to beg for cooperation, and once almost lost tens of thousands of years of accumulation due to an investment failure.”
“It took a full several hundred thousand years for me to develop Elephant Loan to the scale it is today.”
“Yet even so, my status and position are far inferior to a low-order god living in Taichu City.”
Speaking to this point, Ma Yu took a deep breath, but his gaze became increasingly firm.
“Boss, your appearance has allowed me to see another kind of possibility.”
“A possibility that can break through social strata and truly enter the core circle of the Human Federation.”
“Therefore, as long as you need it.”
“Elephant Loan, I offer to you with both hands.”
Yang Fan quietly finished listening without speaking.
He knew that Ma Yu’s allegiance was not because of his own temperament, nor was it because of a few words that made him utterly devoted.
At their level, no one would easily hand over the foundation they had fought for hundreds of thousands of years due to so-called personal charm.
What Ma Yu valued was his potential and identity.
And what Yang Fan valued was Ma Yu’s ability.
When all was said and done, this was an investment recognized by both sides and a cooperation of mutual achievement.
Between people, it was never detached from interests.
Love was like this, friendship was like this, and familial affection was equally like this.
Interests did not mean scheming.
More often, what it represented was mutual need.
Husbands and wives jointly operating a Family, friends supporting each other’s growth, families passing down their Legacy and continuing...
The reason these relationships could last long was not without emotion.
On the contrary, precisely because the directions of emotion and interests were consistent, they could go further.
If the two completely diverged, no matter how deep the affection was, it would eventually face tests.
A truly stable relationship was never a one-sided contribution.
Rather, it was that both sides could obtain what they wanted from this relationship.
Ma Yu needed to rely on him to cross identity strata.
And he himself needed an experienced executor like Ma Yu.
This kind of cooperation was instead even more solid.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and said, “Ma Yu, if Elephant Loan delists, how much capital is needed?”
Ma Yu almost without thinking blurted out:
“Calculated according to the current circulating shares.”
“If buying back everything at a 20% premium, it will take about eight hundred billion Divinity Points.”
Yang Fan gently nodded.
“In a moment, I will let the Intelligent Life transfer one hundred trillion Divinity Points to you.”
The voice remained calm, as if he were just speaking of a trivial matter.
Yet Ma Yu’s entire person stiffened in place.
He froze for a full second, then abruptly raised his head, his voice even starting to tremble.
“B—Boss.”
“What you just said is...”
“One hundred trillion?”
At this moment, Ma Yu even suspected whether he had misheard the unit.
These past years, he painstakingly operated Elephant Loan for over a thousand years.
During this period, he continuously took out Divine Kingdom returns to make additional investments, raised funds everywhere, and expanded the business.
Until today, the market value of the entire Elephant Loan was merely a paltry five trillion Divinity Points.
And the figure Yang Fan just uttered was fully twenty times the market value of the entire Elephant Loan!
The figure Yang Fan spoke had long exceeded Ma Yu’s cognition.
One hundred trillion Divinity Points!
Let alone an Elephant Loan.
Ma Yu even felt that if he packaged and sold all the Divine Kingdom assets of himself, a Fifth-Order God, it might not even be worth this much.
“That’s right.”
Yang Fan’s expression was calm, as if what he spoke was just an ordinary string of numbers.
“After receiving the funds.”
“The first thing, buy back all circulating shares on the market.”
“Then, apply for delisting.”
“The second thing, readjust the company’s equity structure.”
“I’ll leave 1% of the shares for you.”
Yang Fan glanced at Ma Yu and continued:
“Don’t think it’s too little.”
“In the future, I will continue to inject capital.”
“By that time, you will understand what the value of this 1% truly means.”
Hearing these words, Ma Yu hurriedly bowed.
“This subordinate wouldn’t dare.”
“Thank you, Boss, for your appreciation.”
If what Yang Fan said was true.
Let alone 1%, even if there were only 0.1% of the shares, it would be enough to make countless gods fight head-to-head until they bled.
After all, the moment Yang Fan made a move, it was one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Moreover, this was still circulating funds that could be called upon at any time.
“Are the people of the Five Great Families... all this rich?”
“Or is it... that I am too poor?”
Ma Yu screamed frantically in his heart.

“In the eyes of ordinary people, I am a Fifth-Order God and a major shareholder of a listed company, already considered standing at the upper layer of the pyramid.”
“Yet only after truly stepping into this circle did I realize.”
“More than eighty percent of the resources and power in the Human Federation are firmly grasped in the hands of the Five Great Families.”
“These past years, I relied on Divine Kingdom investments to accumulate capital bit by bit.”
“Constantly seeking partners, calculating risks, pulling people to invest, and raising funds everywhere.”

“In order to keep Elephant Loan alive, I even personally visited countless forces, lowered my posture to beg for cooperation, and once almost lost tens of thousands of years of accumulation due to an investment failure.”
“It took a full several hundred thousand years for me to develop Elephant Loan to the scale it is today.”
“Yet even so, my status and position are far inferior to a low-order god living in Taichu City.”
Speaking to this point, Ma Yu took a deep breath, but his gaze became increasingly firm.
“Boss, your appearance has allowed me to see another kind of possibility.”
“A possibility that can break through social strata and truly enter the core circle of the Human Federation.”
“Therefore, as long as you need it.”
“Elephant Loan, I offer to you with both hands.”
Yang Fan quietly finished listening without speaking.
He knew that Ma Yu’s allegiance was not because of his own temperament, nor was it because of a few words that made him utterly devoted.
At their level, no one would easily hand over the foundation they had fought for hundreds of thousands of years due to so-called personal charm.
What Ma Yu valued was his potential and identity.
And what Yang Fan valued was Ma Yu’s ability.
When all was said and done, this was an investment recognized by both sides and a cooperation of mutual achievement.
Between people, it was never detached from interests.
Love was like this, friendship was like this, and familial affection was equally like this.
Interests did not mean scheming.
More often, what it represented was mutual need.
Husbands and wives jointly operating a Family, friends supporting each other’s growth, families passing down their Legacy and continuing...
The reason these relationships could last long was not without emotion.
On the contrary, precisely because the directions of emotion and interests were consistent, they could go further.
If the two completely diverged, no matter how deep the affection was, it would eventually face tests.
A truly stable relationship was never a one-sided contribution.
Rather, it was that both sides could obtain what they wanted from this relationship.
Ma Yu needed to rely on him to cross identity strata.
And he himself needed an experienced executor like Ma Yu.
This kind of cooperation was instead even more solid.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and said, “Ma Yu, if Elephant Loan delists, how much capital is needed?”
Ma Yu almost without thinking blurted out:
“Calculated according to the current circulating shares.”
“If buying back everything at a 20% premium, it will take about eight hundred billion Divinity Points.”
Yang Fan gently nodded.
“In a moment, I will let the Intelligent Life transfer one hundred trillion Divinity Points to you.”
The voice remained calm, as if he were just speaking of a trivial matter.
Yet Ma Yu’s entire person stiffened in place.
He froze for a full second, then abruptly raised his head, his voice even starting to tremble.
“B—Boss.”
“What you just said is...”
“One hundred trillion?”
At this moment, Ma Yu even suspected whether he had misheard the unit.
These past years, he painstakingly operated Elephant Loan for over a thousand years.
During this period, he continuously took out Divine Kingdom returns to make additional investments, raised funds everywhere, and expanded the business.
Until today, the market value of the entire Elephant Loan was merely a paltry five trillion Divinity Points.
And the figure Yang Fan just uttered was fully twenty times the market value of the entire Elephant Loan!
The figure Yang Fan spoke had long exceeded Ma Yu’s cognition.
One hundred trillion Divinity Points!
Let alone an Elephant Loan.
Ma Yu even felt that if he packaged and sold all the Divine Kingdom assets of himself, a Fifth-Order God, it might not even be worth this much.
“That’s right.”
Yang Fan’s expression was calm, as if what he spoke was just an ordinary string of numbers.
“After receiving the funds.”
“The first thing, buy back all circulating shares on the market.”
“Then, apply for delisting.”
“The second thing, readjust the company’s equity structure.”
“I’ll leave 1% of the shares for you.”
Yang Fan glanced at Ma Yu and continued:
“Don’t think it’s too little.”
“In the future, I will continue to inject capital.”
“By that time, you will understand what the value of this 1% truly means.”
Hearing these words, Ma Yu hurriedly bowed.
“This subordinate wouldn’t dare.”
“Thank you, Boss, for your appreciation.”
If what Yang Fan said was true.
Let alone 1%, even if there were only 0.1% of the shares, it would be enough to make countless gods fight head-to-head until they bled.
After all, the moment Yang Fan made a move, it was one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Moreover, this was still circulating funds that could be called upon at any time.
“Are the people of the Five Great Families... all this rich?”
“Or is it... that I am too poor?”
Ma Yu screamed frantically in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: What Can You Use to Run?
paragraphs: Yang Fan continued to make arrangements.
“In addition, allocate 1% of the shares to Yang Chengrou as well.”
“I also have a son in Taichu City named Gu Chengye.”
“You should have heard of him. Give him 10% of the shares.”
“For the remaining shares, temporarily put all of them under my name.”
“Yes, this subordinate understands.” Ma Yu had no objections at all.
In his view, such an arrangement was completely normal.
Even as children, resource allocation could never be made completely equal.
What is more, Gu Chengye had the Gu Family standing behind him.
In the future, whether it was the connections he could access or the Resources he could mobilize, they were far beyond what Yang Chengrou could compare to.
Standing from Yang Fan’s perspective, he naturally had to make arrangements based on the reality of the situation.
This was not about favoring anyone, but rather making the choice most beneficial to everyone under the existing conditions.
After all, as the company continued to grow in the future,
the Luo Family might not necessarily be able to bear that increasingly massive interest.
But the Gu Family possessed such a foundation.
“The third matter is to adjust the company’s business.”
“First, establish an investment department.”
“The investment department will be divided into two parts. The first part is responsible for commercial investment.”

“Including but not limited to investing in small and medium-sized enterprises, acquiring Resource planets, bidding for development rights, investing in war Resource industries, taking stakes in potential enterprises, and acquiring research institutions with special technologies.”
“All of these businesses will be handed over to Intelligent Life for evaluation and operation.”
“The second part is responsible for talent reserve investment, contacting students for me from Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy.”
“In the name of the company, invest in the students with potential among them.”
“After the list is compiled, I will review it personally.”
“In addition, establish a sales department.”
“Currently, we mainly deal in three products: Spirit Stone, Earth Heart Milk, and enlightenment tea leaves.”
“Sell them externally in the name of the company.”
Yang Fan’s expression was serious.
This company, from its inception, was not built to make money.
But rather to integrate the Resources of the Real World for himself.
“This subordinate will go make arrangements shortly.”
Ma Yu nodded respectfully, but in his heart, a few doubts inevitably arose.
If viewed from a commercial perspective, Yang Fan’s arrangements were somewhat overly idealistic.
Investment was inherently about calculating input and return.
Moreover, for those top Genius individuals from Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy, every single investment contract demanded an astonishing price.
Now Xiling Planet had just started out, and there was simply no urgent need to introduce such top talents.
As for the sales department,
selling only three products made the categories far too single-faceted.
Furthermore, Yang Fan did not explain where the source of goods came from.
Surely they couldn’t... rely entirely on his own Divine Kingdom for production, right?
That little output, let alone opening up the market,
probably wouldn’t even be able to supply the orders.
However, Ma Yu ultimately did not speak up to ask.
Being able to walk step by step to today, he was very clear on one principle.
As a subordinate, constantly raising difficulties and questioning decisions before things even started,
was often the easiest way to make superiors feel a sense of aversion.
Rather than that, it was better to handle things well first.
When real problems were encountered, he could then bring back solutions to report.
Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the Virtual World.
He took off the virtual helmet, casually placed it aside, leaned his entire body against the sofa, and slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.
“It is also time... to show off my skills in the Real World.”
Right now, his Divine Kingdom investments were still far from reaching their limit.
Relying on the terrifying returns brought by Evolution Talent, coupled with the Dark Web constantly rolling assets, his Divine Kingdom wealth was growing crazily almost every second.
But problems came along with it.
The speed at which his Divine Kingdom earned Divinity Points far exceeded the speed at which he consumed them.
Massive wealth piled up continuously.
If it were simply left there, it was undoubtedly a waste.
Right now, he needed to make this wealth play an even greater value.
The appearance of the Divine Kingdom War also made Yang Fan realize that he needed to have his own forces, to subdue more demigods and stronger gods.
If wealth was utilized, it could also be transformed into power.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s thoughts flickered slightly.
A new instruction was transmitted to Yang Da.
At the same time,
Xiling Planet.
Ma Yu was standing inside the office, his gaze staring intently at his Divine Kingdom information.
“Real... It actually transferred over!”
“One hundred trillion Divinity Points!!”
Ma Yu completely froze.
Although he believed Yang Fan wouldn’t joke about this kind of thing, when one hundred trillion Divinity Points truly appeared in the Divine Kingdom,
he still couldn’t help feeling his scalp go numb.
One hundred trillion!
Such a massive amount of working capital.
Let alone him, even those behemoth listed companies with market values in the tens of millions of trillions of Divinity Points could hardly mobilize it all at once.
Looking at that string of numbers, Ma Yu’s breathing involuntarily became rapid.
At this very instant,
an extremely dangerous thought suddenly popped up in his mind.
“How about...”
“Taking the money and running away?”
But as soon as this thought arose, he fiercely suppressed it back down.
“Bah!”
“The boss trusts me so much, how could I do such a beastly thing?”
But immediately afterwards, he couldn’t help thinking seriously.
“This doesn’t seem to be a matter of trust either.”
The corners of Ma Yu’s mouth twitched slightly.
Yang Fan dared to transfer one hundred trillion Divinity Points to him all at once.
There were only two possibilities.
First: this little bit of money, others simply didn’t care about it.
Second: others were not afraid of him rolling away with the money at all.
Thinking of this, Ma Yu unhesitatingly ruled out the first possibility.
What kind of joke was that?
One hundred trillion Divinity Points!
Even if Yang Fan had the Gu Family standing behind him, it was absolutely impossible for him not to care about such a massive amount of working capital.
Then... the answer was left with only one.
Yang Fan wasn’t afraid of him running at all.
Or rather, if he dared to run, he had ten thousand ways to drag him back.
Thinking of this, a chill suddenly rose up Ma Yu’s back.
He couldn’t help looking left and right, looking at the surveillance cameras controlled by his Intelligent Life.
He always felt as if there were countless pairs of eyes in the air, silently staring at him.
“Run?”
“What can I use to run?”
“Run with my legs?”
“I’m afraid before I even run out of Xiling Planet, the boss would already be sitting in front of me drinking tea.”
Thinking of this, Ma Yu immediately straightened his back.
The expression on his face instantly became deadpan and serious.
“What kind of person am I, Ma Yu?”
“If the boss tells me to go east, I will never go west.”
“The boss’s money is my life!”
“Whoever dares to touch the boss’s money, I’ll risk my life with him first!”
After saying this, he himself couldn’t help nodding in satisfaction.
Feeling that his ideological awareness was getting higher and higher.
During this period of time, inside the villa at The Frontline, Yang Fan still remained secluded without going out, with almost no external actions.
His life rhythm was extremely simple—resting, checking the Divine Kingdom, and receiving various types of intelligence.
During this period, Gu Jiuheng sent a Feixun message again.
Asking him if he considered joining the Ninth Legion to participate together in the Divine Kingdom War at The Frontline.
Yang Fan politely declined the other party immediately.
To him, joining the legion to fight in coordination with other gods seemed to be able to acquire more military merits and Resources.
But in essence, it was exposing oneself to a highly uncertain environment.
Aliens cannot be trusted.
The Human Race is similarly not completely trustworthy.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Two Months of Divine Kingdom Development
paragraphs: Once he chose to participate in this large-scale joint war, his Divine Kingdom coordinates, military structure, and believer System were very likely to be inadvertently peeped at by others.
Even the slightest anomaly could become a Breakthrough point for deduction.
Moreover, his Divine Kingdom’s believer System had already moved towards maturity and strength.
Once he acted jointly with other deities, that kind of “unreasonable strength” would instead make it easier to expose problems.
Rather than taking risks, it was better to completely isolate variables.
As for resources, he never lacked them.
Risks must be controlled within the smallest possible range.
Truly mature deities never relied on impulse to expand their power.
Instead, they learned to slowly accumulate in unnoticed corners.
The fewer trump cards exposed, the longer one lived.
Gains could be forgone.
Safety was always first.
After receiving the reply, Gu Jiuheng only felt a slight regret and did not persuade him further.
After all, every deity had their own development path.
In his view, Yang Fan had just broken through to a deity not long ago and was in a stage of rapid growth.
Choosing to be cautious at this time was not strange.
As a nominal cousin, he naturally knew his boundaries.
Some suggestions only needed to be said once; saying too much would instead cross the line.
Truly smart people never overly intervened in other people’s Divine Kingdom development.
A sense of distance and boundaries were the most important things to maintain a relationship.
Another month passed in the real world.
Yang Da still continuously purchased resource-type buildings such as the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and enlightenment ancient tree through the Dark Web.
As for top S-Rank Building such as the War God Codex, they still had not appeared in the auction market.
Yang Fan was not in a hurry.
According to auction records over the years, such top S-Rank Building sufficient to change the pattern of the Divine Kingdom would appear several times a year.
Once they appeared in the world, Yang Da would report it at the first moment.
By then, he would definitely not miss it.
Buildings like the War God Codex could even fetch astronomical prices of trillions of Divinity Points in the Dark Web.
But for the current Yang Fan, this price was nothing.
For resource-type buildings, he would control the pace to avoid drawing attention.
But for top buildings that could truly change the structure of the Divine Kingdom, he would never be stingy.
Because that level of buildings provided a qualitative change in improving the combat power of believers.
Now that the Divine Kingdom had broken through to a deity, the Divine Kingdom’s area had expanded a hundredfold.
The coverage range of the Heavenly Court and the War God Codex had already expanded to the limit state, requiring more top S-Rank Building.
At this moment, Yang Fan slowly withdrew his thoughts, and his gaze fell toward the Divine Kingdom information panel.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: Omitted
Talents: Omitted
Believers: Core Formation (650 million)... Martial King (490 million)... Third-Class Intelligent Life (980 million)... White Zombie (420 million)...
Occupations: Alchemist (6.5 billion), Blacksmith (21.3 billion), Talisman Master (3.7 billion), Formation Master (3.2 billion)...
Dependents: Elven Warriors (23.4 billion)
Techniques: Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array (B-Grade, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-Grade, Major Achievement), Corpse Tide Frenzied Dance (C-Grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 343 trillion (Reality provides 445 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Fountain of Life x5 million, War God Codex (S-Rank Building), Heavenly Court (S-Rank Building), Goddess of Wisdom (S-Rank Building), Eternal Corpse Mine (S-Rank Building), World Tree (S-Rank Building), Great Void Warship x50 (S-Rank Building), Mechanical War Puppet x80 (S-Rank Building), God-Slaying Tower x40 (S-Rank Building), Immortal Army Soul Stele x40 (S-Rank Building), flesh disaster hive x30 (S-Rank Building), ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary x10 (S-Rank Building), Nine Nether River x10 (S-Rank Building), Life Essence Conversion Pool x2 (S-Rank Building), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x124,000 (S-Rank Building), enlightenment ancient tree x125,000 (S-Rank Building), Alchemy Tower x600,000 (B-Grade), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x500,000 (B-Grade), immortal nurturing tower x500,000 (B-Grade), Special Life Building elf holy tree (one million years, nurturing Elven Warriors) x10, Special Building Enlightenment Stone x10 million, B-Grade Defense Building City-Annihilating Cannon x100,000, B-Grade Defense Building f3500 fighter jet x1 million, nine profound ice tower x1 million, C-Grade City of Technology x100...
Wonders: Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1 million (deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x1 million

Assets: Spirit Plant Star x60, Mineral Vein Star x60, Third-Class Smart Weapon x6.5 billion, Second-Class Smart Weapon x30 billion, Mechanical Heart x5.1 million, cloning nutrient pod x200 billion, ordinary zombies (x2.8 trillion), Robot Soldiers (x10 million), Super Alloy Robot Warrior (x100,000), Earth Heart Milk (), enlightenment tea (), Spirit Stone (), various Medicinal Pill (), various herbs and Spirit Plant (), B-grade weapon ()”
Two months of real time passed.
The number of high-tier believers in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had more than doubled on the original basis.
As the living space was completely released, population growth also entered an explosive period.
Now the total population inside the Divine Kingdom had broken through 200 billion.
But this was still far from the limit.
Throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, there were still large areas of undeveloped regions.
Under Yang Yi’s dispatch, a large number of City of Technology were continuously deployed to the middle region.
At the same time, the Divine Kingdom promulgated encouragement policies.
Settlement subsidies, resource subsidies, and migration rewards were promoted simultaneously.
More and more believers began to migrate outward and spread.
The settlement belts originally concentrated in the core area had now extended outward.
Sixty to seventy percent of the Divine Kingdom’s area had truly been incorporated into the lives of believers.
At the level of the Dark Web.
Aside from continuously purchasing war-type S-Rank Building, Yang Da...
As long as he encountered S-Rank Building adapted to the Divine Kingdom System, he would also directly participate in the bidding.
For instance, newly added S-Rank Building like the ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary, Nine Nether River, and Life Essence Conversion Pool were all purchased through the Dark Web.
As for B-grade and C-grade buildings, due to spatial turbulence...
Yang Da controlled robots to directly purchase them from various shops on the The Frontline.
Although the cost was slightly higher, for the current Yang Fan, careful budgeting was no longer necessary.
Meanwhile, with the crazy expansion of the believer scale,
the Divine Kingdom’s defense System was also comprehensively upgraded under the overall planning of Intelligent Life.
Starting from the Divine Kingdom Core all the way to the peripheral areas,
every newly deployed City of Technology had its city walls equipped with a systematic array of City-Annihilating Cannons.
High altitudes were permanently stationed with f3500 fighter jet formations.
The ground and low-altitude areas formed a grid-like patrol System managed by Patrol Robots.
As believers constantly migrated to the periphery,
whether it was the living environment, daily material supply, or logistics and transportation network, everything underwent proportional expansion simultaneously.
Moreover, the defense System was stretched into a three-dimensional network covering the entire territory.
If foreign enemies attempted to break into the middle region of the Divine Kingdom from the periphery,
a complete defense line System would be triggered almost every tens of kilometers.
Layer by layer, it progressed like a Divine Kingdom barrier forged of steel.
All of this was personally requested by Yang Fan.
Although the overall combat power of the Divine Kingdom had greatly increased nowadays, coupled with the blessing of a large number of s-class war structures,
it was almost impossible for deities of the same level to invade his Divine Kingdom.
But Yang Fan never believed in “almost”.
Any risk, as long as it existed, was worth erasing in advance.
Moreover, what he lacked the least right now were Divinity Points.
Rather than calling these defense Systems war preparations, it was better to call them an “insurance System”.
Even if they would never be activated, they must exist.
As for the f3500 fighter jets, under non-wartime states, they also undertook cross-regional material transportation tasks.
The efficiency was extremely high, which could be considered making the best use of everything.

At this moment, Yang Fan slowly withdrew his thoughts, and his gaze fell toward the Divine Kingdom information panel.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: Omitted
Talents: Omitted
Believers: Core Formation (650 million)...
Martial King (490 million)...
Third-Class Intelligent Life (980 million)...
White Zombie (420 million)...
Occupations: Alchemist (6.5 billion), Blacksmith (21.3 billion), Talisman Master (3.7 billion), Formation Master (3.2 billion)...
Dependents: Elven Warriors (23.4 billion)
Techniques: Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array (B-Grade, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-Grade, Major Achievement), Corpse Tide Frenzied Dance (C-Grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 343 trillion (Reality provides 445 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Fountain of Life x5 million, War God Codex (S-Rank Building), Heavenly Court (S-Rank Building), Goddess of Wisdom (S-Rank Building), Eternal Corpse Mine (S-Rank Building), World Tree (S-Rank Building), Great Void Warship x50 (S-Rank Building), Mechanical War Puppet x80 (S-Rank Building), God-Slaying Tower x40 (S-Rank Building), Immortal Army Soul Stele x40 (S-Rank Building), flesh disaster hive x30 (S-Rank Building), ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary x10 (S-Rank Building), Nine Nether River x10 (S-Rank Building), Life Essence Conversion Pool x2 (S-Rank Building), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x124,000 (S-Rank Building), enlightenment ancient tree x125,000 (S-Rank Building), Alchemy Tower x600,000 (B-Grade), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x500,000 (B-Grade), immortal nurturing tower x500,000 (B-Grade), Special Life Building elf holy tree (one million years, nurturing Elven Warriors) x10, Special Building Enlightenment Stone x10 million, B-Grade Defense Building City-Annihilating Cannon x100,000, B-Grade Defense Building f3500 fighter jet x1 million, nine profound ice tower x1 million, C-Grade City of Technology x100...
Wonders: Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1 million (deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x1 million

Assets: Spirit Plant Star x60, Mineral Vein Star x60, Third-Class Smart Weapon x6.5 billion, Second-Class Smart Weapon x30 billion, Mechanical Heart x5.1 million, cloning nutrient pod x200 billion, ordinary zombies (x2.8 trillion), Robot Soldiers (x10 million), Super Alloy Robot Warrior (x100,000), Earth Heart Milk (), enlightenment tea (), Spirit Stone (), various Medicinal Pill (), various herbs and Spirit Plant (), B-grade weapon ()”
Two months of real time passed.
The number of high-tier believers in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had more than doubled on the original basis.
As the living space was completely released, population growth also entered an explosive period.
Now the total population inside the Divine Kingdom had broken through 200 billion.
But this was still far from the limit.
Throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, there were still large areas of undeveloped regions.
Under Yang Yi’s dispatch, a large number of City of Technology were continuously deployed to the middle region.
At the same time, the Divine Kingdom promulgated encouragement policies.
Settlement subsidies, resource subsidies, and migration rewards were promoted simultaneously.
More and more believers began to migrate outward and spread.
The settlement belts originally concentrated in the core area had now extended outward.
Sixty to seventy percent of the Divine Kingdom’s area had truly been incorporated into the lives of believers.
At the level of the Dark Web.
Aside from continuously purchasing war-type S-Rank Building, Yang Da...
As long as he encountered S-Rank Building adapted to the Divine Kingdom System, he would also directly participate in the bidding.
For instance, newly added S-Rank Building like the ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary, Nine Nether River, and Life Essence Conversion Pool were all purchased through the Dark Web.
As for B-grade and C-grade buildings, due to spatial turbulence...
Yang Da controlled robots to directly purchase them from various shops on the The Frontline.
Although the cost was slightly higher, for the current Yang Fan, careful budgeting was no longer necessary.
Meanwhile, with the crazy expansion of the believer scale,
the Divine Kingdom’s defense System was also comprehensively upgraded under the overall planning of Intelligent Life.
Starting from the Divine Kingdom Core all the way to the peripheral areas,
every newly deployed City of Technology had its city walls equipped with a systematic array of City-Annihilating Cannons.
High altitudes were permanently stationed with f3500 fighter jet formations.
The ground and low-altitude areas formed a grid-like patrol System managed by Patrol Robots.
As believers constantly migrated to the periphery,
whether it was the living environment, daily material supply, or logistics and transportation network, everything underwent proportional expansion simultaneously.
Moreover, the defense System was stretched into a three-dimensional network covering the entire territory.
If foreign enemies attempted to break into the middle region of the Divine Kingdom from the periphery,
a complete defense line System would be triggered almost every tens of kilometers.
Layer by layer, it progressed like a Divine Kingdom barrier forged of steel.
All of this was personally requested by Yang Fan.
Although the overall combat power of the Divine Kingdom had greatly increased nowadays, coupled with the blessing of a large number of s-class war structures,
it was almost impossible for deities of the same level to invade his Divine Kingdom.
But Yang Fan never believed in “almost”.
Any risk, as long as it existed, was worth erasing in advance.
Moreover, what he lacked the least right now were Divinity Points.
Rather than calling these defense Systems war preparations, it was better to call them an “insurance System”.
Even if they would never be activated, they must exist.
As for the f3500 fighter jets, under non-wartime states, they also undertook cross-regional material transportation tasks.
The efficiency was extremely high, which could be considered making the best use of everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Greetings, Chairman
paragraphs: Even with such frantic expansion and consumption, coupled with the one hundred trillion Divinity Points previously given to Ma Yu...
Two months later, the working capital of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom not only did not decrease, but continued to grow.
This was still without him completely selling resources such as Earth Heart Milk and Enlightenment Tea.
Now within the Divine Kingdom, resources such as Spirit Stone, Earth Heart Milk, and Enlightenment Tea had accumulated to a quite massive scale.
Among them, White Zombie believers and Intelligent Life could not completely consume such resource supplies.
Relying solely on the Immortal Cultivation and Martial Arts Systems could not keep up with the speed of resource output by a long shot.
One must know that there were simply too many resource-type buildings purchased in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Forming a rare phenomenon:
Even if the believers’ investments were maxed out, a continuous accumulation was still forming between output and consumption.
Resource reserves continued to rise.
However, Yang Fan was not worried.
He had long found a new outlet for these resources.
That was—the company that Ma Yu was about to establish.
Selling resources on a large scale in the Divine Shop through personal channels made the target too conspicuous.

With a monthly transaction volume close to one hundred trillion Divinity Points in liquidity, once he continued to ramp it up, even if he was a “Peerless Prodigy” and possessed the highest-level information protection of the federal supreme intelligent life, it would inevitably attract the attention of certain existences.
But a company was different.
A company was a legal transit institution.
It could conduct multi-level material procurement and resale through real-world channels, network platforms, and cross-enterprise transaction networks.
During this process, it also needed to pay various taxes to the Federal Government.
Corporate income tax, transaction turnover tax, resource value-added tax, cross-domain transportation tax, environmental governance tax...
As well as various nominal “compliance costs”.
On the surface, this was a standardized commercial System.
But in the deeper logic, these so-called taxes were essentially just “pass tokens” to enter the rule System.
As long as enough “protection costs” were paid according to the rules, transactions would be legalized, standardized, and even systematically ignored for risk review.
Rules made the world run more efficiently and made the flow of wealth smoother.
But the essence of wealth had never changed.
It still followed the most primitive logic—big fish eat small fish, small fish eat shrimp.
Small companies squeezed employees to gain profits.
Large companies delayed payments and compressed costs to squeeze the supply chain.
And the Federal Government “reasonably” robbed the profits of large companies through institutional, taxation, and rule design.
This was not a conspiracy, but the way order itself operated.
Yang Fan suddenly remembered that he had once browsed an economics work in the Primordial City Library.
One sentence in it left a deep impression on him:
“Every grain of spiritual rice you buy for your believers, under tax preferences, still has about thirty percent of the cost flowing into the Federal Government.”
“For every weapon you equip your legion with, the actual tax burden can reach over fifty percent.”
“As a god, you should skillfully use high-level legal Intelligent Life to reasonably plan your tax structure.”
“Only in this way can your Divine Kingdom, company, and assets avoid being diluted by the rules to the maximum extent.”
“The strong optimize rules, the weak obey rules.”
“Paying taxes is the obligation of ordinary citizens, while the strong have more choices.”
These contents were not written obscurely, but were placed for a long time in the most inconspicuous corner of the Primordial City Library.
Almost no one browsed them.
Meanwhile, whether it was libraries, academies, or roadside bookstores,
the best-selling and most conspicuously placed books were often another type—
“Federal Citizen Tax and Responsibility Guide”
“Divine Kingdom Civilization Compliance Operation Manual”
“Starting from Scratch as a Law-Abiding God”
“How to Become an Excellent Federal Taxpayer”
Seeming orthodox, they were actually more like a gentle guidance of order.
The weak could only submit to the rules, struggling to arrange for believers to farm and mine in exchange for meager survival resources.
Exchanging for a cramped room of fifty or sixty square meters in the real world.
While the strong sought gaps within the rules, or even utilized the rules themselves.
However, these cognitions were heavy enough for ordinary people.
And for Yang Fan, there was not much need for deep research.
What he truly needed to do currently was just build a new sales System.

Turn the overflowing Spirit Stone, Earth Heart Milk, Enlightenment Tea, and other resources in the Divine Kingdom into Divinity Points in reality, and then use this to leverage influence in the real world.
Even looking across the entire world, existences capable of having resource-type buildings of such scale like him were extremely rare.
Even some Mid-tier Gods were far from able to achieve this level of resource output.
A clear prototype had gradually formed in his heart.
The established company did not source externally; all sources of goods came entirely from his own Divine Kingdom.
And the company itself only served high-net-worth divine groups.
The lowest-tier sales resource was Spirit Stone.
As for resources like Earth Heart Milk and Enlightenment Tea... they inherently belonged to scarce luxury goods.
Every time they were listed in the Divine Shop, they would be snatched up instantly.
Thinking of this, a rare trace of interest appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Ma Yu’s side... should be finishing soon.”
“With sufficient funds, one month should be enough for him to complete the share acquisition.”
Just as Yang Fan was about to ask Ma Yu about the acquisition progress, a Feixun message suddenly popped up.
Without hesitation, he directly put on the virtual helmet.
Consciousness instantly entered the Virtual World—Xiling Planet.
Inside the conference room.
Space slightly shook.
Yang Fan’s figure slowly condensed.
“Your subordinate greets the boss.”
Ma Yu saluted respectfully at the first instance.
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “How did things go?”
His tone was calm, without any superfluous emotions.
Ma Yu immediately reported:
“Reporting to the boss.”
“Through the exchange and off-market agreement acquisitions, about fifty percent of the shares were recovered.”
“The remaining part is scattered in the hands of some old friends.”
“To complete the mission as soon as possible, I specifically took a space spaceship to travel to multiple galaxies to meet and communicate with them one by one.”
Speaking of this, he paused.
“Fortunately, Elephant Loan itself is a financial company with no core technology, coupled with my proposed 20% premium acquisition, they didn’t have much suspicion.”
“They all readily agreed to the transfer.”
As his words fell, Ma Yu waved his right hand gently.
Buzz—
A huge electronic panel unfolded in front of Yang Fan.
Densely recorded on it were: company share transfer agreements, latest equity structure adjustment plans, company governance reorganization details, and all current asset details.
The complexity of the content amounted to thousands of pages.
However, with Yang Fan’s current mental strength, reading this amount of data was a piece of cake.
His gaze flickered slightly, and the data before his eyes began to turn pages rapidly.
One page, ten pages, a hundred pages...
Finally staying on the final confirmation interface.
Yang Fan raised his hand and tapped gently.
“Confirm.”
Almost at the same time, Ma Yu bowed again, his expression even more respectful.
“Ma Yu greets the Chairman.”

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Establishment of Yang Corporation
paragraphs: Yang Fan casually waved his hand.
“There is no need for these titles.”
“Just keep calling me Boss.”
“Right now, besides those two little fellows Cheng Rou and Chengye, the company’s shareholders are just the two of us.”
His tone was calm.
“You are temporarily appointed as the General Manager.”
“You will be solely responsible for all operational affairs of the company.”
“Yes, Boss.”
Ma Yu immediately replied.
However, he hesitated for a moment before speaking,
“Boss, there is something I would like to report and ask for instructions on.”
“When I originally founded Elephant Loan, it was meant to serve large enterprises.”
“It’s just that later, limited by strength and Resources, I could only pivot to loan services for small and medium-sized enterprises and low-Rank demigods.”
“Now that the company is reorganized, do I need to rename it?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan fell into a brief contemplation.
After a moment, he slowly spoke,
“The company name?”
“I seem to have named up to ‘Yang Eleven’, how about we call this company... Yang Twelve Corporation?”
As he spoke, he nodded thoughtfully.
As if this were a well-thought-out decision.
The air fell briefly silent for a second.
“Yang... Twelve?” The corners of Ma Yu’s mouth twitched slightly.
He raised a hand to scratch his head, his gaze looking at Yang Fan somewhat complicatedly.
This name... how should he put it?
It had an extremely casual and disjointed feeling.
A capital behemoth that casually threw out trillions of Divinity Points.
Yet the company name sounded like a random serial number?
Ma Yu was somewhat speechless.
Tens of thousands of years ago when he had just founded Elephant Loan, he tossed and turned for over a whole month, repeatedly agonizing over the company name.

Back then, full of confidence about cooperating with powerful listed companies to provide them with financial services, he and his partners had chosen for a long time before settling on the name Elephant Loan!
Back then, he treated every single detail with utmost solemnity.
Thinking of this, he suddenly felt a strong sense of disjointedness.
His own boss seemed a bit too “casual”.
He couldn’t help but add another sentence,
“Um... Boss.”
“Actually, when it comes to naming a company, Intelligent Life is more professional.”
“How about letting the intelligent System of your Divine Kingdom assist with this?”
“The name Yang Twelve Corporation... really is a bit...”
Yang Twelve Corporation, no matter how one listened to it, felt weird!
Ma Yu felt that if he became the General Manager of this corporation in the future, when meeting old friends and reporting his identity, he would be too embarrassed to speak up.
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “That makes sense.”
He raised his hand and commanded, “Yang Da, project your consciousness into the Virtual World.”
Along with Yang Fan’s command falling,
the next moment, a stream of data followed the Divine Kingdom coordinates and instantly descended into the Virtual World.
Lights gathered, and Yang Da’s figure slowly condensed into existence.
“Master.”
Yang Da respectfully bowed.
As an extension of Yang Fan’s will, it had long since synchronously known the contents of the conversation between the two just now, so naturally, no further explanation was needed.
Yang Fan asked directly, “What do you think is a suitable name for the company?”
Data streams flashed rapidly in Yang Da’s eyes.
After a moment, it answered earnestly,
“Reporting to Master, although Yang Twelve Corporation is not bad,”
“yet Master seems to have overlooked one thing.”
“Now that you have achieved a Breakthrough to a God, the scale of your Divine Kingdom will continue to expand.”
“In the future, if a Divine Kingdom War breaks out with an Alien God, relying solely on the computing power of Yang Four and the others might make it difficult to meet the demands of war.”
“Therefore, this subordinate suggests reserving numbers in advance.”
“The company can be named——Yang One Hundred Corporation.”
“That way, there will be enough numbers in the future to continue naming Intelligent Life.”
“???” Ma Yu on the side was completely dumbfounded.
He looked at Yang Fan, then looked at Yang Da who was analyzing with a straight face.
His mind went completely blank.
What kind of... Intelligent Life is this anyway?
This naming talent... isn’t it a bit too outrageous?
Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully, then turned his head to look at Ma Yu.
“What do you think?”
Ma Yu gave a light cough, barely squeezing out a smile on his face.
“Boss.”
“This subordinate thinks... it’s better to just call it Yang Corporation.”
“Simple, clear, and convenient for spreading.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes instantly lit up, “Not bad! As expected of someone who has been a big boss.”
“Let’s go with your idea; from now on it will be called Yang Corporation.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu finally breathed a secret sigh of relief.
Fortunately, he managed to pull the company name back.
In the Human Federation, there are countless group corporations.
Among them, enterprises named after their founders’ surnames are naturally countless.
Although Yang Corporation cannot be considered stunning, it is grand enough and formal enough.
At least... when meeting old friends in the future,
he could finally openly and generously say, “I am currently employed at Yang Corporation.”
without worrying about others pressing him with, “What on earth is Yang One Hundred Corporation?”
“Boss.”
Ma Yu reined in his thoughts and reported earnestly,
“The company has completed its federal registration and certification anew, and just now I submitted the new company name for review.”
“It is expected to complete the change within a day.”
“In addition, I will organize the specific plans for the investment sector and sales sector as soon as possible and submit them to you for approval.”
“Very well.” Yang Fan nodded lightly.
Afterward, his consciousness exited the Virtual World and returned to reality.
Just at this moment, Yang Da’s voice sounded in his ear once again, “Master.”
With a thought from Yang Fan, his consciousness descended into the Divine Kingdom once more.
Inside the grand hall, Yang Da and Ling Xuzi had been waiting for a long time.
“Master, those three Subordinate Gods have all completed the Divine Kingdom War and all won.”
“They have already sent messages waiting for Master to arrange the reclamation work.”
Hearing this, a trace of faint disappointment instead flashed across the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
Three... actually all won.
He originally thought that this time he could capture a Human Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core to try something fresh.
In the end, it turned out to be three Alien Divine Kingdom Cores again.
These Alien Demigods... couldn’t take a beating at all.
Sensing the emotional change in Yang Fan’s eyes,
Yang Da immediately explained,
“Master, this time the Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates were all screened by Intelligent Life on The Frontline.”
“The intelligence System of The Frontline is extremely comprehensive, having detailed ratings on the overall strength of Alien Demigods.”
“Therefore, as the actively invading party, the overall win rate of Human Demigods is naturally around seventy percent.”
“In addition, because Master distributed a large amount of Divinity Points in advance,”
“they were able to purchase war supplies in advance, further increasing their probability of winning.”
After hearing this explanation, Yang Fan finally understood.
To attract more demigods to join the proxy war, he had Li Tianheng offer prices higher than the market rate, and settled all Divinity Points in a single lump sum.
After getting the Resources, these demigods purchasing more war supplies in advance and enhancing their Divine Kingdom’s strength was naturally the most rational choice.
As a result, the win rate naturally increased accordingly.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan looked at Yang Da and directly commanded:
“Arrange for the Otherworldly Collector to immediately enter the three Alien Divine Kingdoms to begin reclamation.”
“All C-Rank and below buildings, as well as ordinary Spirit Plant Resources, are all rewarded to the corresponding Subordinate Gods.”
“All other high-Rank buildings, rare Resources, and Divine Kingdom Cores are to be transported back to the Divine Kingdom.”
