“Boss.”
“This subordinate thinks... it’s better to just call it Yang Corporation.”
“Simple, clear, and convenient for spreading.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes instantly lit up, “Not bad!
As expected of someone who has been a big boss.”
“Let’s go with your idea; from now on it will be called Yang Corporation.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu finally breathed a secret sigh of relief.
Fortunately, he managed to pull the company name back.
In the Human Federation, there are countless group corporations.
Among them, enterprises named after their founders’ surnames are naturally countless.
Although Yang Corporation cannot be considered stunning, it is grand enough and formal enough.
At least... when meeting old friends in the future,
he could finally openly and generously say, “I am currently employed at Yang Corporation.”
without worrying about others pressing him with, “What on earth is Yang One Hundred Corporation?”
“Boss.”
Ma Yu reined in his thoughts and reported earnestly,
“The company has completed its federal registration and certification anew, and just now I submitted the new company name for review.”
“It is expected to complete the change within a day.”
“In addition, I will organize the specific plans for the investment sector and sales sector as soon as possible and submit them to you for approval.”
“Very well.” Yang Fan nodded lightly.
Afterward, his consciousness exited the Virtual World and returned to reality.
Just at this moment, Yang Da’s voice sounded in his ear once again, “Master.”
With a thought from Yang Fan, his consciousness descended into the Divine Kingdom once more.
Inside the grand hall, Yang Da and Ling Xuzi had been waiting for a long time.
“Master, those three Subordinate Gods have all completed the Divine Kingdom War and all won.”
“They have already sent messages waiting for Master to arrange the reclamation work.”
Hearing this, a trace of faint disappointment instead flashed across the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
Three... actually all won.
He originally thought that this time he could capture a Human Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core to try something fresh.
In the end, it turned out to be three Alien Divine Kingdom Cores again.
These Alien Demigods... couldn’t take a beating at all.
Sensing the emotional change in Yang Fan’s eyes,
Yang Da immediately explained,
“Master, this time the Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates were all screened by Intelligent Life on The Frontline.”
“The intelligence System of The Frontline is extremely comprehensive, having detailed ratings on the overall strength of Alien Demigods.”
“Therefore, as the actively invading party, the overall win rate of Human Demigods is naturally around seventy percent.”
“In addition, because Master distributed a large amount of Divinity Points in advance,”
“they were able to purchase war supplies in advance, further increasing their probability of winning.”
After hearing this explanation, Yang Fan finally understood.
To attract more demigods to join the proxy war, he had Li Tianheng offer prices higher than the market rate, and settled all Divinity Points in a single lump sum.
After getting the Resources, these demigods purchasing more war supplies in advance and enhancing their Divine Kingdom’s strength was naturally the most rational choice.
As a result, the win rate naturally increased accordingly.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan looked at Yang Da and directly commanded:
“Arrange for the Otherworldly Collector to immediately enter the three Alien Divine Kingdoms to begin reclamation.”
“All C-Rank and below buildings, as well as ordinary Spirit Plant Resources, are all rewarded to the corresponding Subordinate Gods.”
“All other high-Rank buildings, rare Resources, and Divine Kingdom Cores are to be transported back to the Divine Kingdom.”

chapters.title: Chapter 337: A Gentleman Judges by Deeds, Not Intentions
paragraphs: According to the regulations of the Subordinate God Contract,
after the proxy war ended, all the spoils of war within the Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom naturally belonged to the Main God.
Therefore, after the war ended, those three Subordinate Gods did not handle any Resources without authorization, but instead notified Yang Fan at the first opportunity.
Now, Yang Fan was willing to reward them with buildings below C-rank and ordinary Spirit Plants, which could already be considered extremely generous.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully accepted the order.
The next moment, a mighty army of Otherworldly Collectors set out from Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
These Otherworldly Collectors had almost no combat capabilities whatsoever.
The significance of their existence was gathering, transporting, and land-clearing.
Numbering over a hundred million, the Otherworldly Collectors, like a torrent of steel, entered the Divine Kingdoms of the three Subordinate Gods one after another.
Afterwards, using their Divine Kingdoms as spatial trampolines, they descended upon those three Alien Demigod Divine Kingdoms.
A large-scale land-clearing officially began.
Meanwhile.
The consciousnesses of the three Subordinate Gods remained within their own Divine Kingdoms.
Gazing at the dense, almost endless Otherworldly Collectors, they couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva.
“Th-This... Are these the Otherworldly Collectors specifically responsible for land-clearing?”
“There are actually over a hundred million of them!”
One of them was filled with shock, “This Lord God is simply too wealthy!”
Another person’s eyes even revealed a look of envy.
“Such strength, such foundation.”
“Once this contract ends, I wonder if there will still be a chance to continue signing a Subordinate God Contract.”
For a moment, the same thought arose in the hearts of all three.
Being able to follow such a Main God...
It seemed... pretty good too.
Real World.
Yang Fan sent a Feixun message to Li Tianheng.
[From now on, recruit Subordinate Gods at market prices, and still pay out Divinity Points in advance all at once.]

[However, a new contract reward can be added: after winning a Divine Kingdom War, Resources of C-rank and below in the Alien Divine Kingdom will be disposed of by the Subordinate God at their own discretion.]
As soon as the message was sent, Li Tianheng replied immediately, “Understood!”
Looking at the new arrangement, Li Tianheng couldn’t help but reveal a smile.
He had long felt that the treatment Yang Fan previously offered was simply too high.
Now that it had been adjusted, it finally looked much more pleasing to the eye.
In fact, Yang Fan’s large-scale recruitment of proxies was not just for the Alien Divine Kingdom Core and finding the Divine Kingdom coordinates of Alien Gods.
Besides that, the Divine Kingdom Cores of these proxies themselves were also a part of Yang Fan’s layout.
He was not a babysitter, naturally he would not support these unrelated people.
Therefore, he would constantly adjust the contract content based on actual circumstances.
Now he needed to increase the win rate of the Alien Demigods a bit.
In this way, it aligned better with Yang Fan’s own interests.
Furthermore, in Yang Fan’s view, all of this was within the scope permitted by Federation rules.
It was both legal and compliant.
And in the eyes of those demigods, Yang Fan was still a good Main God who was generous with his spending and paid rewards in advance.
As the saying goes, a gentleman judges by deeds, not by intentions.
At least from the perspective of the results, even if it returned to market prices,
due to paying Divinity Points in advance, the overall win rate of those demigods participating in the Divine Kingdom War would still be higher than other gods’ Subordinate God Contracts.
Yang Fan believed that as the first batch of Subordinate Gods spread the news out,
even if the price was lowered, there would still be quite a few demigods with decent talent who would actively come to sign contracts.
What he needed was not treatment far above the market.
As long as it was slightly higher than other gods, that was already enough.
This way, he could continuously obtain Divine Kingdom Cores without interruption.
And it wouldn’t cause other gods to dislike him due to overly outrageous treatment.
Three more days passed in the Real World.
On this day, Ma Yu sent three more documents over.
The first was regarding the planning of Yang Corporation’s future investment directions.
Among them, the commercial investment portion would be entirely handed over to Intelligent Life to be responsible for.
Considering the future development potential of Xiling Planet,
Ma Yu suggested taking Xiling Planet as the core to gradually invest in enterprises on surrounding living planets, while simultaneously acquiring resource stars in the Real World.
As for technological research and development, it would be uniformly laid out on Xiling Planet.
Because the company’s funds were currently extremely abundant, Ma Yu suggested investing ten trillion Divinity Points first in the initial stage.
Yang Fan just glanced at it and directly signed his approval.
The second document was the talent reserve plan.
Although Elephant Loan had already been delisted,

but relying on its status as a former listed company, it still maintained a fixed office spot of about thirty square meters in Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy to this day, allowing it to carry out talent investment business at any time.

However, Ma Yu still specially made a note: [The students able to enter these two top academies are all arrogant people. Now that Yang Corporation has just been delisted, its brand influence has already declined to some extent.]
[If we want to sign these Geniuses, the price we need to pay will likely be higher than before, and it might not be cost-effective.]
As for the third document, it was the preparation plan for the sales department.
The content of the document was not complicated; it was more of a market research report.
It clearly pointed out that Spirit Stones, Earth Heart Milk, and enlightenment tea were the most stable hard currency in the Federation.
Especially Earth Heart Milk and enlightenment tea; because they had to rely on S-rank resource-type buildings to be produced, the market was always in a state where demand exceeded supply.
And the massive commercial channels accumulated by Elephant Loan in the past could still continue to be used today.
As long as the supply of goods was sufficient, whether online transactions or offline cooperation, sales channels could be quickly opened up.
Even some long-term cooperative major clients preferred offline transactions to further reduce transaction costs and evade taxes.
Apart from that document on talent investment,
in the other two documents, Ma Yu not only listed detailed investment directions but also formulated complete implementation plans and staged goals.
From fund allocation and project approval to risk assessment and personnel arrangement, everything was planned in an orderly manner.
Yang Fan just briefly browsed through it once, and couldn’t help nodding gently.
Ma Yu truly lived up to being a boss who once managed a listed company.
This capability was indeed beyond doubt.
The next moment, Yang Fan put on the virtual helmet, and his consciousness re-entered the Virtual World.
Xiling Planet.
With the official establishment of Yang Corporation, various constructions had long been completed.
And Xiling Planet in the Real World also welcomed its first commercial landmark.
A skyscraper thousands of meters high pierced straight into the clouds.

The entire building was forged entirely from silver-white metal, its surface flowing with a faint data stream of light, and the four large characters “Yang Corporation” at the top slowly emitted a soft glow.
With a sweep of Yang Fan’s Mental Energy, the scene of the entire corporate headquarters came into full view.
Inside the office lobby, a large number of staff members were shuttling back and forth quickly.
One floating light screen after another constantly unfolded and closed.
[Contract uploaded, please confirm permissions.]
[Cross-Star Domain transaction application has passed review.]
[Resource star acquisition plan has been synchronized to the intelligent hub.]
[The Federation Industry and Commerce System is verifying enterprise information...]
[The seventh financial intelligence has completed today’s tax calculations.]
One intelligent prompt tone after another rose and fell, and countless data streams intertwined and flickered in mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Embryonic Form of a Business Empire
paragraphs: The entire group headquarters resembled a high-speed data hub.
In fact, the vast majority of the staff here were not actually on Xiling Planet.
They were distributed across various planets of the Human Federation.
They merely used the Virtual World to project their consciousness and work at the Yang Corporation headquarters.
This was also the greatest advantage of the Virtual World.
Even separated by countless light-years, they could still collaborate as if they were right there in person.
Now, the Yang Corporation had just been established.
Various approval processes, government filings, departmental coordination, corporate Aptitude changes, and countless financial statements all needed to be re-established.
The employees left behind by Elephant Loan had been running around busily off their feet during this period.
Fortunately, the company currently had abundant funds.
Within his authority, Ma Yu also issued an additional two months of bonuses to all employees.
After the bonuses arrived in their accounts, the work efficiency of the entire company was actually a bit higher than before.
Yang Fan’s thoughts stirred slightly.
The next moment, his figure directly appeared at the top floor of the Yang Corporation.
Inside the spacious chairman’s office, Ma Yu had been waiting for a long time.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, he immediately stood up and saluted, “Your subordinate greets the boss.”
Yang Fan nodded gently.
“I have already read your report.”
“I agree with the Early Stage investment plan.”
“However...”
Yang Fan’s tone shifted.
“You can be a bit bolder with the investment amount.”
“Later, after returning to reality, I will inject another one hundred trillion Divinity Points into the Yang Corporation.”
“That will be enough for you to let loose and go all out.”
As soon as his voice fell, Ma Yu was completely stunned.
“Another... one hundred trillion?”
He felt his head spinning slightly.
This was one hundred trillion Divinity Points!
Even looking across the entire Federation, the annual net profit of those behemoth listed companies with market values in the tens of millions of trillions might not even reach this figure.
Yet when it came to his own boss...
Such a massive sum of money was decided as casually as a temporary thought.
“Is... this really normal?”
The more Ma Yu thought about it, the more outrageous it felt.
How long had it been since the boss’s Breakthrough to a god?
Where did such a terrifying cash flow come from?
Could it be that... that High-Order God from the Gu Family directly handed over all of their divine kingdom’s liquid funds to the boss?
But... was there really such a father-in-law?
Ma Yu secretly swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
Then he said with a trembling voice:
“Boss, naturally, the more funds the better.”
“It’s just that the scale of industries around Xiling Planet is currently limited.”
“In a short period of time, it’s simply impossible to digest such a massive amount of funds.”
“If we want to fully realize the value of these funds, we can only continuously acquire shares of other companies through the capital market, or even control more enterprises.”
“Otherwise, leaving such a massive sum of money in the company accounts for a long time would be a terrible waste.”
Yang Fan only smiled faintly.
“No matter, how to spend the money is your business.”
“What I want to see is only one result.”
“Make the Yang Corporation grow rapidly at the fastest speed.”
As he spoke, he slowly walked to the floor-to-ceiling window, overlooking the bustling Xiling Planet beneath his feet.
“Influencing the entire Human Federation—that goal is still too far away right now.”
“However, taking Xiling Planet as the core, I want the Yang Corporation to first have its own right to speak in this Star Domain.”
His voice was calm, yet it exuded an unquestionable firmness.
“Yes, Boss!”
Ma Yu’s expression was solemn, and his body stood straight.
This Fifth-Order God who had once managed a listed company was filled with respect in his eyes at this moment.
Ma Yu had been a major shareholder of a listed company for so many years.
For the first time, he felt an extremely unreal sensation—he had never fought such a wealthy battle before.
In his mind, countless expansion plans emerged almost instantly.
He even began to think about whether to directly carry out premium acquisitions of all living planets around Xiling Planet.
There were no loans, no capital chain pressure, and even risk assessment seemed redundant.
In front of this level of cash flow, any refined strategy seemed overly complicated.
Only the simplest logic was needed: expansion, annexation, acquisition.
Just ‘bigger, bigger, bigger’, ‘merge, merge, merge’, ‘buy, buy, buy’ would do!
He even faintly saw the embryonic form of a business Empire taking shape.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s expression suddenly froze slightly.
“Next, you will be responsible for screening investment targets, covering both Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy.”
“However, the Aptitude ratings shouldn’t be too high nor too low; they should be in the middle tier.”
“In addition, draft a formal investment contract, and I will personally step forward to negotiate.”
“It will ultimately be signed through the Yang Corporation.”
“Understood.” Ma Yu replied almost without hesitation, “I will personally push this forward immediately.”
Yang Fan continued:
“As for the supply of goods for sales, I have already found channels on the The Frontline.”
“Spirit Stones will be shipped at market price, while Earth Heart Milk and Enlightenment Tea will be priced at 1.2 times the market price.”
“If it is difficult to digest in the short term, they can be released in batches without rushing to clear out.”
“The funds for purchasing goods will be provided by me, and all proceeds will uniformly enter the company accounts.”
As soon as his voice fell, Ma Yu’s eyes lit up immediately.
“They’ll sell well! This price is already very conservative.”
“Earth Heart Milk and Enlightenment Tea have extremely strong auxiliary effects on Nascent Soul Stage Cultivation believers, making them hard currency in themselves.”
“Even if we increase the price of such resources by another twenty percent, we won’t have to worry about sales.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help raising his eyebrows; he suddenly felt that listing and trading items directly in the Divine Shop was a bit of a loss.
No wonder every time he put items on shelves, they were snatched up instantly.
After all this, the other party could make a huge profit by casually reselling them!
This couldn’t be blamed on Yang Fan.
Mainly because under the divine kingdom’s thousand-fold returns, making money was too easy for him, and he hadn’t thought about raising prices at all.
Divinity Points were completely just a number to him now, and he couldn’t use them all up anyway.
“There is spatial turbulence on the The Frontline, so arrange an escort team to come over.”
“I will hand the resources over to them.”
“This is the address.”
As he spoke, Yang Fan sent the coordinates directly.
Then, with a thought, he exited the Virtual World.
The next moment, one hundred trillion Divinity Points were directly injected into the Yang Corporation’s account.
Virtual World.
Xiling Planet, Yang Corporation headquarters.
The next second, the entire financial hub suddenly erupted with a piercing alarm.
A red data stream instantly filled the entire light screen.
A financial supervisor rushed into the meeting area fiercely, not even having time to maintain composure, and almost stumbled as he shouted out:
“Gen... General Manager!”
“The company account... has received another one hundred trillion Divinity Points!”
“Did... did the Chairman inject the capital?!”
His voice was trembling, and his whole body was almost unable to stand steady.
As a First-Order God who had served in Elephant Loan for ten thousand years, he had never seen such a terrifying capital flow.
Even during the financial expansion of its absolute Peak years, there had never been this level of instantaneous capital injection.

Mainly because under the divine kingdom’s thousand-fold returns, making money was too easy for him, and he hadn’t thought about raising prices at all.
Divinity Points were completely just a number to him now, and he couldn’t use them all up anyway.
“There is spatial turbulence on the The Frontline, so arrange an escort team to come over.”
“I will hand the resources over to them.”
“This is the address.”
As he spoke, Yang Fan sent the coordinates directly.
Then, with a thought, he exited the Virtual World.
The next moment, one hundred trillion Divinity Points were directly injected into the Yang Corporation’s account.
Virtual World.
Xiling Planet, Yang Corporation headquarters.
The next second, the entire financial hub suddenly erupted with a piercing alarm.
A red data stream instantly filled the entire light screen.
A financial supervisor rushed into the meeting area fiercely, not even having time to maintain composure, and almost stumbled as he shouted out:
“Gen...
General Manager!”
“The company account... has received another one hundred trillion Divinity Points!”
“Did... did the Chairman inject the capital?!”
His voice was trembling, and his whole body was almost unable to stand steady.
As a First-Order God who had served in Elephant Loan for ten thousand years, he had never seen such a terrifying capital flow.
Even during the financial expansion of its absolute Peak years, there had never been this level of instantaneous capital injection.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Visitors from Xiling Planet
paragraphs: After delisting, Elephant Loan was having a life that was simply too good!
He even faintly felt a trace of absurd regret: ‘Did I make a mistake by selling my company’s shares through the market?’
But after thinking about it a moment later, he felt no regret.
If they minor shareholders hadn’t sold the company, Chairman Yang might not have injected capital.
Inside the office, Ma Yu took a deep breath and quickly regained his composure.
He was neither excited nor out of line; he just slowly spoke:
“Notify all employees.”
“There will be no leave for the entire year.”
“However, the year-end bonus—will be increased tenfold.”
“Everyone get ready to go all out!”
Yang Corporation was managed by Ma Yu.
The interior of the divine kingdom was coordinated by Yang Da.
Nowadays, Yang Fan had fewer and fewer things that genuinely required his personal handling.
Coupled with the backing of the Gu Family, although he held the status of a god in The Frontline Ninth Legion, he was not forcibly assigned tasks for the Divine Kingdom War.
Compared to other gods who bustled about the battlefield all day and walked between life and death,
Yang Fan’s life was peaceful and cozy.
Meanwhile,
as those three Subordinate Gods won a sweeping victory in the Divine Kingdom War, coupled with the fact that Yang Fan subsequently rewarded them with all buildings and Resources below C-rank,
Yang Fan’s reputation quickly spread within the circle of demigods on The Frontline.
For a time, more and more demigods took the initiative to find Li Tianheng.
Hoping to sign a Subordinate God Contract with Yang Fan through him.

Among these people, some possessed war-type talents like Li Tianheng’s that could provide large-scale buffs to believers, some possessed various special Physique-type talents, and quite a few were demigods with resource-type talents who had always been unfavored by gods on The Frontline.
However, according to Yang Fan’s request, as long as the divine kingdom’s talent reached C-rank or above, Li Tianheng would not turn anyone away.
On the other side, Li Tianheng’s own divine kingdom was likewise not idle.
Although to this day he still didn’t know why Yang Fan was so obsessed with invading the divine kingdoms of Alien Demigods.
He still meticulously executed the order.
On the periphery of the divine kingdom, high-tier war-type Intelligent Life constantly commanded robots to transport corpse pills to various Alien Divine Kingdoms, continuing to poison them.
However, today’s Li Tianheng was no longer like before, constantly monitoring every Divine Kingdom War.
With the divine kingdom defense system crafted for him personally by Yang Fan,
nowadays, even if he dispatched robots to simultaneously invade ten Alien Divine Kingdoms at once, he wouldn’t feel the slightest bit timid.
In just a few days,
Li Tianheng arranged for robots to bring twenty Subordinate God Contracts to Yang Fan’s villa.
After a brief check, Yang Fan signed the contracts one by one.
Immediately afterward, through The Frontline Intelligent Life, he applied to match these demigods with Alien Divine Kingdoms.
At the same time,
Ling Xuzi, following the coordinates provided by Yang Da, quietly dispatched believers to enter the divine kingdoms of those Human Demigods, secretly monitoring the progress of each war.
Once any changes occurred, he would report to Yang Da at the first moment.
A few more days passed.
Under Ma Yu’s arrangement, a space spaceship passed through the wormhole and slowly docked at The Frontline port.
As the cabin door opened, a group of people slowly walked out.
If Yang Fan were here, he would definitely recognize the visitors at a glance.
The head of the Luo Family—Luo Hai.
The Luo Family Elder—Luo Chengfeng.
Besides them, his wife, Luo Bing, was nervously gripping Luo Hai’s sleeve at this moment.
Her pretty eyes kept looking around, somewhat nervous.
However, the one truly standing in the center of the crowd was not Luo Hai.
Instead, it was a Divine Being.
The reason for this was because this person was Yang Fan’s father—Yang Tiexin.
The two high-ranking members of the Luo Family, Luo Hai and Luo Chengfeng, stood respectively on the left and right sides instead, faintly carrying a sense of accompaniment.
Yang Tiexin’s nervousness at this moment was no less than Luo Bing’s.
This place was completely different from a living planet.
Looking as far as the eye could see, there were demigods and gods everywhere.
Even though these powerhouses did not intentionally release their might,
just the oppression naturally existing between life levels made Yang Tiexin’s heart panic for a while.
He even felt his legs going a bit soft.
Right at this moment, an First-Order God from the Luo Family was quick-witted and quick-handed, gently supporting him.
“Big Brother Yang, after your Breakthrough to a demigod, you will also have to come to The Frontline to serve for ten years; this is a regulation of the Federation.”
“However, rest assured, this place belongs to the hinterland of The Frontline, and it is very safe.”
“Even those Mid-tier Gods, no one dares to make a move here arbitrarily.”
“What is truly dangerous is The Frontline battlefield.”
That Luo Family god smiled and comforted him, his tone full of courtesy.
“Many thanks, Brother Luo Xuan.”
Yang Tiexin patted his chest and let out a long breath.

“I’ve gotten used to lying flat at home recently; washing dishes and cooking are all done by household robots. That tigress of mine insisted on letting me come out to stretch my bones and muscles, and incidentally see how my son is doing nowadays.”
“This trip today is truly an eye-opener.”
Speaking of this, Yang Tiexin still felt his heart pounding wildly.
“Sister Sun is also doing it for Big Brother Yang’s health.”
Luo Xuan hurriedly chimed in with a smile.
“Moreover, coming in advance to familiarize yourself with The Frontline is not a bad thing.”
“With Chairman Yang’s support, Big Brother Yang achieving a Breakthrough to a demigod is only a matter of time.”
While speaking, the smile on Luo Xuan’s face grew increasingly enthusiastic.
Between his words, there was even a bit of undisguised respect and ingratiation.
Right at this moment, Luo Hai suddenly turned his head to look at Luo Bing.
“Bing’er, go over and support your dad.”
“You are both Divine Beings, stand a bit closer to the middle.”
“Although this place belongs to the safe zone and brawls basically won’t happen, the aura inadvertently exuded by some gods alone is a huge oppression to Divine Beings.”
“Alright.” Luo Bing nodded obediently.
Then she quickly came to Yang Tiexin’s side and gently took his arm.
Seeing this, Luo Xuan also very tactfully stepped back.
Only then did Luo Hai look at Yang Tiexin and say with a smile:
“In-law, Manager Ma asked us to come over, and we still have business to attend to. Let’s go see Chairman Yang first.”
“Alright, alright, alright!”
Yang Tiexin nodded repeatedly.
“Let’s hurry and find Xiaofan.”
“There are too many people here, looking at them makes my heart panic.”
In recent years, apart from moving a few times, Yang Tiexin had hardly gone out at all.
The divine kingdom had always been managed by Intelligent Life.
As for himself, he had completely started a retired life.
Either he was soaking in the Virtual World binge-watching shows and entertaining himself, or he was spending money to play various large-scale online games.
Occasionally when Sun Rong and his two daughters-in-law went out shopping, he would sneak off to Tianxiang Renjian to listen to little tunes and watch shows.
As for the only thing that could be considered business... it was trying out new dishes for Sun Rong every few days.
Now suddenly arriving at The Frontline of the Human Race, looking at the demigods and gods coming and going all over the streets,
Yang Tiexin felt as if his social anxiety was about to act up.
Afterwards, following the coordinates sent by Ma Yu, the group walked all the way toward Yang Fan’s residence.
Luo Hai, walking at the very front, feigned a calm expression.
As a Tier 3 God, placed on any living planet, he was enough to be called a big figure on one side.
Yet upon arriving at The Frontline of the Human Race, he tucked away all his sharpness.
A graceful smile consistently hung on his face as he walked ahead unhurriedly to lead the way.
He even rarely glanced around.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: A Prominent Figure in the Business World
paragraphs: As they walked along the way, the expressions on the five people’s faces kept changing.
From feigned composure at the very beginning to utter shock later on.
Finally... it turned into complete numbness.
When they first entered the The Frontline.
What they saw were dense clusters of small buildings.
These houses were generally not tall, but they were arranged extremely compactly, with streets crisscrossing, utilizing almost every inch of land to its limit.
The group could understand this.
After all, this was the The Frontline, where every inch of land was extremely precious.
But as they continued walking inward and entered the trading area.
The scene before them left Yang Tiexin and Luo Bing, the two people who had come to the The Frontline for the first time, gaping in astonishment.
On both sides of the street, various shops were lined up row upon row.
Many shop owners were even standing at their doorways, loudly greeting passing gods, their shouts rising one after another.
A large number of transport robots shuttled back and forth, constantly carrying various war resources.
The entire trading area was as lively as a huge marketplace.
This made Yang Tiexin and Luo Bing, these two Divine Beings who had never been to the The Frontline, feel incredibly intrigued!
Modern society actually doesn’t rely on the Virtual World for transactions?
Continuing forward, the surrounding buildings began to change.
Replacing them were rows of neatly arranged small western-style houses, and the environment was significantly quieter.
Even Luo Hai and Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help but show expressions of surprise at this moment.
When they were serving back then, they were only demigods, and their range of activity was almost limited to their own residential areas.
Every day they waited for gods to come and sign Subordinate God Contracts.
How could they have been qualified to step into such a place?
Luo Hai’s throat moved slightly, and he marveled inwardly.
“My son-in-law...”
“Is his status at the The Frontline this high?”
Further ahead, what came into view was a villa area.
It was exceptionally quiet here, yet the air faintly emitted waves of powerful life energy.
Even though Luo Hai was a Tier 3 God, after arriving here, he felt his heartbeat quicken involuntarily.
Especially since there were two Divine Beings, Yang Tiexin and Luo Bing, in their group.
Along the way, he could even faintly feel it.
It seemed as if gazes were sweeping over them from the shadows.
However, those gazes only lingered for an instant before being withdrawn completely.
No accidents occurred.
Soon, the group arrived in front of a detached villa.
Luo Hai looked down at the coordinates on his communicator, then looked up at the detached villa in front of him, which covered an area of four or five hundred square meters.
After checking back and forth several times, he still didn’t dare to reach out and ring the doorbell.
In a place like the The Frontline, where every inch of land was worth its weight in gold, being able to own a detached villa of this scale was completely beyond his understanding.
At this moment, he even suspected that Ma Yu had sent the wrong coordinates.
What if... a High-Order God lived inside?
Wouldn’t ringing the doorbell rashly disturb the other party?
“Patriarch... Patriarch.”
Luo Chengfeng, who was beside him, wiped the beads of sweat from his forehead and asked in a low voice:
“We... shouldn’t have made a mistake, right?”
“No mistake.” Luo Hai confirmed the coordinates again and nodded slowly.
Hearing this, Yang Tiexin, who was standing to the side, let out a long sigh of relief instead.
“As long as we didn’t go to the wrong place.”
After saying that, he reached out and pressed the doorbell directly.
The sound of the doorbell rang slowly.
Yang Fan, who was in the living room, furrowed his brows slightly, and a wisp of Mental Energy instantly swept outside the door.
The next moment, the figures of the five people outside the door were all reflected in his mind.
“Ma Yu’s actions are quite fast.”
Yang Fan murmured softly, then stood up and walked to the door himself.
Click—the door opened.
“Dad, Bing’er.”
“Why are you all here?”
A smile appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Seeing that the person who opened the door was indeed Yang Fan.
Luo Hai, Luo Chengfeng, and Luo Xuan all breathed a sigh of relief almost simultaneously.
The hanging hearts were finally put at ease.
After all, this was the The Frontline villa area.
If they had rung the wrong doorbell... they dared not imagine the consequences.
“It was your mother who arranged it.”
Yang Tiexin waved his hand.
“She insisted on seeing for herself how you were doing at the The Frontline, otherwise she wouldn’t be at ease.”
Speaking of this, Yang Tiexin suddenly straightened his back, looking triumphant.
“Your old man is not an idle person anymore.”
“I am now a prominent figure in the business world of Xiling Planet!”
“I started a company with Brother Luo Xuan, and our territory is expanding very fast now!”
As he spoke, Yang Tiexin naturally put his arm around Luo Xuan’s shoulder.
Looking like good brothers.
“Xiaofan, are you short on money?”
“Although your mother holds the financial power of the Family, your dad still secretly saved a few thousand Divinity Points as pocket money.”
“The consumption at the The Frontline feels quite high, how about I transfer some to you?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was momentarily dumbfounded, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.
Today, not to mention a few thousand Divinity Points, even hundreds of billions of Divinity Points were nothing to him.
However, he also knew in his heart that these few thousand Divinity Points were his father’s good intentions.
That was equivalent to hundreds of billions of Faith Points, which, on an ordinary life planet, would be enough to equal the entire liquid capital of many families.
There was no need to think to know that this was probably something his father had saved for a very, very long time.
On the other side, Luo Xuan, who was much taller than Yang Tiexin, was subconsciously bending over slightly.
His legs were slightly bent, just enough to make it convenient for Yang Tiexin to rest his arm on his shoulder.
His eyes looked at Yang Fan from time to time.
There was a hint of reverence in his eyes, as well as a trace of nervousness and unease that could not be concealed.
However, Yang Fan did not care about all this.
Or rather, even if he noticed, he wouldn’t take it to heart.
Because... he didn’t know this First-Order God from the Luo Family at all.
“Your son is not short of these.”
Yang Fan smiled and shook his head, “Keep it for yourself to spend.”
At this moment, he just nodded slightly to Luo Xuan to acknowledge him, and did not take the initiative to strike up a conversation.
When one’s status reaches a certain height, many things will quietly change.
When you are strong enough, what others pursue is no longer just you.
Your Family, your relatives, and even those close to you will receive preferential treatment because of this.
This is what it means when one person attains the Dao, and their chickens and dogs ascend to heaven.
As for what thoughts Luo Xuan was harboring, Yang Fan didn’t care.
As long as the other party could keep his old father happy, that was enough.
In the eyes of outsiders, a Divine Being and a First-Order God calling each other brothers looked somewhat incongruous no matter how you looked at it.
But if placed in a place like Taichu City, where the powerful and influential gathered.
This scene, on the contrary, was perfectly normal.
Some people are born at the finish line.
Many low-tier gods, throughout their lives, are nothing more than followers of those true powerful scions.
“Come in first.”
Yang Fan stepped aside.
“There are many rooms here.”
“Stay here for the night, and go back tomorrow.”
“Good, good, good.” Yang Tiexin was the first to walk in.
Compared to the other four, he was the most relaxed and at ease.
After all, Yang Fan was his own son.

On the other side, Luo Xuan, who was much taller than Yang Tiexin, was subconsciously bending over slightly.
His legs were slightly bent, just enough to make it convenient for Yang Tiexin to rest his arm on his shoulder.
His eyes looked at Yang Fan from time to time.
There was a hint of reverence in his eyes, as well as a trace of nervousness and unease that could not be concealed.
However, Yang Fan did not care about all this.
Or rather, even if he noticed, he wouldn’t take it to heart.
Because... he didn’t know this First-Order God from the Luo Family at all.
“Your son is not short of these.”
Yang Fan smiled and shook his head, “Keep it for yourself to spend.”
At this moment, he just nodded slightly to Luo Xuan to acknowledge him, and did not take the initiative to strike up a conversation.
When one’s status reaches a certain height, many things will quietly change.
When you are strong enough, what others pursue is no longer just you.
Your Family, your relatives, and even those close to you will receive preferential treatment because of this.
This is what it means when one person attains the Dao, and their chickens and dogs ascend to heaven.
As for what thoughts Luo Xuan was harboring, Yang Fan didn’t care.
As long as the other party could keep his old father happy, that was enough.
In the eyes of outsiders, a Divine Being and a First-Order God calling each other brothers looked somewhat incongruous no matter how you looked at it.
But if placed in a place like Taichu City, where the powerful and influential gathered.
This scene, on the contrary, was perfectly normal.
Some people are born at the finish line.
Many low-tier gods, throughout their lives, are nothing more than followers of those true powerful scions.
“Come in first.”
Yang Fan stepped aside.
“There are many rooms here.”
“Stay here for the night, and go back tomorrow.”
“Good, good, good.” Yang Tiexin was the first to walk in.
Compared to the other four, he was the most relaxed and at ease.
After all, Yang Fan was his own son.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Worried Sick
paragraphs: As soon as he entered the courtyard, Yang Tiexin’s gaze was drawn to several robots that were trimming plants and cleaning the grounds.
He walked over quickly.
He looked left and right, touching them here and there.
Suddenly, his eyes widened.
“Isn’t this the latest household robot from the Qin Technology Alliance?”
“Hasn’t it not been officially released yet?”
“You brat, you’re already using it this quickly?”
Before Yang Fan could answer, Yang Tiexin discovered something new.
“Huh?”
“There’s actually an Intelligent Life taking over the entire villa here?”
“You can’t even tell from the outside!”
He looked around and touched things as he walked, his face filled with non-stop surprise.
The entire villa did not look luxurious.
But the various configurations inside far exceeded the house they currently lived in on Xiling Planet.
Many of the technological products were things Yang Tiexin had only heard of but had never actually seen.
“Your mother was really worrying for nothing.”
“Your living conditions here are more comfortable than ours on Xiling Planet.”
“And this is the The Frontline!”
Yang Tiexin became more satisfied the more he looked.
Meanwhile, Luo Xuan followed quietly behind him the whole time.
He didn’t say a single extra word.
He just silently maintained a half-step distance, his gaze fixed on Yang Tiexin.
As if ready to reach out and support him at any moment, afraid that this old father might accidentally trip or bump into something.
Just then, Luo Hai gave Luo Bing a discreet look.
Luo Bing understood instantly.
Her cheeks flushed slightly, and she walked with light steps to Yang Fan’s side, naturally taking his arm.
That pair of beautiful eyes gazed at Yang Fan, filled with irrepressible tenderness and love.
“Chairman Yang.”
“Then we shall stay for the night and set off tomorrow.”
Luo Hai asked with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but chuckle.
“There are no outsiders here, Father-in-law, there is no need to be so polite.”
Hearing this, Luo Hai nodded, looking slightly embarrassed.
“Alright.”
Afterwards, he took Luo Chengfeng and casually chose a guest room to stay in.
As gods, they would not feel tired from traveling at all.
The reason for insisting on staying for the night.
To put it bluntly... was just to create an opportunity for his daughter.
As soon as they entered the room, Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help but give a thumbs up.
“Patriarch.”
“You really know how to seize an opportunity.”
“You didn’t even forget to bring the girl Bing along.”
Luo Hai sighed helplessly upon hearing this.
“My girl’s belly is not very cooperative.”
“Back when Chairman Yang hadn’t yet achieved his Breakthrough to become a god, she couldn’t conceive an heir.”
“Now that he has become a god, it will only be harder.”
“Since there is such an opportunity, as her father, I naturally have to help her seize it.”
Speaking of this, Luo Hai looked at Luo Chengfeng with some envy.
“Unlike your granddaughter.”
“The girl Rou is truly lucky.”
“She already has that child, Yang Chengrou.”
Speaking of this matter, Luo Hai was filled with emotion.
In order to create this opportunity for his daughter, he, as an old father, had been worried sick.
He even pulled strings all the way to Sun Rong and roped in his in-law, Yang Tiexin, to make this opportunity possible.
Thinking of this, Luo Hai couldn’t help but pray silently in his heart.
“My daughter...”
“You must make an effort.”
“Don’t sleep tonight!”
Hearing the name “Yang Chengrou,” a thick smile appeared on Luo Chengfeng’s wrinkled old face.
Now that the Yang Corporation had just been established, his great-grandson, Yang Chengrou, already held 1% of the group’s shares.
This little guy, who hadn’t even been fully weaned yet.
His net worth... had already far exceeded the entire Luo Family.
In just a few years, such earth-shattering changes had occurred.
Even now, Luo Chengfeng felt like he was dreaming.
When he first invested in Yang Fan, his initial purpose was merely to borrow his seed.
Who would have thought that it would cause the entire Luo Family to soar to the skies.
Hard work is indeed important.
But what truly determines the height of one’s life is often luck.
A single correct choice is better than thousands of years of painstaking effort.
If not for fate favoring him, allowing him to make that decision back then.
In this life, he likely would never have had such an encounter.
Thinking of this, Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help but shake his head and chuckle.
Although he was still only a First-Order God now.
But relying on the connection through his granddaughter, Luo Rou.
Even if it was just helping to pass on a word, many companies outside would scramble to send money and shares, just to establish a good relationship.
Thinking back to the past.
In order to earn a few Divinity Points, he had to make his believers risk their lives participating in the Divine Kingdom War.
After the war ended, he wouldn’t even let go of a piece of soil or a mountain in the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.
Looking back now, it felt like a lifetime ago.
In another room, Yang Tiexin was busy studying the Intelligent Life one moment and teasing the various robots the next.
After the novelty wore off, he finally felt tired.
Not long after lying on the bed, snores could be heard.
Over the years, with the help of Yang Fan’s massive resources, his body had long since recovered, and his Divine Kingdom had regained its vitality.
Now, he was only one final step away from becoming a demigod.
As long as believers at the Qi Refining Realm were born within his Divine Kingdom, he could naturally step into the demigod rank.
However, he was still a Divine Being after all.
Having traveled across the Star Domain on a space cruiser to reach the The Frontline, his mind was somewhat exhausted.
At this moment, he just wanted to have a comfortable sleep.
Seeing that Yang Tiexin was finally fast asleep, Luo Xuan, who had been guarding by his side, breathed a sigh of relief.
Afterwards, he tiptoed to pick up the Virtual World helmet on the nightstand, his movements so light that he didn’t make a single sound.
After confirming he hadn’t woken Yang Tiexin.
He put on the helmet, and his consciousness instantly entered the Virtual World.
The next moment, his figure appeared in his own home on Xiling Planet.
Inside the room, his wife, Rao Mingming, had been waiting for a long time.
Seeing that Luo Xuan had finally logged on, she immediately walked up to him, her expression full of tension.
“How is the situation?” Rao Mingming asked anxiously.
Their son, Luo Mingxuan, had formed a grudge with Yang Fan, and over the years, this had been a thorn in the side for the couple.
Since then, the two had tried every possible way to ease the relationship between the two parties.
But Yang Fan grew too quickly.
So quickly that before they could react, the other party was already standing at a height they could never reach in their entire lives.
Because of Yang Fan, the strength of the entire Luo Family had undergone earth-shattering changes.
But at the same time, the couple clearly felt that many people in the clan began to deliberately distance themselves from them.
The reason was simple.
No one knew if Yang Fan still remembered what happened back then.
If Yang Fan still held a grudge, then whoever got close to them might be implicated.
So the couple simply changed their approach.
Since they couldn’t get close to Yang Fan directly, they would start with Yang Fan’s parents.
Fortunately, back when they were still in Yang County, Luo Xuan had voluntarily transferred a significant amount of shares of the Xuanming Group to Yang Tiexin’s name.
After arriving on Xiling Planet, they would send shares and gifts every few days, and occasionally create a few chance encounters.
Over time, the two actually became close friends who talked about everything.
Therefore, when he learned that Yang Tiexin was preparing to go to the The Frontline to visit Yang Fan, Luo Xuan just casually mentioned that he hoped to accompany him.
Yang Tiexin didn’t think too much about it and readily agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: Don't Think You Can Succeed on the First Try
paragraphs: At this moment, Luo Xuan leaned back on the sofa and let out a long sigh of relief, feeling much more relaxed.
“Chairman Yang has already forgotten about what happened back then.”
“And... he doesn’t even recognize me at all.”
Upon hearing this, the heart that Rao Mingming had been keeping in her throat finally settled down.
“That’s good.”
“That’s really good...”
For these past years, the couple had been unable to eat or sleep in peace because of this matter.
Now, they could finally catch their breath.
Suddenly, as if remembering something, Luo Xuan’s eyes turned cold.
“Arrange it immediately; remove Luo Mingxuan’s name from the genealogy.”
“Also, hurry up and dispose of that urn of ashes you had someone put away back then.”
“Damn it, how unlucky!”
Rao Mingming was stunned. “The ashes are still in Yang County; we didn’t bring them over.”
“Then send someone to Yang County.”
Luo Xuan slammed the table.
“I do not have such a son!”
Rao Mingming couldn’t help but frown. “Is this necessary?”
“Since Chairman Yang doesn’t care anymore, why go through all this trouble?”
For gods, lifespans are long and they have many offspring.
The mere vengeance for killing a son was not that important.
It was just that Xiling Planet was too far from Tiannan Star, and sending someone specifically for this trip was indeed quite a hassle.
Luo Xuan, however, shook his head seriously. “What do you know? That’s a woman’s perspective.”
“Do as I say.”
“The power Chairman Yang possesses now far exceeds our imagination.”
“As long as we keep the two elders, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong, happy, we will enjoy endless benefits in the future.”
“Perhaps there’s even a chance for our Divine Kingdom to advance further.”
“Any potential leverage left behind must be handled cleanly in advance.”
“Right now, who knows how many people are eyeing the position of being Yang Tiexin’s little brother.”
Hearing this, Rao Mingming finally nodded seriously. “I understand.”
Luo Xuan continued to arrange:
“Also, doesn’t Sister-in-law like to visit the department Divine Shop on the East Street of Xiling Planet?”
“Find a way to acquire a portion of the shares.”
“Create more accidental encounters in the future.”
“After a few times, we will naturally become familiar.”
“Don’t ever put on the airs of a god. Not to mention us, even Lord Ma Yu has to greet Sister-in-law Sun Rong politely when he sees her.”
“Try your best to become close friends with Sister-in-law.”
“Remember, only talk about life, not interests. Don’t let people think we have too strong of an agenda.”
“Also, learn more about cooking; Sister-in-law loves researching that.”
Speaking to the end, a shrewd glint flashed in Luo Xuan’s eyes.
On the other side. Inside Yang Fan’s room.
Luo Bing stood behind Yang Fan, gently massaging his shoulders.
A soft voice slowly sounded.
“Husband.”
“Can I... have a child?”
Yang Fan gently held her hand and said with a mischievous smile:
“Of course you can.”
“However, now that I have achieved a Breakthrough to become a god, the probability of conceiving offspring is much lower than before.”
“Don’t think you can succeed on the first try.”
Hearing this, Luo Bing nodded gently, a blush appearing on her pretty face.
She slowly snuggled into Yang Fan’s arms.
The two smiled at each other, everything understood without words.
The night grew deeper, and starlight spilled outside the window.
The lights in the room also quietly went out.

The divine body is like a mountain, the night feels long; the moon sets and stars sink, yet the night refuses to end. Bing’er whispers timidly several times; only when pushing open the window does one see the first rays of the sun.
It wasn’t until the first rays of dawn appeared on the horizon the next day that the door slowly opened.
Luo Bing had dark circles under her eyes and a clear look of fatigue on her face, but her eyes were filled with undisguisable happiness and satisfaction.
Yang Fan moved his mind.
The next moment, a large number of resource cards appeared in his hand.
Among them were not only piles of Spirit Stones, but also a large amount of Earth Heart Milk, as well as incredibly precious Dao-Enlightenment Tea.
These items all came from the reserves within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
“After leaving the The Frontline area, you can use the Virtual World to transfer these resources to the Yang Corporation,” Yang Fan said calmly.
“Understood.”
Luo Hai respectfully took the cards.
However, when his Mental Energy swept over the quantity of resources, his heart couldn’t help but thump violently.
Even though he was a Tier 3 God and the head of the Luo Family who had seen many big scenes, he still couldn’t control his emotions at this moment.
It was simply too much!
If these resources were placed in the outside world, they would be enough to make countless gods fight crazily for them.
Yet Yang Fan handed them to him so easily.

If it weren’t for the fact that Luo Hai had held a high position for many years and had long developed the habit of not showing his emotions on his face, he would have likely lost his composure by now.
He took a deep breath and put the cards into his Divine Kingdom.
Afterward, he bowed seriously. “Yes, Chairman.”
Now, the Luo Family had long since completely attached themselves to Yang Fan.
With the establishment of the Yang Corporation, the Luo Family naturally became a part of the Yang Corporation.
As for the title Luo Hai used, Yang Fan found it a bit awkward.
After all, no matter what, the other party was his father-in-law.
However, looking at Luo Hai’s current appearance, it was clear he wouldn’t be able to change it in the short term.
Yang Fan couldn’t be bothered to force it.
As his strength and status continued to rise, many things were quietly changing.
Even his own parents now showed a hint of restraint when facing him compared to the past.
Not to mention Luo Hai, his father-in-law.
The higher the status, the easier it is for distance to arise between people.
Soon, Luo Hai and his group left Yang Fan’s villa and headed to the location where the space ship was docked.
After entering the ship, everyone finally relaxed completely.
Just now at the The Frontline, although they had stayed in the safe zone and had not encountered any danger.
The powerful gods around them still put them under immense pressure.
Any figure passing by here could be a god.
Even if the other party didn’t release any aura, the difference in life level alone was enough to make them terrified.
“Phew...” Yang Tiexin let out a long sigh.
“It’s still more comfortable here.”
“I’m going back to my room first.”
“My guild in the game seems to be raiding a large dungeon today, and as the guild leader, I need to go watch over it.”
After saying this, a hint of embarrassment appeared on Yang Tiexin’s face.
Along the way, everyone else was busy with important business.
Only he had been eating and drinking along the way, still thinking about the game, which made him feel a bit ashamed.
“Brother Yang, please go ahead,” Luo Xuan quickly said with a smile.
“You’ve been tired from the journey; resting well is the most important thing.”
“Right, right, right.” Luo Hai also nodded with a smile.
“With Chairman Yang’s current standing, you, as a father, should enjoy a life of leisure.”
“The company matters are enough for us to worry about.”
Luo Xuan even took the initiative to say: “Brother Yang, play to your heart’s content. When mealtime comes, I will personally have it sent to you.”
“Just tell me what you want to eat.”
Yang Tiexin nodded awkwardly. “Alright, then I won’t stand on ceremony.”
After speaking, he entered his room.
After Yang Tiexin left, Luo Hai suddenly looked at Luo Bing.
“Bing’er, after we go back, remember to have a robot doctor give you a comprehensive check-up.”

If it weren’t for the fact that Luo Hai had held a high position for many years and had long developed the habit of not showing his emotions on his face, he would have likely lost his composure by now.
He took a deep breath and put the cards into his Divine Kingdom.
Afterward, he bowed seriously.
“Yes, Chairman.”
Now, the Luo Family had long since completely attached themselves to Yang Fan.
With the establishment of the Yang Corporation, the Luo Family naturally became a part of the Yang Corporation.
As for the title Luo Hai used, Yang Fan found it a bit awkward.
After all, no matter what, the other party was his father-in-law.
However, looking at Luo Hai’s current appearance, it was clear he wouldn’t be able to change it in the short term.
Yang Fan couldn’t be bothered to force it.
As his strength and status continued to rise, many things were quietly changing.
Even his own parents now showed a hint of restraint when facing him compared to the past.
Not to mention Luo Hai, his father-in-law.
The higher the status, the easier it is for distance to arise between people.
Soon, Luo Hai and his group left Yang Fan’s villa and headed to the location where the space ship was docked.
After entering the ship, everyone finally relaxed completely.
Just now at the The Frontline, although they had stayed in the safe zone and had not encountered any danger.
The powerful gods around them still put them under immense pressure.
Any figure passing by here could be a god.
Even if the other party didn’t release any aura, the difference in life level alone was enough to make them terrified.
“Phew...” Yang Tiexin let out a long sigh.
“It’s still more comfortable here.”
“I’m going back to my room first.”
“My guild in the game seems to be raiding a large dungeon today, and as the guild leader, I need to go watch over it.”
After saying this, a hint of embarrassment appeared on Yang Tiexin’s face.
Along the way, everyone else was busy with important business.
Only he had been eating and drinking along the way, still thinking about the game, which made him feel a bit ashamed.
“Brother Yang, please go ahead,” Luo Xuan quickly said with a smile.
“You’ve been tired from the journey; resting well is the most important thing.”
“Right, right, right.” Luo Hai also nodded with a smile.
“With Chairman Yang’s current standing, you, as a father, should enjoy a life of leisure.”
“The company matters are enough for us to worry about.”
Luo Xuan even took the initiative to say: “Brother Yang, play to your heart’s content.
When mealtime comes, I will personally have it sent to you.”
“Just tell me what you want to eat.”
Yang Tiexin nodded awkwardly.
“Alright, then I won’t stand on ceremony.”
After speaking, he entered his room.
After Yang Tiexin left, Luo Hai suddenly looked at Luo Bing.
“Bing’er, after we go back, remember to have a robot doctor give you a comprehensive check-up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Two Investment Contracts
paragraphs: “I know.” Luo Bing rolled her eyes.
There wasn’t a hint of the reverence she showed Luo Hai in her tone; instead, it carried a touch of casualness.
Back in Yang County, Luo Hai was the head of the Luo Family and a Tier 3 God.
Within the entire Family, his word was law.
Even his own daughter, Luo Bing, had always been cautious in front of him.
But things were different now.
Now, Luo Bing was Yang Fan’s wife. Although she herself was only a Divine Being, her true status on Xiling Planet had already far surpassed that of her father.
Of course, Luo Bing knew in her heart that Luo Hai had been looking out for her all these years. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have forced her to marry Yang Fan back then.
But thinking back to how Luo Hai had even used the Family’s greater good to coerce her, she still held a bit of resentment in her heart.

Occasionally, she wanted to let this father, who had been serious his entire life, experience what “fatherly kindness and filial piety” was all about. Unfortunately, she had never found an opportunity to give him a hard time.
Watching his daughter’s expression, Luo Hai could only smile bitterly and helplessly, his eyes filled with a hint of doting and resignation.
He had pampered her too much since she was little; even though she had grown a lot after going to university, that little temper of hers was still there!
“Patriarch.” At this moment, Luo Xuan suddenly spoke up.
“The place where we stayed yesterday should have been the Gu Family’s station on the The Frontline, right?”
“As expected of one of the Five Great Giants.”
“Back when we came here for service, let alone staying there, we didn’t even have the qualifications to approach it.”
Luo Hai also nodded with a sigh.
“Indeed, the heritage of the Gu Family is far beyond what an ordinary Family can compare to.”
Hearing this, Luo Bing couldn’t help but curl her lip.
“The Gu Family is so amazing.”
“My husband is really biased.”
“They are both his children, so why does Luo Rou only have 1% of the shares?”
As soon as she finished speaking, Luo Hai’s expression changed instantly.
“Bing’er!”
His voice carried an unprecedented sternness.
“Watch your words!”
Luo Bing’s body stiffened; she realized she had said the wrong thing, but she was still unwilling to admit it.
“I’m going to rest.”
With that, she turned and entered her room, closing the door behind her.
Watching this scene, Luo Hai rubbed his temples.
“Chengfeng...”
“Do you think I’ve spoiled this girl too much?”
“Why is your granddaughter so much more sensible?”
Luo Chengfeng, who was beside him, was silent for a moment and did not refute him. Because that was indeed the truth.
In terms of talent, Luo Bing was far superior to Luo Rou. But in terms of vision and perspective, the two were on completely different levels.

When the Yang Corporation was first established, after Luo Rou learned that her child only had 1% of the shares, not only did she have no dissatisfaction, but she even proactively urged Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong never to mention this matter in front of Yang Fan.

Because she knew very well that the Luo Family’s Foundation was too shallow. Being able to obtain 1% of the shares was already a huge blessing. If they continued to ask for more, it would not be a blessing, but a curse. Luo Rou understood this principle. But her own daughter, Luo Bing, had not yet truly seen it clearly.
Luo Chengfeng slowly spoke, “Bing is still young; she just needs more guidance.”
“However, it is not just Bing who needs strengthened ideological education.”
“Now, the entire Luo Family, from the Elders down to the younger generation, needs to learn to understand their boundaries.”
As he spoke, his expression gradually became serious.
“Xiling Planet is not some small place like Yang County.”
“It is located at a major transportation hub, with a constant stream of passing spaceships, and many big figures stop here to rest.”
“The reason the Luo Family can stand here today is not because of our own strength, but because of Chairman Yang.”
“The Luo Family only has a stomach of this size; if we are still greedy and unsatisfied, we will only choke ourselves to death.”
“Only by restraining our clansmen, being cautious in word and deed, and keeping to our roles can the Luo Family go further.”
After hearing these words, Luo Hai nodded in deep agreement.
“Well said.”
“I will leave this matter to you and Luo Xuan to handle.”
“Yes!” The two answered in unison.

A glimmer of joy flashed in the depths of Luo Xuan’s eyes. It had been years; ever since the incident with Luo Mingxuan, he had been gradually marginalized by the Family. Now, he had finally received an important Family task again. It seemed that by following Yang Tiexin to the The Frontline this time, he had indeed made the right bet.
Not long after everyone left, Yang Fan received two investment contracts sent by the Yang Corporation.
One was from the Primordial Academy.
One was from the Xingqiong Academy.
Both were Grade-A Geniuses. Yang Fan casually opened the first file.
[Name: Ma Mian]
[Sophomore at Primordial Academy]
[Grade-A Talent: Meat Consumption]
[Path: Martial Arts]
[Background: Ma Family of the Luo Tian Star Domain]

[Comprehensive Evaluation: The Family belongs to a mid-sized power; they can provide certain resources but cannot support his subsequent growth, therefore he has a strong willingness to accept external investment.]
[Psychological Expectation: 500,000 Divinity Points per year during university.]
[Note: Since the Yang Corporation is not yet listed, although the other party has an intention to cooperate, they are still observing the company’s development potential.]
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly, and he turned to the second one.
[Name: Niu Tou]
[Sophomore at Xingqiong Academy]
[Grade-A Talent: Berserker]
[Path: Martial Arts]
[Background: Commoner, no Family background.]

Both files were recorded in great detail. These were excellent Geniuses who were willing to accept investment, screened by Yang Corporation staff after visiting a large number of students at the Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy.

However, the number was not large. After all, the Yang Corporation had just been established, and its reputation was not yet prominent. Compared to those listed companies with hundreds of thousands of years of history, its heritage was still lacking quite a bit.
Investment was inherently a two-way choice. The Yang Corporation was selecting talent. Those students were also selecting their future platforms.

The contract not only stipulated the resources provided by the company but also clearly stated the rights and obligations of both parties. Once the investment was accepted, they would need to join the Yang Corporation to work after graduation. If they breached the contract, not only would they have to repay all training resources, but they would also need to pay an extremely high penalty fee.
Therefore, faced with such a contract, no one would sign easily. Divinity Points were certainly important, but the future platform also determined the development ceiling of a God.
After briefly browsing the information, Yang Fan directly sent a message to Ma Yu.
“Contact the two of them.”
“I will interview them personally in the Virtual World.”
Not long after the message was sent, Ma Yu replied with a string of Virtual World coordinates. Yang Fan put on his virtual helmet and tapped the coordinates.
The next moment, his consciousness appeared at the Yang Corporation headquarters on Xiling Planet.
Inside the lobby, Ma Mian and Niu Tou were standing by the glass of the conference hall, constantly observing the entire Xiling Planet.
There was unconcealable surprise in both of their eyes.

Originally, they had thought that the Yang Corporation was just a well-funded startup. But after truly arriving at the headquarters, they realized that they seemed to have underestimated this company.
The entire headquarters building towered into the clouds. Among the staff coming and going, there was no lack of Demigods, and they could even occasionally feel the aura of Gods.

What shocked the two even more was that, through the holographic star map in the conference hall, they discovered that the entire Yang Corporation actually owned a life-bearing planet. Such strength, even among those old-established listed companies, could definitely not be considered weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Is It Really Compliant?
paragraphs: Thinking of this, their expressions relaxed significantly.
They were indeed lacking resources at the moment.
But they would never sell their future cheaply for immediate benefits.
After all, once the investment contract was signed, they would need to serve the Yang Corporation for at least a thousand years after graduation.
If it were just an ordinary startup company, their asking price would naturally need to be higher.
Now it seems... this company appears more worth considering than they had anticipated.
As Yang Fan’s consciousness appeared in the room, the two who were gazing at Xiling Planet by the window immediately turned around.
The moment they saw Yang Fan, their expressions became visibly reserved, and their faces even flushed slightly.
The two walked over quickly and sat down opposite Yang Fan.
“Um... this Deity, you must be the HR for this company, right?”
Ma Mian spoke first; although his tone was a bit nervous, he remained quite composed.
“I wonder what the company’s benefits will be like after we graduate? Will there be stock options or equity incentives?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm as he said indifferently:
“My name is Yang Fan, and I am the chairman of this company.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Ma Mian and Niu Tou were stunned.
They looked at each other, a flash of confusion and disbelief in their eyes.
Although they had only recently achieved a Breakthrough to Demi-god, at this Realm, they could already roughly judge the aura of a Deity.
The aura of the Yang Fan before them was very obscure, making it impossible for them to perceive it accurately.
However, in their estimation, the other party was most likely just a low-Rank Deity.
A company as large as the Yang Corporation, and the chairman is actually just a low-Rank Deity?
This was just too strange.
They had seen the Fifth-Order God Ma Yu, so could the structure behind the Yang Corporation be completely different from what they had imagined?
Just as the two were puzzled, Ma Mian suddenly frowned.
“Yang Fan...”
He whispered the name, feeling as though he had heard it somewhere before.
The next moment, a flash of insight struck his mind, and he suddenly looked up, his face showing excitement.
“So it’s Senior Yang!”
“You are the Senior Yang who just graduated from our school, the Peerless Prodigy who achieved a Breakthrough to Deity in his junior year and joined the Gu Family!”
At this moment, the look Ma Mian gave Yang Fan was full of admiration.
Niu Tou, who was beside him, came from Xingqiong Academy, so he hadn’t heard of Yang Fan’s name.
But through Ma Mian’s introduction, he quickly understood the identity of the person before him.
Achieving a Breakthrough to Deity in his junior year, and being a member of the Gu Family.
The significance of these combined pieces of information went without saying.
The two looked at each other, seeing excitement in each other’s eyes.
Originally, they thought this was just a startup company that had just begun.
But who would have thought that such a Prodigy Genius stood behind this company.
If they joined the Yang Corporation after graduation, it would definitely be an excellent choice for them.
This time, they had really struck gold.
“If there is no one else with the same name, then that should be me.”
Yang Fan nodded casually and then continued:
“I have already reviewed your profiles, and I can agree to the requirements you proposed.”
“During your university years, we will provide a subsidy of 500,000 Divinity Points annually, and you will join the Yang Corporation after graduation.”
“As for the equity and stock option incentives you proposed, we don’t have those for now, but the contract will clearly state the base salary and benefits.”
“The fixed base monthly salary for a Demi-god is 3,000 Divinity Points.”
“If you achieve a Breakthrough to Deity, the base salary will increase to 30,000 Divinity Points per month.”
“In addition to that, the company also has quarterly bonuses, semi-annual bonuses, and year-end bonuses.”
“The Yang Corporation is not lacking in funds, so you can rest assured.”
Upon hearing these conditions, Ma Mian and Niu Tou hardly hesitated at all.
“Chairman Yang, we are willing to accept this investment contract.”
The two spoke simultaneously.
For them, this compensation was far above the market level.
You have to know, those students who graduated from key universities, while excellent, most of their salary packages don’t even reach one percent of this contract.
And as Grade A Geniuses from the two major academies, although their potential was greater, the conditions Yang Fan offered were already generous enough.
More importantly, what they valued right now was not just the Divinity Points.
It was the future of the Yang Corporation.
Being able to follow a Peerless Prodigy who achieved a Breakthrough to Deity in his junior year was, in itself, an opportunity for them.
Yang Fan gently raised his hand and flicked his finger.
Accompanied by a crisp snap, two agreements slowly appeared in his palm.
“Our company wishes to purchase the slots for the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone in your possession.”
“For every challenge opportunity, our company is willing to pay 10 million Divinity Points as compensation.”
“This is the detailed contract I have drafted; you can take a look at it first before deciding whether to sign it.”
“Even if you refuse, it will not affect the investment contract from just now.”
Yang Fan sat in the main seat with a calm expression, his tone remaining unhurried, as if he were simply discussing a transaction that couldn’t be more ordinary.
However, upon hearing the words “10 million Divinity Points,” Ma Mian and Niu Tou couldn’t help but swallow simultaneously.
They were naturally no strangers to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
It was a special trial area possessed only by the Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy, and the rules of the two academies were almost identical.
Every student only had two challenge opportunities in their lifetime.

The Alien Demigods imprisoned there were trial subjects specifically prepared by the entire Human Federation for the younger generation, with the goal of honing the students’ actual combat capabilities in their God-Kingdoms.
This was the first time they had heard that challenge qualifications could actually be sold.
‘Is this... really compliant?’
Doubts couldn’t help but arise in their hearts.
Although they were both Grade A Geniuses, they had a clear understanding of their own strength.
The Demi-gods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone were far stronger than those of the same Rank.

Even waiting until graduation in their senior year, they would at most only dare to challenge the Level 1 zone; as for higher-level zones, it was almost no different from sending themselves to their deaths.
If they could really exchange one challenge opportunity for 10 million Divinity Points, they would naturally be ten thousand times willing.
But... did the Federal Government really have a loophole?
The two quickly dismissed this speculation in their hearts.

After all, the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone had long since perfected all its rules; after the opponent’s God-Kingdom was opened, only the challenger’s own believers could enter, and no external force could intervene.
They really couldn’t understand how Yang Fan intended to purchase the challenge opportunities.
Carrying full hearts of doubt, the two slowly opened the agreements in their hands.
As they flipped through the pages, their expressions became increasingly shocked.
Their eyes widened more and more, until finally, Ma Mian slowly looked up at Yang Fan, his voice trembling slightly.
“Chairman...”
He couldn’t help but swallow.
“Are you... not joking?”
