Every student only had two challenge opportunities in their lifetime.

The Alien Demigods imprisoned there were trial subjects specifically prepared by the entire Human Federation for the younger generation, with the goal of honing the students’ actual combat capabilities in their God-Kingdoms.
This was the first time they had heard that challenge qualifications could actually be sold.
‘Is this... really compliant?’
Doubts couldn’t help but arise in their hearts.
Although they were both Grade A Geniuses, they had a clear understanding of their own strength.
The Demi-gods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone were far stronger than those of the same Rank.

Even waiting until graduation in their senior year, they would at most only dare to challenge the Level 1 zone; as for higher-level zones, it was almost no different from sending themselves to their deaths.
If they could really exchange one challenge opportunity for 10 million Divinity Points, they would naturally be ten thousand times willing.
But... did the Federal Government really have a loophole?
The two quickly dismissed this speculation in their hearts.

After all, the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone had long since perfected all its rules; after the opponent’s God-Kingdom was opened, only the challenger’s own believers could enter, and no external force could intervene.
They really couldn’t understand how Yang Fan intended to purchase the challenge opportunities.
Carrying full hearts of doubt, the two slowly opened the agreements in their hands.
As they flipped through the pages, their expressions became increasingly shocked.
Their eyes widened more and more, until finally, Ma Mian slowly looked up at Yang Fan, his voice trembling slightly.
“Chairman...”
He couldn’t help but swallow.
“Are you... not joking?”

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Signing the Agreement
paragraphs: According to the terms of the agreement, the entire Divine Kingdom War did not require them to dispatch any believers to participate in the battle at all.
The only thing they needed to do was guard their own divine kingdoms well during the war to prevent Alien Demigods from taking the opportunity to launch a reverse invasion.
Apart from that, there were no other additional requirements.
“At that time, I will provide you with the required war resources through the Yang Corporation.”
“Those drugs can pollute the environment of the divine kingdom and slowly erode the alien believers.”
“Without losing a single soldier, you can take down the opponent’s divine kingdom.”
Yang Fan picked up the teacup in front of him and took a gentle sip, his expression still calm, as if he had everything under control long ago.
Hearing this, Ma Mian and Niu Tou looked at each other, both seeing thick shock and incomprehension in each other’s eyes.
In the Divine Shop, there were indeed many special drugs sold that could pollute the environment of a divine kingdom.
Even high-level believers of the Nascent Soul realm, if exposed to high-concentration ordinary toxic fog for a long time, would likewise face the risk of falling.
But it was the first time they had ever heard of conducting a Divine Kingdom War in this manner.
It was not that it couldn’t be done, but that the cost was simply too high.
The divine kingdom of a top Alien Demigod had an area close to nearly one hundred million square kilometers.
Wanting to rely on poison to cover the entire divine kingdom and continuously maintain a sufficient concentration, the consumption would simply be an astronomical figure.
Could it be that in order to poison to death a demigod, one would directly hollow out most of a god’s net worth?
Thinking of this, Ma Mian took a deep breath and asked with a serious expression:
“Chairman Yang, although the conditions you offered are indeed very tempting,”
“yet it is impossible for us to expose our divine kingdom coordinates. How is this matter to be supervised?”
This was the issue they cared about the most.
Both of them were Grade-A Geniuses of the Two Major Academies, and they were full of confidence in their own futures.
Becoming a god was merely a matter of time.
In the future, there was even a chance to step into the realm of the Mid-tier God.
People like them naturally could not become another person’s Subordinate God, nor would they easily hand over top-secret information like divine kingdom coordinates to anyone.
They had no need to be like Li Tianheng, using their own divine kingdom as a bargaining chip to participate in a proxy war just to fight for a sliver of a chance to achieve a Breakthrough to a god.

If Yang Fan requested them to open their divine kingdom coordinates, or even dispatched robots to enter and garrison their divine kingdoms, then no matter how generous the conditions were, they would never agree.
Regarding this, Yang Fan was obviously well-prepared long ago.
“The company will not require you to hand over your divine kingdom coordinates.”
“However, I need all the video data of the entire Divine Kingdom War.”
Yang Fan said calmly:

“Before the war begins, you need to purchase panoramic high-definition war monitoring equipment through the Federal Mall and deploy them on the periphery of the divine kingdom to ensure that the entire battlefield can be recorded 360 degrees without blind spots.”
“During the war, none of your believers are allowed to enter the opponent’s divine kingdom. Throughout the entire process, only robots are allowed to enter and deploy the drugs.”

“After the war ends, all land reclamation, collection, and transportation work within the divine kingdom must also be completely handed over to the Otherworldly Collector to complete, and independent monitoring equipment must be equipped for each collection team.”
“The data collected by all monitoring equipment must be synchronized in real-time to the data center of the Intelligent Life of the Yang Corporation.”
“From the beginning of the war to the end of resource recovery, the entire process must leave traces, be recorded, and be traceable.”
“Any artificial interference or missing data will be regarded as a breach of contract.”
After hearing this set of procedures, Ma Mian and Niu Tou instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
Being able to be admitted into the Two Major Academies of the Human Federation, they were inherently the top Geniuses of the younger generation.
Their future path was far from comparable to those ordinary demigods who relied on proxy wars to make a living.
If what Yang Fan demanded just now was the divine kingdom coordinates, then not to mention this cooperation agreement, even the previous investment contract would have to be reconsidered by them.
As dignified proud sons of heaven, they had come to the Yang Corporation to serve as senior executives.
They certainly hadn’t come to sign an indenture or be other people’s slaves.
It was good that there was no danger of divine kingdom coordinates being exposed!
“Apart from that.”
Yang Fan continued to say:
“After the Divine Kingdom War ends, I will only take away all S-rank and above buildings, as well as the opponent’s entire Divine Kingdom Core.”
“The remaining resources will all belong to you.”
“Considered as an additional investment by the Yang Corporation in you.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the breathing of the two instantly grew hurried, and their faces were filled with hard-to-conceal excitement.
Not only could they obtain twenty million Divinity Points, but their own believers did not need to participate in the battle throughout the entire war.
Now even the spoils of war, Yang Fan was willing to share with them.
Such conditions were already generous to an unimaginable extent.
At this moment, Niu Tou, who hadn’t spoken much all along, finally couldn’t help asking:
“Chairman Yang, given the conditions you offered, we indeed have no reason to refuse.”
“It’s just that the strength of the demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is extremely strong. With my current strength, even the first-tier area is something I wouldn’t dare to easily attempt.”
“If the opponent launches a reverse invasion, how should the safety of our divine kingdoms be guaranteed?”
Yang Fan smiled faintly.
“This problem is very simple.”
“I can advance you twenty million Divinity Points in advance.”
“With this sum of funds, you can completely purchase enough divine kingdom defense buildings in advance.”
“In this way, there shouldn’t be any worries behind, right?”
Hearing these words, Ma Mian and Niu Tou no longer had any objections and successively nodded in agreement.
As long as they signed the agreement, they would immediately be able to obtain twenty million Divinity Points!

Such a massive sum of funds—they only needed to take out one-tenth of it to build the divine kingdom defense system, and they would have absolute certainty to resist the reverse invasion of the vast majority of Alien Demigods.
Unless they encountered that batch of top monsters in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, there would hardly be any danger.
What’s more, the biggest difference between them and those Alien Demigods was that they could communicate with the outside world.
Once the battle situation was unfavorable, they could completely continue to purchase defense buildings and constantly reinforce the divine kingdom’s defense line.
Money was the guarantee.
Money was safety.

As long as the funds were sufficient, a large number of A-rank defense buildings could be completely deployed within the divine kingdom, forging the entire divine kingdom into something as impregnable as an iron wall.

If they really smashed all twenty million Divinity Points into the defense system, I’m afraid that even if a god forcefully broke through the rules of the divine kingdom to launch an invasion against them, they would feel incomparably headache-inducing.
Of course, they wouldn’t be foolish enough to actually do this.
For a god, the development of believers was always the foundation of standing.
No matter how sturdy the defense was, it was merely a means of saving one’s life.
Only by continuously expanding the divine kingdom, cultivating believers, and enhancing one’s own strength was the true long-term solution.
If all resources were invested into the defense system, that would undoubtedly be putting the cart before the horse.
There shouldn’t be such a fool in this world!
Soon, Ma Mian and Niu Tou solemnly signed their names on the investment contract and cooperation agreement.
After putting away the agreement, the two stood up simultaneously and bowed respectfully to Yang Fan.
“Subordinates greet the Chairman!”

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Believer Breakthrough
paragraphs: From the moment they accepted the investment from Yang Corporation, they officially became members of Yang Corporation.

As long as Yang Corporation did not go bankrupt, did not commit any serious breach of contract, and did not force them to engage in high-risk work clearly beyond the scope of the contract, they would serve Yang Corporation for the next thousand years.
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Develop your Divine Kingdom well.”
“Although you only have A-grade talent, as long as resources are sufficient, your future achievements will not necessarily be inferior to those so-called Human Race Prodigies.”
Speaking of this, he added:
“In addition, there is no need to conceal the fact that you have signed an investment contract with Yang Corporation.”
“You can even promote it to your friends.”
“However, this cooperation agreement must never be revealed.”
Yang Fan’s expression gradually became serious.
“Yang Corporation is currently launching a special scientific research project.”
“We need the Divine Kingdom Core of the most top-tier Alien Demigods as research material.”
“There is only one goal.”
“That is to develop new technology that can significantly reduce the mortality rate of young Human Race Demi-gods.”
“But the coordinates of this level of Alien Demigods are too rare; after much thought, only the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone of the two major academies meets the requirements.”
“For the future of the Human Race, I have no choice but to resort to this desperate measure.”
Speaking to the end, Yang Fan sighed softly, his face full of helplessness.
In fact, although this agreement did not violate any laws or regulations of the Federation.
But in essence, it still exploited a loophole in the rules.
The original intention of establishing the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone was to temper young Demi-gods, not to become an object of commercial transactions.
Naturally, the fewer people who know about this kind of thing, the better.
Hearing this, the look of admiration in the eyes of Ma Mian and Niu Tou became even stronger.
“Chairman, you are so righteous!”
Ma Mian said sincerely.
“Nowadays, many companies only care about financial lending and capital operations, looking only at profits.”

“It is becoming increasingly rare to find a company like Yang Corporation that is still willing to invest massive resources and focus on researching technological achievements that can benefit the entire Human Race.”
Niu Tou also nodded solemnly.
“Rest assured, Chairman.”
“The two of us understand the gravity of the situation and will naturally keep our mouths shut.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, revealing a trace of satisfaction.
Whether the two of them were genuinely admiring him or deliberately catering to him, he did not care.
However, Yang Fan was willing to believe what they said.
The trading of quotas for the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone was inherently a mutually beneficial arrangement for both parties.
Once leaked, it would not benefit either side.
Compared to relying solely on contractual constraints, a cooperative relationship maintained by common interests is more solid.
His consciousness slowly withdrew from the Virtual World.
The next moment, Yang Fan opened his eyes again and returned to reality.
Without the slightest pause, he immediately contacted Yang Da through Divine Thought.
“Mobilize another fifty million White Zombies to fully refine corpse pills at the Eternal Corpse Mine.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da’s voice sounded immediately.
After giving the order, a flash of thought crossed Yang Fan’s eyes.
Those Demi-gods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone of the two major academies were far from comparable to the ordinary Demi-gods on the The Frontline.
The area of their Divine Kingdoms had mostly approached one hundred million square kilometers infinitely.
The reason they had not broken through for so long was merely because they were deliberately suppressing their Realm and did not dare to break through.

The larger the Divine Kingdom area and the longer the Evolution time, the more perfect the laws of heaven and earth would be, and the stability and self-purification ability of the entire Divine Kingdom environment would also be greatly improved accordingly.
Therefore, when using poisoning to erode the Divine Kingdom environment for conquest, the resource consumption does not increase proportionally with the area of the Divine Kingdom.
Instead, it will explode exponentially as the opponent’s Divine Kingdom becomes stronger.

For the vast majority of Divine Kingdom Wars, whether it is poison pills, healing Medicinal Pills, or special potions that stimulate the potential of believers, they only affect the outcome of a war between the believers of both sides.

Like Yang Fan, who relies entirely on Medicinal Pills to erode the Divine Kingdom environment, bypassing believer wars, and continuously obtaining Divine Kingdom Core, one cannot find a second person in the entire Human Federation.
All of this is built upon the terrifying production capacity bestowed upon him by his Evolution Talent.
However, even so.
If he wanted to help Ma Mian and Niu Tou conquer those top-tier Demi-gods in the academy’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone without losing a single soldier.
He still had to make more preparations.
In the real world, another ten days passed.
On this day, Yang Fan was staying in Taichu City in the Virtual World, accompanying Gu Le to tease Gu Chengye.
The little guy could already understand a lot of words now; although he was still young, his eyes were incredibly lively and very adorable.
Just at this moment, Yang Fan’s expression suddenly changed.
He felt that there seemed to be a slight, special change in his Divine Kingdom.
Seeing Yang Fan suddenly stop his movements, Gu Le immediately noticed the abnormality.
She looked at Yang Fan tenderly and asked softly:
“Husband, has something happened?”
“A believer in the Divine Kingdom has broken through.” Yang Fan said in a calm tone.
Hearing this, Gu Le widened her eyes instantly.
She subconsciously covered her lips with her hand, her face full of surprise.
“Husband, how long has it been since you reached the God level?”
“Could it be... that a believer in the Core Formation Realm has already been born?”
Speaking of this, Gu Le’s eyes were full of pleasant surprise.
“You should go and take a look quickly!”
“I will graduate next year, and by then I will bring Xiao Ye to join you, Husband!”
The look in her eyes as she gazed at Yang Fan was full of admiration and love.
It had been less than half a year since Yang Fan reached the God level.
In Gu Le’s view, for the Divine Kingdom to be able to give birth to a believer in the Core Formation Realm in such a short time was already an extremely terrifying development speed.
This level of growth speed, I’m afraid, could only be achieved by a Peerless Prodigy.
Yang Fan looked at Gu Le’s excited appearance and did not explain too much.
He just smiled and rubbed Gu Chengye’s little head.
Subsequently, his consciousness slowly withdrew from the Virtual World and returned to reality.
Without any delay.
With a movement of his consciousness, Yang Fan immediately entered his Divine Kingdom.
“Greetings, Master!”
As soon as he entered the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da’s figure had already appeared before him.
Compared to before, Yang Da’s figure had undergone earth-shaking changes at this moment.
In his eyes, there was no longer just the cold light of data, but a hint of a more lively spirit.
The Mental Energy fluctuations emitted by his entire person were far beyond the past.
Obviously, with the birth of the fourth-tier Intelligent Life, Yang Da had also successfully broken through.
“I didn’t expect that after reaching the God level, it would be the Mechanical Civilization that took the lead.”
Yang Fan looked at the changes before him and could not help but sigh.
In his Divine Kingdom, no believer in the Nascent Soul Realm had been born.
The one who broke through was actually the fourth-tier Intelligent Life.
When he was in the Virtual World, Yang Fan had already sensed the changes in the Divine Kingdom.
As a God, Yang Fan’s Mental Energy ushered in a qualitative change.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Money-Making Ability Still Improving
paragraphs: Yang Fan slowly raised his head and looked toward his Divine Kingdom.
At this moment.
Without needing to rely on divine authority, simply by relying on his own Mental Energy, he could clearly perceive every change within the core area of his entire Divine Kingdom.

He could see every move of his believers in their daily lives; he could feel the Spiritual Qi and Immortal Qi constantly intertwining in the air; he could perceive countless resources being transported, distributed, and consumed.
In the past, these changes required the use of divine authority to observe.
But now, he could achieve this solely with his Mental Energy.
Yang Fan closed his eyes and began to carefully feel the changes on a mental level.
A moment later, Yang Da bowed respectfully.
“Reporting to Master.”
“Unlike other civilization routes, the core of Mechanical Civilization lies in resources.”
“Coupled with the fact that the Goddess of Wisdom herself possesses a complete Mechanical Legacy, this has significantly shortened the exploration time for the Mechanical believers.”
“As long as the Mechanical Heart, various intelligent chips, and a sufficient quantity of rare metal resources are adequately supplied, those Intelligent Life forms can constantly evolve themselves.”
“To use a simple analogy.”
“The Legacy blueprints provided by the Goddess of Wisdom are like a complete construction plan.”
“The Intelligent Life forms are the workers responsible for executing their own modifications.”
“And various rare Materials are the foundation for building the civilization.”
“They only need to continuously manufacture, optimize, and perfect. After countless iterations, they will complete their evolution.”
Listening to Yang Da’s explanation, Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully.
Nowadays, the monthly net income of his Divine Kingdom has reached over one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
He did not know exactly how much income those High-Order Gods had.
But judging from Ma Yu’s performance back then, his own wealth was likely far beyond the other party’s.
And right now, he was merely a First-Order God.
The area of his Divine Kingdom was limited, and the number of believers had far from reached its limit.
Most importantly, the strongest believers in his Divine Kingdom before were only at the Core Formation Realm.
Now, relying on the resource system of the entire Divine Kingdom, the investment in believers could be completely maximized.
The Cultivation route requires absorbing Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, the Martial Arts route requires tempering the Physical Body, and the Undead route requires relying on Corpse Qi to Cultivate.
The resources they consume cannot be compared to Mechanical Civilization at all!
As long as there are sufficient resources, the development of Mechanical Civilization is the fastest!
Yang Fan could clearly feel that in his Divine Kingdom now, the major civilization systems had undergone significant changes.
Among them, Mechanical Civilization was leading by a complete gap.
And ranked second was the Corpse Cultivation system.

The number of Corpse Cultivation believers was simply too vast; even if the strength of a single individual was not strong, relying on their terrifying numerical advantage, they still occupied the second position.
Third was the Immortal Alliance system.
Fourth was the Wanxiang Martial Court.
Fifth was the dependent Elf Race.
“Very good.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Continue to develop.”
“After the birth of the fourth-tier Intelligent Life, I can clearly feel that my strength has improved by a large margin.”
As he spoke, Yang Fan slowly extended his right hand.
The next moment, the air above his palm began to fluctuate violently.
Countless tiny material particles continuously converged.
Soon, a small piece of wood appeared out of thin air.
Immediately after, the structure of the wood began to change.
Accompanied by the rearrangement of a large number of molecules and atoms, the wooden structure gradually disappeared and finally turned into a piece of iron.
Subsequently, the iron block changed again, into copper, gold...
Various different substances constantly transformed within Yang Fan’s palm.
This is the special ability that a god gains after possessing fourth-tier Intelligent Life—Creation.
Of course, this Creation ability is not creation out of thin air in the true sense.
Rather, it relies on the god’s powerful Mental Energy to manipulate the most basic structure of matter and rearrange and combine it.
According to rumors, the amount of knowledge stored in the minds of those High-tier Mechanical Gods has even surpassed that of ordinary high-tier Intelligent Life.
In the real world, they only need a single thought to directly create a complete interstellar warship.
They could even manufacture planet-destroying weapons out of thin air.
This is completely different from manifesting items from the Divine Kingdom into the real world.
The former only transfers things that already exist.
While the latter relies on the knowledge system one has mastered, combined with terrifying mental power, to directly use matter in reality to create brand-new products.
These are some rumors about High-tier Mechanical Gods that Yang Fan learned after reading a large amount of Materials in the Taichu City library.
However, Yang Fan clearly has not reached that level yet.
His knowledge reserves are limited, and his Mental Energy is far from being comparable to those High-Order Gods.
Nowadays, he can at most create some low-value ordinary substances.
Want to manufacture real Smart Weapons?
Let alone create them, he cannot even fully understand their internal structure.
“Yang Da, you once said that fourth-tier Intelligent Life possesses the ability of ‘Creation’.”
Yang Fan looked at the constantly changing substances in his palm, a flash of realization in his eyes.
“So that’s how it is...”
Until this moment, he truly understood why the number of gods on the Mechanical Path was so scarce, yet they were always sought after by various forces.
They are scarce because the initial investment for this path is truly too terrifying.
To Cultivate a Mechanical Civilization to the level Yang Fan has reached now, unless one has the support of a big Family or a listed company behind them, it is simply unbearable for ordinary gods.
Large quantities of rare metals, intelligent chips, Mechanical Hearts...
Every single item is a huge consumption.
Furthermore, in the early stages, the development speed of Mechanical Civilization is not fast.
Investing a large amount of resources without seeing obvious returns.
This is also why the vast majority of gods do not choose this path.
But once the Mechanical Path truly grows, the benefits it brings are also far beyond other systems.
Because the greatest advantage of Mechanical Gods is productivity.
As a god, all the abilities Yang Fan possesses now essentially come from his believers.
Consuming Mental Energy to transform a piece of ordinary wood into an iron block, or even gold.
This is almost a business with no capital cost.
As long as his Mental Energy is sufficient, he can continuously create wealth.
In the Federation Divine Shop, from ordinary F-Rank Buildings to precious S-Rank Buildings, many are produced from Mechanical Divine Kingdoms.
From this, one can imagine what kind of terrifying wealth accumulation those Mechanical Gods who have truly reached the Peak possess.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan could not help but shake his head and smile bitterly.
“I am already so good at making money now.”
“I didn’t expect that my money-making ability could still continue to improve.”
However, he quickly collected his thoughts.
Wealth is, after all, only a part of strength.
“Yang Da.”
Yang Fan said:
“Continue to purchase all resources suitable for the development of Mechanical Civilization and increase investment.”
“Besides manufacturing Smart Weapons, there is no need for the Intelligent Life to generate income for me for the time being.”
“The most important thing now is to improve the overall strength of the Divine Kingdom.”

chapters.title: Chapter 348: The Thick Skin
paragraphs: “Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded respectfully.
When wealth accumulates to a certain extent, it becomes just a number.
For the current Yang Fan, what was truly important was not continuing to earn more Divinity Points.
But rather utilizing all these Resources to rapidly enhance his own strength.
As long as one’s strength was powerful enough, wealth would naturally be continuously generated.
There was no need to let Intelligent Life waste a large amount of time producing goods for the sake of immediate gains.
“Master, with the birth of the fourth-tier Intelligent Life, the current Mechanical Civilization is already capable of attempting to manufacture large-scale weapons of war.”
Yang Da continued to report:
“For example, Intelligent Mecha, laser tanks, Mechanical floating turrets, heavy annihilation chariots, and aerospace war platforms equipped with high-energy particle weapons.”
“Once these weapons of war are deployed into the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, they will greatly enhance the overall combat capability of the Divine Kingdom.”
“However, the Resources required for consumption are equally substantial and require the Master’s approval.”
Yang Fan raised his eyebrows slightly.
“How many Resources are needed?”
“Calculated based on the current development speed of the Divine Kingdom, it will require an investment of about one hundred billion Divinity Points every three thousand years.”
Yang Da answered truthfully.

“Currently, the knowledge reserve of the Intelligent Life in the Divine Kingdom is insufficient. The research and development of these large-scale war weapons require going through a large number of experiments and data corrections.”
“Therefore, the resource consumption will be extremely massive.”

“Even if the Divine Kingdom develops in the future and these equipment are replaced by newer models and put into the Federal Mall for sale, the residual value generated is probably not enough to fully offset the R&D costs.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan instantly lost interest.
He originally thought that after the Mechanical Civilization developed, it could provide a new consumption channel for his almost endless Divinity Points.
As a result... one hundred billion Divinity Points every three thousand years?
In reality, only a month’s time had passed.
For the current Yang Fan, this bit of consumption could not even be considered a drizzle.
“Very well.”
Yang Fan waved his hand casually.
“In the future, you don’t need to report such matters to me specially.”
“As long as it can enhance the combat power of the Divine Kingdom, all resource consumption is worth it.”
“As for Divinity Points, give it the green light all the way.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da responded respectfully.
After figuring out the current changes in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
For the next month, he almost stayed in the The Frontline villa without going out even once.
During this period, Gu Jiuheng and Sima Tianci also came to his villa together.
The three of them chatted about quite a few things together.
From the changes in the situation of The Frontline battlefield, to the future development direction of the Human Federation, and then to various policy adjustments of the divine class.
Now, because he frequently met with Gu Le in the Virtual World, Yang Fan had gradually integrated into the upper circles of the Human Race.
As for the topics discussed by Gu Jiuheng and the others, he was no longer as completely clueless as he was at first, and he could occasionally put forward some of his own views.
However, before leaving, Gu Jiuheng still tactfully reminded Yang Fan a few words.
“Yang Fan, although you possess the Hundredfold Time Sequence talent, the development speed of your Divine Kingdom will be very fast.”
“But after becoming a god, the Resources needed for consumption will only become more and more.”
“Relying solely on the investment of the Divine Kingdom is ultimately not a long-term solution.”
“We gods, if we want to go further, still need to look for more opportunities in the Real World.”
Yang Fan naturally understood the meaning in Gu Jiuheng’s words.
This cousin obviously still hoped that he could join the Ninth Legion.
After all, although the legion system was dangerous, it likewise possessed a massive amount of Resources and growth opportunities.
It was just that for Yang Fan, he had not the slightest interest in these Resources.
Therefore, in the end, he still tactfully rejected Gu Jiuheng’s proposal.
At the very moment Yang Fan refused, the eyes of Sima Tianci beside him suddenly lit up.
As if... he had finally found his organization.
In the next few days, Sima Tianci began to run frequently to Yang Fan’s place.
He even didn’t know where he got an old man’s reclining chair and directly placed it in the yard of Yang Fan’s villa.
The biggest thing every day was lying there basking in the sun.
“So comfortable.”
“It’s quiet here, and no one disturbs.”
Sima Tianci had a cozy expression.
According to what he said, he was doing this to hide and seek peace and quiet.
If continued to stay in his own villa, it wouldn’t be long before the elders of the Sima Family stationed at the The Frontline would come looking for him.
And then arrange various tasks.
As for Yang Fan, after hearing this reason, the whole person fell silent.
This guy... actually regarded him as a kindred spirit?
“I am certainly not the same as you.”
“I am working hard to develop the Divine Kingdom!”
“My Divine Kingdom is now countless times stronger than yours.”
Yang Fan complained wildly in his heart.
As the Mechanical Civilization gave birth to the fourth-tier Intelligent Life, his Mental Energy ushered in a huge enhancement once again.
Now, relying solely on mental perception, he could roughly judge the strength of his peers around him.
Although Gu Jiuheng was already a Tier 3 God, the area of his Divine Kingdom far exceeded Yang Fan’s.
But in Yang Fan’s perception, the pressure the other party brought to him was not very strong.
Not to mention Sima Tianci, a First-Order God of a similar age.
Yang Fan, who was accustomed to being alone, looking at Sima Tianci in the yard at this moment, only felt a little headache.
If it were a girl, that would be one thing.
A big man running to someone else’s house every day to bask in the sun, and incidentally freeloading on food and drinks.
This skin... is really a bit thick.
Of course, Yang Fan only thought about these words in his heart.
With Sima Tianci’s identity placed there, it was naturally impossible for him to truly drive people away directly.
Therefore, Yang Fan could only subtly hint and remind him a few words.
However, what left him speechless was.
Sima Tianci acted as if he completely couldn’t understand.
He lay down as he should and basked in the sun as he should.
In the end, Yang Fan couldn’t be bothered to continue persuading him.
Since he liked staying in the yard, the yard was left to him.
Anyway, the two did not affect each other.
Sima Tianci was responsible for basking in the sun.
As for Yang Fan, he went straight back to his room and entered the Virtual World to accompany his wife.
Both sides did their own things, and they lived in peace with each other.
This month, Ma Yu sent someone over to pick up the goods again.
The person who came was still his father-in-law — Luo Hai.
However, coming this time, Yang Fan’s father Yang Tiexin did not follow along.
Luo Bing did follow closely behind.
This was Luo Hai’s second time coming to Yang Fan’s villa.
Compared to his restraint the first time, this time he was obviously a bit bolder.
Glancing at the surrounding environment and confirming that the location was correct, he then stepped forward and rang the doorbell.
“Coming, who is it?”
“It’s broad daylight and not time to sleep, what are you knocking on the door for?”
The next moment, a strange yet lazy voice came from inside the villa.
Hearing this voice, Luo Hai froze instantly.
He subconsciously pulled Luo Bing back a step, and then took another look at the location of the villa.
‘That’s right!’
‘This is it.’
‘But why wasn’t it Yang Fan’s voice?’

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Achieved a Huge Merit
paragraphs: Just as the two of them were in doubt,
The villa door slowly opened.
Sima Tianci walked out yawning, looking sleep-deprived and utterly bored.
“Who are you?”
Sima Tianci frowned slightly.
His gaze swept over Luo Hai and then fell onto Luo Bing, a flash of puzzlement crossing the depths of his eyes.
This was, after all, The Frontline area jointly owned by the Five Great Families.
Those capable of living here were basically important members of the Five Great Families.
Yet the woman before him... was obviously just a Divine Being.
Why would she appear here?
Feeling the faint oppressive aura emanating from Sima Tianci, Luo Hai’s heart instantly tightened.
Although he did not recognize the person before him,
a First-Order God was actually able to put pressure on himself, a Tier 3 God.
Such a figure must undoubtedly be a peerless Prodigy among the Five Great Families.
Naturally, he did not dare to show the slightest negligence.
“Greetings, My Lord.”
Luo Hai hurriedly bowed respectfully.
“We are here to see Chairman Yang.”
“We are staff members of the Yang Corporation.”
Sima Tianci raised an eyebrow.
“Yang Corporation?”
“The company founded by Brother Yang?”
Just at this moment, footsteps came from inside the villa.
Yang Fan pushed open the door and walked out.
“Brother Lay-Flat.”
“These are my Family members.”
“Go back to sleep.”
Yang Fan’s tone was very natural.
Sima Tianci’s mouth twitched slightly, but he did not refute.
After all, this title... he had already gotten used to it.
Ever since he overstayed his welcome at Yang Fan’s place and refused to leave, Yang Fan had given him a nickname—Brother Lay-Flat.
The reason was also very simple.
This guy’s biggest hobby every day was lying on the rocking chair in the yard to sunbathe.
Aside from eating and sleeping, he practically did nothing at all.
Yang Fan was completely speechless about this.
“So it’s my sister-in-law.”
Sima Tianci looked at Luo Bing, a smile appearing on his face.
“For our first meeting.”
“My name is Sima Tianci, and I’ve recently just been temporarily hiding here at Brother Yang’s place for some peace and quiet.”
As he spoke, he flipped his palm over and produced a card.
“This is a greeting gift, please accept it.”
“Consider it rent for these past few days.”
While speaking, Sima Tianci handed the card into Luo Bing’s hands.
Luo Bing lowered her head to check.
The next moment,
her pupils slightly contracted.
Inside the card, an A-grade Spiritual Vein was actually sealed!
“This is...”
“A greeting gift?”
Luo Bing raised her head and looked at Yang Fan somewhat at a loss.
Yang Fan had also given her Spiritual Veins before.
But for her Divine Kingdom, Resources of this level were practically one of the core buildings.
With such a precious item, how could she dare to accept it casually.
Seeing this, Yang Fan directly waved his hand, “Just accept it.”
Afterwards, he looked at Sima Tianci and couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
“You guy has overstayed your welcome at my place for so long.”
“And yet the first time you meet someone, you only take out one A-grade Spiritual Vein.”
“As the dignified future head of the Sima Family, you’re too stingy.”
“It seems that when the Sima Family is handed over to you in the future, things are going to get better and better.”
Hearing this, Sima Tianci’s face turned dark.
But he chose to directly ignore it.
He turned around and walked back into the yard, stretched lazily, and then lay back down on the rocking chair.
Closing his eyes, he entered a state of dozing off.
As if he hadn’t heard anything at all.
Seeing this, Yang Fan only felt speechless.
According to Yang Fan’s past personality,
facing a Genius of the Family like Sima Tianci, he would always maintain politeness and distance.
After all, the other party’s status was right there.
Even though he was now a member of the Gu Family as well, there was likewise no need to offend such a figure.
However, in the past, distance created beauty.
When both sides met occasionally, they could naturally maintain politeness.
But the problem was... Sima Tianci had been living at his place for too long.
Occupying his yard every day to sunbathe.
After a long time, Yang Fan naturally had no way to continue maintaining his initial politeness.
Nowadays, the relationship between the two of them was more like the interaction pattern between bad friends.
On ordinary days, Yang Fan would always tease him a few times.
The purpose was very simple.
It was simply hoping that this fellow could regain his self-awareness early.
And return his villa yard back to him.
Yang Fan brought Luo Hai and Luo Bing into the villa.
Just like last time, he still let his father-in-law stay at the villa for a night.
As for the reason...
Naturally it wasn’t to catch up on old times, but to thoroughly discuss the great harmony of life with Luo Bing.
Having stayed on The Frontline for a long time, even Yang Fan himself felt that he had become a bit too decadent nowadays.
Acquiring Human Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores had long formed a complete assembly line for him.
The refinement and transportation of the corpse pill were all entrusted to Yang Da.
Those Subordinate Gods who signed agreements later were monitored by Ling Xuzi throughout the entire process.
Once the Divine Kingdom War ended, the Divine Kingdom Core would naturally be sent to his hands in a steady stream.
As for the wars at the god level...
Yang Fan had not yet deduced the coordinates of the Alien Gods, so naturally there was no way to start.
Having a rare period of leisure time, he was quite happy to relax for a few days.
This night,
the entire villa appeared exceptionally lively.
Early the next morning, Yang Fan pushed open the door feeling refreshed and stretched a big lazy stretch.
He habitually looked towards the yard, only to find that the familiar rocking chair was already empty.
Sima Tianci had left at some unknown time.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan suddenly couldn’t help laughing out loud.
“Husband, what are you laughing at?”
Luo Bing’s gentle voice came from behind, except her voice was obviously tinged with a bit of hoarseness.
Yang Fan turned back to look at her, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly.
“It’s nothing.”
“You have made a huge contribution.”
“Ah?” Luo Bing wore a blank look, completely unaware of what had happened.
Yang Fan, however, did not explain.
He turned around and came to the living room, taking out the Resources he had long prepared.
Then he said indifferently towards another room, “Father-in-law, you can come out now.”
The door slowly opened.
Luo Hai, who had been hiding inside all along, hurriedly walked out with a face full of smiles, standing respectfully before Yang Fan, “Chairman Yang.”
Yang Fan nodded and handed over the prepared Resource card.
“The Resources transported this time, besides the Earth Heart Milk, also include some special medicines.”
“They are all sealed inside the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box.”
“After sending them into the Divine Kingdom, remember not to open the Seal.”
“Just transport them directly back to the Yang Corporation warehouse.”
“I have my own uses for them.”
Hearing this, Luo Hai’s expression instantly became serious, “Yes, Chairman Yang.”
After sending the two of them off,
Yang Fan’s new month of life also returned to the right track once again.
In the Real World, about twenty more days had passed.
Those Subordinate Gods who had previously signed contracts with Yang Fan successively concluded the Divine Kingdom War.

When the believers within the Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom were completely wiped out, Yang Da received the news and arranged for the Otherworldly Collector to enter the other party’s Divine Kingdom at the first instance, beginning comprehensive land reclamation and gathering all kinds of Resources.
Inside the Divine Kingdom,
Ling Xuzi knelt respectfully before Yang Fan.
“Master.”
“That Human Demigod who possesses the C-grade talent ‘Meat Mountain’ is almost unable to hold on anymore.”

chapters.title: Chapter 350: A Single Wrong Step
paragraphs: “He is a bit unlucky; the Alien Demigod chosen for him by the The Frontline Intelligent Life has hidden its true strength.”
“Within the opponent’s divine kingdom, they actually possess an A-grade war building.”
“Based on the current situation, I am afraid it will not be long before his Divine Kingdom Core falls.”
“Transmit the footage.” Yang Fan’s expression was calm, without the slightest fluctuation.
“Yes.”
Ling Xuzi nodded immediately.
He then took out the war projection equipment specifically manufactured by Yang Da.
A clear war scene then slowly appeared in mid-air.
These war images came from miniature war monitors specifically developed by the Mechanical Civilization.
Before the start of every Divine Kingdom War, the believers that Ling Xuzi arranged to infiltrate would carry these miniature monitoring devices into the battlefield.
They could record the entire process of the war in real-time and synchronously transmit the footage back to Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Soon, the image in the projection gradually became clear.
One could see outside the Divine Kingdom Core area.
A massive ball of flesh, standing a thousand feet tall, was slowly rolling and crushing its way toward the depths of the divine kingdom.
With every step it rolled, the earth would tremble violently.
The massive flesh constantly squirmed, emitting a nauseating, fishy stench.
And atop that mountain of flesh, it was densely packed with burly cannibal warriors.
They brandished huge iron clubs, constantly emitting harsh “gaga” shrieks, their expressions frenzied and ferocious.
On the other side, the Human Race believers had already set up layers of defensive formations.
Countless fireballs bombarded that massive mountain of flesh like a rainstorm.
However, after all the attacks landed on the surface of the flesh ball, it was as if they had vanished into the sea.
The layer of constantly squirming flesh merely rose and fell slightly, actually swallowing and absorbing all the attacks without causing the slightest ripple.
The entire battlefield instantly fell into a stifling silence.
Just then, Yang Da stepped forward and respectfully reported, “Master.”
“As of now, this person has sent you requests for help two hundred and forty-two times.”
“I have rejected all of them on your behalf, in accordance with the terms of the contract.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, his expression unchanged.
“That is good.”
“A contract is a contract.”
“If they fail, they can only blame their own lack of strength.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s eyes gradually became serious.
“Notify the robot legion to get ready.”
“Once this person’s Divine Kingdom Core falls, immediately lead the robot army into his divine kingdom.”
“Bring the Divine Kingdom Core back from the hands of the Alien Demigod.”
“After all, he is my Subordinate God, and he has already established a connection with my divine kingdom.”
“I must eliminate any potential risks that could lead to the exposure of my divine kingdom’s coordinates and have them deduced by other gods.”
Safety is never a trivial matter.
For Yang Fan, there was no room for negotiation on this matter.
“Rest assured, Master.”
Yang Da said with a calm expression, “With the birth of the fourth-tier Intelligent Life, the Mechanical Civilization has now completed the update of the new generation of Smart Weapon.”
“In addition, a batch of large-scale war weapons still in the testing phase has also been completed.”
“These weapons are extremely simple to operate.”
“Even ordinary robots purchased from the Divine Shop can easily operate them.”
“Just in time to take this opportunity to let Master see their actual combat effectiveness with your own eyes.”
Hearing this, a look of anticipation also appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
In the magnificent hall, Yang Fan sat high upon his divine throne, watching everything in the projection with a calm gaze.
Meanwhile, within this Human Demigod’s divine kingdom.
“Quick!”
“Third Legion, move up!”
“You must not let it get close to the Divine Kingdom Core!”
The Human Demigod stood on the city wall, issuing orders continuously with an anxious face.
But as the war situation continued to deteriorate, the cold sweat on his forehead increased.
Looking at the thousand-foot mountain of flesh approaching in the distance, he clenched his fists tightly.
“An A-grade war building...”
“Why would an ordinary Alien Demigod possess an A-grade war building!”
His voice was filled with unwillingness.
“Why!”
“Why did I have to be the one to encounter it!”
“How exactly did those Intelligent Life at the The Frontline conduct their research!”
An A-grade war building had completely exceeded the limit of what he could handle.
Watching his believers charge repeatedly and fall repeatedly.
While that massive mountain of flesh continued to slowly advance toward the Divine Kingdom Core.
Despair gradually appeared in his eyes.
“I cannot die...”
“I worked so hard to become a Human Demigod.”
“I worked so hard to let my parents leave that remote county and settle down in the city.”
“If I die...”
“What will happen to them...”
Thinking of this, he suddenly raised his head and shouted, “Number One!”
“How is the loan situation!”
The next moment, a projection of an Intelligent Life appeared beside him.
A cold, Mechanical voice sounded.
“Master.”
“Because you are currently engaged in a The Frontline proxy war.”
“Relevant information has been synchronized to major financial platforms.”
“After a comprehensive evaluation, you have been listed as a high-risk user.”
“The Intelligent Life of all financial companies have refused to provide you with new credit limits.”
Hearing this, his body swayed slightly.
After a moment of silence, he hurriedly asked, “What about my hometown?”
The Intelligent Life immediately responded, “Your father has already mortgaged all the Family’s properties.”
“Due to his advanced age and the limited value of the divine kingdom, he cannot continue to receive new loan support.”
His face became increasingly pale.
After several seconds of silence, he asked again with a final glimmer of hope, “What about the God?”
The Intelligent Life calmly replied, “I have just initiated the two hundred and forty-third request for help on your behalf.”
“The opponent’s Intelligent Life has rejected this request again in accordance with the terms of the contract.”
At this moment, the last glimmer of hope was completely extinguished.
The Human Demigod sat down on the ground powerlessly.
The light in his eyes faded away bit by bit.
He was just an ordinary person.
Born in a remote county on a remote planet.
When he was young, relying on his daring and adventurous character, he mortgaged all his divine kingdom assets and carried out several high-risk investments in succession.
Fortunately, he won the gamble.
Relying on those few successes, he earned wealth that ordinary people could not imagine in several lifetimes.
Eventually, relying on his immense wealth, he made a Breakthrough to Human Demigod and became a big shot admired by everyone in his hometown.
He brought his parents and brothers all to the city.
Bought a house and settled down.
Everyone said he had rewritten the fate of his entire Family.
But the human heart is never satisfied.
When he was still a Divine Being, his dream was to become a Human Demigod.
After truly becoming a Human Demigod, he began to crave becoming a god, possessing near-endless lifespan.
No one is willing to stop.
It’s just... fate never favors the same person forever.
Success obtained by luck makes one mistakenly believe that it is their own strength.
When the day comes that luck runs out, those who have had smooth sailing often fall harder than anyone else.
Life is not always smooth sailing.
The favor of fate will not always stand behind you.
It is a pity, however, that as far as the Divine Kingdom War is concerned.
A single wrong step is often an abyss.
